After everything we've seen, it's now crystal clear that the cargo from the crashed helicopter has been taken by the rats in the town. I don’t know how, and I don’t know why, but I want it back, understood?

Your mission is to locate their main base of operations and recover the stolen container. It's highly likely they’ve stashed it in the most fortified place around, so focus on the town’s marketplace. That place is always crawling with tangos.

Once you're there, find a way in, secure the area, and recover the container at all costs. I'm sure you’ll do a great job. Don’t let me down now.

Handshake_Quest_6B_AcceptMsg:
Based on everything you uncovered during your previous work, it looks like some of the rats in town have formed a little gang and are trying to get themselves organized. It’s also more than likely their leader is the one who struck a deal with the LAF to undermine our operations in the area. And we can’t have that, can we? You need to take him down.

Apparently, this asshole is currently holed up in the marketplace. From what we’ve gathered, he used to be some big-dick businessman before this place went to shit, so look for someone who doesn’t quite fit in with the local rabble. There should still be an observation post at the construction site overlooking the market, so you might want to start there and do some proper recon. But that’s up to you.

However you decide to approach this, just make sure he’s dead when you’re done. Okay?

Gunny_Quest_44B_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: Dammit! This could have been avoided if he hadn't lost it and just stayed put. I hate that you never know what to expect with people like that.
Main_Quest_2B_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objecti: Dammit, this is a fucking nightmare. There's nothing more you can do right now. We'll have to think this through.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Damn it. We had a whole squad guarding that area, four guys total. The rest were supposed to keep an eye on the road. We’ve got a checkpoint there. Go find out what happened to them.
Gunny_Quest_33B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Damn, just our luck. We’ve got reports of bandit activity not far from his house. Maybe they’re the ones who took the supplies. I’m marking the location on your tac device now.
Gunny_Quest_44B_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_O: Damn. I knew this wacko would make things more difficult. Try to search the whole house. Hopefully he left a note or something that'll tell us where he went.

Main_Quest_6B_Debriefing:
Excellent work. Every little detail helps us build a clearer picture of what's going on around here.

Keep this up, and we'll have these guys figured out before they know what hit them.
Handshake_Quest_3B_Debriefing:
Excellent work. I knew I could count on you to get the job done. You uncovered a significant piece of evidence.

It looks like those hicks struck some kind of deal with the local armed forces, the LAF. They’ve been a thorn in our side ever since we first arrived here, fighting not just the Lamang Liberation Army rebels who stayed behind and turned the Event into their rallying cry, but pretty much anyone who isn’t dressed in their camo.

Them helping these rats is strange and very concerning. We don’t have all the answers yet, but this discovery opens up some new avenues for investigation.
Handshake_Quest_79B_Debriefing: Excellent work. The drop went smoothly, and that’s all I needed from you. Now we wait and see if our new friend keeps his word. It might take a while, but either way, we’ll be ready.
Handshake_Quest_5B_Debriefing: Excellent! I knew you wouldn’t have any problems handling those lowlifes. They’ll think twice before crossing our path again. A little display of force goes a long way in maintaining control.
Gunny_Quest_1B_Objective_1_Description: Find and mark the weapons cache
Gunny_Quest_43B_Objective_1_Description: Find out what happened to Tyron Williams

Handshake_Quest_2B_Objective_1_Descripti: Find the isolated house in the southern part of town and neutralize the equipment within
QuestItem_BunkerFloppyDisks_Description: Floppy disks that carry valuable information.
Artisan_Quest_28B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obj: Fuck. What a sad way to die. I hope whatever he was looking for was worth it...
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objec: Fucking animals. We’ll get them for this, don’t you worry. I won’t have our people going out like that on my fucking watch.

Gunny_Quest_1B_Debriefing:
Good job out there. That cache was a potential disaster waiting to happen. Shame about the guy who had this job before you... we’ll make sure his body gets brought back.

Now it’s up to the others to finish the task. And let this be a lesson to you. No matter how “hardcore” or “tacticool” you think you are, one shot to the head is all it takes.
Gunny_Quest_33B_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: Good work. I’ll send someone to take care of it.
Main_Quest_1B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objecti: Good. That's exactly the kind of lead we were hoping for. We'll check those locations out next.
Main_Quest_1B_Debriefing: Great job! You managed to gather some valuable intel. I knew I could count on you. That's exactly the kind of performance I like to see. I've got another assignment waiting.
Handshake_Quest_79B_AcceptMsg:
Great news, man. We’ve got a unique opportunity to enlist a local who wants in on our operation. Thing is, this sneaky fucker wants payment up front as a show of trust, so I need you to deliver a case with the agreed-upon amount to a designated drop-off point. A tractor in the middle of nowhere. Don’t worry, I’ll mark it on your tac device.

You can pick up the case in the command tent at our Base Camp. Once you reach the location, leave it under the tractor and get lost. I guarantee that rat will be watching the place and won’t make a move until you disappear. After that, we wait for him to contact us.

I know what you’re thinking. How the fuck can we trust this guy? Short answer: we can’t. But we don’t have much of a choice, do we? And don’t worry. If he doesn’t come through, I’ve got a contingency prepared.

I always do.
Handshake_Quest_1B_Debriefing: Great work. You did a commendable job out there. The information you gathered is invaluable. We now have a clearer picture of the local criminals’ hideouts and activities. We’ll be analyzing the data and devising a strategic plan to dismantle their operations.
Gunny_Quest_45B_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDi: Heading out on foot, are you? I hope you weren’t just planning on sightseeing. Take a look at the map on your tactical device. I’ve got something that needs doing.
Main_Quest_5B_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDial: Hello. I’m terribly sorry to bother you, but I wouldn’t if there were any other way. Could you please help me with something urgent?
Main_Quest_1B_AcceptMsg:
Hey there, man! Welcome to Lamang! Truly a paradise on earth, eh? Name’s Lewis Pell, but we can ditch the formalities, right? Just call me Handshake. I prefer it anyway.

You might have heard that we recently had a little… setback regarding our operations here. Well, I can assure you it’s been vastly exaggerated! Everyone’s doing their best, and we’re basically back on track with only a minor delay. I guess it will be even better since you’re here now, right?

To start off, we need to learn more about the assholes currectly ocuppying the nearby town. We've identified one of their observation posts on the outskirts, quite close to the LZ, so I want you to head out there and see what you can find. Don't worry, I'll mark it on your tactical device so you can't miss it.

One other thing. We can safely assume that anyone in that town is hostile, so don't hesitate to use deadly force if needed, got it?

Once you’re done, report back to me pronto, okay? Good luck, champ!
Main_Quest_6B_AcceptMsg:
Hey, I have some more work for you. Hope you weren't planning to settle in just yet.

Based on what you uncovered, I want you to take a look at two spots on the outskirts of town. A roadblock on a bridge and a gas station. Look for anything out of the ordinary, any signs of trouble, or even potential opportunities. We need all the info we can get.

The areas are marked on your map. I'm sure it'll be a walk in the park for somebody of your talents.
Main_Quest_5B_AcceptMsg:
Hey, so I don’t really know how to say this, so I’ll just be blunt. I need your help with something, and I beg you to keep it a secret. I hope I can trust you.

You see, the container you've been tasked to retrieve holds something of immense significance, something that could reshape our understanding of this entire situation. I know that Mr. Pell wants the container for immediate assessment, but I implore you to bring it to me first. I can't reveal the specifics just yet, but trust me when I say that it's vital for me to conduct thorough research on its contents before any further actions are taken.

He may not see the value in this approach, but I assure you that it is in the best interest of our mission. Don’t worry, once my research is complete and I have gained a comprehensive understanding of the container's contents, I will present my findings to Mr. Pell. It will be up to him to decide how to proceed from there.

I know it’s a lot to ask, but will you please help me?
LabRat_Quest_34B_AcceptMsg:
Hi, you must be new here. My name is Jie, but you can call me Lab Rat. Everybody else here already does, but I don't mind. Actually, I think it's rather cute. Makes me feel like a real soldier, having a proper callsign like that. A-ten-hut, or whatever you guys say, right?

Anyway, since you're here, I have a job for you. We're facing a critical shortage of medical supplies after the recent attack. Our people are in desperate need, and it's up to us to find a solution. I've been thoroughly reading all the scouts' reports, and they recently spotted something that might help us. An abandoned ambulance near the town's gas station.

I know I shouldn't get my hopes up. Chances are it was already picked clean, but even a small amount left behind would be incredibly helpful to our efforts here. Could you please take a look and let me know? If you find anything useful, I’ll make sure it gets properly recovered and put to use.

Just keep in mind that areas outside our base might be hazardous, so please be careful. There's no room for mistakes when it comes to securing the well-being of our team, and I need you on your feet, not lying on a stretcher with a bullet hole in your gut.

Thank you, and good luck out there! Dismissed! Am I saying that right?
Gunny_Quest_43B_Debriefing:
I always knew that kid was too careless for his own good, but I never expected him to be this stupid. We were in the Marines together, you know. His mom asked me to take him under my wing, teach him some discipline, and now this… fuck.

I’ll keep searching. He has to be somewhere.

But first, I’ve got a call to make.
Artisan_Quest_28B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obj: I found a body. It looks like it’s our guy. Seems he went back to his office to retrieve something hidden on top of some shelves, but the chair he was standing on toppled over, and he hit his head on the corner of his desk.
Gunny_Quest_4B_Objective_2_PLAYER_Object: I found a diary in the local doctor's office, quote: "A young woman from a foreign PMC contacted me and offered some much-needed help. Without her, I don't know how I could continue treating the remaining locals. She brought everything I needed - bandages, antibiotics, clean syringes..."
Gunny_Quest_44B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I found a note. It says: "They found me. I was right all along! Must go underground. Meet me at the hideout."
Main_Quest_1B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objecti: I found a shift roster. Looks like there are at least two more spots that are being guarded on a permanent basis.
Gunny_Quest_2B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I found the body. Tied to a chair, with clear signs of torture. He was definitely still alive when his squad left him here.
Gunny_Quest_44B_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objec: I found the informant. He's dead.
Gunny_Quest_33B_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objec: I found the supplies. Turns out you were right. The bandits killed him and took everything.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objec: I found the two missing contractors. They were tortured and left in the restaurant. Looks like locals from the nearby town organized the hit while you were still recovering from the last attack.
Gunny_Quest_2B_AcceptMsg:
I have another job for you. We’ve lost a lot of men during our retreat, and many are still unaccounted for. We owe it to them and their loved ones to give them a proper farewell. I need you to find one of these poor bastards so we can recover his body.

According to his squadmates, they were forced out of the town hall and had to leave him behind. Search the area carefully and report his exact location.

Remember, we’re professionals, and we honor our fallen with dignity. Even if y’all think otherwise.
LabRat_Quest_1B_Debriefing: I honestly thought this might be it, but I’m sure it’s just a temporary setback. We’ll find a way, don’t worry. I just hope the civilians got to the supplies first, and not the plunderers roaming around. Either way, thank you for your help.
LabRat_Quest_34B_Debriefing: I knew I could count on you! This will be a tremendous help to everyone. Each vial, each bandage represents a chance for healing and recovery. It's a small victory, but one that matters so much to our people.
Gunny_Quest_43B_AcceptMsg:
I need you to look for one of our boys, Tyron Williams. I sent him into the city to monitor the main street, just west of the marketplace. By now, he should’ve checked in with his routine report, but nothing’s come through.

Listen, Tyron’s young and a bit restless. He’s not stupid, but he tends to… take it easy sometimes. This isn’t the first time he’s gone radio silent, but these aren’t normal circumstances. I know his family, and I’d rather not have to deliver bad news to his mother.

You should be able to find him somewhere along the main street. He’ll likely be in an elevated position with a clear view of the area, so look for a tall building. Find out what’s going on and, if possible, bring him back safely.
Gunny_Quest_43B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I searched the place, but Tyron is nowhere to be seen. He did leave behind an impressive collection of empty beer bottles, though.
LabRat_Quest_1B_AcceptMsg:
I think you can see that our situation when it comes to medical supplies still isn’t great. I’d even go as far as to call it terrible, to be completely honest with you. We’re in desperate need of just about everything. But maybe luck has finally turned our way.

The UNLRA left behind quite a lot of supplies during their hasty evacuation, and we know for a fact there are several UNLRA-marked tents near the town’s water tower. We never paid much attention to that area before. There was no need to. But now, it’s very possible this could be the answer we’ve been looking for.

Please head out there, look around, and try to find anything that might help us. I can’t stress enough how important this is.

Good luck, and please be careful.
LabRat_Quest_34B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I'm at the ambulance. Looks like it wasn't picked clean just yet. There's definitely stuff here we can use.
Main_Quest_2B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objecti: I'm at the crash site. The pilot is KIA. The rest must have managed to get away. No visual on the cargo.
Gunny_Quest_44B_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_O: I'm at the informant's house. He's nowhere to be found.
Artisan_Quest_16B_Debriefing: I'm glad you're not dumber than you look, hireling. I was afraid you might lose the tools, and that would be bad. And I mean bad for your little camp here, because I would have left. Well, whatever. Give me the tools and get lost.
Handshake_Quest_3B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Ob: I'm in the restaurant. I found a folder marked with the Lamang Armed Forces insignia. It looks like they're collaborating with the local thugs. Quote: "We appreciate your continued dedication to this mission. Please ensure regular updates on the ongoing situation, as this will help us provide further assistance and make informed decisions as needed."
Gunny_Quest_5B_Briefing:
I've got another assignment for you: Steven Clarke. He got separated from his squad during the retreat while seeking cover in a farmhouse west of the town's gas station. The last thing they heard on the comms was him screaming in terror and then suddenly dead silence. 

I need you to investigate and mark the body like before. Be extra careful on this one. I remember the guy, and he was tough as nails. No idea what happened to him to make him scream like that, so make sure the same thing doesn't happen to you.

I'll provide you with a tracker right away.
Gunny_Quest_33B_AcceptMsg:
I've got another task for you. Our intel says a prepper lived on the outskirts of town. You know, the type who stockpiles for the end of the world. And this one didn’t mess around. He hoarded everything like his life depended on it. Lucky for us.

We need every bit we can get, so head to his place and secure the stash. The sooner we have it, the better I’ll sleep. Let’s just hope he’s willing to share.
Main_Quest_2B_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objecti: I've located the rest of the crew. Both KIA. There’s evidence of a prolonged firefight. No sign of the cargo. Whoever got them must have taken it.
QuestItem_IndustrialWaterFilter_Descript: Industrial air filter from YBL-1. Dirty.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_2_Description: Inspect the checkpoint on the road to the town
Questitem_FalseIntel_Description: Intel containing deceptive information to confuse the enemy and greatly benefit the PMC.
Handshake_Quest_3B_Briefing: Intel suggests the local armed group is receiving outside support. Infiltrate their meeting spot, an old restaurant on a street corner, and identify any evidence linking the suppliers to the group.
Main_Quest_2B_Briefing: Investigate a helicopter crash north of the gas station. Valuable cargo was present on board. Search the wreck for survivors, render aid, and call for extraction if needed. However, your primary objective is to secure a sealed metal container and extract it intact.
Main_Quest_1B_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the observation post, recover any intel, and report your findings to Handshake
Gunny_Quest_4B_Briefing: Investigate the theft of medical supplies. Search the Nam Thaven doctor’s office for signs of illicit sales and report your findings. If the office is locked, thoroughly search the entire building and try to find the key.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_1_Description: Investigate why the squad guarding the road to the city isn't responding
QuestItem_SuspitiousBox_Description: Is it full of drugs? It's probably full of drugs, isn't it? Of course it's full of drugs...
Handshake_Quest_2B_AcceptMsg:
It appears that the local criminal elements we've been dealing with have acquired some advanced communication interception capabilities and are now able to monitor and decrypt our comms in real-time. This poses a significant threat to our operations and needs to be addressed immediately. 

Your mission is to locate and destroy the enemy's comms equipment. It's apparent that they have established a hidden communication hub within the vicinity of our base, and the most likely place is an isolated house in the southern part of town. Your task is to infiltrate this area, identify the equipment, and neutralize it. By doing so, we'll disrupt their ability to intercept our communications and regain control of the situation. 

Silence and stealth are paramount. We can't afford to alert those rats to our plans. Keep a low profile, gather intelligence, and strike with precision.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objec: I’m at the checkpoint. They were attacked too. Looks like a well-coordinated raid. Another contractor was killed, but the other two were likely taken elsewhere.
Gunny_Quest_33B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I’m at the prepper’s house. He’s dead. I don’t see any supplies lying around.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I’m at the villa. I found one dead contractor. He was shot through the window.
LabRat_Quest_1B_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I’m in the UNLRA compound. Looks like someone beat us to it. All the boxes are empty.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objec: I’ve located the COP. Assessing the situation.
Gunny_Quest_5B_Debriefing: Jesus Christ, what the hell happened to him? We’ll send a team to recover his body ASAP and bring it to the girl for examination. I hope she’ll manage to tell us just what is going on here…
QuestItem_ExpansionPlans_Description: LLA plans that describe further expansion of their influence after sucessfully capturing YBL-1.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Debriefing:
Lamang is no joke. I’ll take care of the fallen and notify their families. What matters now is that we’ve confirmed these aren’t the same guys who gave us so much trouble before you arrived. Trust me, you would have noticed the difference.

That said, don’t get comfortable. This isn’t some uncoordinated rabble either. Whoever hit us this time knew what they were doing, and they were organized enough to make it hurt. We can’t afford to underestimate anyone.
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objec: Listen, I need you to check one last thing. We’ve got a Combat Outpost nearby, and I want a status report. Make sure everything’s in order and the guys there are doing their job, not slacking off. As you can clearly see, on this rock, carelessness will get you killed.
Gunny_Quest_44B_AcceptMsg:
Listen, we managed to "recruit" a local to feed us intel on the nearby town. He was pretty reliable, even if a bit of a nut. The constant fear of being watched by the state took its toll on him, and he became chronically paranoid.

Problem is, he hasn’t contacted us in a while, so I need you to check on him. His house is on the southern outskirts of town, but don’t just waltz in there like you own the place. A crazy bastard like him probably rigged the whole building with alarms, so be careful not to trigger anything that’ll make the entire town swarm on you like flies on a pile of shit. Got it?
Handshake_Quest_7B_Briefing:
Listen, we've got ourselves a delicate situation on our hands, and I'm counting on your discretion to handle it smoothly. You know how it goes - sometimes we face losses in the field. It's a tough reality, but we need to make sure we handle it the right way to protect our reputation and keep things running smoothly.

Now, I know what Sergeant Jackson tasked you to do, and while I agree with him, we need to take a step back and consider our entire situation here. If we release info about every casualty, this could quickly become a PR nightmare, and we can kiss our bonuses goodbye, got it? So, instead of marking the body for retrieval, you're just going to confirm it's really our guy, and that's it, okay?

We don't want this information to get out to the public or even spread in our ranks. It's all about maintaining our image and keeping morale up. I'm sure you understand, right?
LabRat_Quest_1B_Briefing: Locate UNLRA-marked supply tents near the town’s water tower and assess any remaining medical supplies.
Gunny_Quest_2B_Briefing: Locate a fallen contractor left behind inside the town hall. Search the area carefully and report the body's exact location.
Gunny_Quest_33B_Briefing: Locate a prepper's stockpile of supplies on the outskirts Nam Thaven and report back once the cache is secured.
LabRat_Quest_34B_Briefing: Locate an abandoned ambulance near the gas station and identify any remaining medical supplies.
Handshake_Quest_6B_Briefing: Locate and eliminate the gang leader suspected of colluding with the LAF. He is known to dress like a businessman and operates in and around the marketplace.
Handshake_Quest_1B_Briefing: Locate and identify two criminal hideouts in the western part of Nam Thaven. Search both locations for intelligence and deposit any useful items in the collection box at Base Camp.
Gunny_Quest_4B_Objective_2_Description: Locate any evidence that could pinpoint the culprit and report back to Gunny
Artisan_Quest_28B_Briefing: Locate missing construction shop clerk Kanoa Sinarath, last seen during the evacuation. Search his workplace, follow any potential leads, and report your findings.
Main_Quest_2B_Objective_1_Description: Locate the crashed helicopter north of the gas station and report your findings
Handshake_Quest_3B_Objective_1_Descripti: Locate the intel and report back
Gunny_Quest_33B_Objective_1_Description: Locate the supplies at the prepper's house
Handshake_Quest_5B_AcceptMsg:
Looks like we've got a bit of a situation on our hands. It's time to put that local criminal trash in their place. They think they can tango with us? Well, we're about to show them exactly what happens when they step out of line.

I want you to bring the heat and eliminate them with surgical precision. We're going to teach these bastards a lesson they won't soon forget.

Once you're finished mopping the floor with them, report back to me for debrief.
Gunny_Quest_5B_Objective_1_Description: Mark the location of the body
Artisan_Quest_27B_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I got a job for you.

Contrary to what you might believe, some of the people left here are just trying to survive, and you’re going to help them with that. There’s a hidden military truck near the road west of the gas station. Don’t fucking ask me how I know, okay? It was loaded with essentials: food, clean water, and medical gear. With any luck, some of the cargo is still there.

I need you to pick it up and deliver it to the house marked on your map. You think you can manage that? If not, don’t worry too much. I’ll just find some other asshole to do it instead.
Artisan_Quest_28B_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I have another errand for you.

A lot of people went missing during the UNLRA’s so-called evacuation. It’s probably a hard concept for you to grasp, but their families are desperate for answers, and I won’t just stand idly by doing fucking nothing. And you are going to help me.

We’ll start with Kanoa Sinarath. He’s a clerk at the local construction shop and was last seen during the final stages of the evacuation. Go there now and see what you can find.

Who knows? Maybe you’ll manage to do some good for a change. And then a monkey will crawl out of my ass and start dancing the cha-cha.

Both are equally possible.
Artisan_Quest_16B_AcceptMsg:
Merc, if you could stop defiling my country for just a fucking second, I have some work for you.

I need you to go to a warehouse on the edge of town and fetch a set of tools I left there. I was in a hurry, you see. After you stirred up the hornet’s nest and everyone went crazy, guns blazing, it wasn’t exactly the safest place to hang around.

And if you’re wondering why I need those tools when I could just get new ones here at the base, my answer is simple. What the fuck do you care? Shut up, do your job, and you’ll get what you deserve.
Handshake_Quest_6B_Objective_1_Descripti: Neutralize the criminal leader in Nam Thaven
Handshake_Quest_5B_Objective_1_Descripti: Neutralize the enemies in Nam Thaven
Gunny_Quest_45B_AcceptMsg:
No time for chit-chat. I’ve got a job for you.

I need you to check on one of our patrols on the road to town. They stopped answering our calls, and we can’t have that shit right now. After the last attack, we need constant situational awareness, so nobody gets the jump on us again.

Start at the villa across the road from Base Camp. One of them was posted there to secure the site. My guess is those idiots are just loafing around again, so if you catch anyone dodging their duties, feel free to give them a swift ass-kicking on my behalf.
Main_Quest_5B_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fail: Oh, I see. I thought... never mind. I'm sure you did what you thought was best...
LabRat_Quest_1B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Oh, that’s really unfortunate. Those medical supplies would’ve helped us a lot. Well… at least nothing bad happened to you, right?
Main_Quest_2B_AcceptMsg:
Okay, listen up, we got an urgent matter at hand. One of our choppers went down nearby, and we need eyes on it fast. I'll be straight with you, there's valuable cargo on board - a metal container - and securing it is a priority. 

According to our intel, the helo went down north of the gas station. Your job is to assess the crash site and determine if there are any survivors. Check the wreckage thoroughly and report back with details. If you find any injured personnel, aid them and call for immediate extraction. But remember, your primary objective is to retrieve that container! 

It goes without saying, but discretion is crucial. We don't want any unnecessary attention on this one. Oh, and one more thing. Whatever you do, do not open it. Just bring it back here, and we’ll take care of the rest, got it?
QuestItem_UNLRA2_Description: Orders given to LAF about their cooperation with the UNLRA.
Artisan_Quest_27B_Subobjective_3a_Descri: Pick up the food supplies next to the truck
Artisan_Quest_27B_Subobjective_2a_Descri: Pick up the medical supplies next to the truck
Handshake_Quest_79B_Objective_1_Descript: Place the briefcase underneath a tractor
Artisan_Quest_27B_Objective_3_Descriptio: Place the food supplies in a box by the front door of a house nearby Nam Thaven
Artisan_Quest_27B_Objective_2_Descriptio: Place the medical supplies in a box by the front door of a house nearby Nam Thaven
QuestItem_BunkerAttackPlans_Description: Plans describing an attack of the Lamang Liberation Army on YBL-1.
Gunny_Quest_44B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Poor paranoid bastard. Honestly, I've met more of this sort than I'd like to count. If I remember right, his "underground" hideout is just a nearby house across the field. I'll mark it on your tac device.
Main_Quest_1B_Briefing: Recon an enemy observation post on the outskirts of nam Thaven and gather intelligence on the hostile forces occupying the area.
Artisan_Quest_27B_Briefing: Recover a supply box from a hidden military truck outside the town and deliver it to a local family.
Gunny_Quest_1B_Subobjective_1a_Descripti: Retrieve the GPS tracker from the unresponsive contractor
Main_Quest_4B_Objective_1_Description: Retrieve the cargo from the marketplace
Main_Quest_5B_Briefing: Retrieve the container from the fortified marketplace in Nam Thaven and deliver it discreetly to Lab Rat for private analysis before it is sent to Handshake. The contents are said to be of major significance. Keep the transfer secret.
Handshake_Quest_1B_Objective_1_Descripti: Retrieve the intel and store it inside a box at the Base Camp command tent
Handshake_Quest_1B_Objective_2_Descripti: Retrieve the intel and store it inside a box at the Base Camp command tent
Artisan_Quest_16B_Objective_1_Descriptio: Retrieve the tools and report back to Artisan
Artisan_Quest_16B_Briefing: Retrieve the tools stored in a warehouse on the edge of Nam Thaven and deliver them to Artisan.
QuestItem_DrugSamples_Epic_Handshake_08_: Sample collected from the hidden drug lab at Lakevale Sanctuary.
IS_QuestItem_BioSamples_Epic_Labrat_08_D: Samples gathered from deceased patients "treated" by Dr. Khae.
Handshake_Quest_1B_Objective_3_Descripti: Scout the marked area for a suitable Landing Zone
Gunny_Quest_4B_Objective_1_Description: Search for the missing supplies in the nearby town
LabRat_Quest_34B_Objective_1_Description: Search the ambulance for medical supplies
Gunny_Quest_44B_Objective_1_Description: Search the informant's house and find out what happened to him
Gunny_Quest_43B_Briefing: Search the main street west of the marketplace for Tyron Williams. Investigate his last known position and report any findings.
Gunny_Quest_2B_Objective_1_Description: Search the town hall and find the missing contractor
Gunny_Quest_44B_Debriefing: See how this island wears people down? Shit, the sooner we finish our mission, the better. And now we have to find someone else to keep us informed about the town’s affairs. Hopefully, they won’t be a lunatic like this one.
Main_Quest_2B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objecti: Shit... Okay, they likely didn’t get far. Check any nearby buildings they might have used for shelter. Let's just hope they're still there and that container with them.
Handshake_Quest_1B_AcceptMsg:
So, here’s the deal. Looks like some of those rats in town didn’t get the memo and are still scurrying around, causing trouble. It’s time to put a stop to their operations. Your mission is to gather intelligence from the hideouts these punks are using. We’ve identified two possible locations in the western part of town. Keep your eyes peeled for any suspicious signs or markings that might help you uncover them.

Once you’ve identified the hideouts, search them thoroughly and bring back anything useful to our Base Camp. I’ve got a box set up on the ground in the command tent next to the helipads. You can stash whatever you find there before I get a chance to look it over.
Gunny_Quest_1B_AcceptMsg:
So, you're one of the new recruits, huh? Answering the call for action and adventure, or just in it for the paycheck? Makes no damn difference to me. Just do your job well, don’t get killed, and you and I won’t have any problems, got it? The name’s Jackson. Anton Jackson. But everyone here just calls me Gunny. Now that we have the pleasantries out of the way, I have a job for you. 

Some people here don’t want to admit it, but we took a beating, plain and simple. Whoever was behind the attack was no ordinary local force. They were trained, well-equipped, and put some serious hurt on us. We had to abandon our positions, leaving behind a lot of gear. Now it's your turn to help us clean up this mess.

We’ve got a weapons cache unaccounted for out there, and your job is to find it and mark its exact location. The poor bastard who had this job before you stopped responding hours ago. His GPS tracker is still transmitting, but it hasn’t moved in a while… so you’ll need to check on him and finish his mission if necessary.

As for the cache itself, I'll mark its last known position on your tactical device, but we need to make sure it’s still there. We can’t let those weapons fall into the wrong hands, so once you’re done, we’ll dispatch a team to recover or destroy them if needed. You got all that? Good. Now go make yourself useful!
QuestItem_ElisaTestingKit_Description: Specialized tools for analyzing bodily fluids.
QuestItem_ClientPhone_Description: Still contains a written but unsent message.
Artisan_Quest_27B_Debriefing: Surprise, surprise. You might not be as dumb as you look after all. What a joy. Now take your reward and fuck off.
Main_Quest_4B_Debriefing:
Thank fuck! I was a bit worried there for a while, but now everything is back on track, thanks to you. I see that the seal on the container is still intact and has not been tampered with, so we should be golden. Great fucking job, man. You sure deserve that bonus! 

Now that we’ve taken care of this little problem, we can focus again on reclaiming our territory and figuring out what exactly we are dealing with here. Take some rest, and I’ll contact you soon with your next assignment. You know what? I think this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship…
Main_Quest_5B_Debriefing: Thank you! Thank you so much! I understand the trust you’ve placed in me, and I assure you it will not be in vain. The contents of this container hold incredible potential, and I believe it may be the key to truly understanding what’s happening here. I know you must be curious about what’s inside, but I must keep it a secret for now, sorry. Rest assured that once I know more, I’ll share my findings with you. I’m sure that together, we’ll get to the bottom of all of this!
Gunny_Quest_43B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: That damn idiot. So either he bailed on us, or those bastards got him while he was wasted out of his goddamn mind. I can’t believe this shit.
Gunny_Quest_4B_Debriefing:
That stupid girl… I knew she was trouble from the moment I first met her. Look, I won't lie to you. I'm not happy about this. Those things are meant for our soldiers, for our mission. But I'm also not blind to the bigger picture. Some of these people who got left here are in dire need too. We can't just turn our backs on them.

I'll sweep this incident under the rug, but this is the last time, got it? The last thing we need is the higher-ups breathing down our necks. We're in enough shit as is.
LabRat_Quest_34B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: That's great news! I'll send a recovery team straight away. Thank you so much!
QuestItem_BoxFullOfPassports_Descripiton: The box contains passports and other personal documents collected by the gang over the course of their operation.
Main_Quest_4B_Briefing: The cargo from the crashed helicopter was likely taken by the armed group occupying Nam Thaven and stashed in their main base, the fortified marketplace in the town centre. Locate an entry point, secure the area, and recover the stolen container. Expect heavy hostile presence.
QuestItem_UNLRA3_Description: The date of the Event is mentioned in the folder's contents. It does not match with the filing time of this folder.
QuestItem_SoldierDiary_Description: The diary details the first days of the soldier's life at Fort Narith. The last entry mentions Ground Zero.
QuestItem_ArtisanPlea_Description: The drive contains a recording of Artisan's appeal to stop hostilities with the PMC.
QuestItem_AirportFlashDrive_Description: The flash drive contains orders for a foreign gang sent to Lamang to secure some kind of compromising materials.
QuestItem_CameraKanoa_Description: The last viewed photo on this camera is of Kanoa and his family.
Gunny_Quest_33B_Debriefing: The supplies that prepper stockpiled will be a big help in this mess. Too bad an innocent man had to die for it. The rats around here don’t back down from anything, but that’s just the grim reality of this country right now. Although, not that it was so much better before...
QuestItem_ListofNames2_Description: These orders specify how to approach the UNLRA activities regarding the transfers of individuals from the Tiger Bay refugee camp back into the hands of the LAF.
QuestItem_DirtyIntel1_Description: This VHS carries the title "A second to Midnight". You should probably not think too much of the implications.
QuestItem_Codebook_Description: This book contains decryption keys used by the LAF.
QuestItem_UNSupplies_Description: This box contains various medical supplies used to support both the UNLRA and the local populace.
QuestItem_AntiqueRevolver_Description: This case contains an exquisite work of art in the form of a deadly weapon.
QuestItem_FlightPlans_Description: This document contains all the routes taken by pilots in the months leading up to the Event.
QuestItem_ListofNames1_Description: This document contains information about certain people who are not permitted to leave the island under any circumstances.
QuestItem_FlashDrive_Description: This drive contains important information regarding the planned patrol routes of enemy forces.
QuestItem_UNLRA1_Description: This file details the day-to-day activities of UNLRA staff.
QuestItem_UNLRA4_Description: This folder contains a detailed account of the UNLRA operation, its mission and evaluation of success.
QuestItem_MilitaryJetsDeal_Description: This folder contains details of the exchange, the budget and the goods being traded. Somebody gained a lot of money from this deal, and the LAF got barely functional training jets.
QuestItem_PrisonerFolder_Description: This folder contains information about prisoner 23. He was processed here and transported to an unknown location.
QuestItem_SecurityFootage_Description: This footage identifies the current inhabitants of YBL-1 as the Lamang Liberation Army.
QuestItem_BiologicalSampleTakingKit_Desc: This kit is used to safely collect various samples.
QuestItem_GoodbyeLetter_Description: This letter contains a heartfelt goodbye and an explanation of the man's actions - he offered himself as a human target in order to provide for his family.
QuestItem_ShootingGuestsList_Description: This list contains names of guests and what services they purchased.
QuestItem_BlueLagoonNotes_Description: This note contains names of kidnapped people who were being transported to various places. Namely the Midnight Sapphire and Tiger Bay "processing."
Main_Quest_2B_Debriefing:
This turn of events is deeply concerning. It's clear that someone knew about the crash or caused it themselves and acted swiftly to eliminate any witnesses and disappear with the cargo. We can’t rule out the possibility of the other PMCs interfering with our operations, but so far, we're in the dark.

I need your unwavering commitment and utmost discretion moving forward. We're entering uncharted territory, and I'll be relying on your skills to uncover the truth and help us regain control of the situation. You'll get new orders once we learn more about this whole mess, okay?
Handshake_Quest_1B_Objective_4_Descripti: Use a helicopter to get to Base Camp
QuestItem_CigarsResort_Description: Very valuable cigars. Maybe no one will notice if you take one for a job well done?
Gunny_Quest_45B_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: We can’t afford to lose any more men. Keep looking for them. There are some buildings down the road. Hopefully, they’re still alive.
Handshake_Quest_3B_AcceptMsg:
We've got a problem. Seems our adversaries, those local rats, are way more well-equipped than they ever should have been. Now, I know what you're thinking, "How the fuck is that even possible?" Well, it's clear as day that someone gave them a helping hand. And that is a problem we need to swiftly address.

So here's the deal: we're gonna send you into one of their meeting spots, a place we suspect holds the answers we're looking for, to gather some concrete evidence, something that can expose who helped those bastards. Our scouts suggest that the best place to begin your search is an old restaurant on a street corner in the southern part of town.

Once you've found what we need, report to me immediately. We don't want any loose ends that could come back to bite us in the ass.
Gunny_Quest_4B_AcceptMsg:
We've got a problem. Some lowlife has stolen our damn medical supplies right from under our noses. It's a betrayal, plain and simple, and we need to get to the bottom of it. That's where you come in.

I want you to investigate this shit right now. You should focus on the doctor's office in the nearby town. If somebody's stealing the supplies and selling them to the locals, chances are they left a trail there. The place will probably be locked, so try searching for the key inside the building. I'm sure they left a spare somewhere.
Handshake_Quest_3B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Ob: Well, color me surprised; I suspected one of our PMC rivals. Interesting... the LAF does not seem to discriminate when looking for potential allies, eh?
Main_Quest_4B_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fail: What happened to the fucking cargo? Did it grow wings and fly away, or what? I like you, man, but don't play with me, okay?
Handshake_Quest_7B_Debriefing: What the fuck are you talking about!? If what you’re saying about the body is true… This is EXACTLY why we don’t mark them, see? Can you imagine the effect this would have on morale? Or if somebody here leaked this shit to the media? They would have a fucking field day with it, and our funding would go down the drain! You’re doing great work, man. Just keep it to yourself, and I assure you that you and I will come out of this on top, okay?
Gunny_Quest_2B_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: What? Those bastards told me they were sure he was dead. I guess you really can’t expect everyone to stay honorable once they go private, can you?
QuestItem_DirtyIntel3_Description: Whatever is recorded on this flash drive is certainly illegal in most of the civilized world.
Artisan_Quest_28B_Debriefing:
Why do I have a feeling that most, if not all, of these missing persons cases will end the same way? Lonely bodies left behind because of malice, incompetence, and panic.

They did not fucking deserve this.

I’ll make sure his family knows the truth. I’m sure as fuck this isn’t what they hoped for, but I guess it’s better than silence.
Handshake_Quest_2B_Debriefing: You did a great job, but what you found is troubling. There is no way the locals would gain access to equipment like that. It's possible that some of our... competitors here tried to eavesdrop, but we also can't rule out the possibility that a new player has entered the game. Stay sharp. This is far from over.
Gunny_Quest_4B_Objective_2_VENDOR_Object: You gotta be kidding me! This is the last thing we needed... Look, I'll take care of it. Just keep your mouth shut for now and let me do my job, ok?
QuestItem_ResortGold_Description: You will probably not see that amount of riches in one place for a while. Unless its fake, of course.
Gunny_Quest_2B_Debriefing: You've done the right thing. To be honest, I never liked the guy. He was too gung-ho and would always run his mouth, but that’s not the point. We may have lost him in battle, but we haven't lost our sense of duty. Thanks to your efforts, his family will find solace in knowing their loved one will be returned to them, even if he was an asshole.

ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_2_Desc: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_1_Descrip: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obj: <DEV> I found an old weapons cache. Judging by the contents, it's from World War II. There's a letter here from a Japanese soldier, mentioning that he buried something valuable in the roots of a tree behind the southernmost bunker during the war.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objec: <DEV> I'm at the radio station. The broadcaster's dead. The message is playing on a loop here, but there's no interference at all.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: <DEV> No interference at the source? Interesting… That means the distortion you're hearing isn't part of the original broadcast, and it's being introduced somewhere along the way. See if you can access the station’s server room. If there’s any backend data still intact, it could tell us where the interference is coming from.
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obj: <DEV> You found what? Friend, that is absolutely stunning! Music to my ears! Please, do not waste another moment and take a look at your map at once!
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Briefing: A mysterious signal is interfering with the broadcasts. Go to the Siang Radio Station, locate the source of the transmission, and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_04_Briefing: A squad of PMCs was dispatched to assist Lab Rat and to provide aid to civilians. Investigate the reason for their prolonged absence.
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_Briefing: A wartime letter has surfaced suggesting that something valuable may be hidden near an old bunker, which interests Turncoat. The letter mentions a tree with strong roots as a landmark. Investigate the area, search for anything concealed nearby, and report your findings.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Subobjective_2a_Descript: Access the server room and locate the backend data storage device
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Vulture_01_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_14_Briefing: Banshee wants to quietly interfere with drug production across Lamang. Disrupt the operation without drawing attention.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Turncoat_20_Debriefing: Beautifully done! Now, let’s just hope they won’t find a replacement anytime soon.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_3_Desc: Bring the avian tissue samples to Handshake
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_5_Desc: Bring the ground samples to Handshake
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_4_Desc: Bring the water samples to Handshake
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_12_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations southeast of Pha Lang, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Check your tactical map. It should be marked.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Check your tactical map. It should be marked.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_6_Desc: Clarify the identity of the new Ban Pa inhabitants
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_1_VEND: Collect drinking water and ground samples. Look for a well and areas with soil disturbances, such as holes or mounds from deeper underground. Also, if any contagion agent is present, we need to know if it can spread through avian carriers. Find some tissue samples, ideally blood, for analysis. And just so we are clear, when she says “avian carriers,” she means birds that actually fly long distances, not chickens. Oh, and if any of the folks from the "haunted" village try to get in your way, don't hesitate to put them down.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Subobjective_3a_: Collect samples from a dovecot in Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Subobjective_5a_: Collect samples from a mound of soil in Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Subobjective_4a_: Collect samples from a well in Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Damn, that sounds pretty suspicious. Go and locate the "haunted" house. Hopefully, Liebert is okay.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Turncoat_20_Objective_1_Description: Eliminate the leader of the hostile group occupying Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Debriefing:
Excellent! I’ve gone through the data, and it confirms the interference is injected between the source and the receivers. And the point of origin? Ground Zero.

That’s why we couldn't pick it up directly. The signal only degrades after bouncing off specific relays. Unless you were tuned to the exact frequency at just the right moment, you'd miss it entirely.  

Of course, it could be just an anomaly. I can't say for sure yet. But listen, this interference... it’s not just static. It’s structured. Timed. I think that someone, or something, is still broadcasting from Ground Zero...
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDi: Fascinating! Could someone still be broadcasting from there? Please, check your tactical map. We need to investigate right away!
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Subobjective_4a_Des: Find any intel describing what happened to the villagers
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Objective_1_Description: Find out what happened to Somsak Pornnarai
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_04_Objective_1_Description: Find out what happened to the PMC squad south of Pha Lang
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Briefing: Following the incident involving the murdered squad providing aid, it is crucial to verify the safety of the last civilian they assisted. Investigate what happened to the civilian and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Turncoat_20_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I’m afraid I need to call upon your services. The rabble occupying Ban Pa have proven to be more stubborn than I anticipated. They have rejected my friendly recommendations. What a pity.

It would seem they fear their leader’s wrath more than my warning that they are in for a “warm” welcome. A swift solution presents itself quite clearly - silence this individual and free his cohorts from his iron fist. He should stand out among his subordinates quite ostentatiously, so I trust you won’t have any trouble locating him.

Perhaps then the rest will come to their senses and finally understand that it’s in their best interest to listen to me.
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_AcceptMsg:
Friend, what a marvelous discovery you’ve stumbled upon! A wartime letter, no less. From a soldier long gone but not quite forgotten. Lamang never ceases to surprise, does it?

If the words in that letter are true, then something precious may still lie buried near that bunker. Something untouched for decades. Perhaps it is nothing… or perhaps a whisper from another time, just waiting to be heard.

Be so kind as to investigate the area mentioned in the letter. Look for a tree with strong roots. If anything is hidden there, I have no doubt you will find it.

Quickly, friend! History calls, and we shall answer!
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_2_VEND: Fuck. That means somebody invested time and money into setting up shop there. We need to know more, man. Search the most lavish building in the village and see if they left anything behind that explains what they are doing here. If their boss has a hooch somewhere, that'll be it.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_14_Debriefing:
Good. With any luck, they won’t realize what you’ve done until they try to get production running again. Faulty equipment, spoiled supplies, human error, an angry competitor... let them draw their own conclusions.

For now, we leave them to it. The less they understand, the more useful they remain.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_17_Debriefing: Great work, champ. You’ve contributed to a cultural exchange par excellence. I won’t forget that... and if I were you, I’d clean my gear.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_17_Briefing: Handshake's friend left a package for him in a barrel south of Pha Lang, near a confluence. Locate the package and deliver it to him.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Briefing: Hans Liebert, a wealthy German national, has gone missing in Lamang. Search his tent near Ban Pa and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Debriefing: He may have slipped away for now, but we’ll get that bastard next time! But which group is he talking about? Damn! There’s so much we don’t know. Rest assured, I won’t stop until this monster gets what he deserves!
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_AcceptMsg:
Hello, could you assist me with something?

Thank you so much for bringing the samples. I think we’re onto something here. After some thorough testing, I’m almost positive I know what’s been hiding in Ban Pa. I only need the last piece of the puzzle, and I would appreciate your help finding it.

Please return to Ban Pa and investigate anything unusual. This includes anything seemingly out of place in a fishing village, even given its supposed haunted and cult-run reputation. Pay particular attention to anything related to chemical production. If my hunch is correct, then all this time we haven't been dealing with anything supernatural or out of this world, but a classic case of human greed and stupidity.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_18_AcceptMsg:
Here's the deal. Our scouts spotted something suspicious near the road to Tiger Bay but didn’t have time to investigate. They made up excuses about a more critical task Gunny had assigned them. Anyway, based on the description, it looks like they stumbled upon a hidden communications hub - just like the one near Base Camp. And we don't need any more assholes listening in on our comms, right?

I want you to check that place out. The house is near the cliffs, southwest of a bridge and northwest of Ban Pa. You know the deal: investigate the building and sabotage any equipment that could be used against us. Now hurry up!
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_AcceptMsg:
Hey man, wanna hear some spooky shit? There’s a fishing village called Ban Pa in the eastern part of our AO, just north of the Tiger Bay shopping center and marina. The word around town is that it was taken over by some crazy cult a couple of years back, and all the locals were scared shitless to even go near it, saying that the fanatics there are worshipping some demon or whatever and that the entire village is cursed.

Now, since I’m not five anymore, I don’t believe bullshit like that, and neither should you. What I do believe is that it’s the only suitable spot on the shoreline for our future operations in and around Tiger Bay.

Head out there and scout one of the main entry points first. We have to determine if that place is guarded. And don’t get eaten by ghosts! Seriously, these fucking people…
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_17_AcceptMsg:
Hey, I need someone who doesn’t ask unnecessary questions, and you seem like the right person. I’ve made some connections - some that help the company, and some that help me. This one’s the latter.

A local "friend" left me a package in a barrel south of Pha Lang. Shouldn’t be hard to find if you know where to look. He mentioned a confluence as a clue. There might be multiple barrels, so check the riverbank carefully.

Find the package, bring it back, and don’t worry - you won’t leave empty-handed. I’m a generous guy.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_04_AcceptMsg:
Hey, could you do something for me? The project to help the civilians is going well - except for one thing. I managed to persuade a squad of your colleagues to assist me in aiding the locals. They were assigned tasks south of Pha Lang, which worked out well since I was contacted by a civilian from that area.

After delivering the goods, they were supposed to return to base, but they never showed up. The last time I spoke with them, they were heading toward some bridge.

I know it’s dangerous out there, and maybe they had to take a detour, but I’d really appreciate it if you could check on them - for my peace of mind. Would you do that for me, please?
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_12_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I found Liebert's tent. He's not here, but I did find his diary. It mentions him meeting a local from Ban Pa, and staying at a "haunted" house just north of the village.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_6_PLAY: I found a diary describing the group as Malay pirates. They planned to take over Tiger Bay but didn’t expect the LAF to be there. Capturing Ban Pa was an improvised move. However, the last entry is strange. Quote: "The assholes were scared shitless the moment they set foot in this fucking village. They babbled something about ghosts. Superstitious cunts! But the second we found out what the previous inhabitants were doing here, everyone's mood shot up."

I found a diary describing the group as Malay pirates. They planned to take over Tiger Bay but didn’t expect the LAF to be there. Capturing Ban Pa was an improvised move. However, the last entry is strange. Quote: "The idiots nearly pissed themselves when they came into this place. Whispering about ghosts and curses like children. Superstitious motherfuckers. Funny thing is, once we figured out what the villagers were really doing here, everyone's mood shot up."
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_3_PLAYER_: I found a message in a warehouse. The producers were using the building as a temporary storage site before moving the goods out of the village. Based on the information in the note, shortly after the Event they began transporting the drugs from hidden stashes to boats.
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_PLAYER_BecameAvailable: I found an old weapons cache. Judging by the contents, it's from World War II. There's a letter here from a Japanese soldier, mentioning that he buried something valuable in the roots of a tree behind the southernmost bunker during the war.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_04_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objectiv: I have located the missing squad. They're all KIA. Looks like someone knew their route and ambushed them near the bridge.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_2_VENDOR_: I knew it! All the leads pointed to C22H28N2O. It all makes sense now! They were making fentanyl! That’s why all that charade with the cult and the demons. It was all just to keep people from snooping around. They went to great lengths to keep any eyes off their operation. I have to admire their creativity; it's just too bad it all went to the service of… this. Thank you for helping me get to the bottom of this mess.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_12_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_12_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_01_AcceptMsg:
I need your assistance. Quickly.

Turns out the current residents of Ban Pa seem to be more renowned than I originally assumed. I received word from a reliable source that they are a criminal group responsible for countless offenses. He didn't go into detail, but I trust him.

Look, given what he hinted at, if any neighboring countries catch them, they’ll be looking at certain death sentences. No question. But honestly, putting that burden on already overstretched administrations isn’t exactly efficient.

Take care of them. People like that aren’t worth the ink it takes to process them.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Debriefing:
I was pretty sure you were not going to find any demons. Probably just rotting fish and some idiot’s idea of spooky decor. But pirates?

Looks like every vulture in a hundred-mile radius caught the scent of this nation’s corpse and swarmed in to carve it up. What else will we encounter here? Cowboys? The Italian mafia? Fucking UFOs? You did well, but Lamang is turning into a bigger shitshow than initially anticipated.

And thanks for the samples! I'll give them to Lab Rat, so she'll stop bothering me. Hopefully, the biological hazard results will be negative. Still, I’d take a very long shower if I were you...
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Debriefing: I'll contact Liebert's parents and break the sad news. At least the guy died doing what he loved. Chasing nonsense. But I'm still wondering if the oracle actually knew about the Event, or if it was just a lucky guess. Maybe there's more to this island than we think... but probably it's all just a bunch of bullshit.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I'm at the radio station. The broadcaster's dead. The message is playing on a loop here, but there's no interference at all.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: I've found Liebert. He's dead. It looks like the locals sacrificed him.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objectiv: I've located Pornnarai's house. He's absent but left us a note, quote: 'I hope you like my parting gift! Nothing beats dead comrades, right? I will make sure more will follow, you filthy foreign scum!"
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objectiv: I've located the house he was staying at. There’s a notebook here. Aside from his bragging about how easily he tricked us, there’s this quote: "I've shown my worth. Finally, I’ll be able to operate on a larger scale within the group. Time for a change of scenery."
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_3_VENDOR_: Interesting. It appears the Event severely disrupted their drug operation. They moved the drugs onto boats… does that mean they managed to escape the island by sea? But what about the ordinary villagers who had no idea what was really going on here?
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Objective_1_Description: Investigate Liebert's tent near the river north of Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_18_Objective_1_Description: Investigate a potential hidden communications hub northwest of Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Objective_2_Description: Investigate the secluded house north of Ban Pa and find Hans Liebert
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_4_Descrip: Investigate what happened and report back to Lab Rat
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Debriefing:
It never ceases to amaze me how inventive people become when crime is involved. Going so far as to create an entire demonic cult to conceal their operation and scare off the superstitious.

Fortunately, it appears that the leader of the drug ring, a man calling himself Sad sada, was not entirely irredeemable. According to the intel you retrieved, he abandoned part of his stockpile so he could evacuate as many of his followers as possible, claiming he wanted to save them from what he described as Phi Pa Mum’s revenge on the corrupt Lamang state.

I cannot tell whether he eventually started believing his own mythology or whether he was deliberately leaning into it. Either way, a small group of deeply religious villagers refused to leave with him. Where they ended up remains unknown.

For once, I’m relieved by the outcome. Thank you for your work.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_1_PLAY: I’m at the entry point to Ban Pa. It looks like new tenants have moved into town. They are armed and do not look friendly.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_2_PLAYER_: I’m on site in Ban Pa. I’ve located a facility that appears to be a makeshift drug lab based on the equipment and materials present.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_14_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been keeping an eye on the drug trade here. It seems some of the old production sites are still operational. Different people running them, same poison coming out.

I want you to pay one of them a visit. The location is marked on your map. Find where they’re producing the drugs and sabotage the operation. But be subtle about it. The drugs stay, the equipment stays. I don’t want anyone realizing what was actually targeted. The rest is up to you.

The longer they remain unaware of us, the more useful they’ll be.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_PLAYER_BecameAvailableDi: I’ve come across an amateur radio station picking up a strange broadcast. There’s heavy interference, but the signal appears to be coming from the Lamang Liberation Army. It seems to originate from a site called Siang Radio Station.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a job for you, and I need it done fast. Got it?

Back when we still held some ground on this rock, we stashed a few ammo caches around for quick field resupplies. Now, with the situation being what it is, we need to find out if they’re still intact, and if so, recover them.

Your task is to check a few of these locations and report back whether the caches are still there and retrievable. I’ll send someone else to pick them up, don’t worry about that. I just need the intel.

There are four caches in total. I've marked the first one on your tactical map. Take care of it, and I’ll relay the rest to you as you go.

ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_18_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I’ve located the house and identified what the scouts had so hastily described: it's not a hidden communications hub. The guy who lives here is just crazy. According to his diary, he believes all advanced technology is inherently evil and so he steals and hides everything he can.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_12_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.

ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Objective_2_Description: Locate the building in the northern outskirts of Tiger Bay where Somsak was last seen

ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Objective_1_Description: Locate the source of the broadcast at the Siang Radio Station
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_6_VEND: Malay pirates? Fucking wonderful! I’m starting to think this island is more diverse than fucking Toronto! And they found something that cheered them up? That bothers me, man. What exactly makes a crew like that relax after walking into a place everyone else ran from?
