ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_18_Debriefing: Man, this has got to be the funniest shit you’ve ever discovered! The more I learn about the locals, the more I’m convinced they all escaped from a madhouse - there’s a wacko on every corner. Even the local chick helping us is unstable. Every time I try to talk to her, she goes off on some anti-colonial crap or mumbles something about butchers and baby killers.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_01_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies around Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_2_VENDOR_: Next, try searching around the village for any clues about what might have happened to them. It’s possible that the ordinary villagers didn’t know about the drug operation and were genuinely devoted to the occult practices. If that’s the case, there has to be some intel the “initiated ones” left behind. Focus on storage sites. Warehouses, sheds, anywhere large enough to move product through.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: No interference at the source? Interesting… That means the distortion you're hearing isn't part of the original broadcast, and it's being introduced somewhere along the way. See if you can access the station’s server room. If there’s any backend data still intact, it could tell us where the interference is coming from.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_AcceptMsg:
Oh my God! After discovering the horrible fate of the squad ambushed near the bridge, I was so shocked I completely forgot to check on the civilian they were carrying supplies for! What if the murderers got him too? I’d never forgive myself.

Could you please check if he's okay? His name is Somsak Pornnarai, and he lives in a house on the road to Tiger Bay, southwest of the bridge where you found our colleagues. You should pass a lake on your way there. I just hope he's safe...
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_Debriefing:
Oh my… Friend, look at this.

The photograph, the engraving… it’s all so delicately preserved. A token of love, hidden beneath the roots of a tree, waiting silently through the years.

I wonder what became of the young soldier who hid this treasure. Did he manage to return home? Was he able to see his beloved again? So many questions, friend… and all we’re left with are faint whispers.

I will cherish this always and protect it with my life. You have my word. And if you ever uncover more mementos of Lamang’s rich and tangled history, do not hesitate to let me know.

They will make fine additions to my collection.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_04_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objectiv: Oh no, they were just trying to help... I-I can't talk right now. This is too much. I'm sorry...
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_1_VEND: One more thing. We want that place, but we need to determine if it's safe. I mean, not because of demons or some other bullshit, but because there might be something else that might bite us in the ass later. Some of the rumors can be based on truths, and we can't afford to take risks right now. Lab Rat is concerned, and you know how she gets. She wants to rule out the possibility of chemical and biological hazards.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Vulture_01_AcceptMsg:
Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

Search the place marked on your map. Bring back a… sample. I will study it… thoroughly. Then I can decide if it’s time for a… hostile… takeover.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_18_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: Quote: "They control us through the machines, I know it! I liberated as many people as possible and helped them eliminate their machines! I hope one day they will appreciate it!! The government put a chip in me!!!" And then it just rambles on and on.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_Objective_2_Description: Retrieve the backend transmission data and report back to Lab Rat
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_Objective_1_Descriptio: Retrieve the item and report back to Turncoat
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Briefing: Return to Ban Pa and investigate unusual activity that may be connected to chemical production. Search for evidence that explains what was happening in the village before the Event and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_14_Objective_1_Description: Sabotage the drug production at the marked location
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_1_Desc: Scout one of the main entry points to Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Subobjective_1a_: Scout the main northern entry point to Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Subobjective_1b_: Scout the main southern entry point to Ban Pa
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_18_Briefing: Scouts have identified a potential communications hub. Investigate the site and report your findings to Handshake.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_2_Descrip: Search Ban Pa and find anything related to chemical production
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: Second cache located. Where to next?
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: Second cache located. Where to next?
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Vulture_01_Objective_1_Description: Secure the box of samples and report back to Vulture
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_08_Briefing: Several previously established ammo caches may still be intact. Check the marked locations, confirm their status, and report to Gunny on whether the supplies are recoverable. Additional cache locations will be provided as you proceed.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_09_Briefing: Several previously established ammo caches may still be intact. Check the marked locations, confirm their status, and report to Gunny on whether the supplies are recoverable. Additional cache locations will be provided as you proceed.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_18_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Shit, what else is waiting for us on this island? I expected a lot, but a crazy neo-luddite was not on my bingo card. No need to destroy any equipment, looks like he's doing the job for us.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_AcceptMsg:
Sometimes I’m baffled by what people are capable of believing. Listen to this shit - we’re looking for a "ghost hunter" named Hans Liebert. He comes from a wealthy German family who contacted us to find him after he disappeared on this so-called paradise island.

Apparently, his interest in this country began with a visit to a famous European oracle, who told him that an immense paranormal event was about to occur in Lamang. With that knowledge, he immediately traveled here, but since he couldn’t stand idly by, he started investigating other supernatural occurrences to pass the time. That’s when he stumbled upon Ban Pa.

His parents told me that the last time they heard from him, he was very excited about a promising lead. He’d pitched a tent north of the village and described a hut near a river, claiming it had an "undeniable spectral resonance." Find the tent. With some luck, we might uncover a clue about his whereabouts.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Handshake_12_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_01_Briefing: The armed group occupying Ban Pa is reportedly tied to multiple criminal activities. Sweep around the area and eliminate them at Banshee’s request.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_2_PLAY: The current Ban Pa residents are extremely hostile. Based on what I've seen, they don’t appear to be locals.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_04_Debriefing: They were just trying to do the right thing... and someone murdered them. This is a nightmare. I keep thinking about it, and I can’t help but feel responsible for what happened...
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objectiv: This can't be true. He escaped? That treacherous asshole!
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_12_Objective_1_Description: Transfer the data from all the measuring stations southeast of Pha Lang
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_12_Subobjective_1a_Description: Transfer the data from the first station
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_12_Subobjective_1b_Description: Transfer the data from the second station
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_12_Subobjective_1c_Description: Transfer the data from the third station
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Briefing: Travel to Ban Pa to scout one of the village’s main entry points and determine whether the area is currently occupied or guarded. Report your findings to Handshake and await further instructions.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Turncoat_20_Briefing: Turncoat has a problem with the leader of the armed group occupying Ban Pa. Neutralize the target. You can find him at one of the marked locations.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Vulture_01_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Labrat_05_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objectiv: W-what does that... that... THAT MOTHERFUCKER! He tricked us and killed the people who were supposed to help him! I can't believe it! Goddamn, I'm such a fool! Now it all makes sense. I was informed he was seen with some gangsters roaming the northern outskirts of Tiger Bay, just behind the cement factory... I am so FUCKING angry! If only I could’ve put two and two together sooner... Go there and look for him! There has to be something there, some clue about where the bastard went.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_05_Objective_3_VENDOR_: We might find more clues along the shoreline. Please try investigating the pier. I really hope they did not wipe out an entire village just to remove potential witnesses.
ST_BanPaRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_05_Objective_1_VEND: Well, color me surprised! Some of the locals were actually brave enough to move into that "cursed" village. Or they're not locals at all… Fuck! That would mean somebody invested time and money into setting up shop there. We need to know more, man. Search the most lavish building in the village and see if they left anything behind that explains what they are doing here. If their boss has a hooch somewhere, that'll be it.
ST_BanPaRegion.Labrat_Quest_35_AcceptMsg:
What intrigues me more than the broadcast itself is the interference you mentioned. We're not picking up anything like it on our end, and we've scanned every frequency we can think of. I need to know more. This phenomenon could very well be tied to whatever happened there...

Head out to Siang Radio Station and try to pinpoint the exact source of the transmission. Report back to me as soon as you find anything.
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Gunny_14_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: What the hell are those people smoking!? Some village heathens carving up a German ghost hunter. That's just perfect...
ST_BanPaRegion.Turncoat_Quest_26_VENDOR_BecameAvailable: You found what? Friend, that is absolutely stunning! Music to my ears! Please, do not waste another moment and take a look at your active tasks at once!
ST_BanPaRegion.CT_Banshee_01_Debriefing: You made the right call. I’m sure more of them will soon crawl out of their holes, but for now, the coast is clear - literally. Those criminals have been evading justice for too long. Fitting, in a way, that they met their end here. In a place without law. You deserve your reward. Thank you for your assistance.

ST_FTUE_Quests.FTUE_3A_Objective_2_VENDOR_ObjectiveDial: Good aim! You’re clearly not new to using firearms, so let's put your skills to good use. I’ll walk you through accepting tasks.
ST_FTUE_Quests.FTUE_3B_Objective_2_VENDOR_ObjectiveDial: Good aim! You’re clearly not new to using firearms, so let's put your skills to good use. I’ll walk you through accepting tasks.

ST_FTUE_Quests.FTUE_0B_Objective_1_VENDOR_ObjectiveDial: Proceed outside the villa and follow your compass to the obstacle course. This evaluation assesses your physical readiness and overall fitness for operational deployment.
ST_FTUE_Quests.FTUE_0C_Objective_1_VENDOR_ObjectiveDial: Proceed outside the villa and follow your compass to the obstacle course. This evaluation assesses your physical readiness and overall fitness for operational deployment.
ST_FTUE_Quests.FTUE_3A_Objective_1_VENDOR_ObjectiveDial: Solid work on the medical training! Now, we will move on to the part everyone enjoys: live-fire drills. Head to the shooting range and pick up your ammunition. Let's see how you handle a weapon in a controlled environment.
ST_FTUE_Quests.FTUE_3B_Objective_1_VENDOR_ObjectiveDial: Solid work on the medical training! Now, we will move on to the part everyone enjoys: live-fire drills. Head to the shooting range and pick up your ammunition. Let's see how you handle a weapon in a controlled environment.

ST_FTUE_Quests.FTUE_2A_Objective_1_VENDOR_ObjectiveDial: Well done, buddy! You made it through, and that's what counts. Maybe medical training is more your forte. Proceed to the Medical Training Tent. Further evaluation will continue there. It's marked on your compass.

ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_1_Descript: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at Blue Lagoon
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_2_Desc: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at Blue Lagoon
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_18_Briefing: A local woman assisting Lab Rat needs help getting home safely. Locate her and assess the situation.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_Briefing: A young female tourist went missing several days before the Event during a hot air balloon ride. Head west from Tiger Bay to find the crash site and determine what happened. Report your findings to Gunny.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Vulture_02_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Vulture_03_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Alright, if the girl’s not there, she might’ve bailed out or wandered off after the crash. Check the surrounding area. If she was alive when they went down, someone might’ve found her. Let’s just hope it was the right kind of someone...
ST_NamThavenRegion.Handshake_Quest_80_AcceptMsg:
Alright, listen up. I’ve got something that might interest you.

We’ve been tracking some hostile movement around the Blue Lagoon and the nearby coastline. Nothing loud, but still worthy of our attention.

There’s an old boat rental operation in the area that suddenly got very popular with the wrong crowd. I want you to head over there and take a look. We don’t know yet if the guys there are in any way connected to the Blue Lagoon, but they’re definitely up to something, and I’m pretty sure it’s not organizing the next Lamang waterski championship.

Get eyes on the place, gather whatever information you can, and report back. I’m sure you’ll do great, as always.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_08_Briefing: Artisan considers the leader of the armed group occupying the Blue Lagoon an unforgivable criminal. Neutralize the target. You can find him at one of the marked locations.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_05_Briefing: Banshee needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Banshee_Quest_30_Briefing: Banshee suspects that an abandoned car repair shop north of Khonwan village may be connected to a wider criminal operation that thrived before the Event. Investigate the site, search for evidence of illicit activity, and bring back any documents that could shed light on who was really using the facility and why.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_15_Briefing: Banshee wants to quietly interfere with drug production across Lamang. Disrupt the operation without drawing attention.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_21_Briefing: Banshee wants to trace the distribution of drugs across Lamang. Find the shipment at the marked site and plant a tracking device on it.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_5_VEND: Bingo. That’s what we were looking for. The boss is going to be very interested in this.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_07_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations east of Nam Thaven, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Check your tactical map. It should be marked.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Check your tactical map. It should be marked.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Continue with your mission and infiltrate the Blue Lagoon. The girl’s parents provided me with a list of items she likely packed for her trip, and one of them was a pink tent. Search the place from top to bottom and keep an eye out for something like that.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Debriefing:
Damn, looking at the last entry in her diary does not look good. She met some “cool people” who like to party, and they were about to show her their “special place.” Goddammit! Why are kids so stupid!? I have a really bad feeling about this. Let’s just hope I’m wrong.

We'll keep searching for her, but the trail has gone cold here. If she is still alive, she was moved somewhere else.

And as for our fallen. I am not throwing more people at a goddamn tourist trap just to plant a flag. Not yet. But once we stabilize our situation here, those bastards are going to answer for what they did.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_08_Objective_1_Description: Eliminate the leader of the hostile group occupying Blue Lagoon
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_3_Desc: Explore the road leading from the Blue Lagoon and report any pertinent intel
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_5_Desc: Find and investigate a building that may have been used for a human trafficking operation in the Blue Lagoon
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_2_Descript: Find any info regarding the missing girl
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_Objective_2_Description: Find out what happened to the tourist - try inspecting nearby structures
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Turncoat_10_AcceptMsg:
Friend, would you be so kind as to assist me with an unfortunate situation I’ve found myself in?

I need you to relocate a certain highly valuable item from one location to another. Sadly, the previous individual I entrusted with this simple endeavor failed to deliver, so I am now forced to seek help elsewhere. Fortunately, I am confident that a trivial task such as this will be a walk in the park for someone of your talents.

There is a package with my name on it waiting inside a restaurant right next to that nest of sin so crudely named Fanny Paradise. Please, retrieve the package and deliver it posthaste to a shelter just south of that dreadful place.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Turncoat_13_AcceptMsg:
Friend, would you lend me your services once more?

Have you sampled all the culinary marvels Lamang has to offer? If not, there’s a quaint little restaurant perched on a hill northeast of Nam Thaven, just across the river. Phouarun, it’s called, and I’ve heard their Sai Oua is to die for. I must insist you visit it and try it for yourself.

Oh, and while you’re there, would you be so kind as to keep an eye out for a package meant for me? If it’s not too much trouble, retrieve it and deliver it swiftly to a shelter just northeast of the restaurant.

After all, nothing beats a nice walk to help with digestion after a hearty meal, don’t you agree?
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_Objective_2_VENDOR_Object: Fuck... Copy that. We'll notify the family. And you make damn sure you put down every last one of those animals who did this to her. You hear me?
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Subobjective_4a_: Fucking hell. That sounds really suspicious, eh? Seems the stories about Blue Lagoon were true. And if the state really was shielding them, then this runs deeper than just a few thugs.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_05_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_21_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_15_Debriefing:
Good. With any luck, they won’t realize what you’ve done until they try to get production running again. Faulty equipment, spoiled supplies, human error, an angry competitor... let them draw their own conclusions.

For now, we leave them to it. The less they understand, the more useful they remain.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Debriefing:
Grimdark shit, man. Grimdark shit. The boss is going to lose his mind over this.

This wasn’t just some gang running a side hustle. Everything points to a government-sanctioned operation, funneling “fresh meat” to select locations across the island. Midnight Sapphire shows up again and again in those records, which alone is enough to make people nervous.

As for the rest, we don’t have the full picture yet, but I’m confident we’ll dig it up eventually.

Damn good work, buddy.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_19_Briefing: Gunny has received a report regarding a deceased PMC spotted west of Tiger Bay. Investigate the incident and report your findings.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Handshake_Quest_80_Briefing: Handshake wants more information about hostile activity around the Blue Lagoon and nearby coastal areas. Travel to an occupied boat rental site, observe what the group is doing there, and report any findings that might explain their intentions.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_AcceptMsg:
Hey, I got something for you. A few days before the Event, a young tourist girl vanished. She came here with her parents for a family vacation; can you believe that shit? Here, of all places. Anyway, last time anyone saw her, she signed up for a balloon ride out of Tiger Bay. It was supposed to head west. Just a sightseeing tour over the island.

Her parents did everything they could to find her before the island went to hell and they were forced to evacuate. Now, they've contacted us. I need you to find the crash site and find out what happened. 

I know it's been months. Hell, they probably know damn well their little girl isn't coming back, but at least we can give them some answers.

I'd suggest consulting your map. Look for any spot west of Tiger Bay where a balloon might’ve gone down. They probably traveled a long way before crashing, so sweep the whole westward route. Then head out there and see what you can find. Anything. Even wreckage is better than nothing at this point...
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_19_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Hm, try searching for his colleagues. I doubt the guy was alone; maybe look somewhere along the river.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Handshake_14_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Handshake_Quest_80_Subobjective_1b_PLAYE: I checked one of the workshops. Several boats are being repaired, engines stripped down and rebuilt. There’s also a stockpile of supplies nearby. Fuel cans, food crates, water, tools. Looks like they’re getting ready for a long trip.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Handshake_Quest_80_Subobjective_1a_PLAYE: I found a map of Tiger Bay with handwritten notes, possible safe routes, and highlighted buildings. It doesn't look like attack plans. More like plans for scavenging.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_3_PLAY: I found the crashed car. Multiple bodies inside. Looks like they were being transported. There’s a bloodstained list with names and destinations: Tiger Bay and Midnight Sapphire.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_Objective_2_PLAYER_Object: I found the girl. She didn’t make it. Judging by the state of the place, she was taken, held captive, and abused for months. Looks like she died not too long ago.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_05_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_07_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_08_Debriefing: I knew this would be something you’d excel at, merc. I’m glad your appetite for killing was used for a good cause this time. Don’t think this makes us friends, though! In my eyes, you are still only slightly better than the man you just killed.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Handshake_14_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_AcceptMsg:
I need your help with something. 

I was contacted to find a missing girl. Her parents are afraid for her life and trying to get as much info as possible about what's going on here, but the UN officials have turned their backs on them and refused to answer any questions regarding Lamang.

The girl went to Lamang by herself and didn't return with the evacuees. I don't know what she was thinking about going to such an awful place, but foolishness is not a capital offense. I want her to return safely. 

She was staying in a motel near Blue Lagoon, but that's about all we know. Go there and do everything in your power to find her.

I sent a squad to do this job, but they stopped responding. They're solid operators, so silence means trouble. Keep your guard up.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_18_AcceptMsg:
I was contacted by a local woman who needs our help. She was searching for supplies outside of Nam Thaven when she spotted some armed bandits, and now she's too scared to head back.

Please, find her and get her home safely. I’ll mark her last know position on your tactical device.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I'm at the crash site. No sign of the tourist.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_2_PLAYER_O: I'm at the motel where the girl stayed. I found a planner and a handout indicating she went camping at the Blue Lagoon.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Subobjective_4b_: I've found a pile of photos. They feature various tourists staying here and were obviously taken without their knowledge. Looks like someone was documenting potential targets.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_3_PLAYER_O: I've located the squad - all are KIA.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Handshake_Quest_80_Subobjective_1b_VENDO: Interesting. You don’t fix boats and hoard supplies like that unless you’re planning to go somewhere and not come back anytime soon. Are those poor bastards really just trying to run?
ST_NamThavenRegion.Banshee_Quest_30_Objective_1_Description: Investigate an abandoned car repair shop and try to find any evidence of human trafficking
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Briefing: Investigate reports of suspicious activity around Blue Lagoon. Examine a crashed vehicle on the road toward Tiger Bay, gather any intel left behind, and uncover clues about what the area was being used for before the Event. Report your findings to Handshake.

ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_3_Descript: Investigate what happened to the squad
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_19_Debriefing: It's official. I've confirmed that the dead contractors were working for our competition. It seems they got too close to the jungle, and someone definitely didn’t appreciate it. We need to exercise extreme caution around those woods; you never know who might be watching and waiting for the chance to take us out.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_18_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objectiv: I’m at the location. She’s not here.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Banshee_Quest_30_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I’m at the site. They definitely weren’t just repairing cars here. I found cells and metal cages. All big enough to fit people.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_15_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been keeping an eye on the drug trade here. It seems some of the old production sites are still operational. Different people running them, same poison coming out.

I want you to pay one of them a visit. The location is marked on your map. Find where they’re producing the drugs and sabotage the operation. But be subtle about it. The drugs stay, the equipment stays. I don’t want anyone realizing what was actually targeted. The rest is up to you.

The longer they remain unaware of us, the more useful they’ll be.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Banshee_21_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Subobjective_4a_: I’ve discovered a document belonging to the gang operating here. They refer to people as "fresh meat" and claim to have the state's backing.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_19_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: I’ve found the remains of other PMC operatives in the area. Looks like they were hit by mortar fire coming from the jungle across the river. Whoever took them out wasn’t an amateur.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a job for you, and I need it done fast. Got it?

Back when we still held some ground on this rock, we stashed a few ammo caches around for quick field resupplies. Now, with the situation being what it is, we need to find out if they’re still intact, and if so, recover them.

Your task is to check a few of these locations and report back whether the caches are still there and retrievable. I’ll send someone else to pick them up, don’t worry about that. I just need the intel.

There are four caches in total. I've marked the first one on your tactical map. Take care of it, and I’ll relay the rest to you as you go.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_AcceptMsg:

ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got something our employer is very interested in. And when he gets interested in things around here, people usually start digging.

He’s been asking questions about Blue Lagoon. It was a cheap paradise for tourists who couldn’t afford the luxury of Midnight Sapphire. However, beneath the surface, something far more sinister was at play.

The place has been associated with numerous missing persons cases. Tourists have been vanishing in and around it for years, and the boss thinks now is the time to uncover the truth. Fuck me if I know why, but I’m not gonna ask. Given that the same gang seems to be operating in the area again, odds are good they didn’t just move in recently. They may have been part of whatever was going on back then.

Our scouts spotted a crashed vehicle on the road between Blue Lagoon and Tiger Bay, with bodies inside. They couldn’t stop to investigate, but it smells connected. Start there. Search the wreck, gather anything useful, and see if it leads us closer to what Blue Lagoon was really used for. If something ugly was happening there before the Event, I want it dragged into the light.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_10_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I’ve located the first cache. Everything seems to be in order.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_11_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I’ve located the first cache. Everything seems to be in order.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_5_PLAY: I’ve searched the building. There is a hidden room probably used to imprison abducted individuals before they were transported elsewhere. Judging by its condition, this has likely been going on for a while.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: Jesus, that stupid girl! She just had to go to that fucked-up place, didn’t she? At least we know where to look next… I hope we can still return her safely to her parents. A happy family reunion is something of a miracle in these places, but God knows I wouldn't wish for anything else.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_07_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: Listen, I'm sure the boys I sent out found the planner as well. As I said, they're not rookies, so they probably continued through the jungle and looked for an alternate entrance to the Blue Lagoon. Do the smart thing and don't barge through the main entrance! From the reports I read about that place, there should be an office building connected to a fence that seems like the perfect place to infiltrate the site.

ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Handshake_26_Debriefing: Man, you totally know how to handle problems. Love it. Those assholes will likely come back, but we taught them a valuable lesson: Don't fuck with us.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Turncoat_10_Debriefing: Marvelous! You truly have a gift for reliability. And discretion, of course. Please accept this token of my gratitude. Until we see each other again, friend.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Turncoat_13_Debriefing: Marvelous! You truly have a gift for reliability. And discretion, of course. Please accept this token of my gratitude. Until we see each other again, friend.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_18_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objectiv: Maybe she's just hiding somewhere nearby. Can you please look around?
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_18_Objective_1_Description: Meet the woman at the designated location
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_01_AcceptMsg:
Merc, stop picking your nose! This is urgent!

Word is, the bastards holed up in Blue Lagoon are scrambling for anything that might get them off this island. We can’t let that happen. They must pay for the crimes they committed while the government turned a blind eye.

Animals like that can’t be allowed to set up shop somewhere else and spread misery all over again.

Do what you do best. Kill as many as you can. They’ll regroup eventually, cockroaches like that always do, but this’ll slow them down and make them think twice before trying to escape again.

Now move it, merc.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_08_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, those bastards at the Blue Lagoon might be sharing this country with me, but they are not my people; you get that? They’re filth, plain and simple, preying on the weakest around here for far too long. And the worst of them all is their boss.

I want you to pay him a visit and introduce him to the consequences of his actions. His name is Malo Luangrath, and he has been a blight on the face of this country for long enough. His henchmen call him "Grin" because he's always smiling, but don't let that shit fool you. He's a sick, evil man with a massive ego and a soul as black as the ocean at night.

No questions, just kill him, understood? The world will be a better place once he's gone. Trust me...
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_19_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Mortar fire? Shit, whoever those bastards are, they’re better equipped than we'd like. Leave the area ASAP; it's too hot.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_01_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies around Blue Lagoon
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Handshake_26_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies east of Nam Thaven
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Of course. Shit. It's always the same with this place, isn't it? I'll arrange for recovery and you better be extra careful.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_18_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objectiv: Oh no... Why does this keep happening?
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_05_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Once you find the tent, explore the surrounding area and retrieve anything that might help us determine her current whereabouts.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Vulture_02_AcceptMsg:
Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

Search the place marked on your map. Bring back a… sample. I will study it… thoroughly. Then I can decide if it’s time for a… hostile… takeover.

ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_4_VEND: Shit. This all screams human trafficking from miles away. If there really was a government-sanctioned operation running out of that place, the boss is going to lose his shit. It looks like tourists were lured in, drugged, and then moved across the island to whatever waited for them next. We need to find where that part happened.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Handshake_Quest_80_Subobjective_1a_VENDO: So someone put time into charting LAF patrol patterns and figuring out where to grab what they need without getting shot. If they’re studying Tiger Bay like this, they’re either preparing something ambitious… or are planning to disappear.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Objective_3_VEND: So they were moving people to those places. The question is why. Head to Blue Lagoon and search it top to bottom. Start with any admin offices. If this was organized, there’ll be paperwork behind it. Report anything you find.

ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Turncoat_10_Objective_1_Description: Store the package in a shelter south of Fanny Paradise
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_01_Debriefing: Strange feeling, merc. For once, all that aggression of yours was pointed in the right direction. Take your reward and get back to your nose digging. I’ve got work to do, so don’t bother me.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Labrat_18_Debriefing:
Thank you. I know you did your best. It's not your fault.

I have to stop getting my hopes up. This place doesn't allow it.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Banshee_Quest_30_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: That confirms the site’s function. Temporary containment, not long-term housing. Whoever ran this expected a steady flow of prisoners. If you haven’t yet, look for any documents that would explain more. This was clearly part of a larger operation.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Gunny_Quest_42_Debriefing:
That poor girl... what she went through, no one should ever have to.

I made the call to her parents. Told them she died in the crash instantly. Quick and painless. It’s a lie, but... fuck it. Some truths don’t help you sleep better at night.

Thanks for doing this. Now, excuse me. I need a drink...
ST_NamThavenRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_02_Subobjective_4b_: That’s some prime stalker shit, man. Looks like these Blue Lagoon motherfuckers were carefully profiling their targets. Gives me fucking chills.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Handshake_14_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Artisan_01_Briefing: The armed group currently occupying the Blue Lagoon has been marked by Artisan for elimination. Sweep around the area and neutralize as many of them as possible to disrupt their operations.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Handshake_26_Briefing: The hostile elements east of Nam Thaven are causing operational setbacks. Eliminate them.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Gunny_19_AcceptMsg:
The scouts reported seeing a dead PMC to the west of Tiger Bay. I want you to check it out.

I double-checked. It's not our guy, which means he's probably a contractor from another company. I’m not sure what he was doing out here, but the bigger question is who took him out. This spot is pretty far from any local thug dens or LAF territory.

Do a full sweep of the area and figure out exactly what happened. Check for any signs of combat. I have a hunch that whatever happened out there, it has something to do with Ground Zero... and someone there sure as shit didn’t like that.
ST_NamThavenRegion.CT_Handshake_26_AcceptMsg:
Those motherfuckers are pissing me off something fierce! They're becoming a bigger problem than we initially expected.

Look, pal, I know I can count on you, so do me a favor and take care of this problem, okay? Go east of Nam Thaven and teach those assholes a lesson.

ST_NamThavenRegion.Banshee_Quest_30_Debriefing:
Well, there you have it.

The language and the client focus point to something organized, wealthy, and protected. Someone with money to spend and enough influence to keep the machinery running quietly.

This file ties the site to a broader commercial network, not just local thugs improvising. I’ll start pulling on the threads behind that procurement memo and see what shakes loose.

You did good. Maybe we can’t help the people who already fell victim to this disgusting “business,” but at least we can go after the ones responsible.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Handshake_Quest_80_Debriefing:
Well, what do we have here? 

These notes paint a picture of people scrambling, short on parts, and terrified of getting left behind. The map of Tiger Bay confirms it. It's all preparation. Careful, methodical, desperate preparation. Those assholes are absolutely trying to run away, and they are racing against the clock. 

Now the question is, what are they running from?

Thank you for bringing this to my attention, man. We can definitely use it.
ST_NamThavenRegion.Banshee_Quest_30_AcceptMsg:
You have a second? I need your help with something.

We’ve been keeping tabs on a potential human trafficking ring operating somewhere in the area. Recently the trail went cold, courtesy of the Event, but we know for a fact they were using multiple sites to imprison and move people to God knows where. And as luck would have it, I think I just found one of them. An abandoned car repair shop north of Khonwan village. I need you to check it out.

Chances that there are still any poor souls left alive are close to zero, so this is not a rescue mission. What I need is confirmation and intelligence gathering. Investigate the site to see if it was used for their “business,” and try to bring back any documents that might shed light on their wider operations.

I know it’s unpleasant work. But I’m confident you can handle it.

ST_Quests.Main_Quest_4A_AcceptMsg:
After everything we've seen, it's now crystal clear that the cargo from the crashed helicopter has been taken by the rats in the town. I don’t know how, and I don’t know why, but I want it back, understood?

Your mission is to locate their main base of operations and recover the stolen container. It's highly likely they’ve stashed it in the most fortified place around, so focus on the town’s marketplace. That place is always crawling with tangos.

Once you're there, find a way in, secure the area, and recover the container at all costs. I'm sure you’ll do a great job. Don’t let me down now.

ST_Quests.Handshake_Quest_6A_AcceptMsg:
Based on everything you uncovered during your previous work, it looks like some of the rats in town have formed a little gang and are trying to get themselves organized. It’s also more than likely their leader is the one who struck a deal with the LAF to undermine our operations in the area. And we can’t have that, can we? You need to take him down.

Apparently, this asshole is currently holed up in the marketplace. From what we’ve gathered, he's a bling-obsessed young hotshot with a scar on his face who thinks he's tough shit, so keep and eye out for anybody matching that description. There should still be an observation post at the construction site overlooking the market, so you might want to start there and do some proper recon. But that’s up to you.

However you decide to approach this, just make sure he’s dead when you’re done. Okay?

ST_Quests.Handshake_Quest_79A_AcceptMsg:
Great news, man. We’ve got a unique opportunity to enlist a local who wants in on our operation. Thing is, this sneaky fucker wants payment up front as a show of trust, so I need you to deliver a case with the agreed-upon amount to a designated drop-off point. A tractor in the middle of nowhere. Don’t worry, I’ll mark it on your tac device.

You can pick up the case in the command tent at our Base Camp. Once you reach the location, leave it under the tractor and get lost. I guarantee that rat will be watching the place and won’t make a move until you disappear. After that, we wait for him to contact us.

I know what you’re thinking. How the fuck can we trust this guy? Short answer: we can’t. But we don’t have much of a choice, do we? And don’t worry. If he doesn’t come through, I’ve got a contingency prepared.

I always do.

ST_Quests.Main_Quest_1A_AcceptMsg:
Hey there, man! Welcome to Lamang! Truly a paradise on earth, eh? Name’s Lewis Pell, but we can ditch the formalities, right? Just call me Handshake. I prefer it anyway.

You might have heard that we recently had a little… setback regarding our operations here. Well, I can assure you it’s been vastly exaggerated! Everyone’s doing their best, and we’re basically back on track with only a minor delay. I guess it will be even better since you’re here now, right?

To start off, we need to learn more about the assholes currently occupying the nearby town. We've identified one of their observation posts on the outskirts, quite close to the LZ, so I want you to head out there and see what you can find. Don't worry, I'll mark it on your tactical device so you can't miss it.

One other thing. We can safely assume that anyone in that town is hostile, so don't hesitate to use deadly force if needed, got it?

Once you’re done, report back to me pronto, okay? Good luck, champ!

ST_Quests.Main_Quest_5A_AcceptMsg:
Hey, so I don’t really know how to say this, so I’ll just be blunt. I need your help with something, and I beg you to keep it a secret. I hope I can trust you.

You see, the container you've been tasked to retrieve holds something of immense significance, something that could reshape our understanding of this entire situation. I know that Mr. Pell wants the container for immediate assessment, but I implore you to bring it to me first. I can't reveal the specifics just yet, but trust me when I say that it's vital for me to conduct thorough research on its contents before any further actions are taken.

He may not see the value in this approach, but I assure you that it is in the best interest of our mission. Don’t worry, once my research is complete and I have gained a comprehensive understanding of the container's contents, I will present my findings to Mr. Pell. It will be up to him to decide how to proceed from there.

I know it’s a lot to ask, but will you please help me?

ST_Quests.LabRat_Quest_34A_AcceptMsg:
Hi, you must be new here. My name is Jie, but you can call me Lab Rat. Everybody else here already does, but I don't mind. Actually, I think it's rather cute. Makes me feel like a real soldier, having a proper callsign like that. A-ten-hut, or whatever you guys say, right?

Anyway, since you're here, I have a job for you. We're facing a critical shortage of medical supplies after the recent attack. Our people are in desperate need, and it's up to us to find a solution. I've been thoroughly reading all the scouts' reports, and they recently spotted something that might help us. An abandoned ambulance near the town's gas station.

I know I shouldn't get my hopes up. Chances are it was already picked clean, but even a small amount left behind would be incredibly helpful to our efforts here. Could you please take a look and let me know? If you find anything useful, I’ll make sure it gets properly recovered and put to use.

Just keep in mind that areas outside our base might be hazardous, so please be careful. There's no room for mistakes when it comes to securing the well-being of our team, and I need you on your feet, not lying on a stretcher with a bullet hole in your gut.

Thank you, and good luck out there! Dismissed! Am I saying that right?

I need you to look for one of our boys, Tyron Williams. I sent him into the city to monitor the main street, just east of the marketplace. By now, he should’ve checked in with his routine report, but nothing’s come through.

Listen, Tyron’s young and a bit restless. He’s not stupid, but he tends to… take it easy sometimes. This isn’t the first time he’s gone radio silent, but these aren’t normal circumstances. I know his family, and I’d rather not have to deliver bad news to his mother.

You should be able to find him somewhere along the main street. He’ll likely be in an elevated position with a clear view of the area, so look for a tall building. Find out what’s going on and, if possible, bring him back safely.

The UNLRA left behind quite a lot of supplies during their hasty evacuation, and we know for a fact there are several UNLRA-marked tents near the town’s water tower. We never paid much attention to that area before. There was no need to. But now, it’s very possible this could be the answer we’ve been looking for.

Please head out there, look around, and try to find anything that might help us. I can’t stress enough how important this is.

Good luck, and please be careful.

ST_Quests.Handshake_Quest_2A_AcceptMsg:
It appears that the local criminal elements we've been dealing with have acquired some advanced communication interception capabilities and are now able to monitor and decrypt our comms in real-time. This poses a significant threat to our operations and needs to be addressed immediately. 

Your mission is to locate and destroy the enemy's comms equipment. It's apparent that they have established a hidden communication hub within the vicinity of our base, and the most likely place is an isolated house in the northern part of town. Your task is to infiltrate this area, identify the equipment, and neutralize it. By doing so, we'll disrupt their ability to intercept our communications and regain control of the situation. 

Silence and stealth are paramount. We can't afford to alert those rats to our plans. Keep a low profile, gather intelligence, and strike with precision.

ST_Quests.Handshake_Quest_7A_Briefing:
Listen, we've got ourselves a delicate situation on our hands, and I'm counting on your discretion to handle it smoothly. You know how it goes - sometimes we face losses in the field. It's a tough reality, but we need to make sure we handle it the right way to protect our reputation and keep things running smoothly.

Now, I know what Sergeant Jackson tasked you to do, and while I agree with him, we need to take a step back and consider our entire situation here. If we release info about every casualty, this could quickly become a PR nightmare, and we can kiss our bonuses goodbye, got it? So, instead of marking the body for retrieval, you're just going to confirm it's really our guy, and that's it, okay?

We don't want this information to get out to the public or even spread in our ranks. It's all about maintaining our image and keeping morale up. I'm sure you understand, right?

Merc, I got a job for you.

Contrary to what you might believe, some of the people left here are just trying to survive, and you’re going to help them with that. There’s a hidden military truck near the road east of the gas station. Don’t fucking ask me how I know, okay? It was loaded with essentials: food, clean water, and medical gear. With any luck, some of the cargo is still there.

I need you to pick it up and deliver it to the house marked on your map. You think you can manage that? If not, don’t worry too much. I’ll just find some other asshole to do it instead.

According to our intel, the helo went down southeast of the gas station. Your job is to assess the crash site and determine if there are any survivors. Check the wreckage thoroughly and report back with details. If you find any injured personnel, aid them and call for immediate extraction. Oh, and one more thing. Whatever you do, do not open it. Just bring it back here, and we’ll take care of the rest, got it?

ST_Quests.Handshake_Quest_1C_AcceptMsg:
So, here’s the deal. Looks like some of those rats in town didn’t get the memo and are still scurrying around, causing trouble. It’s time to put a stop to their operations. Your mission is to gather intelligence from the hideouts these punks are using. We’ve identified two possible locations in the eastern part of town. Keep your eyes peeled for any suspicious signs or markings that might help you uncover them.

Once you’ve identified the hideouts, search them thoroughly and bring back anything useful to our Base Camp. I’ve got a box set up on the ground in the command tent next to the helipads. You can stash whatever you find there before I get a chance to look it over.

ST_Quests.Gunny_Quest_1A_AcceptMsg:
So, you're one of the new recruits, huh? Answering the call for action and adventure, or just in it for the paycheck? Makes no damn difference to me. Just do your job well, don’t get killed, and you and I won’t have any problems, got it? The name’s Jackson. Anton Jackson. But everyone here just calls me Gunny. Now that we have the pleasantries out of the way, I have a job for you. 

Some people here don’t want to admit it, but we took a beating, plain and simple. Whoever was behind the attack was no ordinary local force. They were trained, well-equipped, and put some serious hurt on us. We had to abandon our positions, leaving behind a lot of gear. Now it's your turn to help us clean up this mess.

We’ve got a weapons cache unaccounted for out there, and your job is to find it and mark its exact location. The poor bastard who had this job before you stopped responding hours ago. His GPS tracker is still transmitting, but it hasn’t moved in a while… so you’ll need to check on him and finish his mission if necessary.

As for the cache itself, I'll mark its last known position on your tactical device, but we need to make sure it’s still there. We can’t let those weapons fall into the wrong hands, so once you’re done, we’ll dispatch a team to recover or destroy them if needed. You got all that? Good. Now go make yourself useful!

Thank fuck! I was a bit worried there for a while, but now everything is back on track, thanks to you. I see that the seal on the container is still intact and has not been tampered with, so we should be golden. Great fucking job, man. You sure deserve that bonus! 

Now that we’ve taken care of this little problem, we can focus again on reclaiming our territory and figuring out what exactly we are dealing with here. Take some rest, and I’ll contact you soon with your next assignment. You know what? I think this is the beginning of a beautiful friendship…

ST_Quests.Handshake_Quest_3A_AcceptMsg:
We've got a problem. Seems our adversaries, those local rats, are way more well-equipped than they ever should have been. Now, I know what you're thinking, "How the fuck is that even possible?" Well, it's clear as day that someone gave them a helping hand. And that is a problem we need to swiftly address.

So here's the deal: we're gonna send you into one of their meeting spots, a place we suspect holds the answers we're looking for, to gather some concrete evidence, something that can expose who helped those bastards. Our scouts suggest that the best place to begin your search is an old restaurant on a street corner in the northern part of town.

Once you've found what we need, report to me immediately. We don't want any loose ends that could come back to bite us in the ass.
