ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_2_Descript: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at Hunter’s Paradise
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: A fully stocked armory would be a huge asset to us, but remember, manpower is more critical than hardware. All the guns and ammo in the world will not help if there is no one left to use them. Stay safe out there.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_17_Briefing: A local woman assisting Lab Rat needs help getting home safely. Locate her and assess the situation.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Turncoat_Quest_27_Debriefing:
Ah. There it is!

Encrypted notes, credentials, access keys… delicious indeed. He was very thorough. Paranoid, even. Exactly the sort of man you want holding secrets, right up until someone decides to pry them out of him.

Don’t worry about the encryption. That’s just a puzzle, and puzzles are my specialty. What matters is that whatever the Vietnamese were so eager to find in here, they didn’t get it. You did.

This little notebook is bound to open all sorts of doors and unearth things that were never meant to see the light of day. It won’t be quick, but it will be… enlightening.

You’ve done very well, friend. Tragic business, all of it, but at least his silence wasn’t for nothing. I’ll make sure his work lives on.

Now go. I have some reading to do.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Vulture_11_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Vulture_12_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Vulture_13_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_06_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Gunny_Quest_46_Briefing: An American civilian who came to Lamang to join the Lamang Liberation Army has gone missing. Investigate a jungle camp south of Ban Phouphienge and determine what happened to him.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_7_Descrip: Ascertain the true nature of the VIP section
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Briefing: Assist Lab Rat by travelling to Hunter’s Paradise to look for a man who disappeared shortly before the evacuation. Follow his trail, search the area for clues, and uncover what happened to him before he vanished.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_07_Briefing: Banshee needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_19_Briefing: Banshee wants to quietly interfere with drug production across Lamang. Disrupt the operation without drawing attention.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_20_Briefing: Banshee wants to quietly interfere with drug production across Lamang. Disrupt the operation without drawing attention.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_26_Briefing: Banshee wants to trace the distribution of drugs across Lamang. Find the shipment at the marked site and plant a tracking device on it.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_5_Descrip: Bring biological samples from Hunter’s Paradise to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_4_Descrip: Bring the proof of identity back to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_25_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Can you believe this guy has three backup locations just in case something feels off? Let's hope you don't find another letter, or you’ll end up even further away. Fucking paranoid wuss. The second spot should be a hut in the jungle. Head straight east from the shack where you found the letter, and you’ll get there.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_10_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations near Hunter's Paradise, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_06_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Check your tactical map. It should be marked.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Subobjective_2a_Descript: Collect samples from the first individual
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Subobjective_3a_Descript: Collect samples from the second individual
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_1_VENDOR_O: Continue your mission. Scout the surroundings and assess the situation.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Could they be the ones who hit the LAF convoy? If so, they probably stashed the weapons in the range’s armory. Investigate the shooting range thoroughly and locate its weapon storage. It is likely locked, so you will need to find a key. Once inside, check how many weapons and ammo are there, if any, and report back to me.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_16_AcceptMsg:
Could you spare a moment? I believe I’m onto something significant, but I need your assistance.

When you're out in the field, I need you to look for a few specific items. It's an oversight on my part, but I couldn't ascertain the exact location of where to find them. However, I have no doubt you'll be able to acquire them nontheless.

Please, I know you have a lot of other work, but I suspect you want to uncover the truth as much as I do. Assisting me with this will set us on the right path. Trust me. I'm counting on you!
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Debriefing: Damn! It looks like the thieves were no rookies either. They left the tracker just to waste our time and laugh at us. You did what you could, but I would have preferred that we recover our property.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_1_VENDOR_O: Damn, I wonder who was brave or stupid enough to steal weapons from the army.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_31_Objective_1_Description: Eliminate the leader of the hostile group occupying Hunter's Paradise
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Fascinating. It appears to be complete cellular degradation, possibly caused by an extreme dose of radiation. Be careful and don’t stay near the body for too long. There’s a good chance it’s still radioactive. That said, please collect some samples before you leave. They’ll be invaluable for my research.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1d_VENDOR_O: Fascinating. Whatever affected them seems to have exploited something deeply personal. If all the villagers felt a similar pull, that could explain why they moved as one toward Ground Zero. I’ve never seen group behavior like this before. I need to study it further.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Subobjective_4a_Descript: Find any intel describing what happened to the individuals
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_1_Descript: Find out what happened on the road leading up to Hunter’s Paradise
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Objective_1_Description: Find out what happened to the stolen shipment
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Subobjective_1c_Description: Find the boxes behind a fence
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Subobjective_1a_Description: Find the boxes next to a house
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_06_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Turncoat_Quest_27_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I have a teeny-tiny favor to ask of you. Barely an inconvenience.

One of my little birds recently stopped singing, and I need to know whether someone rattled his cage a bit too much. This particular individual was one of my greatest assets, posing as a spy for the filthy Vietnamese gang that had been spreading around here like diseased rats even before all this unfortunate business. In reality, he was spying on them for me. Losing him would be… dearly unfortunate.

Please head out to a charming little hamlet where the young man resides and check on his well-being. And if anything went wrong, don’t try to spare me the details out of misplaced sympathy. I’m a big boy. I can take it.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Turncoat_03_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I’m absolutely livid.

You know me, I’ll help anyone who asks. I'm generous to a fault. But it’s always the generous ones who get taken advantage of, isn’t it?

Recently, I heard that the individuals occupying Hunter's Paradise have smuggled in weapons from the mainland. That is unacceptable! I should be the sole arms provider on Lamang. There is no room for competition. Who do these dogs think they are?!

Apologies, friend. I let my temper get the better of me. Do me a favor, go remind them this island has its own ways… and there’s no place here to rewrite the rules.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Turncoat_07_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I’m afraid I must call upon your services once more. You don’t mind, do you?

I need you to search a house on the south end of Ban Phoupienge, a small village on a hill southeast of Kiu Vongsa. Inside, you should find a rather peculiar briefcase that I am very interested in.

Please retrieve it promptly and drop it off in one of my little hiding spots - a small pier at the Lakeside Farm, just south of the village.

As always, you will have my utmost gratitude for your trouble.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Turncoat_08_AcceptMsg:
Friend, do you have it in your heart to help a poor soul?

Did you know that the Mayor of Kiu Vongsa set himself up with a secret rainy-day fund and used all the money to build a cozy little love nest north of town? May lightning strike me if I’m lying, it even has a swimming pool! How delightfully decadent.

Could you please search this den of opulence and retrieve a certain valuable item hidden on the top floor? Once you find it, simply stash it in a large open jug at Inthavong Farm, south of the mansion. And please be quick about it. The person I’m sending to collect the item is in quite a rush.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Turncoat_Quest_27_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obj: Friend, please search the hamlet and look for anything that fits that description. I’m quite certain those hooligans are after the very same thing, so it can’t be far. Once you find it, deliver it to me posthaste.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Turncoat_03_Debriefing: Friend, you’ve done a splendid job. My sources say the dwellers of Hunter’s Paradise are whispering about a vengeful demon that descended upon them. You have my thanks. I doubt they’ll try anything like that again anytime soon.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_25_Debriefing: Fucking hell! I was hoping this guy would live a little longer and sell us some more intel. Well, at least we didn't lose any money getting the information we wanted. Good work. I'll tell our other informants to be more careful. Yeesh, just because you're paranoid doesn't mean they're not out to get you, right?
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_06_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_25_Subobjective_2a_Descript: Go to the hut in the woods east of the shack and secure intel from the contact
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_25_Objective_1_Description: Go to the shack south of Hunter’s Paradise to meet the contact
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_07_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_06_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_5_VENDOR_: Good. Now look around for any documents that could clue us in on what was really going on there. There’s got to be at least one piece of evidence left behind. Check the offices or any other areas where they might have kept records. Report back with what you find.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Subobjective_5a_VEN: Good. Now look around for any documents that could clue us in on what was really going on there. There’s got to be at least one piece of evidence left behind. Check the offices or any other areas where they might have kept records. Report back with what you find.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_26_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_19_Debriefing:
Good. With any luck, they won’t realize what you’ve done until they try to get production running again. Faulty equipment, spoiled supplies, human error, an angry competitor... let them draw their own conclusions.

For now, we leave them to it. The less they understand, the more useful they remain.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_20_Debriefing:
Good. With any luck, they won’t realize what you’ve done until they try to get production running again. Faulty equipment, spoiled supplies, human error, an angry competitor... let them draw their own conclusions.

For now, we leave them to it. The less they understand, the more useful they remain.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Briefing: Gunny needs to look into the theft of a large supply shipment. Proceed to the location marked on your tactical map, determine what happened, and report your findings.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_25_Briefing: Handshake continues to expand his intelligence network. An informant from Hunter's Paradise has valuable information to share. Meet him at the rendezvous point south of the shooting range to retrieve it.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_25_AcceptMsg:
Hey buddy, I've got a special job for you. We’re currently gathering more intel on the Midnight Sapphire Resort, and we've managed to put one of the thugs from Hunter's Paradise on our payroll. Apparently, these guys were gathering intel on the resort long before everything went to shit on this island. Lucky for us! The informant is willing to meet in person and hand over the documents we need. This is where you come in.

There’s a shack south of Hunter's Paradise where you should meet him. He’ll be waiting for you, so watch your trigger! I want to keep a useful asset like him.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_AcceptMsg:
Hey, do you have some time right now? I’d really appreciate your help with something. A local woman contacted me regarding a missing person, and I need you to find him. Think you can do that for me, please?

Aulii Syvongsa used to live near Midnight Sapphire, and from what his wife told me, he couldn’t work because of the injuries he sustained for his "anti-patriotic behavior," courtesy of the local police force. That poor family has been struggling ever since. The thing is, he disappeared a few days before the evacuation even started. The last time someone saw him, he was heading for Hunter’s Paradise.

Please, could you head out there and look for him? I’m sure it will mean the world to his wife… and to me.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_09_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_O: How disturbing. Was something reaching out to the villagers and drawing them in? Or is this a case of mass psychosis? Maybe some hallucinogenic compound? Stay alert and leave immediately if anything feels wrong.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Subobjective_4a_VEN: Hunter’s Paradise keeps coming up in rumors like this, and I can’t ignore them anymore. Please keep searching the area. Check the range and collect biological samples from their food supply if you find any. Bring everything back to me. I'll conduct a thorough analysis. I want to know exactly what was happening there.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Subobjective_1c_VENDOR_Objec: I bet they would even steal the air from the boxes if they knew how. Try to find some that weren't looted.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_3_PLAYER_O: I explored the surroundings. A hostile, unidentified armed group has taken over Hunter’s Paradise.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_16_Debriefing: I find it hard to put into words how thankful I am. Please take this. It's not much, but I hope you'll appreciate it.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_1_PLAYER_O: I found a destroyed LAF truck on the road. Four soldiers are KIA. The weapons they were transporting are missing.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1c_PLAYER_O: I found a diary left behind by one of the villagers. He complains about his ears ringing and describes hearing voices calling him and the others somewhere. Quote: “Voices calling. Have to go. All have to go. We all go. It wants us. It needs us.”
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Subobjective_4a_PLA: I found a goodbye letter. It seems that Aulii sold his life in order to provide for his family. Quote: “I'm selling my life at Hunter's Paradise so that you could live the life you deserve.”
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_O: I found a note covered in two repeating sentences: “There is no need to panic. Proceed to the jungle.” It just goes on and on while losing cohesion.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1d_PLAYER_O: I found a note left behind by one of the villagers. It keeps repeating that he wants to see “her” again and that he has to go somewhere to make it happen.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_5_PLAYER_: I found a refrigerator with suspicious meat. I’ve taken samples.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Subobjective_5a_PLA: I found a refrigerator with suspicious meat. I’ve taken samples.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_O: I found a report written by the hostiles currently occupying this place. It looks like they also spotted the villagers leaving and decided to investigate. They mention malfunctioning radios and complain about their ears ringing.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_Objec: I found an empty house. No sign of the tracker or our supplies.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I found one of them. He’s dead. Whatever happened to him, it seems like someone tried to treat him, but the damage was far too severe. His entire body looks like it’s melting.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_Objec: I found some of the boxes from the truck. Empty.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Turncoat_Quest_27_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obj: I found the informant. He’s dead. Tied to a chair and showing signs of torture. The inside of his house has been tossed over. Looks like his “guests” were looking for something and tried to get it out of him.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Gunny_Quest_46_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I found the kid. He’s dead. From what I can tell, he got sick and they just left him to die.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: I found the tracker. As suspected they left it in the truck.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_06_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_07_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_10_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_09_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_3_PLAYER_: I think I found our guy. He’s been tied to a pole and shot multiple times at point-blank range. From the looks of it, it must have happened before the evac took place.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_17_AcceptMsg:
I was contacted by a local woman who has helped me on several occasions. She’s asking for assistance getting home safely to her family in Kiu Vongsa. She had to travel farther to find rations because the city had been nearly stripped bare by criminals.

I would have helped her myself, but she didn’t ask for supplies, and I wasn’t aware of how desperate her situation had become.

Please hurry. She told me she feels like someone is following her. I’ll mark the meeting location on your tactical device.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Debriefing:
I'm afraid it looks like that note was accurate. Human remains were indeed detected in these samples. Was this some freak accident, or were they truly killing and consuming people? I can't even bear to imagine it, but after what you saw in that bunker… after that letter… there’s no room left for comforting explanations. 

This was business. People paid for this. Whatever this country was before the Event… it was already rotten.

Thank you for your assistance, but to be honest, I would have preferred if you hadn't found anything. We'll talk again soon. Just give me a minute.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_25_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I'm at the meeting site. The informant is absent. I found a letter with a message: “Something’s wrong. Meeting at the second site.”
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Banshee_Quest_28_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_: I'm at the smoldering area. It looks like the killers burned several bodies here. Some of the corpses are only partially incinerated.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_6_VENDOR_: I'm going to be sick... This only adds weight to the rumors about that place. You could pick whatever, kill it, and eat it... Jesus. Just thinking about what those coded items might be... Please, go and find out if what's written there is actually true. Look for anything connected with this "butcher," and locate that bunker.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_6_PLAYER_: I've found a VIP program with a selection of what to kill: a list of various animals, each with its own price. A few items on the list look like some kind of code. There's also a food menu and a note. Quote: "The back bunker is getting full again. Send the butcher to clean it up a bit. A walk in the jungle will only do the fat fuck good."
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Subobjective_1c_PLAYER_Objec: I've found empty boxes. The bandits took everything.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_7_PLAYER_: I've located the bunker near Hunter's Paradise. There are bodies everywhere - civilians only. Most of them are at least a couple of months old.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_O: Interesting. Your radio isn’t acting up too, is it? Good. I don’t have an explanation for the ringing phenomenon yet, but be very careful. Who knows what that area is exposing people to.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Objective_1_Description: Investigate Ban Langphou and find any clues that might explain what happened to its inhabitants
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Banshee_Quest_28_Objective_1_Description: Investigate Ban Phouphienge and report your findings to Banshee
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Briefing: Investigate Hunter’s Paradise, beginning with the road leading to the shooting range, and determine what happened to a reported abandoned military truck. Scout the area for hostile forces, locate any weapon storage facilities, and assess whether firearms or ammunition remain on site. Report all findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Gunny_Quest_46_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the LLA outpost and find out what happened to Jacob Murray
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the small hamlet west of Ban Phouphienge and find the individuals who returned from Ground Zero
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_4_Descript: Investigate the weapon storage at Hunter’s Paradise
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Debriefing:
It seems we were right. The villagers didn’t flee. They were drawn in.

Everything you described paints a horrific picture. Something manipulated these people into abandoning all survival instincts and heading directly into Ground Zero. We can’t be sure whether this “calling” came from Ground Zero itself or from some other, still unknown source, but whatever it was, the ramifications are terrifying. We are no longer dealing only with physical and biological processes. This is something else.

I need to thoroughly reconsider how I approach my research into Ground Zero. If there’s something here that can manipulate behavior like this, then distance alone is no longer protection. Anyone within range could become susceptible without ever stepping inside. And if this can happen to the locals… how long before it happens to us?
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_17_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objectiv: I’m at the meeting point. She’s nowhere to be seen.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Banshee_Quest_28_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_: I’m at the town hall. Whoever did this was merciless. They gathered a large number of townsfolk out front and executed them. No exceptions. There are children among the dead.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Objective_4_PLAYER_O: I’m in the weapon storage. It's empty.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_19_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been keeping an eye on the drug trade here. It seems some of the old production sites are still operational. Different people running them, same poison coming out.

I want you to pay one of them a visit. The location is marked on your map. Find where they’re producing the drugs and sabotage the operation. But be subtle about it. The drugs stay, the equipment stays. I don’t want anyone realizing what was actually targeted. The rest is up to you.

The longer they remain unaware of us, the more useful they’ll be.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_20_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been keeping an eye on the drug trade here. It seems some of the old production sites are still operational. Different people running them, same poison coming out.

I want you to pay one of them a visit. The location is marked on your map. Find where they’re producing the drugs and sabotage the operation. But be subtle about it. The drugs stay, the equipment stays. I don’t want anyone realizing what was actually targeted. The rest is up to you.

The longer they remain unaware of us, the more useful they’ll be.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Banshee_26_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_06_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a job for you, and I need it done fast. Got it?

Back when we still held some ground on this rock, we stashed a few ammo caches around for quick field resupplies. Now, with the situation being what it is, we need to find out if they’re still intact, and if so, recover them.

Your task is to check a few of these locations and report back whether the caches are still there and retrievable. I’ll send someone else to pick them up, don’t worry about that. I just need the intel.

There are four caches in total. I've marked the first one on your tactical map. Take care of it, and I’ll relay the rest to you as you go.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Gunny_Quest_46_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got something for you.

We picked up word about an American civilian who came to Lamang just before everything went to hell. Name’s Jacob Murray. Kid thought he was gonna play hero and join up with the Lamang Liberation Army to “fight for freedom.” Real romantic shit. You can guess how that turned out.

The LLA grabbed him and held him for ransom instead, using him to squeeze his family back in the States. Last intel places him at one of their jungle camps south of Ban Phouphienge.

I want you to head there and find out what happened to him. If he’s still alive, we pull him out. If not, I want confirmation. My money’s on the latter, but even if that’s the case, maybe his death will help deter other naive little shits from the same fate.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_AcceptMsg:
I’ve just received some deeply unsettling reports from our scouts. Ban Langphou, a small village west of Hunter’s Paradise, has been completely abandoned. The people weren’t driven out by bandits, nor was there any other immediate danger present. They all simply… left.

At first we assumed they had fled the area for some unknown reason, but it appears they walked away together, as a group, all heading in the same direction. Toward the center of Ground Zero. No one came back.

This isn’t normal panic behavior. Villagers don’t willingly march into a lethal zone unless something compels them to do so. I need you to go there and find out what happened. Look for anything they might have left behind that could explain why they walked straight into the most dangerous place on the island, especially when it lies so far from their village.

Please be careful. Something about this doesn’t feel right.

ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_17_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objectiv: Jesus... If only she had asked me for the supplies, this could have been avoided.

ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Turncoat_Quest_27_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obj: Oh dear me. That is very unfortunate. I suppose it was only a matter of time before the Vietnamese started sniffing out betrayal. I just hoped it would last a little bit longer. Well, no sense crying over spilled milk. Thankfully, the poor soul had a contingency for something like this. A notebook full of delicious intel. The problem is that, to find it, I was given just one keyword. “Underwater.”
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Subobjective_4a_VEN: Oh my God, he... he volunteered to be killed to help his family? What kind of sick monsters would let something like this happen? The more I learn about this country, the more I feel like what happened here was well-deserved. At least the majority finally had a chance to escape this hell…
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_40_Subobjective_1c_VENDOR_O: Oh my God… What could cause something like this? I need to start forming hypotheses right away. This is extremely unusual.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Labrat_17_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objectiv: Oh no. Please, can you look for her? She can’t be far. Maybe she’s hiding somewhere nearby.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_AcceptMsg:
Okay, here’s the thing. Our supply situation still isn’t great, and that’s a big understatement, believe me. Since the entire place is under international quarantine, sending anything our way is proving very difficult. Simply put, if we don’t make use of everything that can help us, we’re done for.

There’s some kind of luxury resort north of our AO. You know, the kind that definitely wasn’t meant for locals unless they were scrubbing toilets there. It sticks out like a sore thumb, so you can’t miss it. However, it’s the place just west of it that interests me. It looks like the top one percent staying at the resort weren’t satisfied with just lying by the pool and tanning their rich asses. They also wanted some action. Naturally, the locals couldn’t say no and built them a shooting range where they could play soldiers.

A shooting range means weapons and ammo, things that are in short supply around here. I need you to go there and put eyes on it. But don’t just storm the place. We don’t know who might still be there. Scout around the area and investigate what happened on the road leading to the site. We got reports of an abandoned military truck, so begin your search there.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: One last thing. You mentioned he was being treated. Please search the area for any notes the person treating him might have left behind. They could prove crucial to understanding exactly what we’re dealing with here.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Vulture_11_AcceptMsg:
Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

Search the place marked on your map. Bring back a… sample. I will study it… thoroughly. Then I can decide if it’s time for a… hostile… takeover.

ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Banshee_Quest_28_Debriefing:
So it’s true. The entire village was massacred.

Whoever did this acted with precision. Professional killers. There are two likely suspects: the LAF, or those unidentified mercenaries I keep hearing about. The ones who attacked all the PMCs on Lamang.

The question is why. Did the villagers see something they weren’t supposed to? Were they hiding something? And why go through all the trouble to burn some bodies but leave the rest?

And one other thing... why didn’t UNLRA evacuate the village in the first place?

I’ll have to dig deeper. This all stinks to high heaven.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_07_Debriefing:
So the LAF swooped in, confiscated everything, and then somebody took it from them. Damn. It's a fucking dog-eat-dog world out here.

Anyway, it does not matter who the new proud owner of those weapons is. The result is the same. No guns, no ammo, not even a sharp stick.

At least we know who we are dealing with. Turns out they are gangsters from Vietnam. Exactly what we needed. Foreign thugs sniffing around for blood.

Well, they'll get blood, all right. But it is going to be theirs.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Banshee_Quest_28_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_: So they weren’t just shooting wildly. They were organized and worked methodically. Interesting. Doesn't sound like a job of local bandits, does it?
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_3_VENDOR_: So, someone did this to him before all the chaos even started. But why? Please try to find anything that might confirm it's really him, and maybe give us some answers...
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Sometimes I hate being right. Damn it. I was really hoping they would be dumber than that. Crafty bastards...

Maybe if... no. There was nothing more that could have been done.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_09_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.

ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_31_AcceptMsg:
The hostiles at Hunter’s Paradise keep causing us trouble. We need to eliminate the head of their little operation, and hopefully, the rest will follow soon.

If I were you, I’d look for any commander-type dude, and shoot him promptly in the face. Anybody with better gear would be a hot target, so observe them carefully and take the shot. I know you got this.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Turncoat_03_Briefing: The hostiles from Hunter's Paradise have reportedly smuggled weapons onto the island, and Turncoat does not want any potential competitors gaining a foothold in Lamang. Sweep around the area and eliminate them.

ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Debriefing:
These notes... This shouldn't be possible. Not in this timeframe. Less than six hours from exposure to complete bodily failure. That simply doesn’t happen. Even the most extreme forms of radiation damage don’t progress like this. Not this fast, and not this thoroughly.

The samples you brought back confirm it. The tissue isn’t burned, poisoned, or necrotic in any conventional sense. The cells are losing cohesion, like the mechanisms that hold them together are being disrupted. It’s not killing the body so much as unmaking it.

I don’t have a name for it yet. It doesn’t fit any known radiation model, and it doesn’t behave like a chemical agent either. It’s more like something that alters matter at a fundamental level. That’s just a hypothesis, but it’s the only one that fits what we’re seeing.

I need to rethink our safety protocols. Immediately.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_AcceptMsg:
This damn country is really driving me mad. Someone ambushed one of our supply transports and nicked a large shipment. Fortunately, we put trackers in the boxes, so we now know exactly where our supplies are.

The tracker is pinging from a small roadside market east of Kiu Vongsa, right on the main road.

Go and get the supplies back.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_02_Objective_7_VENDOR_: Those monsters! They murdered them for sport, and then they just dumped them in some hole like garbage! I... I can't do this anymore...

ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Gunny_Quest_46_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Typical. I told you where my money was, didn’t I? Nothing more we can do for him now. Maybe he was stupid, but he still didn’t deserve to go out like that.

ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_AcceptMsg:
We have a unique opportunity to learn more about Ground Zero. Our scouts spotted two individuals venturing inside, staying there for a couple of hours, and then returning to Ban Mala, a small hamlet west of Ban Phouphienge. As far as we know, they haven’t been seen since.

I need your assistance with this. Please search the hamlet and find out what happened to them. The effects of Ground Zero on humans are still largely a mystery, so being able to study someone exposed to its processes would be incredibly valuable to my research.

Make sure to take every precaution before you head out. I’ll send some iodine pills to your locker, just in case. We can’t know whether they brought back anything dangerous with them… or even inside them.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_27_AcceptMsg:
We have to stop those fuckers from spreading any further. How the fuck are we supposed to work with them running loose? They’re making a fucking mess of the area, and I won’t tolerate it.

I want you to deal with them. I can’t think of anyone more deserving of a little restructuring than these assholes. Their chaos ends now. Move southeast of Kiu Vongsa and deliver the consequences they’ve earned.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Labrat_Quest_39_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: While you’re there, try to locate the second individual as well. If he met the same fate, make sure to collect samples from him too. We might not be able to help these two, but maybe we’ll be able to save more lives in the future.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Banshee_Quest_28_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_: Why burn some bodies and leave the rest out in the open? Either they got sloppy, or the burned ones were somehow different...
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Gunny_Quest_46_Debriefing:
Yeah, I figured that’s how it would end.

The kid came here chasing some Hollywood version of a revolution. Thought he’d be fighting tyranny shoulder to shoulder with brave rebels. Instead, he got locked up, milked for ransom, and thrown away the second he stopped being worth anything.

I’ll forward everything to command and make sure his family finally gets some answers. It’s gonna hurt like hell, but they deserve the truth.

I just hope this stops the next wide-eyed idiot from running off to join “freedom fighters” they saw on some damn forum.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Handshake_27_Debriefing: You handled them the way you should have. Well done. I think they’ll crawl back eventually, but you’ve bought us a minute of some much-needed peace.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.CT_Gunny_18_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: You know what? Forget it. You won't find anything. Looks like they took everything and wrecked the tracker. At least find the other one. Follow the main road; you should spot it on the side. My guess is they left it in the truck.
ST_Quests_HuntersParadiseRegion.Banshee_Quest_28_AcceptMsg:
You're just in time.

I caught wind of some disturbing rumors. Reports of atrocities committed against civilians. I need someone to look into it, and you're the best person for the job. There is a village south of Hunter's Paradise, called Ban Phouphienge. Word is, the entire place was massacred. It seems recent, so the site should still be fresh. I need answers.

Head there. Investigate the local town hall and the area that appears to still be smoldering. Find any evidence that could point to who was behind these inhuman acts.

<DEV> Friend, I've heard that you found some interesting things in the abandoned UNLRA camp. As you know, I'm an information trader, always on the lookout for new secrets. Therefore, I would like to ask you to bring me the files you are looking for right now.

There are always people who would pay good money to get documents that will reveal at least some of the mysteries that have befallen this beautiful country. And with your help, we can quench their thirst for answers.

I look forward to seeing you soon.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_14_Debriefing: <DEV> Friend, this is marvelous! These documents are packed with groundbreaking and shocking information. Just skimming through them, I think I’ll have to raise the price a little! You have my heartfelt thanks. And as always, don’t worry - I’ll put them to good use...
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_2_VEND: <DEV> Fuck the LAF! Focus on what matters. This UNLRA business is what worries me. It doesn't add up. We need to figure out what they were really doing if we want to make sense of everything else that has gone sideways on this island. Humanitarian cover stories are cheap. Setting up an entire UN specialized agency is not. That kind of effort means there was something very specific at stake.
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_49_Subobjective_1a_Descr: <DEV> Gather intel from a laptop in the comms room
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_49_Subobjective_1b_Descr: <DEV> Gather intel from a laptop in the makeshift operating room
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_49_Subobjective_1c_Descr: <DEV> Gather intel from an inventory list

ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_45_Objective_3_Descripti: <DEV> Gather intel from the third LAF checkpoint in Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_6_VEND: <DEV> Good. Check whether it is Taylor. If we're lucky, they left some of his personal effects behind.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_7_PLAY: <DEV> Got it. I've gained full access to the terminal and managed to connect to their server. Downloading the data now.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_7_VEND: <DEV> Great job! Copy all that shit to a flash drive and get moving! I can’t wait to see what they found out.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_2_VEND: <DEV> Head to their HQ and start digging. Look for any serious data stash. A full workstation would be perfect. They probably ran most systems through terminals, but if you can reach their server, then we are fucking golden, my man.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_10_Debriefing: <DEV> I can’t believe I’m saying this, but thanks. Don’t think this makes us friends, though! In my eyes, you are still only slightly better than the man you just killed. Don’t forget your place.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_6_PLAY: <DEV> I found a body in the UNLRA dormitory area. It looks like it was moved to an abandoned storage building away from the rest of the personnel.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_5_PLAY: <DEV> I found an active UNLRA terminal, but it is locked behind a security card. The nameplate says it belonged to someone named R. Taylor.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_10_Briefing:
<DEV> I have one more thing to ask of you, Merc. I need to be sure that the head of this entire sick operation, at least at this level, has been taken care of. His name is Malo Luangrath, and he has been a blight on the face of this country for long enough. Can you believe he calls himself “Butcher”? He's a sick, evil man with a massive ego and a soul as black as the ocean at night.

Get rid of him, mercenary. The world will be a better place once he’s gone. Trust me.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_16_Objective_1_Description: <DEV> Investigate the boat moored at Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_24_Objective_1_Description: <DEV> Investigate what happened to the recon team sent to the Blue Lagoon
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_2_VEND: <DEV> It really feels like they knew something was coming and prepared for it. Then they bailed anyway, even after operating here for months.

ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Briefing: A Lamtel office located south of the mall in Tiger Bay has been linked to multiple digital fraud cases. Your task is to get inside, find a functioning terminal, and pull whatever records you can. While you're in there, keep your eyes open for anything that feels off, and find out what was really happening there.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_20_Briefing: A family searching for a missing UNLRA employee contacted Gunny after the organization refused to answer their questions. In his last message, he mentioned an "expedition" towards Ground Zero. The missing person was staying north of Tiger Bay Central, near a seafood restaurant. Locate him to uncover what happened.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_O: A fish with spider legs? No clue what that could be, but it reminds me of a manga I read when I was little. It scared me so much I avoided the sea for an entire month.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_25_Debriefing: A sniper took them all out. Jesus, can you imagine? They were about to depart, and then the pilot got shot. Goddamn camping sons of a bitches. It's another debt we'll pay back with interest, mark my words.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_29_Subobjective_1a_Descrip: Access Vice President Park’s office in Tiger Bay and secure any relevant files
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_29_Subobjective_2a_Descrip: Access the Municipal Office Building archive and secure any relevant files
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Subobjective_3a_Descrip: Access the server room and secure the backup drive
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Vulture_14_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Vulture_15_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Debriefing:
Alright, I’ve gone through the drive.

Looks like Lamtel was running more than just scams. The people working there had their documents confiscated, were kept under constant surveillance, and lived in conditions barely fit for animals. Anyone who underperformed got humiliated, beaten, or worse...

Some of the names in the system are worrying. I ran a quick check, and they match missing persons reports. All tourists who traveled to Lamang.

One more thing. Buried deep in the logs are authorizations, permits, and payments. This whole operation wasn’t just tolerated. It was actively supported at the highest level.

The Lamangese government signed off on all of it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_18_Briefing: An UNLRA evacuation convoy from Kiu Vongsa mysteriously disappeared. It was last seen past Pha Lang Airfield, heading towards Tiger Bay. Search the road northwest of Ban Pa for any signs of what happened and report your findings to Artisan.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_16_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Are you fucking kidding me? This isn’t just some prank. No, man. This was an organized effort to waste our time and slow us down. Once we find those bastards, they'll wish they were already dead!
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_12_Briefing: Artisan needs more information about the UNLRA evacuation. Investigate the UNLRA camp in Tiger Bay, search for documents or evidence identifying those who issued orders preventing certain civilians from evacuating, and report your findings to her.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_13_Briefing: Banshee needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_27_Briefing: Banshee wants to trace the distribution of drugs across Lamang. Find the shipment at the marked site and plant a tracking device on it.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_28_Briefing: Banshee wants to trace the distribution of drugs across Lamang. Find the shipment at the marked site and plant a tracking device on it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_21_Briefing: Based on the evidence Banshee has gathered, it appears that a major drug trading point has been operating from Tiger Bay Central. Search the shopping center for discreet stash locations where narcotics could be hidden and collect any evidence of the operation before it disappears.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_21_Objective_1_Description: Bring the fentanyl from the area around Ban Pa to Gunny
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_11_Objective_1_Descriptio: Bring the fentanyl to Turncoat's drop-off point

ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_26_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need you to find a colleague and dear friend of mine, Neil Osprey, a renowned astrophysicist. I recently learned from his agent that the UNLRA approached him to assist with their research. Although it seems a bit odd for them to need someone in his field, I can see why they'd want him. It's not easy to find someone who is highly regarded by both the scientific community and the general public. He even has a popular science TV show where he- ...uh, I’m rambling, aren't I? Sorry about that.

The last time anyone heard from him was during the evacuation. He mentioned he was set to board a UNLRA convoy from Nam Thaven to Tiger Bay. After that - silence. He was supposed to notify his agent once they arrived in Tiger Bay, but that never happened.

Please, try to find out what went wrong. The world would lose one of its greatest minds if something terrible occurred, and I’d lose a good friend...
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_14_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations at Tiger Bay, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Check the two main entrances to Tiger Bay Central and assess the situation there. We’re going to smoke them out sooner or later, and I want that intel before anything kicks off. Once we know what they’re packing, we can plan accordingly.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_20_Objective_1_Description: Conduct a search of a house with large amounts of medical waste in Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Briefing: Convenience store manager Lae Sayasane, who worked near Tiger Bay Central, has gone missing, and Artisan wants to find her. Investigate the store, search for evidence, and determine her whereabouts.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_4a_VEND: Copy that. That means they’re either stretched thin or saving the good stuff for somewhere else. Either way, that entrance isn’t their priority.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Subobjective_8a_: Copy the data on a USB drive
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_15_AcceptMsg:
Could you spare a moment? I believe I’m onto something significant, but I need your assistance.

When you're out in the field, I need you to look for a few specific items. It's an oversight on my part, but I couldn't ascertain the exact location of where to find them. However, I have no doubt you'll be able to acquire them nontheless.

Please, I know you have a lot of other work, but I suspect you want to uncover the truth as much as I do. Assisting me with this will set us on the right path. Trust me. I'm counting on you!
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_25_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Damn it! That's exactly what I was talking about. Get out of there, or you might end up like them.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_20_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Damn, the family insisted that he was in perfect mental health, so whatever happened to make him want to off himself must have been pretty goddamn out there. I'm not sure I even want to know...
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_20_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Dear God, I was really hoping I was wrong... Just what kind of hellish place was this?
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_AcceptMsg:
Do you think you'll ever tire of killing, merc? Or will you just move on to another third-world country you've never heard of to continue your bloody business? You don't have to answer. From the look on your face, I can guess what you'll do.

I've been informed about a missing person from Tiger Bay. Her name is Lae Sayasane; she's a manager at a convenience store close to Tiger Bay Central, so look for any clues there. Her friend mentioned that she was acting oddly before she disappeared, often seeming lost in thought. Apparently, she started dating someone not from the island, which might be somehow connected.

I hope this time will be different and that you actually find a living person, merc. It's starting to feel mighty suspicious that you only seem to find dead bodies...
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_01_Objective_1_Description: Eliminate the LAF hostiles at Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_11_Briefing: Evidence suggests that the former residents of Ban Pa were running a drug ring prior to the Event. It's likely they left behind a hidden stash of drugs. Sweep the hills overlooking Ban Pa to locate the stash and deliver the merchandise to Turncoat's shack northwest of the village.
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Objective_4_VENDOR_Ob: Fantastic. I'm sure it really ties the room together. You’re not planning to haul that monstrosity back here, are you? Try to find something smaller we can work with.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_3a_VEN: Fascinating! I can't wait to start reading those documents. While you are still in the refugee camp, can you help find a missing person? I have a feeling this might give us another piece of the puzzle.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Objective_4_VENDOR_: Fascinating! We know so little about this kind of phenomenon... Could you bring me a sample? Uh, to be clear, I’m NOT suggesting you snap off his finger and shove it in your pocket. No, no. Look around. If anyone examined him when things fell apart, they may have left something behind.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_4_Descript: Find and report all the LAF weapon caches in Tiger Bay Central

ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_20_Objective_1_Description: Find out what happened to the UNLRA staff member in Tiger Bay

ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_1a_Des: Find the testing kit at the UNLRA checkpoint west of Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_13_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_: Friend, I am tremendously disappointed in you. Please refrain from such acts of hostility in the future, or I might reconsider our friendship...
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_10_VENDOR._BecameAvailabl: Friend, I have a proposition for you. I believe you're looking for something I could utilize. Let's talk.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_01_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I need a small favor… and I need it done quickly.

Some people out there still haven’t learned that crossing me is a mistake they can’t afford.

Pay them a visit. Remind them that nobody stabs me in the back and then gets to enjoy the life they built off my generosity. It’s time to cut these moochers off for good. These parasites don’t deserve to breathe the same air as decent people.

Head to the Tiger Bay residential area and put them down. You’ll find them wandering the streets like they own them. Make sure they understand otherwise.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I need you to do me an urgent favor. I've been contacted by my informant from Tiger Bay, who suspects that he’s about to meet an untimely demise. It’s possible that his colleagues have discovered he had a little chat with me regarding some... not-so-public information. I don’t want him to end badly; he’s still of great use to me. I need you to go to Tiger Bay and get him out of there.

I know this is an unorthodox request on my part, not to mention a rather quick one, but I will pay you in gold if you succeed in rescuing this rascal. He lives in the southern part of Tiger Bay, behind a garage that is used for a small entrepreneurship.

Make haste, friend. Time is our enemy.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_10_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I recently found out that the good people in charge of the Blue Lagoon had a very immoral yet lucrative side business. What was happening there is sad, very sad, yes, but the past is the past. We can't change what happened. We have to look to the future.

The unfortunate individuals who disappeared while visiting the Blue Lagoon are gone, and therefore, they no longer need their IDs and passports. I'm a man who can use such documents bestowed by providence itself, so be kind and bring them to me. To do otherwise would be a waste. Try searching the remote homestead on the road leading west from the Lagoon. I believe it was used as their little hiding place.

I will not forget such a favor and will reward it accordingly.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_11_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I suspect that by now, you are already aware of the exact nature of events that unfolded in Ban Pa before your arrival. The village's original inhabitants utilized their entrepreneurship and passion for drama to create a delightfully macabre and, more importantly, very profitable business. Sadly, even though they shared some of their wealth with... certain individuals in power to look the other way, judging by what you’ve discovered, it wasn’t nearly enough.

I believe it's only fair I get my slice of the pie, and I hope you'll help me secure it. No need to fret; unlike those tight-fisted folks, I understand the value of sharing. There's bound to be a stash hidden away somewhere, containing the finest of their craft. From what I know, I'd suggest a short hike around the hills overlooking Ban Pa. If you'd kindly procure some of these materials for me, I'll ensure your efforts are handsomely rewarded. When you find it, simply bring it to a shack on the other side of the hills, northwest of Ban Pa. I'll take care of the rest.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_19_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I’m reaching out with another request. You’re familiar with the LAF occupation of Tiger Bay Central, and I know you're eager to reclaim that territory. So, let me propose a bold move: eliminate their commander. Taking him out would deal a serious blow to their morale, especially given how much they depend on his leadership.

Why suggest such a drastic measure? Partly to assist a valued client, and partly because of a personal grievance. The commander and I have a history, and let’s just say it’s not a pleasant one. He betrayed me when I needed him most - truly a disappointing failure.

But let's focus on the rewards. A substantial one awaits you. Waste no time; let's bring this plan to fruition.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_25_Debriefing: Friend, excellent job! I hope the weapons arrive at that annoying buyer soon enough. I'm looking forward to having a "friendly" chat with him. Here is your promised reward.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_13_AcceptMsg:
Friend, is what I hear true? Are you looking for more information about the drug trade on the island? That's perfect!  As you know, I am also very interested in this market... because of my curious personality, of course. Ha ha.

Anyway, I don't know what you were offered for your discoveries, but if you bring me the information you find, I will be extremely generous.

You can leave your findings at a humble little abode northwest of Tiger Bay Central, right on the edge of town. Have a safe trip!
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_01_Debriefing:
Friend, it’s always good to be reminded I have someone as reliable as you on my side.

The parasites got the message loud and clear. Those who survived your little visit were quick to call, apologize, and crawl back where they belong.

You have my thanks. Take your well-deserved reward.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_19_Debriefing: Friend, my gratitude knows no bounds. That scoundrel had it coming for far too long - his obstructionism was intolerable. I'm glad that your actions not only benefit me and your company but also contribute to the betterment of this land!
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_25_AcceptMsg:
Friend, the time has come to honor the memory of the fallen informant - may his soul find peace - and put the intel that cost him his life to good use. One of the greatest joys in my life has always been moving means of defense from those who don't need them to fine people who do. But someone has taken this joy from me, and now my philanthropic efforts are short on supplies. Because of this individual, not even the good folk of Tiger Bay will sell me so much as a sharp stick. They claim it's no longer safe, but I can smell treachery a mile away, friend!

Thanks to the deceased snitch, I now know these pests found a new buyer who dishonestly outbid me. That means competition, and I’m not too fond of competition. They used a "floating" restaurant on the coast of Tiger Bay to conduct their business, so I need you to go there and discreetly plant a tracker in one of their weapon cases. I have to find the cockroach who’s getting in my way, and crush him!

Make haste, friend. The sooner you complete your task, the sooner I can reward you.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_14_AcceptMsg:
Friend, would you kindly assist me?

There’s a house at the southeast end of Tiger Bay, just beside a small pond and surrounded by a gray-wall fence. The owner of this charming little palace was supposed to send me a package, but alas, it never arrived, and the man has stopped responding to my calls. Not only do I find that rather rude, but it is also terribly inconvenient for my business.

Please, search the house thoroughly, find the package, and store it promptly in a cooler inside a farmhouse southwest of the pond. Please be as fast as the wind. Unfortunately, the contents are quite sensitive to the beautiful Lamang heat.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_13_Debriefing: Friend, you are a miracle! It is truly educational to learn how drug distribution works. I feel like a drug archaeologist discovering long-lost treasures. Don't worry, I won't forget your friendliness.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_10_Debriefing: Friend, you have my thanks. Your money-hungry attitude is a blessing to a man like me. You deserve every penny for your favor. I can guarantee you that these documents will serve a new purpose and produce a lot of capital.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Objective_1_Description: Gain access to a terminal in the Lamtel Offices in Tiger Bay

ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5b_Desc: Gather intel from a laptop in the makeshift operating room
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5c_Desc: Gather intel from an inventory list
