ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_3_Desc: Gather intel from the first LAF checkpoint in Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_4_Desc: Gather intel from the second LAF checkpoint in Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5b_VEND: Glad to hear we're not the only ones having a bit of trouble. It looks like the LAF encountered the same guys who caused our unfortunate setback a while back. Just who the fuck are they?
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Objective_2_Descriptio: Go to the cement factory in Tiger Bay and find out what happened to the informant
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Objective_1_Descriptio: Go to the informant's house in Tiger Bay and find out what happened to him
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_13_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Debriefing:
Good work. Thanks to you, we’ve learned a lot more about our enemies in this area, and I’m damn sure this intel will come in handy once we’re ready to deal with them permanently. In any case, the LAF in Tiger Bay is weaker than we expected, which means we can start stepping on the gas there.

But what really has my attention are the bastards who attacked us and seem to be operating against everyone on this island. Whoever they are, they’re playing a bigger game. And I want us a whole lot closer to it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_6_VEND: Good. Check whether it is Taylor. If we're lucky, they left some of his personal effects behind.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_27_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_28_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Good. That's a relief. Junk and transport trucks I can live with. I'm not gonna lie; they had me worried for a while. The LAF may not be as well-trained as we are, but they have strength in numbers, and if backed up by heavy vehicles, we would be in for a pretty rough time.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_7_PLAY: Got it. I've gained full access to the terminal and managed to connect to their server. Downloading the data now.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: Got it. Let me see... we’ve got financial records tied to dummy companies, mentions of confiscated IDs, and internal memos that should’ve never seen the light of day. This wasn’t just simple fraud; something uglier was going on here.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_7_VEND: Great job! Copy all that shit to a flash drive and get moving! I can’t wait to see what they found out.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_21_Briefing: Gunny needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_25_Briefing: Gunny wants to know what happened to a missing squad that disappeared near Ban Pa. Locate any signs of the team or their helicopter and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_17_Briefing: Gunny was informed that a tourist matching the description of an athletic white male disappeared just before the Event. Search the suspected hideout thoroughly and recover any evidence that could reveal his plans.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_01_Briefing: Handshake arranged for the handover of important intel from an LAF informant. Retrieve the flash drive from the Kuna shop in Tiger Bay Central. Create a diversion to cover our contact’s escape and neutralize any resistance as needed. Deliver the drive to the designated drop-off point in the southern residental area.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_4_VEND: Head to their HQ and start digging. Look for any serious data stash. A full workstation would be perfect. They probably ran most systems through terminals, but if you can reach their server, then we are fucking golden, my man.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_01_AcceptMsg:
Hey man, I need you to hit the shopping center fast.

I’ve made contact with an individual from LAF who was willing to sell us some intel. He stashed it on a flash drive in Tiger Bay Central, specifically, at the Kuna shop. The plan was to leave it outside the mall, but he started drawing too much attention. In the end, he had to hide it inside that viper's nest.

I know it’s not ideal, but if he tried to walk out, they’d have grabbed him. Fucking troublemakers.

So here’s the plan. Get in there, grab the flash drive, and stir up some trouble. Take out a few of their soldiers while you’re at it. My guy needs a distraction to slip out, and you’re perfect for that. Don’t worry, you won’t hit him by mistake. He swears he knows how to keep his head down.

Once you’ve secured the flash drive, drop it off at Riki’s Gamer Grill, a small restaurant in the southern residential area.

Nothing but a simple trifle for someone like you, right?
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_29_AcceptMsg:
Hey, I’ve got something big lined up here. Do you have a moment?

Ever heard the name Jan Park? He's the Vice President of this country and Narith's right hand man. Nobody knows where he’s hiding now, probably somewhere safe with Narith, but his absence gives us a chance to dig deeper into the corruption rotting this place from the inside out. Sounds good?

There’s a Municipal Office Building in Tiger Bay, right next to the old UNLRA Refugee Camp. I need you to get in there and find Park’s office. Careful though. I’ve heard some bandits took it over after the evacuation, but the LAF kicked them out pretty fast. Now they’re the ones calling the shots, so expect some heavy defences. Once you find the office, search it thoroughly and bring back anything that might shine a light on what was happening behind closed doors there.

And while you're at it, check the archive as well. I'm sure they're hiding something good in there.

Thanks in advance. We would not have gotten this far without you.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_16_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man, we have an urgent matter to attend to. Our scouts spotted something suspicious under a bridge west of Tiger Bay but didn’t have time to investigate further, making excuses about a more critical task Gunny had assigned them. Anyway, from their description, it sounds like they stumbled upon a mined bridge. Looks like someone here is raising the stakes.

I want you to check it out. Confirm that the bridge is mined, and I’ll send a specialist to deactivate the charges. Now hurry up!
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man. Get this. For some fucking reason, the boss is very much interested in Ban Pa, not just for its possible strategic value but for whatever was going on there in the past. You know my opinion on that bullshit, but you know what they say, “He who pays the piper calls the tune.“

So go there and look around for any piece of intel that would make the boss happy, alright? If there really was a cult operating there, I’d bet they had some kind of sacred place. A house of prayer or some shit like that. Look for it and bring back whatever you can find. Don’t worry, you’ll get a real mission soon enough.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man. Listen, the longer we are here, the more I have the feeling that this shit doesn't add up. I feel like there's something wrong here, but I can't put my finger on it. The UNLRA's humanitarian mission just months before the Event... it's far too convenient, don't you think?

Don't get me wrong, this fucking country needed outside intervention like no other, but the UNLRA showing up and barely doing anything? That's a red flag if I ever saw one.

I'm pretty sure you and I are thinking the same thing, so I want you to head out and investigate the area around Tiger Bay. That place is swarming with hostiles, so keep your head down. Try searching the UNLRA checkpoints on the south main road leading to Tiger Bay. I bet there's paperwork lying there that will shed some light on this fucking mess.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_AcceptMsg:
Hey, merc. Have you heard the stories about Ban Pa? This is all probably some big fucking joke to Mr. big-dick stone-cold-killer like you, but people here were terrified just to go near that place, and when somebody did, they would find them later cut to pieces lying in a ditch somewhere with their faces torn to shreds. Cut off limbs, eyes gauged out, nose and ears missing… I know it’s giving you a hard-on just thinking about it, but for people that aren’t fucking evil, this is not okay.

I want to know what was happening there and why. The most widespread rumors were about some kind of cult worshipping evil spirits, so head out there, check around the place, and look around for anything like that. Murals, statues, weird symbols, anything, ok?

I’d normally say be careful, but honestly, I couldn’t care less. If you get killed, I’ll just find somebody else to do it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_13_VENDOR_BecameAvailableD: Hey, merc. I need to talk to you about something. You're not busy, are you?
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_21_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDia: Hey, we need to talk. I have an important request for you.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_AcceptMsg:
Hey. I’ve got something here, and I could use your help.

Ever heard of Lamtel? Officially, it’s just a local telecom company. Nothing to write home about. But the deeper you dig, the more it looks like they were involved in some pretty shady business. We don’t know the full extent yet, but we’ve already linked their offices to multiple digital fraud cases. And that’s just the tip of the iceberg.

Their main office is in Tiger Bay, south of the mall. The building’s probably abandoned now, but with any luck, some of the hardware still works. Get inside, find a functioning terminal, and pull whatever records you can. Emails, financials, anything that might point to what they were really doing.

And while you’re in there, keep your eyes open. If anything feels off, anything that doesn’t belong in a regular office, report back to me. We need to figure out exactly what was going on in that place.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obj: Hmm, it looks like he was running out of time and desperately tried to ask for help... and the other word was probably meant to be "cement." There’s a cement factory in the northern part of Tiger Bay, so you should head there. Be swift, friend! I have a very bad feeling about this...
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_O: Hmm, that sounds like a Churel. It's a mythological, vengeful creature that hunts men. You can look for her in the jungle, merc.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: Hmm, the pond? That could be the one southwest of Tiger Bay Central. It’s a known love nest. Fuck, do you think he lured Lae there and killed her? The way everything's going, I wouldn't be surprised... fucking foreigners.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_13_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_10_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_: I am very disappointed, friend. I was sure you would see the value of such difficult-to-obtain assets. Hopefully, next time you'll reconsider.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_4b_PLAY: I checked the southern entrance to Tiger Bay Central. They’re light on supplies and fortifications.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_15_Debriefing: I find it hard to put into words how thankful I am to you. Please take this. It's not much, but I hope you'll appreciate it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1c_PLAYER_O: I found a bizzare mural. It looks like a floating, disembodied head of a woman, with her internal organs still attached and trailing down from the neck.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_6_PLAY: I found a body in the UNLRA dormitory area. It looks like it was moved to an abandoned storage building away from the rest of the personnel.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1d_PLAYER_O: I found a disturbing statue in a shrine. It looks like a two-headed fish with spider legs. There are offerings on the altar - some fruit and a dead goat.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Subobjective_2a_PLAYER_: I found a notice board in one of the rooms. It's full of photos of workers. Looks like they were singled out for underperforming. The notes underneath insult them, call them lazy, stupid, a disgrace, and threaten them with punishment. Some of the photos are crossed out.
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Objective_4_PLAYER_Ob: I found a statue depicting a two-headed fish with spider legs. There are various rotting offerings scattered benath it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_O: I found a strange mural. It looks like a deformed, ghostly woman with a tail, and her limbs appear adapted for moving through the trees.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_O: I found a weird mural. It looks like a fish with spider legs.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_5_PLAY: I found an active UNLRA terminal, but it is locked behind a security card. The nameplate says it belonged to someone named R. Taylor.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_1_PLAY: I found some UNLRA documents. They describe the mission as humanitarian, but the preparations are suspicious. According to these files, it looks like the people in charge had at least some idea that "something" was going to happen here.
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Objective_3_PLAYER_Ob: I found some sort of altar. There was definitely some religious activity going on here, but it doesn’t look like it belongs to any religion I recognize.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Subobjective_2b_PLAYER_: I found some sort of living quarters. If you can call it that. Looks more like a prison to me.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_16_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I found the bridge and confirmed what the scouts had hastily described: someone had cleverly placed rocks and bricks to mimic explosives from a distance.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_3a_PLA: I found the medical records at the refugee camp. The Event appears to have had serious consequences for those affected by it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_20_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I found the missing UNLRA staff member - dead. It looks like he committed suicide. There are also some notes around full of illegible gibberish.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Objective_4_PLAYER_: I found the peacekeeper. Dead. It looks like he burned to death, but his clothes are completely untouched. I think I’ve seen something like this before...
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_20_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I found the place. It's clear that part of the house had been converted to a makeshift surgery room and used regularly for organ harvesting.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_13_AcceptMsg:
I have another resource-saving job for you. There’s a harbor in Tiger Bay that requires your attention. Our intelligence indicates that a weapons cache is stowed away on a boat moored there. Given our supply situation isn't improving, we need to seize every opportunity we can.

Conduct a thorough search of the harbor and locate that boat, preferably with all the weapons still on board. Hell, even a pile of nine-mils would be a welcome addition. We really can't afford to be picky.

You got all that? Move out!
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_13_VENDOR_BecameAvailable: I have heard that you are looking for some rather... interesting things. Do you have a moment for a quick chat?
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1d_VENDOR_O: I have no idea what this creature might be called, but I have heard many stories about a bizarre fishy deity that the villagers worship.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_3_VEND: I have to say, I'm no stranger to dealing with a complete mess when it comes to command, but this feels like something else.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_13_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_17_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! According to this intel, this guy was a trained contractor who disappeared into the jungle just before the Event. He’s probably working for the bastards who attacked us, and now we know they’ve been preparing for something like this for a long-ass time! Damn it, the more we learn, the more I feel like we’re being kept in the dark.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_14_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_01_Debriefing:
I knew you wouldn’t let me down, champ. That intel’s already paying off. We’ve got eyes on a bunch of LAF’s plans and can act accordingly. And as a nice little bonus, you gave them a proper beating.

Yeah… today’s a good day. Enjoy your reward.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_18_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I located the UNLRA convoy. It’s evident they encountered a well-organized force. Given the number of casualties, it seems most of the civilians were relocated elsewhere.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_13_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_AcceptMsg:
I need your help. I urgently require a specific testing kit for my research to confirm certain suspicions. Something like that should be standard in any well-stocked medical supply depot, but those are hard to come by on this island. I am fairly certain the UNLRA had them. Based on what I have seen so far, they were conducting extensive research into the effects of the Event. At least, before they all suddenly left.

Please find the kit and bring it to me. Focus on the checkpoint west of Tiger Bay. Once you have it, report back and we can start uncovering what the UNLRA was actually up to.

Good luck.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Subobjective_2a_VENDOR_: I see. Disgusting, but not surprising. Sounds like they ran the place like a prison camp. If you find names, faces, or anything we can tie to missing persons, let me know.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_4_VEND: I see. It really looks like this entire "evacuation" was just a fucking sham, doesn't it?
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_15_Debriefing:
I see. So our suspicions were right. There was definitely something cult-like going on there, but I don’t think that was the main point. Whatever they were moving through that dock, it was meant for both foreign and domestic markets.

That logbook you brought back paints a much clearer picture, but we’re still missing pieces. I’ll dig deeper and let you know when I connect the rest of the dots.

Good work.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_21_Subobjective_X_VEDNOR_F: I see. Well, I hope next time you won't be blinded by money.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_21_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_F: I see. Well, I hope next time you won't be blinded by money.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_20_AcceptMsg:
I want to identify at least some of the people who went missing at Blue Lagoon. Even if saving them seems impossible right now, we still have to try. If nothing else, their identities could serve as evidence and bring some closure to their families and loved ones.

I’m sure there’s a place around the Lagoon where they stored personal documentation of the tourists after kidnapping them. I just hope they’re oblivious to our investigation and aren’t planning to close shop and move somewhere else with all the evidence. If that’s the case, search the entire area carefully, focusing on any places they might pack the documents before leaving.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_1_VEND: I want you to continue to Tiger Bay and look for any files related to the evacuation. Try to search the military checkpoints there. I bet the LAF had their own set of orders on how to "cooperate" with the UNLRA, so maybe we’ll be able to compare and contrast. Got it?
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_3a_VEN: I was contacted by a distraught woman from the mainland. Her husband served as a UNLRA peacekeeper but did not return with the others. She has not been able to get any answers through official channels, so she turned to us. What caught my attention is that he mentioned visiting a “dangerous area” northwest of Tiger Bay shortly before the evacuation. I suspect he meant Ground Zero, which raises the possibility that he was deliberately left behind. Something may have happened to him. Just like it did to others who were exposed to that place. Of course, that is only a hypothesis. I didn't say like that anything to her, but we should prepare for the worst.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_29_Debriefing:
I wasn’t expecting this.

I thought you were going to find something about the local drug trade, embezzlement, maybe even human trafficking, but this doesn’t look like it’s about money at all. The list of families not allowed to evacuate makes a certain kind of sense. Narith and Park probably didn’t want anyone getting out and running their mouths. But entire villages, forced to stay behind?

Now we know that not evacuating Ban Phouphienge wasn’t some UNLRA oversight. They were actively prevented from doing so. But for what? And then there’s that note about Phase 3, and considering the entire village ended up massacred...

Just what the hell were they planning?
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_20_AcceptMsg:
I'm afraid I have bad news. Judging from all that you've managed to uncover at the Blue Lagoon, I am fairly certain it wasn't just slavery or sex work that the kidnapped tourists were subjected to. I feel queasy just thinking about it, but we have to explore all plausible avenues to find out the truth.

We know that some of the poor people were transported to Tiger Bay, so I'll need you to search the place and look for any large amounts of medical waste or other signs of unauthorized surgery. If you find something like this, gain access to the house, search it, and report back to me.

God, I really hope I am wrong on this one...
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obj: I'm at the cement factory. I’ve found the informant's body - he was hacked into pieces.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I'm in one of the UNLRA dormitories. I've found a letter from Lae. It ends with, quote: "Let's meet at the pond."
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I'm in the convenience store. I've found a letter from someone associated with the UNLRA. It appears they were romantically involved with Lae.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5c_PLAY: I've found an inventory list. From the looks of it, their supply situation is even worse than ours, with no respite in sight. However, they are fully stocked on hazmat suits and iodine pills.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5b_PLAY: I've gained access to a laptop in a makeshift operating room. It appears that the LAF garrison here suffered multiple casualties, both from the PMCs operating in the region and from an unknown force residing in Ground Zero.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5a_PLAY: I've located a laptop in an improvised comms room. According to the logs, the LAF stationed here is still sending regular reports to someone in Midnight Sapphire. They were also given orders to guard Tiger Bay with their lives and to shoot any trespassers on sight, whether foreign or domestic.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obj: I've located the informant's house. He is absent, but I found a phone. Looking at the messages, the most recently sent one states: "HELQ CEMNT."
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_25_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I've located the missing Little Bird. As suspected, it’s situated northwest of Ban Pa. The pilot and the squad are all KIA. After examining their bodies, it appears they were all taken out by a sniper.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_21_Briefing: Instead of delivering the drugs to Turncoat, hand them over for proper disposal to Gunny.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_25_Briefing: Intel recovered from the deceased informant points to a rival buyer who has disrupted Turncoat’s weapons supply network in Tiger Bay. Proceed to a floating restaurant and place a tracker inside one of the weapon cases.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Briefing: Investigate LAF activity in Tiger Bay and locate a warehouse suspected of storing weapons and heavy equipment. Identify key assets on site, mark them for tracking, and await further instructions.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_20_Briefing: Investigate Tiger Bay for evidence of illegal activity related to the tourist kidnappings from Blue Lagoon. Search for large amounts of medical waste or signs of unauthorized surgery. If found, enter the location and report your discoveries to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Briefing: Investigate UNLRA activity around Tiger Bay and search their checkpoints along the southern road for documents that may explain their presence on the island before the Event. Report any findings to Handshake and await further instructions.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_11_Briefing: Investigate the UNLRA camp in Tiger Bay, secure any relevant documentation, such as evacuee lists, and report your findings to Artisan.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_13_Briefing: Investigate the area around Ban Pa for any intel related to signs of past cult activity and deliver your findings to Artisan instead of Handshake.
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Briefing: Investigate the area around Ban Pa for any signs of past cult activity and locate a possible house of prayer or sacred site. Recover any relevant intel and deliver it to Handshake.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_13_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the boat moored at Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_15_Briefing: Investigate the dock north of Ban Pa and search for records related to suspected smuggling activity tied to the village. Recover any logbooks or ledgers you find and deliver them to Banshee for analysis.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_13_Briefing: Investigate the harbor in Tiger Bay to locate a suspected weapons cache. Find the boat believed to be storing the weapons and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Objective_2_Description: Investigate the offices and report anything unusual
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_16_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the potentially mined bridge west of Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_20_Debriefing: It looks like he went insane after witnessing whatever is happening in Ground Zero and decided it would be better to take the easy way out. Shit. It’s like something out of a messed-up horror flick. Just what the hell is happening in that part of the island?
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_4_VEND: It really feels like they knew something was coming and prepared for it. Then they bailed anyway, even after operating here for months.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_20_AcceptMsg:
It seems that the UNLRA is doing their best to avoid answering any questions from the public, even refusing to provide information to the families of their employees. One such family has reached out to us, asking for our assistance in locating their missing relative.

The last contact they had with him was just before he embarked on some sort of "expedition" into the jungle, likely towards Ground Zero. From the communication transcripts provided by his relatives, we know he wasn't staying at the UNLRA camp; instead, he secured a room somewhere north of Tiger Bay Central. He frequently complained about the smell of fried seafood, so there's likely a restaurant nearby. How he managed to swing that, I have no idea, but it suggests someone may have been keeping a close eye on him.

Try to find him, or at least uncover what happened, okay?
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5c_VEND: It's good to know they’re undersupplied. I wouldn’t worry about that latter part, though; they probably have no idea what they’re doing. I’m sure we’re perfectly safe... not counting all the hostile resistance, of course.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_20_Debriefing: I’m glad that you're on my side with this. I think this is all the info we’re gonna get from that damn place. Hopefully, we can uncover more information elsewhere. I have some promising leads lined up and will contact you once I know more. You did very well, thank you.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: I’m going to need that backup drive you mentioned. Get inside the server room and bring it to me. If it’s locked, check the front office for the key or a code. From what I’m seeing here, I doubt they let the workers anywhere near it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I’ve accessed a connected terminal. Pulling emails and logs, and sending them over. Looks like there’s more, though. I’m seeing mentions of backups stored on-site.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_27_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_28_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_25_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I’ve found an abandoned cottage in the jungle. The inside looks like a scene from a bad horror movie, complete with a freezer full of human remains. If the runaways sought refuge here, they definitely didn’t find it.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_17_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I’ve located a house in Tiger Bay that has a room converted into a listening post. There’s a radio station and a codebook written in Cyrillic.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_17_PLAYER_BecameAvailableDia: I’ve located a house in Tiger Bay that has a room converted into a listening post. There’s a radio station and a codebook written in Cyrillic.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_4_PLAY: I’ve located joint LAF and UNLRA documents. From what I understand, the UNLRA made guarantees that certain people would not be evacuated. Not just individuals, but entire villages - especially around Fort Narith.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_26_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I’ve located the UNLRA convoy. It looks like they were ambushed by a well-organized force, resulting in the massacre of both the civilians and UNLRA personnel. There is no sign of Osprey among them.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Objective_3_PLAYER_Obje: I’ve located the UNLRA staff member - he’s dead. The multiple stab wounds on his body combined with all the empty bottles of alcohol scattered around suggest Lae may have gotten him drunk before taking him out. It’s unclear if she acted alone or had help. There's no indication of where she might have gone afterward.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_4a_PLAY: I’ve located weapon caches at the northern entrance to Tiger Bay Central. It doesn’t look like they have much here.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_3_PLAY: I’ve managed to gain access to an LAF laptop. Its logs are full of contradictory orders from the last stages of the evacuation. It looks like complete and utter chaos. Some parts of the LAF were ordered to engage the UNLRA, while others were instructed to assist them. This seems to stem from who was present on which evac convoys.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_3_PLAYER_O: I’ve marked their reserves. From what I’ve seen, we don’t have to worry. There are mostly old trucks and no tanks. They are more ready for the scrap heap than for battle.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_29_Briefing: Jan Park, the Vice President of Lamang, has disappeared and abandoned his office. Infiltrate the Municipal Office Building in Tiger Bay, near the former UNLRA Refugee Camp. Locate Park’s office and the archives. Gather intel related to corruption and report your findings to Banshee.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_26_Briefing: Lab Rat has requested assistance in locating Neil Osprey, a renowned astrophysicist recruited by the UNLRA. He was last heard from during the evacuation. Trace the UNLRA convoy, investigate what happened en route, and determine Osprey’s fate.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_14_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_15_Briefing: Lab Rat needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to her.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_21_AcceptMsg:
Let's cut to the chase. I don't have time for long talks.

I need you to look for a few specific items. Reconnaissance teams were unable to narrow down the exact location where to look for them, so you'll have to sniff them out. You're not a rookie, so you'll pull it off.

Any questions? If not, then off to work. I have to keep Base Camp afloat.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_21_AcceptMsg:
Listen, I know you’re here for the money. Hell, I’d say all of us are. But there comes a time when you draw a goddamn line in the sand and say to yourself, “I ain’t crossing this shit!” I’m pretty sure that time has come for you right now.

I couldn’t help overhearing your conversation with that asshole. You know what that stuff can do, right? I’ve seen too many good people slowly eaten from the inside out or dying outright because they took a speck too much. Let me ask you: do you really want to be a part of that?

Bring the shit to me. I'll get rid of it so it doesn't end up in the wrong hands... especially that prick's.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_25_AcceptMsg:
Listen, do you have a minute? I've thoroughly examined all the intel gathered at the Blue Lagoon, and I found something very interesting. It seems that two tourists managed to escape that hellish place, and nobody knows where they are! The notes left by the monsters running the human trafficking operation suggest they fled northwest of the Lagoon and disappeared somewhere in the jungle.

I know it’s a minuscule chance, but what if they’re still alive, hiding through everything that’s been going on here? Please, would you try and look around there? Even if they didn’t make it, at least we’ll know what happened to them.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_4_VEND: Listen, there's bound to be more intel. I can feel it. The UNLRA business fucking worries me. It doesn't add up. We need to figure out what they were really doing if we want to make sense of everything else that has gone sideways on this island. Humanitarian cover stories are cheap. Setting up an entire UN specialized agency is not. That kind of effort means there was something very specific at stake.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_11_Subobjective_1a_Descri: Locate a stash of high-grade fentanyl around Ban Pa
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_5_Desc: Locate an active UNLRA terminal inside their HQ at Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_1_Desc: Locate intel at the southern UNLRA checkpoint
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_21_Objective_1_Description: Locate the AZART P1 Radios and report back to Gunny
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Banshee_13_Objective_1_Description: Locate the Biometric Thumb Drives and report back to Banshee
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_15_Objective_1_Description: Locate the Disinfectants and report back to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_20_Subobjective_1a_Descrip: Locate the IDs near Blue Lagoon
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_3_Descript: Locate the LAF warehouse in Tiger Bay and identify the military reserves
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Vulture_15_Subobjective_1a_Descriptio: Locate the box of samples on the top floor
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_01_Subobjective_2a_Descript: Locate the flash drive stored at the Kuna shop inside Tiger Bay Central
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_3a_Des: Locate the medical records in Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Objective_3_Description: Locate the pond southwest of Tiger Bay Central and find out what happened to Lae Sayasane
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_11_Debriefing: Look at this shit! This isn't a list of evacuees, but a list of people that were forbidden to leave the island! I knew there was something else going on here!
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_4b_VEND: Looks like they're running lean. Good. The less they have, the better.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_16_Debriefing: Man, this has got to be one of the most infuriating things I’ve encountered in this fucking country. They want to fuck with us like this? We’ll catch those bastards and shove those "explosives" so far down their throats they’ll shit bricks!
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_14_Debriefing: Marvelous! You truly have a gift for reliability. And discretion, of course. Please accept this token of my gratitude. Until we see each other again, friend.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_18_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I need you to investigate something. I've got more and more poor people who were forced from their homes contacting me, trying to find out what happened to their relatives and friends who disappeared during the UNLRA's "evacuation" bullshit.

The so-called saviors simply put everyone on trucks like cattle and drove them to God knows where. Officially, they all went to Tiger Bay, but a few of these convoys disappeared and never arrived at their destination.

I know for sure about one of the missing convoys from Kiu Vongsa. I managed to find out that it was last seen on the road past Pha Lang Airfield, heading towards Tiger Bay. That means you might find some clues about the convoy somewhere on the road northwest of Ban Pa. Now go; try to do something positive for a change, hm?
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_13_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, I see that even your superiors are taking an interest in that forsaken village. Well, I am also still interested, so why not do what I’m sure you do best, backstab those pricks you’re working for, and bring anything you dig up to me, hm?

Maybe I’ll even feel generous and share anything I can figure out with you.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_12_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, make yourself useful and help me get to the bottom of this UNLRA shitshow. Based on the list you brought me last time, it seems the UN had some instructions not to let certain people out of the country. I want to know who gave those orders. It's disgusting that someone would just decide who has the right to survive and who doesn't.

I need proof of their misdeeds. Go to Tiger Bay, search their camp, and bring me anything that can point us in the right direction. These foreign cunts won't get away with this.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_11_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, you have to do something for me. Don’t worry, I know you lot wouldn’t save your own mothers from a nursing home fire if they didn't pay you upfront, so rest assured that you will be rewarded.

I think even you can now agree that what the UN did here was a total sham. It wasn’t an evacuation; it was expulsion, and I won’t stop until I know why. I need you to head out to the UNLRA camp in Tiger Bay and find any relevant documentation. Start with a list of evacuees. I need to know who got out, at least according to them, and why some were left behind. I refuse to believe this all wasn’t a part of some sick fucking plan.

Well? What are you waiting for?
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_19_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the LAF commander in charge of Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_01_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies in the Tiger Bay residential area
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_17_AcceptMsg:
Not too long ago, we received a tip about a tourist who was behaving strangely and didn’t evacuate with the others. This individual is described as an athletic-looking white male who vanished just before the chaos erupted. While it’s possible he’s just a random person acting oddly, I have my doubts. It seems unlikely that someone would disappear like that right before shit hit the fan.

I have a strong feeling you’ve just stepped into this guy’s hideout, so search the place thoroughly and bring back anything that might tell us more.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_17_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Now that is pretty damn suspicious! I think I have a hunch about what we're dealing here, so have a look at your active tasks.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_17_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDia: Now that's pretty damn suspicious! I think I have a hunch about what we're dealing with here, so have a look at your map. I've marked something for you.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Debriefing:
Now we are one step closer to finding out the extent of what actually happened here. Give me a sec…

Yes, I knew it! They were researching the changes the Event had on the affected population. Let's see... complete cellular degradation... profound alterations at the molecular level... manifestations of psychosis... Oh! Thank you for the records! These medical files are full of strange data, but given our own research, it's nothing I wouldn't believe. I'm eager to learn more!

All of this is so fantastic! Thank you for the samples, especially the one from the peacekeeper; it will help me a lot with my research. it all ended up really well, didn't it?

Oh, and I will inform the widow of the tragic outcome of our search, of course...
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_13_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_F: Of course, exactly as I expected. You really love licking your bosses' boots, don't you? Now, go play fetch like a good dog and piss off.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_5_VEND: Of course. Otherwise, it would be too fucking easy, wouldn’t it? Try looking around their dormitory space and see if you can figure out what happened to him.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_25_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Oh God, no... Is there really not a single place on this... fucking island devoid of human misery and suffering? I don't think I can take much more of this...
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_26_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Oh my God! Was he taken? Who would target an astrophysicist? Sure, he’s a celebrity among scientists, but that doesn’t seem like a good enough reason to kill all these people just to get him. Please, look around and see if you can find his laptop. Neil never left the house without it, so if the unknown assailants didn’t take it, we might be able to gather information about his research - and figure out why they abducted him, of course!
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_21_AcceptMsg:
Once again, I would greatly appreciate your cooperation.

I see you have already figured out what was happening in Ban Pa. My investigation led me in the same direction. I have to admit, I am impressed, but it is not over yet.

Everything points to this being just a small part of a larger operation. We can assume the bulk of the merchandise was smuggled abroad by ships, but there was likely a domestic distribution network as well. Tourists flocking in, itching for a taste of excitement, and ending up OD’d in a ditch somewhere. You get the picture. I would like you to explore that possibility.

I am still gathering evidence on the drug trade in Lamang, and based on what I have learned so far, there appears to have been a significant trading post in Tiger Bay. The Ban Pa producers were actively supplying pushers in that area, so I suspect you may find the drugs stored somewhere easily accessible within the Tiger Bay Central shopping center. Look for any place that would not raise suspicion but could conceal bags of white powder.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_13_Debriefing: One by one, we're checking off all the places where we might find something useful, and we keep coming back with jack shit. I really need to have a word with Handshake about the supply situation here. If it continues like this, we're gonna be ass-deep in trouble.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_1a_VEN: Outstanding! I hope it wasn’t too much of a hassle. Please, can you help me a little further? I need to know more about what the UNLRA was studying. Many people were examined before being cleared to leave the island, and given how rushed the evacuation was, there should still be medical files lying around that could be invaluable to my research.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Vulture_14_AcceptMsg:
Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

Search the place marked on your map. Bring back a… sample. I will study it… thoroughly. Then I can decide if it’s time for a… hostile… takeover.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Vulture_15_AcceptMsg:

ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Objective_3_VENDOR_Ob: Probably just some local occult bullshit. Keep digging. I’m sure if you search hard enough, you’ll find a closet full of Kool-Aid and tinfoil hats. These types are always the same.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Debriefing: Really? This is what you found out? Honestly, it looks like complete amateur hour. All this cult shit was most likely used only to scare people off. The question is why… Run along, merc. You did your job; now get out of my sight.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_13_Objective_3_Description: Recon the shed near a pond
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_25_AcceptMsg:
Remember when I told you about the beating we took and how we had to vacate some of our positions? The bastards who hit us were as organized as a Swiss watch. Initially, we thought it might be another rival company attacking us, but we later discovered they had been hit as well. Of course, it could just be some kind of psy-op from their side, but I doubt it. No, I believe there’s another force roaming around us, and we need to sniff them out.

At the time of the attack, we lost contact with a squad near Ban Pa. A whole team and a Little Bird just went dark, and no one has come back. This isn’t something a mere gangster could pull off. Those assholes must have been behind it.

Your task is to locate the missing squad. Focus on the area around the lake northwest of Ban Pa - their designated extraction point - and report back with anything that might give us a clue about what the hell happened.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_13_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: Reporting from a pier in Tiger Bay. Nothing useful in sight, except for a battered old boat. Looks like whatever was on board is long gone.

ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_20_Briefing: Several people went missing at Blue Lagoon, and their identities must be confirmed. Search the area for any stored personal documents, especially in locations where evidence might be kept. Recover the personal documents and deliver them to Banshee.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Since you’re already in the area, I need eyes on the Tiger Bay Central shopping center. The LAF turned it into their forward base, and I want a clearer picture of what kind of hardware they’ve got sitting there.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_12_Debriefing: So it's true. My gut feeling was right. This document clearly states that the ultimate fucking "good guys," the UNLRA were working with the Lamangese government. The UN troops cooperated with the LAF and had a deal that ensured there would be no conflict if the UN guaranteed that certain individuals would not leave the country. Fuck foreign intervention and fuck this corrupt state!
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: So she was whoring around with those Bluehead fuckers? Disgusting. But people are fallible, as you well know. Keep looking for her, merc. Check the UNLRA dorms for more clues.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_21_Debriefing:
So they used the bakery as a front. Exactly the kind of place no one thinks to question. I doubt the staff cared what kind of powder they were pushing, as long as the money kept flowing. 

This evidence will strengthen my case considerably. Thank you.
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_21_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fai: So, this is how it's gonna be, huh? You're really all just about the fucking money, aren't you? Well, at least now I know who I'm dealing with...
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_13_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: So, yet another failed attempt to get anything of value from this godforsaken island. I really need to stop getting my hopes up.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_14_Objective_1_Description: Store the package inside a cooler at a farmhouse southwest of the pond
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_25_Debriefing: Thank you for looking into this, even though it ended up as always. I honestly don't think I can keep doing this. Always getting my hopes up and then... I better focus on my research, yes. That's why I agreed to all of this in the first place. No more drama, no more needless death. I just need to take a step back...
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Subobjective_1c_VENDOR_O: That’s a Phi Kasu. It’s a vicious creature driven by extreme hunger and thirst. She’s active throughout the night until she must return to her body by daylight. Watch your back, merc. She can be behind you right now.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Handshake_13_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_26_Subobjective_2b_VENDOR_: That’s what I thought. The people “working” here weren’t doing it by choice. They were imprisoned and forced. Probably had their IDs taken by the owners and then told to earn them back.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_13_Name: The Call of Phi Pa Mum
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_AcceptMsg:
The LAF in Tiger Bay seems to be better equipped than we expected. The intel we've received from our sources indicates that there is a warehouse somewhere in the northern part of the area used to store their arsenal and heavy equipment. We know that much, but we need to pinpoint exactly what they have in stock and keep it under surveillance.

Based on past experience, it's highly unlikely they'll have anything particularly advanced, but armor is still armor. I don’t want to crawl out of bed one day and find a couple of T-55s parked in front of our base. That'd be one hell of a wake-up call.

Find their warehouse, identify the hardware, and mark it. I'll have the trackers sent to your locker. Once you’re done, we can adjust our plans based on what we learn.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_1_VEND: The documents state that the UNLRA was here for humanitarian reasons, yet when shit hit the fan and it was their time to act, it’s almost as if they completely shifted focus and screwed over the people they were supposed to be helping. The subsequent evac felt more like they were trying to get rid of any witnesses than anything else.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_20_Debriefing: These monsters must have been operating here for a long time right under everyone's noses. I can't believe something like this went on for so long without anyone noticing. Were they really that clever, or, even worse, did some higher-ups give them their blessing and cover it up?
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_20_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_F: This is very unfortunate. I really believed you and I were on the same page. I suppose it's all about the reward for you, isn't it?
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_13_Debriefing:
This... this is nonsense! Complete fucking nonsense! These people were playing us all for fools. Now I'm not even sure if those tales about mutilated bodies hold any truth. Likely a part of the same scam to scare folks away. 

I just can't wrap my head around why those bastards from the LAF turned a blind eye to it. They had no qualms about cracking down on everyone else on this island, so why let this slide?
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_14_Objective_1_Description: Transfer the data from all the measuring stations at Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_14_Subobjective_1a_Description: Transfer the data from the first station
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_14_Subobjective_1b_Description: Transfer the data from the second station
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Labrat_14_Subobjective_1c_Description: Transfer the data from the third station
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_8_Briefing: Travel to Ban Pa and investigate rumors of cult activity and ritual killings. Search the area for symbols, murals, statues, or any other evidence of occult practices and determine what truly happened there. Report all findings back to Artisan.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Briefing: Travel to the UNLRA checkpoint west of Tiger Bay and locate a specialized testing kit used for research into the effects of the Event. Recover the equipment, report back to Lab Rat, and await further instructions.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_19_Briefing: Turncoat has a problem with the LAF commander of Tiger Bay. Neutralize the target.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_10_Briefing: Turncoat has found a way to utilize the personal documents of the missing Blue Lagoon tourists. Search the area thoroughly, retrieve the documents, and deliver them to Turncoat.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_13_Briefing: Turncoat is interested in acquiring more information regarding the island's drug trade. Recover the evidence and deliver it to him instead of Banshee. Leave it at a drop-off point northwest of Tiger Bay Central.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_01_Briefing: Turncoat is seeking revenge. Proceed to the Tiger Bay residential area and eliminate the hostiles operating there.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Turncoat_14_Briefing: Turncoat needs a favor, as there's something he desperately wants to possess. Locate the item he seeks and store it at the designated location.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Briefing: Turncoat's informant in Tiger Bay has been compromised and is in immediate danger. Head to the southern part of Tiger Bay, find the house behind a small garage business, and safely extract the informant.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_25_Briefing: Two tourists escaped a human trafficking operation at the Blue Lagoon and fled into the nearby jungle. Search the area for any trace of them, uncover what happened, and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_7_Desc: Use the security card to access the terminal and download the data from the server
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_11_Debriefing: Very good! I am glad to see that you are an intelligent man who is not afraid to seize the day, and I have to say I feel genuinely delighted by our friendship. To future endeavors!
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Objective_1_VEND: Very interesting. But I need to know more. The entire UN operation here stinks to high heaven. How is it possible that so many people have gone unaccounted for during and after the evacuation? I mean, I always pick incompetence over malice, but this is still suspicious as hell.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Subobjective_5a_VEND: Very interesting. Could it be that the son of a bitch leading this country is holed up somewhere there? We'll have to look into this.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Vulture_14_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Vulture_15_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Debriefing: We didn't find Lae, but at least we know she's probably alive. A girl with her skills is definitely a survivor. I'll inform her friend of our findings... Why are you looking at me like that? Should I shed tears for that pig? No way. I wouldn’t be surprised if he abused her or something and got what he deserved. Your job is done, mercenary; you can return to your own killings.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_20_Objective_3_VENDOR_Obje: Well, color me surprised. I guess I was too quick to judge. It’s possible that Lae is still alive, then. Merc, this looks like a somewhat satisfying conclusion to our search.
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obj: Well, that is very unpleasant. I was hoping a man of your talents would be able to save him. Unfortunately, there's nothing to be done.
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Subobjective_X_VEDNOR: Well, this is dissapointing. I suggest you shape up, and fast. You don't want to make the boss angry, do you?
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: Well, this is dissapointing. I suggest you shape up, and fast. You don't want to make the boss angry, do you?
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_24_Debriefing: What a tragedy, friend. What a tragedy. If you had brought him back alive, I would have rewarded you handsomely. Regrettably, you’ve only brought information about his sorrowful demise. But don’t grieve, friend. I know you did your best. Here is a small reward for your efforts; hopefully, it will motivate you to accomplish your next task. I will tell you more soon.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Objective_5_VENDOR_: What is happening on this island is truly fascinating... I mean, terrifying, but fascinating. The UNLRA had some top-notch scientists stationed here, so they must have made some interesting discoveries. And if that data is still sitting out there, it could answer some of our biggest questions about the Event.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_5a_VEN: What is happening on this island is truly fascinating... I mean, terrifying, but fascinating. The UNLRA had some top-notch scientists stationed here, so they must have made some interesting discoveries. And if that data is still sitting out there, it could answer some of our biggest questions about the Event.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_18_Debriefing: What kind of sick bastards would attack a convoy full of civilians? Was it the LAF? I wouldn’t be surprised, but I doubt they’d let the UNLRA move the people just to attack them later. And it's not like it explains almost everybody missing... I’ll keep digging into this, and you can stay on top of it as my little assistant, got it?
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Objective_5_VENDOR_: What luck! One last thing, I promise. The UNLRA stationed in Tiger Bay left behind some of their lab equipment. We know they were conducting some sort of research on the refugees, so I would like you to go to the camp and find any more samples left behind, if there are any.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Labrat_Quest_06_Subobjective_5a_VEN: What luck! One last thing, I promise. The UNLRA stationed in Tiger Bay left behind some of their lab equipment. We know they were conducting some sort of research on the refugees, so I would like you to go to the camp and find any more samples left behind, if there are any.
ST_Quests_Mall.Artisan_Quest_18_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: What the fuck? You're saying that someone organized an attack on an UNLRA convoy, but for what? Don't tell me they were after the people. This is a fucking nightmare...
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_4_VENDOR_O: While you're at the mall, I need one last window-shopping session. The LAF converted some of the shops inside to suit their needs. We’ve got partial intel, but not the full picture. Find their primary hideout inside the complex and figure out what they’re doing in there. I won’t sugarcoat it; this won’t be a walk in the park. But we need that information.
ST_Quests_Mall.LabRat_Quest_26_Debriefing: Who could have abducted Neil? I'd suspect the LAF, but why? I don't know... something doesn't seem right. God, I just hope he's still unharmed somewhere. At least we managed to find his laptop. Maybe there's a clue in there about where to look for him.
ST_Quests_Mall.Handshake_Quest_13_Debriefing: Would you look at that shit? A book about floating heads with hanging guts. Cute. I’ll relay what you found to the boss right away, and hopefully, he’ll be satisfied and let us do some actual work for a change.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Handshake_Quest_06_Debriefing:
Would you look at that! Unusual phenomena, mutated vegetation, contaminated animals and people... Well, well, well, we’ve gotten ourselves into some pretty fucked up territory. Not only that, but it looks like those UNLRA idiots also had some close encounters with whoever caused our unfortunate setback some time ago.

I have to say, this feels more and more like a fucking dumpster fire. I think I need to have a few words with the boss…
ST_Quests_Mall.Turncoat_Quest_11_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_: You are breaking my heart! I thought we were friends. Next time you might want to reconsider such actions. Friendship is a two-way street after all...
ST_Quests_Mall.Gunny_Quest_21_Debriefing: You did the right thing. Trust me, stuff like this is never worth the profit, and I know what I’m talking about, ok? Now get lost and keep your shit clean, you got me?
ST_Quests_Mall.CT_Gunny_21_Debriefing: You did well. Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_Mall.Epic_Gunny_Quest_02_Objective_4_VENDOR_O: You did well. Those cache locations will be worth their weight in gold when we move on them, and the fact that they’re lighter than expected is a nice bonus.
ST_Quests_Mall.Banshee_Quest_15_AcceptMsg:
You got a minute? I want to talk to you about a certain fishing village - Ban Pa, it's called. The name keeps surfacing in my investigation, and never in a good way. From what I’ve gathered, some seriously dodgy stuff was going on there, mostly tied to some kind of cult and smuggling goods out of the country. It’s the latter that interests me the most.

There’s a dock north of the village that saw a lot of activity in the past. Vans transporting something from Ban Pa, people loading it onto boats and shipping it off God knows where. Then the Event happened, and everybody just left.

If you’re interested, head to the dock and see what you can find. They must’ve been keeping records of whatever they were doing, so look for logbooks, ledgers, or anything of the sort they might’ve left behind.

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_29_Briefing: A reconnaissance team monitoring Fort Narith has gone silent after entering the jungle northeast of Savanpha village. Proceed to their last known position, determine what happened, and report back to Gunny.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_3_Debriefing: According to this document... the army was ordered to actively prevent civilians from evacuating?! What a bunch of monsters! Using innocent people as shields. But why? And... where is everyone? I need to think. This doesn’t make any fucking sense...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Vulture_06_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_04_Briefing: An LAF informant attempted to double-cross Handshake. Eliminate LAF soldiers as retribution, retrieve the flash drive from the building next to the air control tower at Fort Narith, and stash it at the designated drop-off point.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_17_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: And he's just lying there, and nobody noticed? Those assholes just left him to rot... You've done your job, merc. Come pick up your fucking reward.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_1_Briefing: Artisan believes the missing mechanic from Fort Narith was imprisoned in YBL-1. Enter the facility through the abandoned west entrance, search the archive, and recover any records related to his detention.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_2_Briefing: Artisan has lost contact with a mechanic who worked at Fort Narith and lived in the nearby village of Savanpha. Travel to the area, search for his whereabouts, and uncover what happened to him.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Briefing: Artisan has lost contact with her friend Jai Tan, who lives in a restaurant in Savanpha village near Fort Narith. She is concerned that the LAF may be involved in his disappearance. Head to Savanpha village, investigate the restaurant, and determine what happened to him.

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_04_Briefing: Banshee has expressed interest in the LAF jets stationed at Fort Narith. Locate the aircraft and mark their positions with GPS trackers. Ensure you bring the markers with you.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_22_Briefing: Banshee is interested in acquiring the folder as well. Retrieve the specified folder from the Fort Narith archives and deliver it to Banshee instead of Turncoat.

That's why I need you to collect samples from these individuals

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_29_AcceptMsg:
Can you believe this shit? We've lost contact with one of our reconnaissance teams. I swear, it's like the island itself is swallowing us one by one. Their task was to monitor Fort Narith and gather intel, but after they ventured into the jungle northeast of Savanpha village, we lost all communication.

I need you to head over there and find out what went down. Be extra cautious; these guys were no rookies. I regularly sent them out on dangerous assignments, so if someone managed to silence them, they’re likely a serious threat.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Labrat_09_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations in the Fort Narith area, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_3_AcceptMsg:
Do you remember the jets and how shitty they looked? I can't stop thinking about them. You see, I've heard some interesting rumors about a deal to modernize the Lamangese air forces, so this doesn't add up.

I'm really curious. I want you to go to the Fort Narith air control tower and look for documents that might shed some light on this mystery. It is obvious that someone fucked up... be it on purpose or by mistake; we better find out.

I would really appreciate it if you would help me find enough evidence to take down the big shots that are exploiting this country. If you're interested, you can start with getting your hands on those documents.
