ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_22_Objective_3_Descriptio: Ensure your survival and do not lose the packages
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Debriefing: Excellent work! Thanks to your diligent efforts, we now have a clearer picture of the LAF's operational plans. No one will so much as pick their nose without our knowledge, and not a single word goes undetected. Just how I like it!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_04_Debriefing:
Excellently done, friend! At last, I can take my associates on a pleasant stroll through the charming streets of those villages. If all goes according to plan, I might even name one of the new buildings after you. I can tell you like the idea...

In the meantime, enjoy your hard-earned reward.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Debriefing:
Fascinating. It appears that the soldiers underwent some... changes due to their presence inside Ground Zero. I can only imagine the extent of the physical alterations, as the preliminary findings reveal a vast spectrum of very unusual anomalies...

Based on everything you’ve found, it’s clear that Atsawin was sent to Ground Zero as well. The radiation levels there must be off the charts! I urge you not to set foot in that place until we know more.

While Atsawin's death is unfortunate, it has given us valuable insight into what we’re dealing with here. I’ll inform his girlfriend, and you should take a thorough scrub. Reach out to me immediately if you start feeling unwell, okay?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_3_Objective_1_Description: Find the water cistern near the barracks at Fort Narith and poison it
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_3_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I am well aware that you are having troubles with the fine young men in Fort Narith, and I want to help you. As an information trader, I sometimes come across interesting findings. In this case, it is the location of a very useful poison. 

There's a small shed to the east of Nakasa village where the locals used to store some rather unsavory chemicals and other harmful waste. Ha, I see you are starting to understand where I am going with this, right? Head over there, get your hands on some of the poison, and introduce it to the water supply in Fort Narith. Then just sit back and watch the magic. It won't kill them all, but it will undoubtedly weaken them.

What's my motivation? Let's say that the army hasn't been fair to me in the past. And knowing that you will give them hell puts a smile on my face. So consider this poison a token of goodwill - a gift to strengthen our bond.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_15_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I don't know who asked you to search for those orders, but I would be tremendously grateful if you could bring them to me instead.

This kind of information would be of interest to many, and I consider myself an expert when it comes to handling such demands. There's one particular person who would kill for these files, so your cooperation in this matter would be greatly appreciated.

Knowledge is power, and that is something I intend to possess.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_06_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I find myself in desperate need of your particular talents once again, and I simply cannot afford to wait!

There’s a rather sizable house in Savanpha village, just beside Fort Narith. A little bird tells me that something of great interest to me may be hidden beneath the bed on the second floor there.

If you’d be so kind, retrieve the item and discreetly drop it off in one of my little hiding spots - a storage shed near the Xiong Family Farm.

Do this for me, and you’ll have my undying gratitude.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_04_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I have a pressing issue that I need to address immediately.

I’ve got some lucrative investment opportunities around Fort Narith, but a band of freeloaders is standing in my way. Armed men have taken over the streets of Savanpha and Nakasa villages, making it far too dangerous for anyone looking to assess the abandoned real estate there.

It’s a shame to see such beautiful homes fall into ruin; such a waste of potential. I’ve made arrangements with a few influential entrepreneurs from the western part of Lamang who know how to ensure those properties are put to a far better use in the near future. And let’s be honest, the original residents wouldn’t want these ruffians squatting in their homes like they are now.

Friend, it is time to banish these squatters and make way for the free market. You’re not just doing this for me and my associates. No, you’re doing it for the good of the people… and, of course, for the reward I’ve set aside just for you.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_3_Debriefing: Friend, I must say that your unscrupulous approach to this task is truly laudable. Your actions have increased my respect for you.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_2_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I need you to do a favor for me, or to be more precise, for a... friend of mine who needs to disappear from official records. At Fort Narith headquarters, there are records of all the soldiers who have served or are currently serving at the base. I need you to locate one of them and promptly dispose of it.

I understand that infiltrating such a large military compound isn't easy, but I have faith in your abilities. You've proven you're not afraid of hardship, so I've arranged a reward that will certainly meet your expectations.

Find the archive containing the documents and throw folder 00616 directly into the shredder. I'm sure one will be available to you right inside the archive. After all, not all documents are meant to last forever, wouldn't you agree?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_22_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I require your professional assistance once again. It would seem that a couple of gentlemen have been running their mouths and need to be promptly hushed. I can't have anyone tarnishing my hard-earned reputation, as I’m sure you understand.

That’s why I’ve prepared two little... mementos to remind these rapscallions of their place. I may still have use for them, so I’d prefer a more... permanent solution only as a last resort.

You can pick up these reminders inside a barn at the Xiong Family Farm just north of Fort Narith. Please do so quickly, and then gently place one of them next to a water cooler in an office building just across the street from the main entrance to Fort Narith, and the other on a bed in a motel room in Nakasa village. The interested parties have been informed to look for them there. I’m confident that once they peruse the contents of the folders, they will be more than happy that no one else is around...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_15_VENDOR_BecameAvailable: Friend, a little bird told me that you're looking for some files about the civilian evacuation around Fort Narith. I have a proposition for you.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_16_Debriefing: Friend, great job! The soldiers must be running around the base like chickens hit by a hawk. I'm happy that you're happy. Now I'll sleep a little easier... I mean because you did what was best for you. Yes, that's why! Ha ha!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_3_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_F: Friend, it saddens me that you don't appreciate my gifts. I hope next time will be different; otherwise, I might be offended.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_15_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_: Friend, what are you doing? Don't treat me like a stranger. I'd be very sad if I had to... unfriend you.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_17_Debriefing: Friend, you are an unstoppable force of nature. Such a beautiful display of pure violence. I'm sure even Mr. Handshake will be happy to see your company spread its wings a little further. You have my gratitude for getting rid of the alien worm.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_17_AcceptMsg:
Friend, you are just as callous as I like, and I applaud your skills. It’s been like watching an artist craft his magnum opus. Truly inspiring. Now, there’s only one obstacle remaining: cut off the dragon's head - the commander himself.

I won’t pretend I have no grievances against him. It’s an affront to this country that such a critical military base is commanded by a foreign dog.

Now, go and complete your masterpiece. The time for a change in leadership is upon us!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_18_Debriefing: Friend, you did it! You are a true treasure. I'm sure you've figured out that I wouldn't send you for some shitty baubles. You just made the current commander of Fort Narith a lot poorer. Ha ha ha! He stashed his money in this briefcase, and you... Ha ha ha, the look on your face! I'm sorry I had to deceive you. You know how it is with money and friends - you just don't ask a friend for cash.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_18_AcceptMsg:
Friend, you got some spare time? I have a personal favor to ask of you. I had to abandon my home in a hurry and left some belongings behind. They are family heirlooms that I cherish very much. I left them in a briefcase, but I can't get there myself, so I'd like you to help me.

Naturally, you're my first choice, because I know you've got a good heart, and a struggling man looking for a heartwarming patrimony won't leave you cold... I'll also give you a big bonus! For your irreducible work and your willingness to help without asking too many questions. You will find the briefcase in the largest house in Nakasa village, north of Fort Narith. It's likely to be locked, so I suggest searching the backyard for a spare key. I seem to have misplaced mine...

So what do you say, friend? Are you interested in helping a local merchant in his time of need? You will not regret it, I can assure you.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_15_Debriefing: Friend, you have my thanks. If it weren't for your help, who knows what shady person would have gotten their dirty hands on these documents. I'm getting sick to my stomach just thinking about it.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_16_AcceptMsg:
Friend, you know that I only want what’s best for you, right? That’s why I’d like to make a suggestion: take out five of the officers at Fort Narith and bring their dog tags back to me as confirmation that they’re really gone. Don't worry, you will know who they are thanks to the berets these opportunists seem to wear even while lying in bed. This will surely create exquisite chaos among the remaining soldiers at the base, making your work here much easier.

Don’t look for ulterior motives, friend. I’m just an altruist who loves to help. Now, could the disappearance of these individuals benefit my continued well-being? Might it be true that these gentlemen possess certain information that shouldn’t be shared? Who knows! What makes you happy makes me happy… and to motivate you even further, if you do what’s best for you and dispose of them all, I’ll even throw in a reward! Just to see your joyful smile.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_2_Debriefing: Friend, you've done a great deed. By destroying these records, you ensured that my... friend can live substantially more freely. You have my eternal gratitude!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_1_Debriefing: Fuck! Those motherfuckers tortured him! Sick bastards! I'm gonna kill every last one of them! Thank God he wasn't executed, but they've transported him somewhere else, and I have no idea where! All this time, and I'm back to square one! Po, I'm so sorry... Why the FUCK are you still here!? Just get lost, okay!? I need to be alone!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Objective_4_Descript: Gain access to the computers at Fort Narith HQ and extract intel about the new commander
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_6_VENDOR_: Given our limited understanding of the situation, this information is vital. The lack of clarity surrounding the Event makes every piece of information valuable, and retrieving these samples would greatly assist us in our quest for the truth.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Objective_1_Description: Go to Savanpha village and find out what happened to Jai Tan
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Objective_2_Description: Go to the dumping ground near Savanpha village and locate Jai Tan
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_8_Debriefing: God, how could I be so stupid? I just wanted to help, and instead I nearly got you killed. Are you alright? I'm so, so sorry. I swear I'll be more careful next time. Please forgive me...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_04_Debriefing: Good fucking job, compadre! I hope that dipshit who betrayed us was among the ones you dropped. You really can’t trust anybody in this shithole. Anyway, here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_12_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_23_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_24_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_17_Briefing: Gunny is assessing fuel availability. Determine the amount of fuel stored at Fort Narith and report your findings.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Subobjective_3a_: Hack the camera at the air traffic control building
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Subobjective_3b_: Hack the camera at the main entrance
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Subobjective_3c_: Hack the camera at the northern entrance
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Subobjective_3d_: Hack the camera in the army headquarters
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Objective_3_Desc: Hack the cameras at Fort Narith
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Subobjective_4b_: Hack the central radio tower at Fort Narith
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Objective_4_Desc: Hack the communication devices at Fort Narith
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Subobjective_4a_: Hack the radio tower at Fort Narith airfield
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Subobjective_4c_: Hack the satellite dish at Fort Narith HQ
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_15_Briefing: Head out to Fort Narith and search the administrative areas for records related to the arrested mechanic. Locate interrogation transcripts or other official documents explaining why he was detained and report all relevant information back to Artisan.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_4_Descrip: Head to Fort Narith barracks and locate Atsawin Xiong's quarters
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_AcceptMsg:
Hey there, buddy. I've got a special task for you. A top-tier clandestine mission.

I need you to infiltrate Fort Narith, hack their surveillance systems, and seize their means of communication. We need as much intel on them as possible. I don't want to go a minute without being alerted when soldiers enter, or when they send a love message to their sarge. I want them on my screen 24-7. Like some Big Brother bullshit, got it?

I'll provide you with some state-of-the-art gadgets, and you just need to install them in the cameras and transmitters around the base. There shouldn’t be a single exchange we’re unaware of. Also, even if we intercept their comms, we need to know what they’re saying, so make sure to retrieve any documents that can help us decode that fucking crap.

Soon, we'll know more about them than their own mothers do!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_22_VENDOR_BecameAvailableD: Hey, do you have a second? We need to talk.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_20_AcceptMsg:
Hey, how are you adapting to being a spy? I hope you've settled in because I have another mission for you. While the hacked cameras are providing valuable intel, we still have blind spots that need addressing. Your objective is to infiltrate Fort Narith and gather actionable intelligence on the LAF’s patrol routes around the base.

I understand that intel like this won’t be readily available, so you'll need to dig deep. Focus your search in the barracks and identify any documents or communications that could give us the edge we need to eliminate these amateurs once and for all.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_24_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man. We're shifting our efforts near Fort Narith. There could be equipment inside that would really help us out, and we don’t want it rusting away out there, do we? Your task is to scout the base and search for any entrances or weak points we can exploit later.

Move stealthily if you can, but if a confrontation’s unavoidable, do what you have to do.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_08_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_12_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fa: How could you... I hope it was worth it.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_23_Debriefing:
I apologize if their presence here has made things more difficult for you, but rest assured, it was all part of a broader effort to eliminate them with minimal collateral damage. I simply did not expect them to be so… resilient.

Regardless, thank you for your help. Those detonators were the final piece they needed. Without them, everything they were planning is going to stall. Or implode. Either outcome works for me.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_22_Debriefing: I applaud your expertise, friend! I'm sure that once the two gentlemen learn what I know about them, they will hastily fall in line. Thank you very much for taking care of this little matter for me.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_17_Debriefing:
I can’t believe they would just leave him there… Don’t tell me the damn UNLRA didn’t check the place out! They probably just didn’t care and wanted to avoid the paperwork, fucking bastards. 

I hope you’re not that dumb to think this was really a humanitarian mission or, God forbid, a rescue. But why would you care, right? As long as the money keeps coming! Just go and play soldiers somewhere else, okay?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_4_PLAYER_: I found a notice stating Atsawin Xiong was moved to the infirmary. Anyone in contact with him is ordered to report there immediately, under penalty of execution.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_3_PLAYER_: I found call-up papers for Atsawin Xiong. According to them, he was ordered to report to Fort Narith ASAP.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_23_AcceptMsg:
I guess you've already figured out what the Cambodians are cooking up in and around the Sawmill. I've been following this particular group for a while and, regretfully, I must admit that I am at least partially responsible for their current mood and actions. However, to prevent them from causing harm on a massive scale and endangering your... work here, I need your help.

In order for them to successfully execute their plan, they need detonators that are currently being fitted at the Kongthab Depot, south of the Sawmill. If you are willing to help me and also yourself, head out there, find them, and bring them back to me.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Debriefing: I had my suspicions that Jai was working with the LLA, but now they say he was Narith's lapdog - a spy! I knew him from childhood... No! This must be a mistake. I refuse to believe he was just full of shit after all this time. But the LLA... I have to do something. This isn't right!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: I have no idea who these broadminded friends could be. Jai never mentioned anyone like that... Quickly, go look for him at the dumping ground. I have a bad feeling about this...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_8_AcceptMsg:
I just received a request regarding a missing person. An LAF guardsman named Long Vong. He was stationed at the FN-3 Auxiliary Base, which was overrun by the Lamang Liberation Army.

Before communications went down, he managed to send a message to his father, who then contacted me. According to him, Long was terrified. He said he was hiding somewhere in a bunker and begged for help… and then the connection was cut.

Naturally, his father fears the worst.

If he’s still alive, he won’t be able to stay hidden for long. I know the LAF aren’t exactly seen as the good guys around here, but his family has done nothing wrong. Please, go and look for him. And if there’s no hope left… then at least confirm what happened. His father deserves that much.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_12_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Subobjective_4b_VEND: I knew it! Call it a sixth sense, but I believe this Russki had something to do with the prisoner's escape.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Labrat_09_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_08_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_5_VENDOR_: I need more data. It’s possible that the infirmary at Fort Narith was also used to treat any affected civilians living around the base. I doubt they’d let anyone walk around freely if they had contact with personnel stationed at Ground Zero, so we might uncover something valuable there.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_04_AcceptMsg:
I need you on this now, man!

Those double-crossing local assholes! I recruited an LAF soldier who was supposed to hand over a flash drive containing intel about their little expeditions into Ground Zero. And just as one of our guys was about to grab it, the fucker pulled a pistol and tried to shoot him. Lucky for us, the weapon jammed, and our guy got out alive.

It happened just moments ago, so we’ve got to move fast! The flash drive should still be at the meeting point - a small building next to the air control tower. Get over there and retrieve the device. While that LAF snake was putting on his little theatre act, he flashed some of the data on it. There's definitely something we can use.

Once you find it, stash it in a car wreck near the airfield’s back entrance in the southern part of Fort Narith.

And while you’re there, send a message that we don’t get fucked with. Bury as many of those motherfuckers as possible!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_3_VENDOR_: I see. Please head out to Fort Narith and try to find his quarters in the barracks. Maybe we'll learn more there.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_1_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: I see. So it looks like there were multiple similar deals done in the past, and now they have pretty much nothing left! That sneaky son of a bitch!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_5_PLAYER_: I think I found him, but it's hard to tell, because his body is terribly disfigured. It looks like radiation damage, but I can't be sure. Whatever happened to him, he did not live through it.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_12_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDi: I urgently need to speak with you! Do you have a second?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_17_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I'm at Fort Narith. I've assessed the fuel levels in the tanks, and they’re completely dry. No gas to be found.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Objective_1_PLAYER_Ob: I'm at the checkpoint northeast of the complex. There's a destroyed LAF truck and dead soldiers on the bridge. It looks like they were heading from Fort Narith to reinforce the garrison at the complex, but the rebels anticipated their move. No usable intel found.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Objective_2_PLAYER_Ob: I'm at the checkpoint northwest of the complex. I found a map indicating something hidden in the jungle to the west. No other usable information.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I'm at the dumping ground. I’ve found Jai Tan - dead. There was a note on his body stating that he was executed for his crimes against the people of Lamang. According to whoever wrote it, Jai Tan was a government spy and a traitor to the revolution.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I'm at the restaurant in Savanpha village. There's no sign of Jai Tan, but I found a letter stating: "My broadminded friends contacted me unexpectedly. They want to meet at the nearby dumping ground. It's an unusual request, but I've never failed them in my duty." It seems like he was writing this for someone, but never got around to sending it.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_24_Debriefing: I'm glad we were able to rule out other, far more severe causes for the disease, but it still saddens me that people can act this way. When the rules of society come crashing down, we really turn into nothing more than animals, don't we?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Subobjective_4b_PLAY: I'm in one of the computers. The new commander's past is a complete mystery. No references, no records. The only thing here is his nationality - he's Russian.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_1_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I'm in the ammunition depot. Looking at the logs here, the LAF had a broad sideline selling weapons stockpiles. And from the empty look of this place, it was definitely very lucrative.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_04_AcceptMsg:
I'm really glad to see you again. If your schedule is open at the moment, I've got a straightforward job for you. According to my intel, there are fighter jets at Fort Narith. I need you to locate them and mark their positions with GPS trackers. Simple enough, right? I just need to assess what kind of hardware we're dealing with, and if those birds are still functional.

And please, keep it sneaky. I'd prefer if you could pull this off at night, when there are fewer eyes around to spot you, but it's your call.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_24_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I've found an LAF truck full of bodies. It seems they were dumping them in the river, most likely to get rid of their troublesome neighbors at the Sawmill.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Subobjective_4a_PLAY: I've gained full access to one of the computers at Fort Narith. Judging from the files here, the new commander arrived just three months before the Event, and was immediately put in charge of the base.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_8_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I've identified Vong's remains. He was tortured and then executed. Judging by the way things look over here, I think this was all a setup
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_17_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I've located the missing person. All indications point to an accident; a log fell on him and crushed his head.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_29_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I've located the recon team - all KIA. It appears they were ambushed. Two members were drowned in a small pond, while the last one had been shot.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_31_Briefing:
If the rebels really have outposts like this scattered across the island, we need to initiate a full sweep of the area and identify every last one. We can’t leave any potential threats unaccounted for!

Analyze the map and pinpoint the locations of the remaining camps. That way, we can eliminate any surprises before they hit us.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Handshake_Quest_04_Briefing: Infiltrate Fort Narith to compromise surveillance systems, intercept military communications, and recover any materials used to decode transmissions. Deliver the collected intel to Handshake.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_20_Briefing: Infiltrate Fort Narith to gather intel on LAF patrol routes. Search the barracks for relevant documents and report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_8_Briefing: Investigate the FN-3 Auxiliary Base overrun by the Lamang Liberation Army and search for missing LAF guardsman Long Vong, who was last heard hiding in a bunker during the assault. Determine his fate and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_3_Briefing: Investigate the Fort Narith air control tower for documents related to the purchase of fighter jets by the LAF. Secure any relevant records, then report your findings to Banshee.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_1_Briefing: Investigate the ammunition depot at Fort Narith. Assess the current stockpiles of weapons and ammunition, and report your findings to Banshee.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Objective_1_Descripti: Investigate the checkpoint northeast of YBL-1
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Objective_2_Descripti: Investigate the checkpoint northwest of YBL-1
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Briefing: Investigate the disappearance of a local man named Atsawin Xiong, last known to be living near Savanpha village east of Fort Narith. Track his movements, determine what happened to him, and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_5_Descrip: Investigate the infirmary at Fort Narith and locate Atsawin Xiong
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Subobjective_3a_Descr: Investigate what is hidden in the jungle west of the checkpoint and locate any intel
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_24_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Is there no low these people won’t sink to? The more I see of this island, the more it disgusts me. At least the good news is that our efforts here won’t be compromised by this. Just make sure to avoid that river… like the plague.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_22_AcceptMsg:
It has come to my attention that you accepted an assignment to retrieve a specific folder from the Fort Narith archives. All indications suggest that the soldier seeking to disappear from the records is a former army chief with blood on his hands. I understand you came here primarily to make money, but this could be a significant breakthrough in my investigation. I urge you to consider the bigger picture and assist me in capturing the bad guys.

While I may not be able to offer a reward as substantial as promised, your cooperation would greatly enhance my case. I hope this will be enough to encourage your support.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_12_AcceptMsg:
It has come to my attention that you have recently been tasked with poisoning the water supply at Fort Narith. I implore you not to proceed with this operation. Such an action is not only extremely dangerous but also profoundly inhumane. You must consider all potential consequences.

While the primary targets may be enemy soldiers, the effects of the substance, whether short or long-lasting, are still unknown. I understand I may not have much to offer to change your mind, but I urge you to reconsider.

Please bring the chemicals to me instead, and I will ensure they are disposed of properly.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_24_Briefing: It is essential to assess the condition of all the main entrances to Fort Narith in preparation for Handshake's upcoming operations. Proceed and check the entrances.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_1_Debriefing: It looks like the person I'm looking for sold wholesale. Thank you for your cooperation. This information will be helpful in my investigation.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_23_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_24_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a job for you, and I need it done fast. Got it?

Back when we still held some ground on this rock, we stashed a few ammo caches around for quick field resupplies. Now, with the situation being what it is, we need to find out if they’re still intact, and if so, recover them.

Your task is to check a few of these locations and report back whether the caches are still there and retrievable. I’ll send someone else to pick them up, don’t worry about that. I just need the intel.

There are four caches in total. I've marked the first one on your tactical map. Take care of it, and I’ll relay the rest to you as you go.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_6_PLAYER_: I’ve located the documents. The civilians around the base were exposed as well. While their exposure wasn’t as severe, the medical records still show some very strange readings.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I’ve located the first cache. Everything seems to be in order.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Objective_3_PLAYER_O: I’ve located the interrogation transcript. He wasn’t much of a talker, that’s for sure. The only intel the LAF managed to squeeze out of him is that he’s a contractor from Russia, and his company was operating on this island even before we arrived.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_24_AcceptMsg:
I’ve reviewed the reports regarding the notebook you found at the Sawmill, and the mention of a "strange disease" is quite concerning. To ensure our safety on this island and to uncover any leads about what actually happened here, I need your assistance with a detailed investigation.

Given the circumstances, the most probable source of the infection would be the river. Please examine it for any irregularities or anomalies that could explain the outbreak. If the river was used as a source of drinking water without proper filtration, it might account for the disease. Identifying any such issues would help us rule it out as a factor, so please check it thoroughly and report anything you find to me.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_6_VENDOR_: Just be very careful once you’re there. We’re still not sure what exactly we are dealing with, so exercise utmost caution, and everything will be okay. I promise.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Labrat_09_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_24_Briefing: Lab Rat wants you to investigate the river near the Sawmill for signs of contamination or other irregularities. Determine whether the river could be the source of the "strange disease" and report your findings.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_AcceptMsg:
Listen up. There’s a military base in the western part of our AO. Fort Narith, named after the asshole who used to run this POS country before he disappeared God knows where. That didn’t stop him from leaving his private army, the LAF, behind to make our lives here even more miserable.

Now, hitting the base itself would be a bad idea, so we’ll save that for later. What we can do is scout the area and look for potential outposts that’ll come in handy when shit hits the fan. And that’s where you come in.

There’s a military complex south of Fort Narith that seems to have been recently taken over by the local "freedom fighters," the Lamang Liberation Army. What’s strange is that the locals are wary of the place and affectionately call it The Hole. Normally they avoid it like the plague, but these guys swarmed in like locusts and drove the LAF out. We don’t know much about them yet, except that they’re not fucking around and they really hate the local military. That could be useful to us. So I want you to go there, scout the area, and figure out what these assholes want.

First, check the perimeter. We need to see if we can use these people in any way. The enemy of my enemy, got it? There are two bridges leading to Fort Narith that their guys are guarding, so start by gathering intel there. And if, for some reason, their patrols disappear… well. No one has to trace that back to us.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_1_AcceptMsg:
Listen, I had a deal that went sour with one of the officers at Fort Narith. I recruited him as an informant and gave him the money he demanded, but then he stopped returning my calls. I doubt something bad has happened to him. Rather, he doesn't want to take any risks after already receiving his reward.

Would you be willing to help me instead of that untrustworthy guy? I need you to find out what the weapon situation is over there. Just try to keep it quiet, please. We don't want the entire base on high alert.

Simply find their ammunition depot and check what they have left there. It's necessary for my investigation.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_17_AcceptMsg:
Listen, our supply situation isn't improving. We continue to face significant challenges in acquiring nearly everything we need from the mainland, particularly fuel. Fortunately, the military base appears to be well-supplied. We know they have various vehicles and machinery that consume gas like it's a staple diet.

I need you to infiltrate the military base and assess their fuel supply. Every drop we can seize from them is a critical advantage. We must scavenge as much as we can. Out here, each day feels like an uphill battle. It's like we're living in some goddamn post-apocalyptic movie.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_2_Subobjective_1a_Descript: Locate any intel about Artisan's colleague's whereabouts
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_31_Subobjective_1b_Descripti: Locate the LLA outpost northeast of Ban Pa
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_31_Subobjective_1a_Descripti: Locate the LLA outpost northwest of Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_31_Subobjective_1d_Descripti: Locate the LLA outpost northwest of YBL-1
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_31_Subobjective_1c_Descripti: Locate the LLA outpost west of Midnight Sapphire

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Vulture_07_Subobjective_1a_Descriptio: Locate the box of samples on the ground floor

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_3_Subobjective_1a_Descrip: Locate the poison in a shed east of Nakasa Village
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_24_Debriefing: Magnificent! Thanks to your hard work, we have a better understanding of the military base and its surroundings. Everything you did today will pay off in the near future, my man. Get some rest.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_17_Briefing: Malo Kethavongsa, an employee of the Tonmai Hainy Lumber Company, disappeared amid the chaos of the evacuation. Investigate what happened to him and report your findings to Artisan.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_04_Objective_1_Description: Mark all the jets at Fort Narith
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_06_Debriefing: Marvelous! You truly have a gift for reliability. And discretion, of course. Please accept this token of my gratitude. Until we see each other again, friend.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_15_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I want you to head back to Fort Narith and gather any information on the arrested mechanic. I don’t know what led to his imprisonment, but I need to know as much as possible. Look for interrogation transcripts or any similar files that explain why he was taken into custody. They’re likely keeping that kind of information in the administrative section of the base, so search the HQ from top to bottom and bring me anything relevant.

The reward is on the table, don’t worry. You don’t have to remind me that you only work for the right price, mercenary. I understand our relationship.

Now, don’t waste any more time and go!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_17_AcceptMsg:
Merc, wanna do some good for a change? I need you to track a missing person.

I know you and your buddies think that helping anybody here is a waste of time. Maybe apart from that egghead woman - you call her Lab Rat, right? - who seems to be the only person with at least a shred of decency, but these are my people, and I’ll see to it personally that you won’t make a half-assed attempt and call it a day. At least when looking for some of them...

Malo Kethavongsa was working at a logging site south of the Tonmai Hainy Lumber Company when all that hell broke loose. From what I’ve heard, everyone from there ran for their lives almost immediately and didn’t look back. His mother was one of the first to get booted off the island, so she couldn’t even look for him. I don’t know how she managed contact me from the mainland, but I bet it must have cost her everything she had left.

Now run along, look into his disappearance, and report back to me with anything you find.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_3_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, I have another one of your favorite assignments stemming from human misfortune. While most of the people on the island were part of the UNLRA "evacuation," the civilians living around Fort Narith were left behind. However, now they are nowhere to be found. I want to know what happened, and you're gonna help me.

Investigate Fort Narith and look for any orders related to UNLRA activities in this area. I suggest searching the air control tower, since the officers stationed there likely received instructions to monitor the situation from above.

Get moving.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_1_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, I need your help.

You've probably figured out that the Lamangese government isn’t too fond of criticism, and makes all dissidents disappear into that damned bunker, The Hole. It seems the same thing happened to my… colleague from Fort Narith. According to my sources, those fuckers held him captive there as prisoner number 23.

I need you to stop everything you’re doing and go through the west entrance to that place to access their archives. That section hasn’t been used for a long time now, so it should be easier to get inside. Once you’re there, look for any information on him. Anything, you understand?

And make sure you bring some light. As I said, those tunnels haven’t been used in a while, so who knows if there’s even any power down there. Usually, I’d find the thought of you fumbling in the dark very amusing. But not now. I cannot stress how important this is to me. 

Whatever you may think, how little you might care... please, help me with this...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_2_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, rejoice, the terrible fate that has befallen the Lamang people has brought you another task to satisfy your money-hungry heart. I've lost contact with a colleague of mine, and I need you to find out what happened to him. He worked as a mechanic at Fort Narith and lived in Savanpha village, east of the base. It shouldn't be hard to find.

I want you to look for him, or at least find out what happened to him.

Time is money, as your kind of people like to say, right? So don't waste it anymore and do your damn job, merc.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_AcceptMsg:
Mercenary, stop loitering; I've got a job for you. My friend Jai Tan has been staying in Savanpha village near Fort Narith, helping the remaining few villagers survive the harsh conditions of today's Lamang. Shocking, I know. He's doing something you probably don’t understand - helping others without expecting anything in return.

Don't give me that look. You know I'm right. You wouldn't lift a finger for me if I didn't pay you, so let’s not pretend you're the good guy here. Anyway, I've lost contact with him, and I’m afraid the damn army is behind it. I need you to find out what happened. He owns a restaurant there, so you can't miss it.

Now go! I’m not paying you to stand around looking confused.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_2_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_F: My friend is not happy with this outcome. I hope you never put me in such a situation again, because it could seriously damage our friendship.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_17_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the LAF commander in charge of Fort Narith
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_04_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies in the Savanpha and Nakasa villages
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_31_Debriefing: Nicely done. Let’s hope that’s really all of their camps. Stay sharp and watch your back. You never know when one of those bastards might pop out of the ground like a pissed-off gopher.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_17_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: No fuel at all? So they have all that stuff just sitting around? Damn it...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Objective_2_VENDOR_Ob: Now we're cooking! Go to that place and investigate. I'll be damned if there isn't something useful that will tell us what those assholes are up to.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_4_VENDOR_: Oh no, what on earth could have happened to him? Can you please go to the infirmary and see if you can find out more?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_17_Debriefing: On one hand, it's a relief that they can’t use their vehicles against us. On the other hand, it means we’ll have to find fuel elsewhere. If it weren’t for that damned quarantine...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Banshee_04_Debriefing: Only three, huh? So much for air superiority. Anyway, thanks for your work. I think I'll look into it further.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Vulture_06_AcceptMsg:
Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

Search the place marked on your map. Bring back a… sample. I will study it… thoroughly. Then I can decide if it’s time for a… hostile… takeover.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Vulture_07_AcceptMsg:

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_7_Descrip: Retrieve the samples from Fort Narith infirmary and report back to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_18_Objective_1_Descriptio: Retrieve the valuables from Nakasa village and report back to Turncoat
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_22_Briefing: Retrieve two intimidation packages from the Xiong Family Farm north of Fort Narith and plant them at designated locations to silence individuals threatening Turncoat’s interests. Place one near a water cooler inside an office building by Fort Narith’s main entrance and the other on a motel bed in Nakasa village.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Russian, you say? Interesting. Fort Narith recently got a new foreign commander. Try looking into his identity. Head to the Fort Narith HQ. It wouldn't surprise me if we found out he is his countryman. While you're there, see if you can find more intel on the prisoner. I want to know everything there is to know about this bastard. We have a lead, and we’re going to follow it like goddamn bloodhounds!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_3_Briefing: Scour Fort Narith for information on the missing civilians near the base. Search the air control tower for UNLRA-related orders, then deliver your findings to Artisan.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Briefing: Search Fort Narith for records related to a captured prisoner believed to be linked to recent PMC setbacks. Locate interrogation materials or related documentation and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_3_Descrip: Search Savanpha village and uncover what happened to Atsawin Xiong

ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: Second cache located. Where to next?
