ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Vulture_07_Objective_1_Description: Secure the box of samples and report back to Vulture
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_12_Briefing: Secure the chemical agents intended for use at Fort Narith and prevent their deployment. Deliver the substances to Lab Rat for disposal.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_04_Objective_2_Description: Secure the flash drive and store it at the designated drop-off point
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Gunny_04_Briefing: Several previously established ammo caches may still be intact. Check the marked locations, confirm their status, and report to Gunny on whether the supplies are recoverable. Additional cache locations will be provided as you proceed.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_29_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Shit! This doesn't look like the handiwork of the local hicks. Not only were they damn good at their job, but they were also extremely merciless. This just keeps getting worse and worse.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_2_Objective_1_Description: Shred the folder and report back to Turncoat
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_15_Debriefing: So he sabotaged the vehicles at Fort Narith? God, you old fool! He was always opposing the government, but to be so reckless... it's not like him at all. I must make some calls and find him quickly...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_2_Debriefing: So he was arrested? Ah, fuck! You stupid old idealist, what the hell have you done this time? Merc, I need some time to think. Why don’t you go away and kill some babies or whatever it is you do for fun, hm?
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Debriefing:
So, Narith Sayavong himself appointed Arkady Vititsky as the commander of the largest military base. That must have made the local racists extremely happy, hah. Never heard of him. But that's not surprising; the Russians have a lot of wild cards up their sleeves.

And the prisoner? No name, number, or unit, but it's clear the guy wasn't local, nor was he affiliated with either of the rival PMCs we’re dealing with here. However, it seems our enigmatic prisoner managed to slip through the LAF's fingers. Doesn’t matter, though. What truly counts is that we finally have some information on those bastards. They won’t be hiding in the shadows for much longer!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_06_Objective_1_Description: Store the valuable item under a storage shed near the Xiong Family Farm
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_12_Debriefing: Thank you. I genuinely appreciate your decision. You have proven that greed does not blind your humanity, and I won't forget that.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_Subobjective_4a_VEND: That timing can't be a coincidence. Showing up right before everything went to hell and walking straight into command raises a lot of red flags.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Handshake_08_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Briefing: The Lamang Liberation Army has taken over a military complex south of Fort Narith. Scout the perimeter, investigate nearby checkpoints, and gather intel on their operations. Report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Objective_1_VENDOR_Ob: They certainly seem to be smarter than the thugs we have faced so far. It looks like they have planned their actions carefully. Try to find some clues at the second checkpoint.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Labrat_09_Objective_1_Description: Transfer the data from all the measuring stations in the Fort Narith area
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Labrat_09_Subobjective_1a_Description: Transfer the data from the first station
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Labrat_09_Subobjective_1b_Description: Transfer the data from the second station
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Labrat_09_Subobjective_1c_Description: Transfer the data from the third station
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_17_Briefing: Turncoat has a problem with the new commander of Fort Narith. Neutralize the target.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_3_Briefing: Turncoat has a proposal to weaken the LAF troops at Fort Narith. Acquire the chemical agents from the shed east of Nakasa village and infiltrate Fort Narith to introduce the substance into the base’s water supply.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_16_Briefing: Turncoat has unfinished business with the LAF officers at Fort Narith. Eliminate five of them and retrieve their dog tags as proof.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_15_Briefing: Turncoat is interested in acquiring the orders as well. Recover the orders and deliver them to Turncoat instead of to Artisan.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Turncoat_Quest_2_Briefing: Turncoat needs a favor to dispose of a folder. Infiltrate the Fort Narith headquarters, locate the personnel archives, find folder 00616, and destroy it.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_06_Briefing: Turncoat needs a favor, as there's something he desperately wants to possess. Locate the item he seeks and store it at the designated location.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Turncoat_04_Briefing: Turncoat wants the villages of Savanpha and Nakasa near Fort Narith cleared of hostile elements to secure future business opportunities. Eliminate the armed group operating in the area.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Vulture_06_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.CT_Vulture_07_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_AcceptMsg:
We have got another missing local to track down. A young woman reached out looking for her boyfriend. He stopped responding weeks before the evacuation, and she has not heard from him since. According to what she gave me, he was living on a farm near Savanpha village, east of Fort Narith. His name is Atsawin Xiong.

I do not like these cases. Too many people just vanished when everything started to fall apart, and most of the time the answers are not good.

Please find him. Or at least find out what happened to him.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Gunny_Quest_04_AcceptMsg:
We may finally have a lead on the bastards who pushed us back. Looks like the Lamang Army is not as incompetent as we thought. They managed to grab a very suspicious-looking individual. Supposedly, he is no longer being held at Fort Narith, but there should still be a paper trail. Something that points us in the right direction.

I'm still furious how easily they caught us flat-footed. A goddamn shadow outfit right under our noses. But soon, we’ll have the opportunity to expose them for what they really are.

According to the intel we deciphered from the hacked communications, the prisoner was interrogated in the jail block. I’m certain the Lamangese used some "progressive" interview methods, so there’s bound to be a transcript we can use to get more info. Find it.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Gunny_Quest_29_Debriefing: We really have to be more careful when operating in the woods near Fort Narith. Shit, we really need to start being way more careful all the damn time! Looks like we're not fighting just some hicks with guns anymore. I'll inform the others; you get some rest.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_20_Debriefing:
Well done! With information like this, we are one step closer to seizing Fort Narith. And it gets better - this document reveals why the LAF is still hanging around and opening fire on anyone who dares to show their face near Fort Narith, Tiger Bay, and Midnight Sapphire. 

Executive Directive 423-A. They were ordered by El Presidente himself to protect all high-value targets after the UNLRA cleared everyone out. Seems like the main man was worried someone might do some snooping around after all the dust settled. Well, he was right about that...
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_22_Debriefing: Well, this is something! This folder contains a wealth of interesting and valuable information about a suspect I’m after. Thank you very much for your assistance. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_5_VENDOR_: What do you mean? If what you're saying is true, then you need to leave that room immediately. This could be extremely dangerous! Make sure to take some iodine when you can, and in the meantime, I’ll try to make sense of this mess…
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_19_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: What? Are you... FUCK! I don't believe this! What have those LLA bastards done?!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_8_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: What? Oh no… They used him as bait, and I fell for it! Please, get out of there immediately before more of them show up!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.LabRat_Quest_8_Objective_1_What?_Objecti: What? Oh no… They used him as bait, and I fell for it! Please, get out of there immediately before more of them show up!
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Handshake_Quest_14_Debriefing:
Would you look at that. So, YBL-1 stands for Yaderny Bunker Lamang 1. An old Soviet bunker, eh? Those commies really were everywhere.

From what you managed to retrieve, that place served as some kind of hardcore prison for opponents of the local regime, and the Lamang Liberation Army decided to take it over and bolster their ranks. Shit. I'm beginning to think this island is some kind of fucked-up party where everyone's invited. We really don't have time for this crap.

I'll have to think about how to best use this new info. In the meantime, get some rest. You did good, man.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Epic_Labrat_Quest_03_Objective_6_VENDOR_: Yes! I knew it! Thank you for your help. This is a significant find, and I’m excited to see where it leads. Hopefully, we can gather more data.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Banshee_Quest_3_Debriefing:
You just made my day! This document is exactly what I needed. It looks like the former base commander had a lucrative side business selling government weapons, but on this occasion, he bit off more than he could chew. 

He thought he could buy these wrecks and report them as new. The Lamangese government is as corrupt as they come, but they couldn't even turn a blind eye to what he had done this time. That's why he was kicked out of the army. He must have been a big shot if they did not execute him. Very interesting.

Thank you for this intel. I hope we can collaborate again.
ST_Quests_MilitaryBase.Artisan_Quest_3_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fa: You really don't give a shit about anything, do you? Hundreds of innocent people needelessly died, but who cares as long as you get paid, right? Get the fuck out of my face!

ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_2_Descript: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at Pha Lang Airfield
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_2_Desc: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at Pha Lang Airfield
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_AcceptMsg:
A certain wealthy group has contacted me to help them gain access to some computers at Pha Lang Airfield. Unfortunately, they have also reached out to our competitors, so we have a head start, but not by much.

You will need to locate a hacking device that has been stashed around the airfield. Just plug it in and let it do the work for you. The device is at the aircraft wreckyard, a dumping site next to the airfield.

Once you have secured the tool, your next step is to gain access to a PC somewhere on site. I do not have exact locations, but I am confident you will find one if you search the buildings at the airfield. All I know is that the machine should contain records of the “official” business being conducted there.

Hey, do not look at me like that. I am as confused as you are.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Briefing: A remote farmstead has gone silent, and early reports suggest possible exposure linked to Ground Zero. Travel to the site, investigate what happened, and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_04_Briefing: Artisan is looking for a missing individual working at Pha Lang Airfield. Investigate and uncover the fate of pilot Liko Savang.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_07_Briefing: Artisan needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to her.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_02_Briefing: Artisan needs you to deliver supplies covertly and without causing any casualties. Retrieve the supplies from the abandoned shed east of Fort Narith and deliver them to the radio tower.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_06_Briefing: Artisan's friend failed to check in as expected. Go to the construction site west of Pha Lang, find out what happened, and report back.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Banshee_08_Briefing: Banshee needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Bastards… Nothing we can do for them now. Just find the ones who did it.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_AcceptMsg:
Buckle up, we’ve got a hot tip.

Some shady PMCs were spotted combing through houses on the outskirts of Ground Zero. Might’ve been one of our rivals… but I doubt it. Intel says they were aggressive, like they were hunting someone. This wasn’t a casual sweep. They were on a mission.

I want you to check it out. My bet is they’re tied to the bastards who hit us. If I’m right, this could be our chance to nail them.

Search the area, check those locations, and report everything you find before the trail cools off.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_11_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations near Pha Lang Airfield, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_06_Objective_1_Description: Check on Artisan's friend at a small construction site west of Pha Lang
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Chemical barrels? But what… Do not open any of them! Do not even touch them or go near them, okay? I was wrong. This probably doesn’t have anything to do with Ground Zero, but it could still be very deadly.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: Chemical barrels? But what… Do not open any of them! Do not even touch them or go near them, okay? I was wrong. This probably doesn’t have anything to do with Ground Zero, but it could still be very deadly.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Subobjective_2a_Descript: Collect samples from one of the villagers
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Dead end. At least we know they’re fighting among themselves.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_33_Objective_1_Description: Eliminate the leader of the hostile group occupying Pha Lang Airfield
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_3_VEND: Fantastic job, my man! Listen, since you're already there, why not make the most of it. As we get closer to Midnight Sapphire, I need to know who the armed group currently occupying that airfield actually is. I would rather not get caught with our dicks in our hands while we lay siege to that place, understand?
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Objective_2_Description: Find out what happened to the bodies
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_03_Objective_1_Description: Find the Chichor family and bring them the supplies
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_4_VEND: Find the flight manifest database, and bring it over here. I’m sure that even a backwater country like this didn’t store all that shit on paper, so look for a PC and see what you can get from it. And remember, the password is usually “password.”
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Turncoat_11_AcceptMsg:
Friend, could you spare a moment of your time to help a friend in need?

How is your relationship with hiking? There’s a package waiting for me atop the lookout tower inside the Dongphou Hiking Camp up on a hill west of Pha Lang. I need you to retrieve the package and relocate it to a far less conspicuous location - a storage shed at the base of the hill, just south of the camp.

Please, do it as quickly as possible, but don’t forget to take in the view. It truly is a spectacular sight.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_06_Debriefing: Fuck! I thought this would go south. If we lost even the letter... What?! What are you still doing here? Oh, right. Stop grumbling, hireling. Here's your reward. Now, go bother someone else!
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Good job. Now confirm whether the drugs are actually on site. They would not store that kind of cargo near the main terminal. Check the hangars and any outbuildings you can access.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_20_Debriefing: Good job. These types of people are stubborn. They won’t learn and will keep pushing back for the foreseeable future. For now, though, we’ve got some breathing room.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Banshee_08_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: Good work. I’ve already contacted my colleagues to search the refugee camps for the owners of the property. If they made it off the island… they’ll wish they never did.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Briefing: Gunny received information about unknown PMCs seen sweeping houses near Ground Zero. Investigate the area and check the marked locations to determine what they were doing.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_03_AcceptMsg:
Hey man, I need you to act fast.

Those fuckers holed up at Pha Lang Airfield are really pushing it. I’m trying to gather some valuable intel from Midnight Sapphire, and guess what? They’re poking around there too, getting in the way, screwing everything up.

I’ve had it. No more Mr. Nice Guy.

Take out as many of them as you can. They should’ve cleared out while they still had the chance. Now they’ll pay for staying.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_03_AcceptMsg:
Hey, listen. We have more civilians who need our help. The Chichor family was left behind during the UNLRA evacuation, and we need to make sure they make it through this. They live west of Pha Lang, next to the main road, just north of Pha Lang Airfield. Their home is a semi-decayed building. I have no idea how they even get inside since the doors are barred shut. Maybe that's why they were overlooked; the peacekeepers probably didn’t realize anyone was living there.

Please, be kind when you bring them the much-needed aid. They've endured so much, and even before the Event, they were mistreated because of their ethnicity. Oh, and say hi to Makmangkon - she's a lovely doggo.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_AcceptMsg:
Hey, you got a moment?

During my investigation into Lamang’s rampant corruption and crimes against humanity, I came across a place linked to multiple missing persons cases over the past few years: Sunny Skies Guest House.

Some of these disappearances date back to the mid-2010s, while others are as recent as just days before the Event. None were ever resolved, and the people were never found.

I know you probably have more urgent matters to attend to, but we now have an opportunity to thoroughly search the place and uncover what was really happening there. You’ll find the guest house by the road, west of Pha Lang Airfield. You can practically see it from the end of the runway. Go check it out. With your help, maybe we can finally close these cases for good.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Debriefing:
Hopefully, it will now be possible to identify most of the victims and return their remains to their families. We’re following up on the owners as we speak, but so far, they’re nowhere to be found. You know I prefer to do things by the book, but in this case… I hope they suffered as much as the people they hurt, before dying very, VERY slowly.

In any case, if they’re still alive, we will find them. You have my word.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_11_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: I arrived at one of the houses. A local was living here; he was shot. Doesn’t look like there was any reason for it. More like they did it for fun.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I found a truck parked in the middle of the farm. It’s loaded with blue chemical barrels. The same kind is scattered all over the place too.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_03_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objectiv: I found the Chichor family, they are dead. Someone executed them and displayed them in front of the house, even the dog.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I found where they dumped the bodies. It's by the river. They couldn't even be bothered to drag them too far. Most were probably carried away by the current, but there’s still more than enough to aid your investigation.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Debriefing:
I had some time to go over what you sent. These Thai boys figured the post-evacuation chaos would make this a simple snatch and grab. Turns out they did not count on the LAF sticking around to guard the Midnight Sapphire Resort. According to the comm logs, they are not getting any backup until the job is done. Sucks to be them.

Oh, and thanks for the hard drive. I have to say, some of these names do pop up! Politicians, celebrities, entrepreneurs, you name it. All of them flocking here to have a taste of something they can’t find anywhere else, it seems. Just what was so special about this fucking place?

To be honest, this makes me even more interested. Looks like the resort could be full of some juicy shit that I’m sure some rich bastards would pay a pretty penny for. What do you think?
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_3_PLAYER_O: I have found the guy with the list. As expected, he is dead. The list contains these names: Owney Madden, Danny Greene, Dean O’Banion, Whitey Bulger, Tom O’Folliard, John Kinney, Khun Sa.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Banshee_08_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_11_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_11_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: I need one more thing from you. Have a look around the house, especially the backyard. We need to know what they did with the rest of the bodies. Maybe then, after identifying all the victims, we can finally put this to rest.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_AcceptMsg:
I owe a favor to an old friend who reached out asking for a helping hand.

He claims that something suspicious was going on at Pha Lang Airfield and that it was related to the cargo they were transporting off the island. Putting it bluntly, they were smuggling drugs. And not some street trash. Something high grade. There's a strong reason to believe that this entire operation had government backing and that they used civilian planes to get the drugs to nearby countries. He needs to know more.

Your goal will be to find and report the contents of a document listing names that supposedly "cannot get into the wrong hands." The list should be on one of the smugglers connected with the operation. Last time anyone heard from him, he was fleeing from something - or someone - at the airfield toward Midnight Sapphire.

Good luck, and don’t screw this up.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_04_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objecti: I think I found your guy. Looks like he tried taking off, but gravity had different plans. He managed to crawl out of the wreckage, but he didn't make it.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_06_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objecti: I'm at the meeting point. Your friend is dead.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I've gained access to the basement. It's clear the owners were killing their guests. They probably drugged them, dragged them down here, tortured them, and then cut them to pieces. There are a few bodies still here, but it looks like the rest have already been... processed.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_4_PLAY: I've gained full access to a laptop belonging to the hostiles at the airfield. Sending the data over now.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_4_PLAYER_O: I've located a narcotics distribution hub at the airfield. It looks like the drugs were being prepped here to be loaded onto planes.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_4_VEND: Interesting. It seems our boys here are out of town. Thailand, to be more specific. Some Thai big shot hired them to infiltrate the Midnight Sapphire Resort and extract sensitive material. Probably him doing God knows what with a pig or some shit, judging from the stories I heard about that place.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_1_Description: Investigate Na Xieng Farms and report your findings to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_4_Descript: Investigate Pha Lang Airfield and find proof of drug trade
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Briefing: Investigate suspicious activity at Pha Lang Airfield connected to drug smuggling operations. Track down a smuggler believed to be carrying a sensitive document listing key names, recover the list, and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the Sunny Skies Guest House and report your findings to Banshee
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the first house for clues
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_3_Description: Investigate the logging shed for clues
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_2_Description: Investigate the second house for clues
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_07_Debriefing: It took you longer than it should have, but whatever. You did your part. Here's your reward, merc.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I’m at one of the houses. Found dead locals outside. Looks like they were tortured before being killed.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I’m at one of the locations. Found a dead male. Looks like he was waterboarded and drowned. There’s a note on his body with one Russian word: deserter.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_3_PLAY: I’ve found the computer. The device is plugged in.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_02_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a run for you, and I need it done fast.

Look, I don’t want to treat you like a damn pizza boy, but I’m short on hands right now. I need you to hit a few spots where our guys are set up and drop off some supplies. The usual: ammo, grenades, water, rations.

You probably won’t catch them there since they’re out on a mission, but it doesn’t matter. They’ll know you came through. The supplies are stored in a shelter west of Pha Lang. Pick them up and deliver them ASAP.

Now get going; the sooner you handle this, the sooner I can cross it off my list.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_AcceptMsg:
I’ve gotten reports of a remote farmstead that has suddenly gone silent. The farmers there weren’t evacuated for whatever reason, but managed to get by on their own. At least until now. Nothing indicates an armed attack or raid of any kind, which makes the whole situation incredibly suspicious. Based on everything that’s happening here, I wouldn’t be surprised if it’s somehow connected to Ground Zero. That’s why I need your help.

Please investigate the farm and try to find out what exactly happened there. Take every precaution you can, keep your eyes open, and report everything you see!
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Debriefing:
Just as I suspected. Carbofuran.

Extremely toxic carbamate pesticide. Fast-acting and lethal through skin contact, inhalation, and ingestion. Incredibly effective against insects, but catastrophically dangerous to humans if misused. Which, judging by the quantities you described, they absolutely did.

The journal you brought back lines up perfectly. They probably drenched the fields. Spilled it. Breathed it in. Tracked it into their homes. Maybe handled it bare-handed. And once it gets into the body… there isn’t much you can do without proper treatment.

This wasn’t Ground Zero. This was just people trying to survive.

I’ll log this as a false positive and notify Handshake and Gunny immediately. That site is probably just as dangerous now as anything inside Ground Zero.

Thank you for your help. Stay safe, okay?
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_03_Briefing: Lab Rat is concerned because the locals are struggling and require immediate assistance. Ensure you have all the necessary items with you before setting out and deliver the supplies to the Chicor family.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_11_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_3_Descript: Locate and report the list on the road north of Pha Lang Airfield
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_07_Objective_1_Description: Locate the Acetylene Cylinders and report back to Artisan
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Banshee_08_Objective_1_Description: Locate the Businessman ID Cards and report back to Banshee
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Subobjective_3a_: Locate the SD autocracker at the wreckyard
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_06_Objective_2_Description: Locate the letter at the friend's house south of the construction site and deliver it to Artisan
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_33_Debriefing: Man, you were truly born for this! They must have been blown away when they met a real professional. Nicely done!
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Turncoat_11_Debriefing: Marvelous! You truly have a gift for reliability. And discretion, of course. Please accept this token of my gratitude. Until we see each other again, friend.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_04_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I've got a job for you. I'm looking for a certain individual who has been working as a pilot at Pha Lang Airfield.

The pilot's name is Liko Savang, and he's a spineless piece of shit. You two have that in common. From what I know, he got involved in some sort of huge drug deal, tried to skim some off the side, ended up in way over his head, and immediately hopped on a plane and tried to book it. Normally, I wouldn't care for a lowlife like that, but let's just say he and I are bound by blood, much to my dismay, so I need to know what happened to him.

Search the airfield and report back with any info about his fate, no matter what it may be, okay? I'll have your reward ready, don't you worry about that.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_06_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I've got a job for you. My friend wanted to meet, and we agreed that she would contact me when she arrived at the meeting place, but that never happened. I want you to make sure she's okay. We were supposed to see each other at a small construction site west of Pha Lang. It shouldn't be hard to find; just follow the main road.

Stop wasting time. You'll get your reward, so be on your way, hireling.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_07_AcceptMsg:
Merc, why am I not surprised to see you wasting time on your device again? Let me guess, some crappy gacha game, or porn? Figures. Typical mercenary shit. Anyway, I’ve got a job for you.

I need you to look for a few specific items when you're out in the field. There is no particular place to pinpoint, so you’ll have to do a bit of searching, but I'm sure you’ll manage.

Now, stop doomscrolling and get to work, hireling!
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_03_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies around Pha Lang Airfield
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_20_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies west of Pha Lang
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_03_Debriefing: Nicely done, champ! Those cocksuckers got what they deserved. I’m sure they’ll think twice before getting in our way again.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Debriefing: Okay, judging by this logbook, the narcotics were transported here from a yet unknown location, probably the production plant, and then processed, packed, and shipped off by planes with oblivious tourists inside. Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam, Thailand… they were quite busy, I see. With tourists on board the planes, the volume of the shipments wasn’t great, but they clearly made up for it with the frequent flights. You did well. My narc friend will be jumping for joy.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_4_VEND: One last thing, then I need you out of there fast, capiche? It looks like the Pha Lang Airfield was the main entry and exit gate for pretty much anybody visiting this little corner of “paradise.” Be it those rich assholes who stayed at the resort or the more down-to-earth kind with overstocked backpacks and fake Swiss army knives. Well, I have the boss on the line, and he would be very interested in gathering information about who those people were and if they managed to leave the island before what happened here.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_02_Subobjective_2a_Descriptio: Pick up the supplies at a shed

ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_03_Objective_2_Description: Place the supplies in a box by the front door at a house in Namhou village
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_02_Objective_2_Description: Place the supplies in a box inside a storage building at the radio tower
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_6_Desc: Retrieve the hard drive and report back to Handshake
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_3_Description: Retrieve the intel and report back to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_5_Descript: Retrieve the logbook from Pha Lang Airfield and report back
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_2_Description: Retrieve the samples and report back to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_4_Desc: Search Pha Lang Airfield and find out the hostile group's intentions
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Search for the villagers. If you find any bodies, carefully collect some samples for me. And try to look for any paperwork that might explain why so much of that stuff ended up here. Most importantly, please be careful.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Labrat_Quest_41_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: Search for the villagers. If you find any bodies, carefully collect some samples for me. And try to look for any paperwork that might explain why so much of that stuff ended up here. Most importantly, please be careful.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_3_VEND: Search the airfield and try to find where they are holed up. Once you locate it, report any intel that might shed light on what they are doing there. It may not overlap with our immediate goals, but they're still a nuisance. I would sleep better knowing exactly who we are dealing with, alright?
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_04_Objective_1_Description: Search the airfield and uncover what happened to Liko Savang
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Turncoat_11_Subobjective_1a_Descripti: Search the lookout tower at the Dongphou Hiking Camp and retrieve the package
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_02_Debriefing: See? Turns out you can finish a job without painting the walls red. Who got the supplies? Don’t ask. Safer for both of us if you stay in the dark. Just take the win, merc. You did a good thing… for once. Here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_02_Briefing: Several scout squads on patrol need to replenish their supplies. Pick up the shipment west of Pha Lang and deliver it to them.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_04_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objecti: Shit, that’s exactly what I was afraid of... Nevermind. You did what you were told, merc.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: Shit. I was afraid of that. Most of the victims had their accounts stolen as well. They probably tortured them to get access to their personal information, and once they had it...
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Sick fucks. We’ll deal with them later. Anything else?
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Gunny_Quest_03_Objective_4_VENDOR_O: So it's exactly as suspected. Now that we know that the airfield was used for drug trafficking, we need to find out how exactly they did it and where the planes were going. I’m certain there has to be a logbook somewhere in that place that could uncover more info. With an op of that size, they probably weren’t keeping it all just in their heads.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_01_Debriefing: Sounds like they were after that deserter, torturing and killing anyone who might’ve known something. Ruthless bastards. We’ll deal with ’em soon enough. You did well. Take your reward and get some rest.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Turncoat_11_Objective_1_Description: Store the package in a shed south of the camp
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Banshee_Quest_25_Briefing: Sunny Skies Guest House has been linked to multiple missing persons cases spanning several years, including some that occurred just before the Event. Head west of Pha Lang Airfield and locate the guest house. Search it thoroughly for any evidence of what happened. Report your findings to Banshee.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_03_Debriefing: Thank you. The supplies will help others, but I... It's nothing. I just can't understand the minds of these murderers. What's the point of this endless violence? Are they doing it just for fun? I just don't get it...
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_04_Debriefing: That fucking idiot... I kept telling him he'd wind up dead, one way or another. He probably packed up shop at the first sign of trouble, filled the plane to the brim with stolen drugs, and tried to run away. That's all he ever did his whole miserable life. Maybe if I were a better cousin to him, none of this would have happened... You're still here? You did your job, so get lost!
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_11_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_03_Briefing: The armed group from Pha Lang Airfield is disrupting Handshake's operations at Midnight Sapphire. Sweep around the area and neutralize as many of them as possible.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_20_Briefing: The hostile elements west of Pha Lang are causing operational setbacks. Eliminate them.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_33_Briefing: The leader of the armed group occupying Pha Lang Airfield is getting in Handshake's way. Neutralize the target. You can find him at one of the marked locations.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_02_Debriefing: Those bastards were picking our outposts clean? Figures. Turn your back for a second, and the rats come running. At least the boys are stocked now, thanks to you. Not the most glamorous job, but it keeps us in the fight. Here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Handshake_33_AcceptMsg:
Those pseudo-mercenaries occupying Pha Lang Airfield are seriously getting on my nerves! There's no other option than to give them a good beating.

I need you to find their leader and eliminate him. That should teach them not to mess with us. He will certainly stand out from his subordinates, so focus on someone who is better equipped than his goons.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_11_Objective_1_Description: Transfer the data from all the measuring stations near Pha Lang Airfield
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_11_Subobjective_1a_Description: Transfer the data from the first station
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_11_Subobjective_1b_Description: Transfer the data from the second station
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_11_Subobjective_1c_Description: Transfer the data from the third station
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Briefing: Travel to Pha Lang Airfield to gain access to local computer systems using a hacking device and recover records connected to suspicious activity at the site. Extract any usable data, report your findings to Handshake, and await further instructions.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Turncoat_11_Briefing: Turncoat needs a favor, as there's something he desperately wants to possess. Locate the item he seeks and store it at the designated location.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_03_Objective_3_Desc: Use the SD autocracker to access and transfer all the data from a PC
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_02_AcceptMsg:
Wake up, merc!

I’ve got a stealth mission for you. No questions, got it? The less you know, the better your chances of pulling this off.

Go to an abandoned shed east of Fort Narith, grab the supplies stashed there, and deliver them to the radio tower. Who’s getting them? Not your concern. I said no questions.

Here’s the tricky part: no one dies. Zero casualties. You so much as scratch someone, and you blow the whole thing. What’s with that look? Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten how to do a job without leaving a trail of bodies.

No? Then prove it! Deliver the supplies, clean and quiet.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Gunny_20_AcceptMsg:
We have to deal with those assholes hiding in every other building we come across. They are like locusts, destroying everything in their way. I've had enough of stress-induced wrinkles; I don't need any more. Looking like Clint Eastwood is the last thing I want!

Head west of Pha Lang and show those idiots roaming the area that they should hide in the jungle until we leave this damn island.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Labrat_03_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objectiv: What kind of monsters could do this? Their only crime was trying to survive the hell this island has become... Please, just follow the road until you reach Namhou village. Look for a house with a covered chess table nearby. Leave the supplies at the front door. Another contact of mine will take care of distributing them to those in need.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_06_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objecti: What? No! Fucking hell! Move quickly, merc! I need you to search her house and look for a letter. Hopefully, it's still there. Bring it to me when you find it. Her house is south of your current location.
ST_Quests_PhaLangAirfieldRegion.CT_Artisan_02_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fail: You gotta be shitting me! I can't trust you with anything, can I? I’m starting to think it’s time to find someone else to work with...

ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_2a_Des: (Optional) Check if the backup generator is powered on
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_2b_Des: (Optional) Check if the lockdown is lifted at the power-routing station
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_1_VENDOR_O: All right. If they've got wounded stacked up in the mess hall, that's our best shot at finding out what happened during that attack. Check the place for anything the medics left behind. And while you're at it, search the administrative parts of the barracks. With this many troops stationed here, I want to know what the hell they're supposed to be protecting.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: All right. This place is starting to stink. Somebody considers that telescope important enough to throw a whole lot of manpower at it, and somebody else just tried to hit them hard. I want to know what the station commander makes of all this. Head to the HQ and check his office. See what he's got tucked away in there.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_3_VENDOR_: Also, that experiment from the report has to be running on a separate system. Find the setup and get me access to whatever it's recording. If they're really detecting the same phenomenon the Soviets were tracking decades ago, I want to see the raw data for myself.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_1a_VEND: An attack? That's interesting. With this many troops and supplies around, somebody still managed to hit them hard enough to overwhelm their medics. I'd like to know who the hell pulled that off.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_1b_PLA: Connection established. Can you see it?
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_1_VENDOR_: Either way, getting inside probably won't be easy. My guess is the entrance is somewhere underground. Once you're in, find a terminal and establish a remote connection so I can access their systems. Most of the tech is probably ancient, but if they went through the trouble of reactivating this place... well, we might get lucky.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_2_Descrip: Establish a remote connection from inside the radio telescope
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_3a_VEN: Fascinating... So maybe they weren't failing to track it. Maybe they were trying to measure it the wrong way. If this has anything to do with the Event, those old observations could be invaluable.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_2_Descript: Find out more about the RLSL-1 garrison
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_3a_PLA: Found an old report. Apparently, the Soviets detected some kind of signal coming from space and spent years tracking it. They couldn't triangulate it properly, and its position seemed to change without any measurable acceleration. Still, they were certain about one thing: whatever was producing it was getting closer to Earth.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_3_PLAYER_O: Found the commander's journal. He doesn't trust Vititsky, the guy running Fort Narith. Says he's been demanding information on their work without explaining why, so the commander started withholding some of their findings from him. After the attack, he got even more suspicious. The attackers ignored the telescope and supplies and pushed straight for HQ. He thinks they might've been after him.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_2b_PLAY: Found their standing orders. Looks like most of the extra manpower is here to protect the radio telescope and its equipment. They've got restricted areas, constant perimeter patrols, the works. Orders say the telescope stays operational no matter what.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Debriefing:
Good work. Let's see what we've got here...

Huh. Looks like our commander did some digging of his own after the attack. Most of their security cameras were taken out, but whoever did it missed one. He managed to pull a few frames from the footage. Quality's shit, but you can make out an armed man in tactical gear. No visible insignia, and according to the commander, the uniform and equipment don't match the LAF, the rebels, or any PMC operating on the island.

You know what I think? I think those poor bastards at that installation had a run-in with the same outfit that attacked us. Looks like it's not just the PMCs they're fighting. They've got their sights on the LAF too. And judging by what we found, they may have been after the station commander specifically.

Now here's where it gets interesting. The guy doesn't trust Vititsky, starts withholding information from Fort Narith, and then somebody tries to take him out. Could be a coincidence. Or maybe Vititsky decided he had a problem that needed solving, and these guys were his solution.

Be that as it may, there's something going on between Fort Narith and whoever the hell these people are. We need to keep our eyes open.

I'll go through the rest of this laptop and see what else I can dig up. You did good out there.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_AcceptMsg:
Got another recon job for you.

There's an old radio telescope facility called RLSL-1. The place has been running on a skeleton crew for years, but a few months before the Event, the LAF suddenly started moving more personnel there. After everything went to shit, they sent in even more.

That doesn't happen without a reason. Whatever they're doing up there, I want to know about it. More importantly, I want to know what kind of shape they're in and what they're capable of.

Start with the garages and the offices nearby. We need to know what their supply situation looks like. Check for anything that gives us an idea of what we're dealing with.

Once you've got something, report in. We'll take it from there.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_1a_VEN: Got it! Connection is stable. I'll start pulling everything I can.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_5_VENDOR_: I am! Perfect. There's a lot coming through... I'll need time to make sense of it properly, but this should give us a much clearer picture of what they've been detecting.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_3b_PLA: I found a report on a current experiment. They're picking up anomalous emissions from Ground Zero that match the signal the Soviets were tracking. There's also some kind of residual signature along its old trajectory. According to this, it continues past Earth without changing course, with Ground Zero right at the point where it crossed us.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_1a_PLAY: I found a supply request. Looks like they took casualties in an attack a few days ago. Enough to burn through their medical supplies. They set up a makeshift infirmary in the mess hall to handle the overflow.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_1c_PLA: I found an operational directive. RLSL-1 was running on a skeleton crew for years, but they started bringing old systems back online and transferring more personnel here last year. It also says the facility was put under lockdown after a recent attack.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_AcceptMsg:
I need your help with something urgent.

That radio telescope facility Gunny sent you to investigate has caught my attention. RLSL-1 was barely operational for years, and now suddenly it's crawling with personnel and running again? I need to know why.

We've already found evidence that the Soviets were conducting some highly unusual research on this island, and I have a feeling this place was part of it. If there's even a chance their work can tell us something about the Event... God, just imagine what could still be stored there!

Start with the headquarters. Access their servers and establish a remote connection so I can pull whatever data they're keeping there. While you're at it, search the archives as well. I want everything that could tell us what they were working on.

Once you're done, contact me. We'll decide where to go from there.

This could be important. Really important!
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_5_PLAYER_: I'm connected. You should be getting the data now.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_1a_PLA: I'm in. You should have access to the server now.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_1b_PLAY: I'm inside the garages. They're packed with supply crates. Looks like they turned the whole place into a warehouse.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_2a_Desc: Investigate the makeshift infirmary and learn more about the attack
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_1_Descript: Investigate the supply situation at RLSL-1
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_2_PLAYER_: I’m inside. Connection should be live.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_2a_PLAY: I’ve located a medical report. Fourteen casualties, three dead on arrival. Most were shot or hit by shrapnel, but some had severe injuries the medics couldn't explain. Survivors couldn't even agree on what happened. Some said they were taking fire from multiple directions, but others swore there was only one attacker.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_3_Descrip: Locate intel about past and current research
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_1a_Desc: Locate intel in the adjacent offices
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_5_Descrip: Locate the current experiment and access its data
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Now that's interesting. A station commander starts keeping secrets from Fort Narith, then some unknown outfit punches through his perimeter and makes a run at his office? Could be coincidence, but I sure as hell wouldn't bet on it. Take another look around. See if you can find his laptop and bring it back. I want to know what else he's been keeping to himself.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_3_VENDOR_: Okay, I've been going through what I can access from here, but the data seems incomplete. There should be a main computer lab somewhere inside the building. Find it and look for a local data drive. If they're keeping the datasets offline, that's where they'll be.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_1_VENDOR_: Okay, I've got the server data, and that directive gave us plenty to work with. It's time we took a closer look at that telescope.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_2a_VEND: One attacker doesn't put seventeen soldiers in the infirmary. Either those men were too damn rattled to know what they saw, or whoever hit this place knew exactly what they were doing. Doesn't sound like your average LLA raid.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Briefing: RLSL-1 has seen a significant increase in LAF personnel and supplies despite operating with only a skeleton crew for years. Head to the radio telescope facility, assess the garrison's capabilities, and find out why the LAF is so determined to protect it. Report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Briefing: RLSL-1 may hold valuable information about the Soviet research conducted on Lamang decades ago. Head out to the radio telescope facility, access its systems, and uncover any connection between the old research and the Event. Report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_4_Descript: Retrieve the commander's laptop and report back to Gunny
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_4_Descrip: Retrieve the data drive and report back to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_1_Descrip: Search the HQ for intel and access the servers
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_2b_Desc: Search the administrative parts of the barracks and learn more about the garrison's orders
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_3a_Des: Search the archive for intel connected to past research
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Objective_3_Descript: Search the commander's office in the HQ for intel
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_3b_Des: Search the computer labs for intel connected to current research
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_4a_Des: Search the main computer lab and retrieve the data drive
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_2b_VEND: So that's what all the muscle is for. Whatever they're doing with that telescope, somebody considers it important enough to protect around the clock. Starting to look like this place is a lot more than some old listening post.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_1c_VEN: So the reactivation started before the Event... Interesting. Very interesting. And now they're determined to keep that telescope running no matter what. There has to be a good reason for that.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Gunny_Quest_09_Subobjective_1b_VEND: That's a lot of gear for a place that used to run on a skeleton crew. Whatever they're doing here, they're sure as hell not planning on packing up anytime soon.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Debriefing:
This is... I don't even know where to begin.

I've compared the Soviet records with the data you recovered and the live readings from the experiment. They weren't wrong. At least, I don't think they were. I think they were trying to describe something their instruments simply weren't designed to measure. The more I look at it, the less sense it makes as something moving through space normally. And now we know its residual signature continues straight past Earth, while Ground Zero sits almost exactly where the two intersect.

So I've been thinking... what if it didn't actually travel through space the way we do?

Imagine an object moving through a higher spatial dimension and only intersecting ours along parts of its path. We wouldn't see the whole thing. We'd only detect the places where it touched our space. Its position could appear to jump, its trajectory wouldn't make sense, and even something as simple as distance might not mean what we think it means.

It would also explain something else. Whatever happened at Ground Zero may not have been an impact at all. It could have been a point of intersection. Something passed through our world and kept going.

I know how that sounds. And I am not saying this is what happened. Not yet. But right now, it's the first model I've found that doesn't immediately contradict half the data.

I need more time with this. Much more.

What the hell did they find?
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_3b_VEN: Wait... it continues past Earth? Then whatever they were tracking didn't arrive here. It passed through. And Ground Zero appeared right where that happened... That's... I don't even know what to make of that yet. But there's no way these are separate phenomena.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_1_VENDOR_: We can't know for sure if the lockdown is still in effect, so you might have to check the generator and the power-routing station mentioned in the file. Or you can just find the entrance and hope for the best. I'll leave that up to you.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Objective_2_VENDOR_: Yes! I have access. There's a lot here... far more than I expected. This is going to take some time to sort through, so let's get some context while I work. Search the archives for anything related to the old research, then check the computer labs for records of their current experiments. I want to know what they were doing here then and what they're doing here now.
ST_Quests_Radar.Epic_Labrat_Quest_10_Subobjective_1b_VEN: Yes, I'm in. Leave it to me. I'll go through everything from here.

ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Objective_1_VENDOR_O: All right, that's enough to tell me this isn't some temporary outpost. Whatever they're doing up there, somebody's putting serious resources into it. We need more. There's a radio tower on site. Get into their comms and see what you can pull. Watch yourself. The deeper we dig into this place, the less I like it.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Subobjective_1a_VEND: Copy that. This has to be the first place we’ve seen here that actually has some damn fuel left. This operation has to be top priority, and it looks like they intend to keep it going.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Subobjective_1b_VEND: Could be combat stress. Could be that place fucking with them. Don't jump to conclusions yet. See what else you can find.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_4_VENDOR_: Disfigured? Fascinating... I wonder what could cause such rapid physiological changes. Radiation alone shouldn't... Sorry, the key. A dragon in the ruins, was it? Delirious or not, that's the only lead we have. Find those ruins and look for a dragon.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_1_VENDOR_: Excellent! There should be a control terminal somewhere nearby. Find it and see if you can get the machine running.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Subobjective_8a_Des: Extract the data drive from the computer
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_3_Descrip: Find out the whereabouts of the lead scientist
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Subobjective_1b_PLAY: Found a soldier's journal. Says they were making regular trips into Ground Zero. Guy started hearing voices over a dead radio and seeing things moving in the jungle.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_2_PLAYER_: Found the terminal, but I can't get in. It requires a hardware key.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Subobjective_1c_VEND: Good intel. So we've got their numbers. supply situation, and confirmation they're operating inside Ground Zero.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: Good work. Now let's find out what they're really doing here. There's a server room in the HQ. Get in there and pull whatever data you can. Then check the commander's office. If there's anything they don't want people knowing about, that's where I'd keep it.

Good work. Now let's find out what they're really doing here. There's a server room in the HQ. Get in there and pull whatever data you can. Then check the commander's office. If there's anything they don't want people knowing about, that's where they'd keep it.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Debriefing:
Good work. This is exactly what I needed.

Northern Reach isn't just supporting operations inside Ground Zero. That's what the whole damn place was built for. They're running teams in there on a regular basis, recovering material, taking measurements, and doing whatever else the science team has them doing. And they're taking casualties in the process. Men are coming back sick, confused, or sometimes not returning at all. Command knows it, and they're still sending them in.

Then there's that machine mentioned in the file you brought back. According to the commander's report, the science team brought it online not long after they established the base. It's running around the clock, they're feeding everything they recover into it, and nobody outside them seems to know what the hell it's actually doing. Not even the base commander.

That's what bothers me. Somebody built an entire military installation to support an operation they won't even explain to the officer responsible for protecting it. At least we've got a window into their comms now, plus whatever you managed to pull off that server. There's a lot to go through, but from now on, if they learn something, we'll be the first to know.

Whatever they're looking for in Ground Zero, somebody thinks it's worth a lot of dead soldiers.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_6_VENDOR_: Great work! Get back to the main terminal and start the analysis. Let's see what this thing can do.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Briefing: Gunny is interested in an LAF military installation that did not exist before the Event. Recon the area, secure any pertinent intel, and await further orders.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Subobjective_1c_PLAY: I found an admin report. Fifty-seven personnel on site, including fourteen researchers. Supplies are holding, but they're short on protective gear. It also says anyone coming back from Ground Zero has to undergo medical screening.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_3_PLAYER_: I found something. The Lead researcher was Dr. Chanthalangsy. Looks like he went into Ground Zero alone, came back in bad shape, and they transferred him to the hospital.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Objective_2_PLAYER_O: I'm in. You should have access to their comms now.
I'm in. You should have access to their comms now.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_AcceptMsg:
I've been going through the data you pulled from Northern Reach. Gunny was right to be concerned about that place, but I think he may have overlooked the most interesting part. That experimental machine their science team has been running.

From what I can piece together, they've been using it to analyze material recovered from Ground Zero. Unlike the equipment we currently have here, it may be sophisticated enough to tell us far more about what we're dealing with. And thanks to your previous efforts, we happen to have a rather interesting container of our own that I've been dying to learn more about. This seems like the perfect opportunity to do exactly that.

Unfortunately, the whole setup is enormous, so bringing it back here isn't exactly an option. Which means we'll have to bring the material to it instead. I've tasked one of your colleagues with hiding the container near Northern Reach for you. Pick it up, get into the laboratory, place it inside the machine, and see if you can get it running.

I have absolutely no idea what kind of results we'll get from this. Isn't that exciting?
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Subobjective_6a_Des: Initiate the boot-up sequence from Terminal 1
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Subobjective_6b_Des: Initiate the boot-up sequence from Terminal 2
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Subobjective_6c_Des: Initiate the boot-up sequence from Terminal 3
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Subobjective_6d_Des: Initiate the boot-up sequence from Terminal 4
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Subobjective_1a_PLAY: I’m at the supply yard. There's tons of containers and crates everywhere. A couple of vehicles too. Looks like they’re keeping the place well stocked.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_4_PLAYER_: I’ve located Chanthalangsy. He's dead, and his body is badly disfigured. Medical records say he deteriorated fast after coming back from Ground Zero. Before he died, he kept rambling about a dragon eating his key somewhere in the ruins.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Briefing: Lab Rat needs more information about the previously recovered exotic material. Retrieve the container hidden near Northern Reach and use the research site's experimental equipment to analyze its contents.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_AcceptMsg:
Listen up. There's a military installation up north that wasn't there before the Event. From what we can tell, they threw the place together a few months ago, and they've been keeping pretty damn quiet about what they're doing there.

I don't like unknowns, especially armed ones operating this close to us. I need to know what kind of manpower they're sitting on, what supplies they have, and what the hell they're doing out there.

Get inside and have a look around. Check their supply yard, accommodations, and offices. Anything that tells us how well supplied they are, how many people we're dealing with, or why they're there in the first place is worth knowing.

Keep your eyes open. Something about that place doesn't sit right with me.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Subobjective_4a_Desc: Locate a file in the commander’s office
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_2_VENDOR_: Of course it does. Because apparently a password would have been too easy. Look around for any documents about the machine or its operators. We need to find out who had access to that key.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_1_Descrip: Place the container inside the experimental machine at Northern Reach
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_5_VENDOR_: Progress! There has to be some kind of operating procedure nearby. Look around for anything that might tell us where those terminals are.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Subobjective_1a_Des: Retrieve the container hidden at a shelter northeast of Northern Reach
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_8_Descrip: Retrieve the data drive and report back to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Gunny_Quest_08_Objective_4_Descript: Retrieve the file and bring it to Gunny
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_4_Descrip: Search the hospital for the lead scientist
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_6_PLAYER_: That's all four. The machine should be ready.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_7_PLAYER_: The analysis is complete. The results are stored on a local data drive, but I can't recover the container. The system says it's locked down for a twelve-hour cooldown.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_5_PLAYER_: The key worked. I'm in, but the system says I need to initiate the boot-up sequence from four separate terminals.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_3_VENDOR_: The lead researcher? If anyone had access to that key, it was probably him. Head to the hospital and see if you can find him.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Debriefing:
This is... incredible. These readings shouldn't be possible. The material's molecular structure keeps changing, but not randomly. It's as if it's trying to maintain some kind of configuration that simply can't exist under normal conditions.

And look at this. The radiation spikes happen after the structural changes, not before them. Do you realize what that means? We've been looking at this backwards. The radiation isn't causing these changes. It's a byproduct of them.

The people affected by Ground Zero... I thought radiation exposure was responsible for what happened to them. The mutations, the tissue damage, all of it. But what if it was the other way around? What if something changed them first, on a fundamental level, and the radiation came afterward?

That means there's something else happening in Ground Zero. Something we haven't accounted for yet.

Fascinating... and absolutely terrifying.

I need time to go through the rest of this data. You've given me a lot to think about.
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_5_Descrip: Use the hardware key to access the control terminal
ST_Quests_ResearchSite.Epic_Labrat_Quest_09_Objective_7_VENDOR_: Wonderful! Take the drive and leave the container in the machine. Whatever happened during the analysis may have altered the material, so don't touch it. Besides, the data is far more valuable to me now. Bring it back as soon as you can.

ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_38_Briefing:
<Dev> Friend, I was hoping you could do me a small favor. The Midnight Sapphire resort has safes with valuables, and one of my friends lost the codes to his belongings. There was panic and chaos everywhere, so it's not inconceivable.

He's very upset that he can't get his stuff back, and when I mentioned that I was working with a very talented PMC friend who has helped me on more than one occasion, he asked me if I could persuade you to help with this little task.

I can guarantee you won't be disappointed with the reward. Just go to the resort, find the codes for the safes, and bring back what my friend has stored there.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_38_Debriefing: <Dev> Friend, you are a savior. I love that you don't ask too many questions. A prime example of the "don't ask, don't tell" attitude. It's great to see that even though you're a foreigner, you still care about the welfare of the local people. I will spread good news about you.

Travel to the Pha Lang Airfield checkpoint, search through abandoned luggage for a distinctive purple suitcase, and determine whether she attempted to evacuate after the Event.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Subobjective_3a_VEND: A particular LAF official was a central figure in these affairs. The guy was a big shot who knew the right people. Truly a man in his element.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Briefing: A squad monitoring enemy activity went dark west of Pha Lang Airfield. Investigate what happened and report their status to Gunny.

ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_3_Desc: Access and transfer all the data from the laptop
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_2_VEND: According to our intel, Narith wasn’t the most trusting person around and always had a failsafe just in case someone was hiding something from him. That means, even though his right hand thought he had the only key, that was far from the truth. Our best bet is that the commander of Midnight Sapphire's defenses also received a copy. He's supposed to be holed up in an office somewhere near the front desk. Search the place, look for the key, and then use it to get inside that laptop.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_24_Briefing: An undercover operative was captured trying to smuggle evidence out of Midnight Sapphire. The evidence is likely still concealed in his car. Search the road leading out of the resort to find the car, retrieve the USB drive, and deliver it to Banshee.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_35_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: Are you even trying? Fuck, man! Don't disappoint me again.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_15_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fai: Are you one hundred percent sure? Shit, I hope you really did your best to find him because we can’t have casualties unaccounted for, understand?
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Banshee_09_Briefing: Banshee needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: Before you make your way back, there's something I need you to pick up. We’re looking for a briefcase with highly valuable and extremely fragile contents that’s supposedly been left behind in the bar area of the Midnight Sapphire Hotel. Keep your head down, infiltrate the hotel, and grab it. Just make sure you don't end up like those two.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_43B_Debriefing:
Brilliant! I'll inform the client that he can start celebrating. 

Although the more I think about it, the more it seems that someone might have wanted that passport planted there to tarnish somebody else's reputation. Letting anybody know that you visited a place like that would deal a massive blow to your credibility. Even more so after all that shit that was going on there gets unearthed... 

Oh well, whatever the case may be, we make a great team, buddy. I see our prosperous future as clear as day!
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_53_AcceptMsg:
Buddy, I need your help. You might’ve heard, but Hunter’s Paradise had some sort of VIP program for those with the deepest pockets. I don’t care what kind of fucked up stuff they were up to, but the boss reached out, and he wants to know who was involved.

There’s gotta be a client list somewhere, so search carefully, find it, and bring it back. I’d bet it’s stashed somewhere around the main entrance gate - they would want to know immediately who to let in to the VIP section, right?
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Labrat_13_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations at the Midnight Sapphire Resort, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.

ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_Ob: Copy that. RTB only when you find out what happened to all of them, ok?
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_14_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_Ob: Dammit! Not what I wanted to hear. Did you check both?
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_2_VEND: Damn it. Of course the damn thing would be impenetrable. Listen, try as we may, the only way to get inside is through a hardware security key. Without it, it's about as useful as a fucking cutting board. You'll have to find it. Don't worry though, we might have a lead.
ST_Quests_Resort.LabRat_Quest_15_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDi: Do you have a minute? I need your help with something.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_11_AcceptMsg:
Do you have a moment? I’m sure you’ve noticed that this island is a veritable paradise for drugs; they’re everywhere. We suspect the government is controlling the trade from the shadows. That’s why we need to gather as much evidence as possible.

The Midnight Sapphire is an opulent resort catering to the wealthiest clientele, which means there’s likely a designated spot where they keep the merchandise close to the guests. The rich are drawn to drugs like moths to a flame.

I doubt they store the bulk of the product directly in the hotel, so look around the more secluded parts of the resort. There’s probably some location where employees can take a breather when they’re not getting screwed over by the 1%. My money is on it being there.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_12_Briefing: Due to the chaos at Midnight Sapphire during the Event, Turncoat's affiliate left valuable items behind. Retrieve these possessions from Villa Anna Jana and Villa Marta Monica, and deliver them to Turncoat.
