ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_6_Debriefing: Excellent work! Just glancing over the list, I can see some incredibly high-profile people. This is exactly what we need to bring them to justice. You have done very well, thank you.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_39A_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: Excellent work, man! Now just wait a while until we do our magic...
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_39B_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: Excellent work, man! Now just wait a while until we do our magic...

ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_29_Debriefing: Excellent work, my man! I’ll see to it personally that this little thing doesn’t cause us any trouble. Could you imagine that someone else would get their grubby hands on it and leak whatever’s on there to the outside world? The last thing we need is more publicity, that’s for sure.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_3_VEND: Excellent work. Let’s see… well, look at that. Mr. Park lied to the president. That sneaky bastard falsified the army’s reports about Ground Zero and kept the main man in the dark about what was really going on there.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_Objective_4_VENDOR_: Excellent! Let us see what they were so desperate to erase.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_52_Debriefing:
Excellent! You’d expect these rich fucks to be more careful about losing incriminating evidence, right? Especially when they’re into nasty shit like this. Guess they’re so used to getting away with everything that they no longer give a damn.

Anyway, I’ll swiftly inform the client that we’ve secured his phone. Good job.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_Objective_5_VENDOR_: Fantastic! I cannot wait to go through those. If there is even a fraction of what I suspect in there, this could be extremely valuable.

Maybe we'll get lucky, and whatever you find will point us toward some of his hidden supplies.

Eliminate the LAF forces, retrieve the flash drive, and stash it at the designated drop-off south of the resort and west of Sapphire Waterfalls.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_23_Debriefing: Friend, I am eternally grateful for your favor. I would love to see those backstabbers get what they deserve personally, but a man can't have everything. The phone you retrieved will help me establish new desirable relationships with people who could refine this country when everything is settled.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_02_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I have a task for you that cannot be delayed.

It seems some of my former associates have grown… less fond of me. I can understand that. But they’re not content with mere resentment; they’re actively trying to dismantle everything I’ve built. That is unacceptable.

It breaks my heart, but it must be done. Travel south of Midnight Sapphire to the villages of Namhou and Chon. Find them, and end them. They chose betrayal; let them pay its price.

Oh, friend. Why is it so hard for people to understand that I am not someone to be trifled with?
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_17_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I have the utmost respect for Mr. Handshake, and I don’t want to go against him, but I am very interested in the golf club you were asked to retrieve. You see, I used to play golf in better times, and it would mean a lot to own such a beauty. I’d display it where I could see it every day, as a reminder of the time when I could play this fantastic sport again.

I would greatly appreciate it if you could do me this small favor. I’m sure Mr. Handshake wouldn’t mind if the golf club didn’t make its way to him.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_12_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I was hoping you could do me a small favor. My... acquaintance left his most valuable possessions at the Midnight Sapphire Resort. There was panic and chaos everywhere, so it's not inconceivable.

He's very upset that he can't get his stuff back, and when I mentioned that I was working with a very talented friend who has helped me out on more than one occasion, he asked if I could persuade you to help with this little task.

I can guarantee you won't be disappointed with the reward. Just go to the resort, find the valuables, and bring back what my friend stored there. He left his belongings at Villa Anna Jana and Villa Marta Monica. Some golden bars and Cuban cigars, he told me. Or was it Golden Cuban cigars? Guess you'll have to find out for yourself.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_16_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I've heard that you're searching for the source of illegal substances distributed to the upper crust in Midnight Sapphire. Regrettably, I can’t divulge the location, as my interests leaned more toward other forms of entertainment during my stay. Rest assured, I regret that decision now, as I wouldn’t need to bother you with a request to retrieve the merchandise stored there. Of course, only for academic reasons - I’m quite interested in the history of the Lamang drug trade.

Please be so kind as to assist with my research. Simply retrieve anything you find in that magical place and gently place it inside a blue barrel behind a shelter in the middle of a field southwest of Midnight Sapphire. Just make sure to polish your boots afterwards. The trek is a little bit muddy, I'm afraid. Once you're done, I'll send one of my birds to pick it up.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_09_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I’m in dire need of your assistance!

There’s a two-storey house near a gas station between Chon and Namhou villages. On the second floor of this house, you shall find a package that interests me dearly. Please, retrieve said package and bring it swiftly to a shelter in the middle of a field south of the house.

I know you’re just dying to know what's inside, but I implore you - no peeking! The reward for your discretion shall be my everlasting gratitude.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_23_AcceptMsg:
Friend, can you believe how treacherous some people are? Imagine this: I made a deal with a few friends employed at Midnight Sapphire. They were locals from Chon village, just south of the resort, who wanted to make some extra money, and I, being a compassionate person, obliged them. They ran some small errands for me - you know, the usual "grab this thing from the rich Western colonizer and relocate it somewhere else" deal.

Now, prepare for the unfortunate twist. After our mutually beneficial collaboration, where I provided them with tips and they simply moved things from A to B, the greedy blighters decided they wanted more money. For what? Picking junk up and putting it back down?! The swines even waited for the perfect moment when an object I genuinely desired - a phone possibly full of deliciously compromising materials - appeared, and then came up with their despicable proposal.

It breaks my heart, but I no longer consider them friends. They're just rats, and you can't tolerate vermin. Go, friend, be the bearer of my righteous wrath. Kill the unreliable goons and bring me the promised phone.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_17_VENDOR_BecameAvailable: Friend, it has come to my attention that you are looking for something that might interest me. Do you have a moment?
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_5_AcceptMsg:
Friend, it’s a pleasure to see you again! May I propose a mutually advantageous arrangement? A blue airplane housed in one of the remote hangars at Pha Lang Airfield lacks a crucial component that would elevate its significance greatly. I currently possess this component and urge you to assume ownership of it and transfer it to the aforementioned plane.

Simply make your way to a charming little shelter south of the airfield, pick up a small package, and then venture forth towards the aircraft. Just a delightful short trek through our enchanting countryside. Nothing to it, right? Just make sure to not "kick the bucket," if you capture my meaning.

One last thing. I kindly request you refrain from perusing the contents of the package and ensure its safekeeping. Rest assured, your compliance will be generously compensated.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_02_Debriefing: Friend, the heavens themselves must have sent me someone like you. The double-crossers have learned, in the most final way possible, that my will cannot be defied. Excellent work. Here is your reward. I trust it will put a smile on your face.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_16_VENDOR_BecameAvailable: Friend, the wind whispered in my ear that you are taking an interest in a field of academic study that just so happens to be quite intriguing for me as well. Why don’t we have a little chat? I believe we could reach a mutual understanding.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_16_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_: Friend, what are you doing? Don't treat me like a stranger. I'd be very sad if I had to... unfriend you.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_12_Debriefing: Friend, you are a savior. I love that you don't ask too many questions. A prime example of the "don't ask, don't tell" attitude. It's great to see that even though you're a foreigner, you still care about the welfare of the local people. I’ll make sure to only speak highly of you.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_17_Debriefing: Friend, you have brightened my day. The gaiety I feel is stupendous. I will cherish this beauty like a treasure. Never shall I forget your wise choice.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_17_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_: Friend, you have hurt me so much that even words cannot describe my feelings. Now leave. I shall mourn the beautiful golf club.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_14_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_Ob: Fuck me! Figures. Anything else, or is that all?
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_14_Briefing: Fuel supplies are running critically low. Recon the area around Pha Lang Airfield where two tanker trucks were last seen, locate the missing vehicles, and assess how much fuel remains.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_31_Subobjective_1a_Descr: Gather any clues about what happened
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_3_VEND: Get over there and grab those documents, fast. We cannot let this opportunity slip through our fingers.
ST_Quests_Resort.LabRat_Quest_15_Debriefing: Give me that! I’ll need some more time to analyze it properly, but everything suggests that the plane suddenly lost all electrical power, which caused it to cease functioning. An EMP of sufficient size and in close proximity to the aircraft may have been the cause, but wouldn’t it damage the flight recorder as well? This model should be capable of flight even without electricity, so why did it… no, I can’t be sure until I dig deeper… oh! Yes! Thank you, of course.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Subobjective_3a_VEND: Good job. I’ve got something else for you to take care of. Handshake’s informants provided us with an interesting tip. According to what they passed along, there is a villa somewhere in the Midnight Sapphire Resort that has been used for some very shady army deals.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Banshee_09_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_29_Debriefing:
Good work, buddy. I knew other people’s incompetence wouldn’t slow you down.

Thanks to you, we got our hands on some extremely valuable intel. What? Who was the second briefcase for? A close friend of mine. Don’t worry; it’s in good hands now.

Enjoy your reward.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Objective_4_VENDOR_O: Good. We will go through it and see if it leads us to where he was stashing the weapons.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_34_Objective_1_VENDOR_Ob: Great job! I’ll inform him right away. I just hope he’s not so grief-stricken that he forgets to pay us.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_51_Debriefing: Great job! Previous experience has taught me not to watch similar videos, so I'm glad I don't have to retraumatize myself. Here's your bonus, pal.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_15_Briefing: Gunny is looking for Jason Novak, a PMC colleague who fell from a helicopter near the Midnight Sapphire Resort. Search the golf course, locate his body, and mark it. Ensure you have the tracker with you.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_50_Objective_2_VENDOR_Ob: Ha! So, Mr. Wordsmith reaped what he sowed. Shouldn't have stirred up a hornet's nest, right? That's enough proof for me that the journalist is no more. You can end your search.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_29_Briefing: Handshake convinced an LAF soldier to hand over valuable intel, but it was hidden in hard-to-reach places. Find both briefcases, leave one at the drop-off location, and deliver the other to Handshake.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_35_Briefing: Handshake has a client who wants a valuable golf club retrieved from the resort. Search the golf course area, find the item, and deliver it to Handshake.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_28_Briefing: Handshake needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_53_Debriefing: Here we go, this is some good stuff! I even recognize some of these names here. Look at that guy, he won a gold medal in Milan this year. And this chick is the CEO of a huge pharmaceutical company. Don’t ask me how I know that. So many different people, but with one thing in common - they are all rich as fuck. Good job, the boss will be thrilled!
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_AcceptMsg:
Hey pal, do you know the game Where's Waldo? We're playing something similar on this shitty island; only the game is: Where's that motherfucker Narith? It's frustrating that the piece of shit successfully avoids being found. And we really tried, buddy. No lies.

But fortune has smiled upon us. We got a lead. The numero duo of this country, Sayavong's right hand, Jan Park. This asshole practically lived in the resort and enjoyed the luxuries of this place on a daily basis. What a conceited prick.

Go to the resort, find that bastard's big-ass villa, and bring me any information that might lead us to the head honcho of this shithole.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_11_AcceptMsg:
Hey there, champ. Listen, I’ve got a little side gig going on, and I’m wondering if you’d like a piece of the action. I’ve got a client on the line who was here when shit hit the fan and managed to escape. However, he seems to have misplaced his prized possession - a Colt Single Action Army revolver that John Wayne himself used in True Grit. Now, I’ve never seen that movie; not really a Western fan, you know? But this guy is willing to pay big bucks if we get that little piece of movie memorabilia back to him.

Frankly, I doubt it was even his in the first place. He’s probably just using the situation to nab somebody else’s property, but I really don’t care about that. What matters is that if you help me with this, I might have some more work lined up your way. Off the books, of course.

According to him, the revolver is in a wooden case, and it should be in one of the tourist cottages near Sunset Chalet. It’s a restaurant on a hill south of Midnight Sapphire. You can’t miss it. Just keep your eyes peeled when you're over there, yeah?
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_35_AcceptMsg:
Hey there, champ. Still interested in making some sweet money on the side? That was just a rhetorical question - of course you are! Who wouldn't be, right?

Another dejected gentleman contacted me with a request to retrieve some of his priceless possessions. This time, we’re rescuing a fancy golf club. I'm more of a tennis guy, so I don't personally know how expensive these things are, but judging by the fact that the client is willing to pay top dollar, it must be something special. You know, made of solid gold or sanctified with the blood of Tiger Woods himself.

Go to the resort and check out the golf course. The client practically lived there, so the club should be somewhere around that place.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_51_AcceptMsg:
Hey there, man. Looks like the parties at Midnight Sapphire were really fucking legendary, because I've been contacted by a very famous and very concerned celebrity who’d really appreciate it if we could retrieve a forgotten SD card from his hotel room.

Apparently, he and his chums were partying like animals in heat and recorded some fond memories with the locals. Memories that could shatter his carefully crafted humanitarian image and possibly even land him in jail, and that would be a damn shame. I’ve always liked his movies… I mean, not the ones we’re talking about here, but you get me, right?

Look, just go to the hotel, search his room on the first floor, and retrieve the card, okay?
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_7_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDi: Hey, I need to talk to you in private. Do you have a minute?
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_6_VENDOR._BecameAvailableD: Hey, I need to talk to you. Got a minute?
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_8_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDi: Hey, I need your help with something. Can we talk?
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_30_AcceptMsg:
Hey, I've been contacted by a wealthy individual who needs a favor. According to his information, there’s supposed to be a forgotten flash drive with recordings of a high-profile politician from a wealthy western country doing some pretty NSFW stuff, and he wants it. The guy in question has been staying at Villa Lucia in Midnight Sapphire.

Listen, I doubt he’s after it because he has some weird fucking kink for creepy legislators; it’s obviously for blackmail. Nevertheless, we want to help him because we stand to gain a lot from working with this man.

So search the Midnight Sapphire villas for some hardcore scat porn or whatever he was doing there, and come back soon. We need a happy ending for this task, got it?
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_31_AcceptMsg:
Hey, champ. Wanna help find a missing person? A gentleman from the mainland asked for our help. He's looking for a man named Donald J. Dortmunder, who apparently stayed at the Midnight Sapphire Resort.

Our client doesn’t know much about Mr. Dortmunder, but he does know that he's an avid golfer. Why is the gentleman looking for this man? I didn’t ask, and I don’t really need to know. Too many questions are bad for business. The most important thing is that we will get a really nice reward if we find him.

Go to the resort and try to find out anything about the missing man.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_28_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man. How's it hanging? I bet you wouldn't turn down an easy side gig, eh? I can tell you're interested.

I want you to look for a few specific items when you're out in the field. I have no clue where they are, so you’ll have to do a bit of digging, but I know you’ll manage, buddy. You're a pro, and a small detail like that is no obstacle for you.

If possible, proceed right away. The sooner this is done, the better. Just know that I have your reward on hand. Completely off the record, of course.
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_6_AcceptMsg:
Hey, merc. It seems you’ve taken a liking to Midnight Sapphire. I’m not too surprised; after all, it was made for foreign scumbags. I guess it feels like home for you and your kind.

The place was a paradise for those who could afford it but a hellhole for the poor souls who had to work there. They were nothing more than slaves to the rich bastards who thought they could do anything to them. I know empathy’s not your business, but I also know you won’t turn down a paying job.

I want you to go there and look for an employee named Deesabun Nguyen, who mysteriously disappeared a few days before the evacuation. Check south of the golf club where the employees live. That’s all. Go and enjoy your stay there, sell-out soldier.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_39B_Subobjective_X_VENDO: Hey, what are you doing? Get back on your feet, man! We need this done!
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Debriefing:
Hmm, interesting. It's obvious the new commander is hiding his true intentions while feeding information to someone unknown… at least for now.

Thanks to your efforts, we managed to identify several locations we suspect the LAF officer was using as storage sites. Damn. Gotta say, the level of corruption in this country is sky high. It's like a mold that spreads and infects everything within its reach.

You did well. Good job. It's just a damn shame we lost those two.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_30_Debriefing: Holy Shit! This is fucked up as hell! The video is a LOT weirder than I imagined, buddy. I'm not gonna lie. But the more twisted the content, the happier our client will be. Now excuse me, I need to wash my fucking eyes with acid...
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_02_Briefing: Hostile elements in the villages of Namhou and Chon have crossed Turncoat. Eliminate them on his behalf.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_10_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_Quests_Resort.LabRat_Quest_15_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fa: How could you do this? Are you reallly not at least a little bit curious about what happened here? Is blindly following orders the best you can do? I... I need a minute, sorry.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_8_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fa: Huh, I guess you better enjoy your dirty money while you can.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_Objective_5_PLAYER_: I found a computer containing multiple recordings. I'm sending them to you as we speak.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_Objective_4_PLAYER_: I found a laptop with some recordings. I'm sending them over now.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_14_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_Ob: I found a tanker truck. It's been drained dry.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_Ob: I found one of our guys - KIA.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_14_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_Ob: I found one of the tanker trucks. It's completely empty.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_11_Debriefing: I genuinely appreciate your assistance. Thanks to these findings, we’re one step closer to our objective. I can’t wait to slap the handcuffs on the gangsters running this country.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_Ob: I got eyes on one of the guys from the missing squad. He didn't make it.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_29_AcceptMsg:
I have a mission for you that will require a certain amount of discretion. Are you up for it? Good. Thanks to the flight data that you acquired, we now know that there was a plane in the air precisely above the place where shit hit the fan. Naturally, they went down, but everything about their final voyage was stored in a black box, which all these planes carrying rich pricks have as a little extra insurance policy. It is in our best interest that the black box doesn’t fall into the wrong hands, so I’ll need your help locating it and bringing it back to me.

From the manifest, we know that it was a regular night sightseeing flight, starting at Pha Lang Airfield and then heading south over Ground Zero. We have no idea what happened then, but we may assume they tried to return to the airfield from the southeast and crashed somewhere there. If the pilot managed to line the plane to the runway, it should be as easy as following its direction, but if not, you’ll have to look around a bit.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_15_AcceptMsg:
I have another KIA for you: Jason Novak. He fell out of a helicopter during a flyby of Midnight Sapphire. Damn shame we lost him just because he didn’t follow security protocols. Dammit, what do I always say? Don’t do anything stupid, and don’t get killed! But he just HAD to do both, didn’t he? Sometimes, I really think you’re all just a bunch of overgrown children running around with guns...

I want you to search the Midnight Sapphire Resort, find his body, and mark it, just like before. The accident happened somewhere around the golf course, so I suggest you start there.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Banshee_09_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Labrat_13_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_28_Debriefing: I knew this would be a piece of cake for you. Enjoy your undocumented reward, amigo.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_32_VENDOR_BecameAvailabl: I know that Gunny gave you job to do, but I hope you'll reconsider. Let's talk.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_10_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_AcceptMsg:
I need your assistance as soon as possible.

I believe I am on the right track with my research into the Event, but I need more data. There is still so much we do not know, and I am determined to change that. Fortunately, I think I know where to look.

It appears that the people at Midnight Sapphire have been collecting information on their clients, most likely for blackmail. Based on intercepted communications, they are planning to migrate the data and wipe the servers clean. We cannot let that happen. I am not interested in their dirt, but I need to uncover as much information about the Event as possible, and there has to be something in those files.

Don't worry, I have prepared two automated cracking tools: a USB drive and a microSD card. Just plug them in, press a few buttons, and they will handle the rest by collecting and transmitting all the data. They are stored in a box under a billboard next to the main road leading to the main entrance of Midnight Sapphire.

I will also need you to check the main entrance and the Golf Club for a way to access and send me the security camera recordings. This should not be as difficult as the servers. I do not think you will need a hacking device. Good luck!
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_6_AcceptMsg:
I see you’ve been tasked by your superiors to retrieve a list of clients from Hunter’s Paradise. While I understand the importance of following orders, I urge you to hand over the list to me instead. If even half of the rumors about that place are true, this list could contain the names of individuals involved in truly despicable acts. It would be unfortunate if the list were to disappear or, worse yet, be used for blackmail.

It's in our best interest to secure the list and deliver it to me promptly. And don’t worry, your efforts won’t go unrewarded.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1c_VENDOR_Ob: I see. We'll recover his body later. Do you have eyes on anybody else?
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_24_AcceptMsg:
I would appreciate your cooperation. My colleague was undercover at Midnight Sapphire, gathering evidence on the Lamangese government and all the other illicit activities that took there. Unfortunately, he was discovered and had to flee, but the LAF was prepared and ensured his escape didn't happen.

I'm sure the army captured him, but I’m also confident they didn’t find the evidence he was carrying. He had a custom-made hidden compartment in the trunk that’s impossible to find unless you know exactly where to look.

Please head to Midnight Sapphire and check the road leading out of the resort. My guess is they intercepted him at some sort of choke point, and the car might still be there.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_31_Objective_2_PLAYER_Ob: I'm at the golf club. I found papers mentioning that Mr. Dortmunder has a huge debt here and is banned from entering. There is also an address where he resided - Villa Gosia.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_50_Objective_1_PLAYER_Ob: I'm in a security room at the hotel. Judging from this report, the security team was watching the journalist closely, and when they decided he was sniffing around too much, they took him to an interrogation room near the lakeside villa.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_2_PLAY: I'm inside Jan Park's villa. I found his laptop, but I can't access it.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_28_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I'm on-site. Looks like the hostiles from Hunter's Paradise engaged a rival PMC squad. All the contractors are KIA.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_24_Debriefing: I've always told him he needs to be more careful. A damn fine operative, but I think he went through so much shit that he started to feel invincible, you know? Anyway, you have my thanks for finding the USB drive. My colleague worked diligently to obtain the evidence, and I would be deeply saddened if his sacrifice was in vain.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_50_AcceptMsg:
I've been contacted by yet another client to find a missing relative. This time, we are looking for Richard S. Parker. According to his brother, this guy was a professional journalist and seasoned war correspondent who came here to dig up dirt. You know these people, right? They can't help sticking their noses in other people's business.

He was staying at the Midnight Sapphire Hotel, and apparently, he was onto something big. That was the last message his brother got, and then dead silence. Man, I’ve got to be honest - I hate reporters and all the media hyenas. I have a history with these clowns and I wouldn't shed a single tear if there were one less of them in the world. But the client had some excellent arguments to persuade me to look for Mr. Dick Parker... a shitton of money!

Go to the hotel and search for him. Start by locating the security room, likely somewhere near the reception. You may find clues there that point us in the right direction.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_50_Objective_2_PLAYER_Ob: I've found the interrogation room. It looks like they tortured him here - there's a bloodied chair and even more blood splattered on the wall. Unfortunately, I see no indicators of where they took him.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1d_PLAYER_Ob: I've got a casualty here. One of ours. Must be from the missing squad.
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_21_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I've located Ying Vilaysack - she's dead. After examining her body, it seems like she overdosed on drugs.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Objective_4_PLAYER_O: I've located a laptop with evidence of multiple transactions concerning firearms and other LAF hardware. When it came to selling the army reserves, this guy was the real deal. I'm sending you all the data now.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1c_PLAYER_Ob: I've located one of the missing guys. He's dead.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Objective_2_PLAYER_O: I've located the scouts. Both KIA. From what I can tell, they were ambushed by someone who knew exactly what they were doing.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_34_Objective_1_PLAYER_Ob: I've located the suitcase. Judging by its contents, it's definitely the one our client was looking for.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_16_Briefing: Instead of delivering the narcotics at Midnight Sapphire to Banshee, collect any drugs or related evidence you find and place it inside a blue barrel behind a shelter in a field southwest of the resort. Leave the materials there for Turncoat’s retrieval and avoid drawing attention to the exchange.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_31_Objective_2_VENDOR_Ob: Interesting. Mr. Dortmunder sounds like quite a scamp. Try going to the villa. Maybe we'll get lucky, and he'll be there waiting for us.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_53_Briefing: Investigate Hunter’s Paradise for records tied to its VIP program and identify the people involved. Search the area around the main entrance gate for a client list and bring it back to Handshake for review.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_28_Briefing: Investigate reports of armed individuals pursuing an unknown target in the jungle to the southwest of Hunter’s Paradise. Identify who is involved. Proceed with caution, avoid unnecessary engagement, and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_11_Briefing: Investigate the Midnight Sapphire Resort for evidence of drug trafficking tied to government involvement. Search secluded staff areas around the resort for hidden stashes and collect any proof of illicit operations for Banshee.
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_6_Briefing: Investigate the disappearance of Deesabun Nguyen, an employee of Midnight Sapphire. Search the staff housing area south of the golf club for clues and report your findings to Artisan.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_31_Briefing: Investigate the disappearance of Donald J. Dortmunder. Search the Midnight Sapphire Resort, particularly the Golf Club, for clues to his whereabouts and report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_21_Briefing: Investigate the disappearance of Ying Vilaysack, an employee of Midnight Sapphire. Search Villa Elena for clues and report your findings to Artisan.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_50_Briefing: Investigate the disappearance of journalist Richard S. Parker. Search the Midnight Sapphire Hotel for clues about his whereabouts and report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Briefing: Investigate the disappearance of scouts monitoring the Midnight Sapphire Resort from a position near the northeast waterfall. Determine what happened, report your findings to Gunny, and await further instructions.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Debriefing: It looks like our guys vastly overestimated their abilities and paid the ultimate price. It’s the same shit over and over again. Doesn’t matter if it’s a PMC, regular army, or the goddamn Navy SEALs - if you think you’re tough shit and nothing can hurt you, think again. I hope you take something from this. At least then their deaths won’t be completely for nothing.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_Debriefing:
It looks like they already started the migration process, but you still managed to recover a lot of valuable data. It is just… hard to watch. Some of the recordings are beyond disturbing.

I will forward this material to the authorities when I have the time, but first I need to go through everything you brought me. I cannot afford to miss anything. There may be details that reveal what really happened on the night of the Event.

So far, I have uncovered a few deeply bizarre recordings, but I need to cross-check them from multiple angles. They look like scenes from a horror film. Absolute panic, people screaming and trampling one another, all bathed in an eerie light shining in the middle of the night…

Thank you for this. It will take time, but I am confident I will find the answers we are looking for. That said, I may need to take breaks just to keep myself together. Some of what happened here truly turns my stomach. People can be truly horrifying when given the chance.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_28_Debriefing:
It’s good to know we’re not the only ones struggling out here, but no matter how you look at it, it’s still a goddamn waste of life. Can you imagine if we stopped shooting each other for five seconds and turned our guns on the other bastards on this island? Two weeks, tops, and we’d be out of here!

Then again, we’d have to share the spoils, and there’s nobody here willing to do that...
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_34_Debriefing: I’d normally say it’s a shame she never made it out, but from what I understood, my client is more than happy with this outcome. Wouldn’t be my first choice how to get out of a shitty marriage, but hey, as long as they’re paying, I’m not judging.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_7_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been informed that you’ve once again been assigned to retrieve a certain device containing evidence of criminal activity. I would like to ask you to bring it to me instead of your morally ambiguous superior.

People in power think they can get away with a lot of shit, but with your help, we can bring them to justice. I want you to hand over the dirt you were sent to retrieve. I’m sure it will shed light on some of the events on this island. The more we gather, the better.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a job for you, and I need it done fast. Got it?

Back when we still held some ground on this rock, we stashed a few ammo caches around for quick field resupplies. Now, with the situation being what it is, we need to find out if they’re still intact, and if so, recover them.

Your task is to check a few of these locations and report back whether the caches are still there and retrievable. I’ll send someone else to pick them up, don’t worry about that. I just need the intel.

There are four caches in total. I've marked the first one on your tactical map. Take care of it, and I’ll relay the rest to you as you go.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_34_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got another client on the line who’s very interested in the airfield. Apparently, he booked a vacation for his wife to visit this POS country a week before the Event. She stayed at the Midnight Sapphire Resort, but never made it back. The question is, what happened to her after that.

I need you to head to the Pha Lang Airfield checkpoint, rummage through some baggage, and look for a purple suitcase. From what we know, pretty much everyone staying at the resort tried to use the airfield as their first means of evacuation, so there’s a good chance she was among them.

If the suitcase is still there… well. Chances are she won’t be coming home anytime soon. And that’s exactly what the client wants to confirm.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I’ve located the first cache. Everything seems to be in order.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_52_Objective_1_PLAYER_Ob: I’ve searched the room. Nothing. Someone must have taken the phone before us.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Labrat_13_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Objective_4_VENDOR_O: Last thing. One of the Whitewater Villas was given as a gift to the new commander of Fort Narith as his “summer retreat.” We need to learn more about this individual. Find his villa and bring me any documents that might uncover who the hell he is.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_43B_Objective_1_Descript: Leave the passport in the file cabinet at the Midnight Sapphire Hotel reception
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_8_AcceptMsg:
Listen, I know your superior asked you to retrieve some kompromat yet again. It looks like Midnight Sapphire is an actual gold mine when it comes to things like that. However, before that item disappears into the usual channels, I would prefer you deliver it to me instead.

I’m still gathering evidence against the Lamangese government and all those involved in crimes against the local people. Material like this should not be buried or quietly returned to its owner. I know the reward for the smartphone is significant, but this could seriously strengthen our case. Whatever is on that device may connect more threads than you realize.
ST_Quests_Resort.LabRat_Quest_15_AcceptMsg:
Listen, that flight recorder you were tasked to retrieve… I need it. This could be the key to figuring out what exactly happened here. Do you understand? We can’t let this opportunity slip away just because Handjo- Handshake is afraid of someone else sharing whatever information is stored on it. That was always his primary concern, and frankly, I find it idiotic! I- we need to carefully analyze the data right here on site! Not ship it off to some company lab where it will never be seen again!

Will you help me with this, please? I promise I won’t tell a soul and will share everything I found with you.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_34_Objective_1_Descripti: Locate and examine a purple suitcase to confirm the identity of its owner

ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_32_AcceptMsg:
Look, pal, I hate to put you in this position again, but I need you to just confirm the identity of the fallen solder, and forget about recovering his remains. The company can't afford any bad publicity right now.

You get where I'm coming from, right? This is just how it needs to be. Be quick about it, and there will be a nice reward waiting for you.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_3_VEND: Looking at what you sent, there should be some interesting intel at the Midnight Sapphire Hotel, and this feels like the perfect time to chase it.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_5_Debriefing: Magnificent work, friend! Your actions ensured that I will sleep a tiny bit better from now on. While the value of a restful night's slumber may be immeasurable, permit me to express my gratitude nonetheless...
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_11_Debriefing: Magnificent! So much money for a little shitty antique like this. Not that I’m complaining, of course. Keep silent about this, and I’ll have more work coming up. You and me… we’ll be rich men before you know it, don’t you worry.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_32_Debriefing: Man, I feel like you were born for this shit. The Lamang army is losing people at machine-gun speed. You know, like: tah-tah-tah-tah-tah! Excellent work!
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_52_AcceptMsg:
Man, it seems Midnight Sapphire really was a pervert’s paradise. Remember that fucked-up video we secured last time? Yeah, regretfully, I still do, but this isn’t about me. No, this is about our new client. I just got off the phone with some big-shot congressman who claims he lost his smartphone. At least that’s who he says he is. Honestly, I doubt it, but it doesn’t really matter. What matters is that he’s willing to pay a lot of money to get it back.

Given our previous experience, it’s pretty obvious what kind of content is probably sitting on that thing. A bargaining chip like that is useful to just about everyone.

The client says he was staying in a hotel room on the second floor, so head to Midnight Sapphire, find the place, go through every bit of luggage and every drawer, and bring me that smartphone.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_29_AcceptMsg:
Man, sometimes I swear people are dumb as fuck.

I managed to convince an LAF soldier at Midnight Sapphire to hand over some intel, but the absolute idiot stashed it in two ridiculously hard-to-reach places. And he had the nerve to explain how clever he was about it. His exact words: “I left it in plain sight, because the most obvious places are the ones nobody expects.” What is this, a fucking detective show from the ’70s?

Listen, it won’t be easy, but I need you to retrieve two briefcases. They're both in the Lakeside Rest Area. You'll find the first one on a circular path with a big tree in the middle; it should be tucked behind one of the benches. The second one’s on a small peninsula. As I said, the guy’s an idiot.

Once you’ve got them, leave one briefcase at the Teoa Viewpoint and bring the other one to me.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_53_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: Man, why are you doing this to me? Don't you understand that if we work together, we can make a fortune here? I hope you'll be more cooperative next time.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_15_Objective_1_Description: Mark the location of the body
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_09_Debriefing: Marvelous! You truly have a gift for reliability. And discretion, of course. Please accept this token of my gratitude. Until we see each other again, friend.
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_21_AcceptMsg:
Merc, stop watching the paint dry. Seriously, I always find you slacking off. Don’t you hirelings have any obligations whatsoever? I’m surprised the paper pusher Handshake doesn’t give you some bullshit work to keep you from wasting the company’s money.

I need you to look for another missing person. This time, it’s an employee of Midnight Sapphire who has mysteriously disappeared. Her name is Ying Vilaysack, and according to her friends, she was last seen in the company of a wealthy-looking foreign man. You know the type - rich, ugly bastards who love to pay for first-class “fresh meat.” They went to Villa Elena on the day of the Event, and then all hell broke loose...

I expect the worst but still hope for the best. Do your best to find her safe, merc.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_02_Debriefing: My man! You saved my ass. I was this close to telling the client his dirty little secrets were out of reach. Critical intel? Relax. Not mission-critical for us. For him, absolutely. Which means payday. So technically, I didn’t lie, right? Anyway, good work. Here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_23_Objective_2_Descriptio: Neutralize Turncoat's former "friends" in Chon village
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_32_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the LAF commander in charge of Midnight Sapphire
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_02_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies south of Midnight Sapphire
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_32_Debriefing: Nice work, buddy! We need to handle this diplomatically. There’s no reason to shout our failures when we can keep them quiet. I'm sure you understand.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_32_Subobjective_X_PLAYER: No sign of the body anywhere. Looks like we're in the clear.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_15_Subobjective_X_PLAYER_Fai: No sign of the body. It's possible that someone was quicker and already disposed of him. No idea where they might have gone.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_02_AcceptMsg:
No time for lollygagging, champ, we’re hitting Midnight Sapphire like a mad hurricane.

One of your colleagues royally fucked up. He lost critical intel he was supposed to secure, and now it’s just sitting there, ready to be found by the LAF. Gunny’s been on my ass to send the screw-up back to fix his mess, but I don’t trust him not to fuck it up again. That’s where you come in.

That idiot dropped it inside the bar at the Golf Club building. Get it back and raise all hell while you’re there. Make it look like we’re out for blood, ready to wipe them off the map. Once you have the flash drive, safely store it at the designated drop-off point south of the resort and west of the Sapphire Waterfalls.

Eliminate as many of those LAF assholes as you can, recover the drive, and get the hell out. Got it?

ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1d_VENDOR_Ob: Roger. See? This is what happens when you underestimate the enemy. No matter how amateur they might be, a guy with a gun is always a threat.
