ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_3_VEND: Seems like El Presidente himself has a private floor in the hotel, and he was in such a hurry to get lost that he probably left all kinds of documentation behind. The soldiers guarding the location are too scared to touch anything, so it should still be right where he left it. This is our shot to nail the bastard.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Gunny_07_Briefing: Several previously established ammo caches may still be intact. Check the marked locations, confirm their status, and report to Gunny on whether the supplies are recoverable. Additional cache locations will be provided as you proceed.
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_21_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: She OD'd and was just left behind? That motherfucker! No compassion, no remorse, no sympathy... we really are just playthings to them.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_32_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: Shit, man. No, we're fucking not! For all we know, the body is already being transported to our base, or it could pop up anytime and bite us in the ass! Why can’t anything be simple for once?
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_Objective_2_VENDOR_O: Shit. I'll send someone to retrieve their bodies.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_52_Objective_1_VENDOR_Ob: Shit. Okay, let’s not lose all hope yet. Assuming it wasn’t one of our competitors, the phone could still be in the hotel. Try searching the staff room on the same floor. It’s possible some asshole maid or security guard just nicked it for themselves without knowing what’s on it. You can never trust these fucking people.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_3_VEND: Shit. There's nothing about his whereabouts! Look, pal, I really appreciate your work, and I hate to say this, but I am going to need you to dig a little deeper.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_29_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: So I assume the black box was already gone, eh? I truly hope you didn't just give it to anybody else, because then we would have a problem. And I'm pretty good at dealing with problems, understand?
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_6_Debriefing: So they tortured him and then executed him, probably for some petty, stupid crime like stealing. Fucking Midnight Sapphire! This is exactly what I was talking about. You foreigners have no compassion for us; you only bring death and disaster.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_31_Debriefing: So, Mr. Dortmunder had a considerable debt, and someone came to his villa to collect? Well, well, well. And according to some of the text messages on this phone, he was a busy con artist, running up debts at every turn. At least now we have an idea why our client was probably looking for him without needing to ask directly. Anyway, I'll inform him of our findings and collect our reward.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_28_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: So, our competitors are having trouble too, huh? I’d call that good news, except the same thing could easily happen to us. You’d better keep your guard up so you don’t end up like them, you hear?
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_29_Objective_1_Description: Store the first briefcase at the Teoa Viewpoint
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_09_Objective_1_Description: Store the package at a shelter in a field south of the house
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_7_Debriefing:
Thank you for the SD card. I'm not going to reveal who the scumbag celebrity was, but make no mistake, not even their stardom will save him once the prosecution starts. What he and his buddies did to that poor woman is unforgivable. The way people with power treated the locals here is truly sickening. 

You did the right thing bringing this to me.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_8_Debriefing:
Thank you for your help. Gaining acces to the phone was surprisingly easy and the man in the photos and videos is clearly identifiable. What he’s doing is beyond reprehensible. Drug abuse, sexual assault… it’s all there.

It’s a good thing this material ended up in our hands instead of being buried or bought back by the people responsible.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_6_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fa: That is very unfortunate. I certainly hope that next time you'll reconsider.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_15_Debriefing: That poor stupid bastard. He was one of those that would always crack jokes, you know? Never any good ones, though. Guess his final joke was on him. After all, he hit a hole in one.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_10_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_32_Briefing: The LAF commander of Midnight Sapphire is getting in Handshake's way. Neutralize the target.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_50_Debriefing: The Lamangese really ain't fucking around when it comes to dealing with problems. I'll inform the client that his brother was taken to a shack and beaten to death. Lucky for us, I made sure the reward is the same whether we bring Dick back dead or alive. Good job, buddy.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_32_Briefing: The identity of a PMC casualty must be confirmed discreetly. Confirm your fallen colleague's identity without marking the body.
ST_Quests_Resort.Artisan_Quest_21_Debriefing: The rich fucker must have fled the moment something went wrong. I knew it was a long shot, but still... fuck! For once, I wish I could bring some good news... I will tell her friends what happened. You did what you were assigned to do. You can leave, merc.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_50_Objective_1_VENDOR_Ob: The scribbler must have been shocked when they came for him. I'm pretty sure he was under the impression that he was so inconspicuous. What a fucking idiot. Try looking for him in the interrogation room.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Handshake_32_AcceptMsg:
The time has come to eliminate the warmonger operating out of Midnight Sapphire. Your primary objective is to locate the ugly bastard and neutralize him with extreme prejudice - just make sure to put a round through his skull. It's as straightforward as that.

We have our own strategic agenda in this region, and the LAF is proving to be a significant obstacle in our operations. Taking this fucker out will not only eliminate a key threat but also shift the balance in our favor. So gear up and get moving. The sooner this asshole disappears, the better.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_28_AcceptMsg:
There’s a lot of commotion in the jungle southwest of Hunter’s Paradise. Intel’s scarce, but it looks like the thugs from the shooting range are chasing someone down. No clue who.

That’s why I want you to head there and find out. This could be the work of that unknown hostile organization we’ve been tracking, and we can’t afford to overlook any potential leads. Those bastards need to learn their lesson, but don’t rush in guns blazing, alright? You know very well what they’re capable of. Stay cautious, figure out what’s going on, and report back.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Objective_3_VEND: This is only a small piece of a bigger puzzle, but there are reports of casualties, various unexplainable phenomena, and some kind of contamination. Meanwhile, all Narith was getting was distorted information about ongoing research and “successful” containment of GZ.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Labrat_13_Objective_1_Description: Transfer the data from all the measuring stations at the Midnight Sapphire Resort
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Labrat_13_Subobjective_1a_Description: Transfer the data from the first station
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Labrat_13_Subobjective_1b_Description: Transfer the data from the second station
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Labrat_13_Subobjective_1c_Description: Transfer the data from the third station
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_17_Briefing: Turncoat is interested in acquiring the golf club as well. Retrieve it and deliver it to him instead of Handshake.
ST_Quests_Resort.CT_Turncoat_09_Briefing: Turncoat needs a favor, as there's something he desperately wants to possess. Locate the item he seeks and store it at the designated location.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_31_Objective_1_Descripti: Uncover what happened to Donald J. Dortmunder at Midnight Sapphire and report back to Handshake
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_Ob: Understood. Shit, guess I was right again.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_Objective_3_Descrip: Use the Micro SD autocracker to secure all the data from the server in the Midnight Sapphire Hotel
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Labrat_Quest_07_Objective_2_Descrip: Use the USB autocracker to secure all the data from the server on the golf course
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_35_Debriefing: Well, look at that beauty! I'm starting to wonder if it wouldn't be better to keep it for ourselves. Ha! Just kidding. The money the client is offering is much more appealing. Excellent work - I'll get back to you if anything else pops up.
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Handshake_Quest_07_Debriefing:
Well, well, well. Our little scaredy cat has fled to his secret villa. Finding the location will be tough, but I have no doubt that we will finally nail that asshole once we do. Call it a sixth sense.

The second piece of intel you found is also interesting. It seems we have discovered who is financing the bastards who attacked us. Those damn Russians are sticking their red noses everywhere. We will need to look into this further, but I suppose this will cheer Gunny up a bit. He is obsessed with finding out everything he can about those mysterious cocksuckers.

And although that letter reads like the ravings of a pissed-off madman, one thing sticks out. If what that asshole says is true, it seems the Event was not nearly as unexpected as we first thought.

Good job. Thanks to you, we have many new leads to follow.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_14_AcceptMsg:
We’re running dangerously low on fuel and can’t afford to waste a single drop. Luckily, I think we’ve found the place where we can finally get some.

There’s a small airfield east of the shooting range and southeast of that blight of a resort. We had eyes on at least two tanker trucks there, but both of them went missing last night. I need you to recon the area around the airfield, track them down, and check the fuel levels. Every goddamn drop counts, you hear? Just be careful. That place is far from empty.

Once you’re done, report back to me pronto. I’ll be damned if we can’t find any fuel on this rock.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_26_AcceptMsg:
We’ve got a problem. One of our squads has gone dark, and it's likely not just a simple equipment failure. They were stationed in a small hamlet west of Pha Lang Airfield to covertly monitor enemy activity in the area. Looks like they weren’t as covert as they thought, and now I need you to find out what happened.

We have no idea what the situation is out there, so be on the lookout for trouble. There were four men at that location, so search it thoroughly and report back whether they’re alive or dead.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_51_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: What the fuck do you mean you don't have the card? Do you know how much money your failure cost us? Shit, man! Don't disappoint me again.
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_52_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: You couldn't find the phone? Fuck! You're tearing me apart, man! We look like a bunch of fucking amateurs. I'll try to smooth things over with the client. Be better next time.
ST_Quests_Resort.Gunny_Quest_14_Debriefing: You gotta be shitting me! So you’re telling me that they were both empty? Somebody has to be fucking with us, there’s no other way. Either they were quicker and stockpiled all the fuel before we had our chance, or it's got something to do with whatever strange shit happened here. I’m not happy with either option. Looks like we’ll have to make do…
ST_Quests_Resort.Epic_Gunny_Quest_06_AcceptMsg:
You know we’ve had our eyes on Midnight Sapphire, right? Well, we found a great spot to monitor the resort from its northeast point, right next to the waterfall. Everything was going smoothly, like a walk in the park with your sweetheart, and then our scouts just stopped responding.

I’m not gonna lie, this doesn’t look good. They were not pushovers, and they would not desert. Head over there, investigate, and report back on what happened. I'll have more work ready for you shortly.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_7_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fa: You know you are helping to protect some pretty fucked up people, right? Guys like that should rot in prison. I thought you and I were on the same page, but I guess I was wrong.
ST_Quests_Resort.Banshee_Quest_11_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_F: You should honestly rethink who you are helping. Don't let greed be your downfall...
ST_Quests_Resort.Turncoat_Quest_16_Debriefing: You truly are a godsend! I’ll ensure the product you so graciously procured ends up in the hands of skilled academics who will assist me in my research. You have my eternal gratitude!
ST_Quests_Resort.Handshake_Quest_43B_AcceptMsg:
You'll never guess what one of the rich guys wants from us, man. And no, it's not to retrieve some fancy stuff, quite the opposite. My client wants us to plant his passport at the resort, so it looks like he disappeared or was killed. Ha! It seems to me like someone wants to start a new life.

We will, of course, help this man in need, as he is a pleasant and, above all, very generous fellow. Pick up the passport underneath a house near the river in Namhou village, find a file cabinet at the reception of the Midnight Sapphire Hotel, and drop it there. That should be enough for anybody else snooping around to assume he's gone.

ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_38_Subobjective_1c_Descript: <DEV> Assess and report the current situation at the site
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_2_Desc: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at the sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_1_Descrip: <DEV> Eliminate the hostiles at the sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_38_Subobjective_1a_Descript: <DEV> Inspect the tail section and try to locate the flight recorder
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_38_Subobjective_1d_Descript: <DEV> Locate any documents related to the crash
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR: Ah. Yes. That particular flavor of rhetoric. Turning civilians into assets without ever saying the word. Very clever. It keeps your hands clean and your conscience clear. I have a strong feeling that many of these "liberated" individuals are destined to meet a rather explosive finale.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_08_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_09_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_10_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_AcceptMsg:
Alright. I’ve got something I don’t like the smell of.

A depot near Fort Narith went quiet some time ago, but it recently lit up with traffic again. It's not the LAF, though. Different people and a lot of movement for a place that’s supposed to be abandoned. That kind of shift usually means somebody’s repurposing the real estate.

I want you to head over there, take a careful look around, gather whatever intel you can, and report back. If they’re staging something, I want to know before it happens.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Debriefing:
Alright. That fills in a lot of gaps.

What matters most is that the people causing us problems aren’t united. They’re fighting each other just as hard as they’re fighting us. That kind of infighting buys us time, and time is something we desperately need right now.

That said, don’t get too excited. Anyone who can take a camp like that from those maniacs, hold it through a counterattack, and walk away still breathing is no joke.

We’ll mark the area as unstable and keep an eye on it. If those two groups keep tearing chunks out of each other, all the better. But if one side comes out on top, we need to be ready.

You did well. Good job.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Briefing: An abandoned Sawmill north of Fort Narith has been showing signs of hostile activity. Investigate the area, gather any pertinent intel, and report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_05_Briefing: An armed group operating out of the Sawmill ambushed a PMC scout team. Sweep around the area, eliminate them, and reassert control.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_15_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Are you kidding me? Some bloke wasn’t in the mood to distribute the local propaganda, so he just tossed it all behind a billboard? Jesus, laziness really seems to be an international problem...
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_05_Debriefing: As effective as always, amigo! Good job. I bet those cocksuckers won’t be trying anything funny again anytime soon. Don't play with fire if you can't handle the heat, am I right? Here's your reward for a job well done.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2c_Des: Assess and report the current situation at the site
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_11_Briefing: Banshee needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_03_Briefing: Banshee regards the leader of the armed group occupying the Sawmill as a threat. Neutralize the target. You can find him at one of the marked locations.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_17_Briefing: Banshee wants to quietly interfere with drug production across Lamang. Disrupt the operation without drawing attention.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_18_Briefing: Banshee wants to quietly interfere with drug production across Lamang. Disrupt the operation without drawing attention.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_25_Briefing: Banshee wants to trace the distribution of drugs across Lamang. Find the shipment at the marked site and plant a tracking device on it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Objective_3_Description: Bring the LAF intel to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Objective_1_Description: Bring the soil samples to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Objective_2_Description: Bring the tissue samples to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_7_VEND: Cambodia? Pretty fucking far from home. They must have thought the island would be empty after the evac, and decided to help themselves to all the materiel from Fort Narith. No wonder they got their asses kicked.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Labrat_06_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations northwest of the Sawmill and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_16_Objective_1_Description: Check the fuel levels in the tanker truck on the road south of the Sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Check your tactical map. It should be marked.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Subobjective_3a_Descript: Collect any LAF intel in Phousai Village
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Subobjective_2a_Descript: Collect samples from the corpses in Phousai Village
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Subobjective_1a_Descript: Collect soil samples from the epicenter in Phousai Village
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Briefing: Contact with Ban Khantao, a village located southwest of Kiu Vongsa near the Sawmill, has been lost. Travel to the village, investigate the situation, and determine what happened to its inhabitants. Begin your search along the main road, and report your findings to Artisan.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_5_VEND: Crafty motherfuckers. This just turned into a very tricky situation, but now that we know what they’re cooking, we can start pissing on their parade. Before that, we still need to figure out who the fuck they are and why they’re so set on Fort Narith. Inspect the site further and look around for anything that seems out of place. Anything that could shed some light on them.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_03_Objective_1_Description: Eliminate the leader of the hostile group occupying the Sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Debriefing:
Excellent work, friend.

What you found shows three things very clearly. First, they are positioning themselves for a broader offensive. Second, they are perfectly willing to spend civilians, if it advances their cause. And third, they believe they are close enough to victory that restraint is no longer necessary.

Thanks to you, I can now see the shape of what’s coming before it arrives. And that gives me options. Very interesting options.

You’ve done exactly what I asked, and more. Leave the rest to me. I promise this information will not go to waste.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_5_Desc: Explore the Sawmill and determine the hostile group's progress with the explosives
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_6_VEND: Finally some good fucking news! Looks like they already tried pulling shit like this and failed miserably. Their medic had to be keeping notes, so look around for his hooch and see if you can find anything that tells us exactly what went down.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_8_Desc: Find out what happened to the deserters
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_19_Objective_1_Description: Find the two missing PMCs at the crossroads
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Objective_2_Description: Follow the main road and find the origin of the shipment
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_4_VEND: For fuck’s sake. That’s exactly what we didn’t need. A bunch of unknown assholes playing with bombs. Find out how far along they are with this plan, and how they managed to get their hands on ordnance big enough to crack open Fort Narith.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I have a task that requires discretion, initiative, and a certain… lack of hesitation.

Thanks to all the recent commotion, I managed to aquire some delightful intel about a hidden Lamang Liberation Army camp that recently went quiet. Not abandoned, mind you. Just quieter than I’d like. That alone makes it interesting. Camps like that don’t fall silent unless something important is being prepared.

I want you to infiltrate the site and recover any internal documents, orders, or records that might shed light on their current operations and future plans. Anything that connects this camp to wider movements in the region is of particular interest. I have a feeling this little paper trail will tell us far more than any number of dead bodies ever could.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: Fuck! Merc, this wasn't the work of those parasites squatting there right now. Bandits just shoot and loot. No, this was something else. Move your ass and check out the southern trail leading to the river. That was the villagers’ escape route if things ever went to shit. Hopefully at least some of them made it out.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_19_Debriefing: Fucking knew this would happen. What the hell were they thinking, getting mixed up with local gangsters? Anyway, good job. Just keep this under wraps, yeah? If Gunny asks, play dumb and send him my way. I’ll handle it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_03_Debriefing: Good job! Thank you for helping me clean up the mess I caused. Rest assured, I will work extra hard next time to ensure that my plan to eliminate threats works flawlessly.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_8_VEND: Good riddance. Killed by their asshole buddies for desertion, no doubt. Fine by me. Let them butcher each other, that only helps us.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_03_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you again! I think it's well past time to eliminate the leader of the armed group occupying the Sawmill. It would seem I have inadvertently created a monster larger than the one that already existed, and it is high time something was done about it. Leaving him alive would only endanger anyone who crosses his path.

Find the man in charge and ensure he never has to be angry again. Sang Samnang is his name, and he shouldn’t be hard to find. Just look for a guy with the most expensive gear - old Sang always loved his toys…
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_11_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_25_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_17_Debriefing:
Good. With any luck, they won’t realize what you’ve done until they try to get production running again. Faulty equipment, spoiled supplies, human error, an angry competitor... let them draw their own conclusions.

For now, we leave them to it. The less they understand, the more useful they remain.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_18_Debriefing:
Good. With any luck, they won’t realize what you’ve done until they try to get production running again. Faulty equipment, spoiled supplies, human error, an angry competitor... let them draw their own conclusions.

For now, we leave them to it. The less they understand, the more useful they remain.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_21_Debriefing: Great work, buddy. I won’t forget that... Now, go wash off all the mud! You look like you took a bath in it!
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Debriefing:
Great, that’s more than enough to make me lose sleep.

Looks like someone’s investing serious time and resources into cracking Fort Narith, and they’re doing it right under everyone’s noses. The stuff in those barrels is meant to hit hard and fast. And once something like that gets rolling, it doesn’t stop neatly.

You did good bringing this to me before it kicked off. Now we can start thinking about how to use it to our advantage instead of cleaning up after it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Briefing: Gunny has intercepted signs of a prolonged firefight northeast of the Sawmill that ended abruptly and left the area silent. Travel to the site, examine the aftermath, and determine who was involved and how the battle unfolded.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_21_Briefing: Handshake has requested assistance in relocating a package from a barrel on the riverbank south of Kiu Vongsa, near the confluence. Locate the package and deliver it to him.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_AcceptMsg:
Hello, can you help me with something, please? I promise this one is huge...

There’s a civilian airliner downed in the jungle northwest of the Sawmill. ZN209. It crashed after the evacuation, while the island was already under lockdown. Nothing was supposed to be flying over here at that point.

I tried pulling the records. I checked the civil aviation logs and... nothing. No takeoff, no flight path, no registration, and all the news channels are dead silent. It’s like this plane never existed. Either it was wiped from the system, or someone never logged it to begin with.

But the wreck is real, and I want you to check it out. If the flight recorder survived, it should hold all the data we need.

Head to the site, retrieve the flight recorder if you can, and let me know what you find. I’ve got a hunch this is tied to the Event. And if I’m right, someone really didn’t want this flight to be seen.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_16_AcceptMsg:
Hey, I've got some bad news. Our fuel situation hasn't improved, and incoming shipments are becoming more sparse every day we stay in this shithole. We need to look for alternatives, and we might just found one.

Apparently, there should be a tanker truck parked on the road connecting the Sawmill to Fort Narith. If there is any fuel left, it could drastically improve our chances here. 

Report back to me once you find anything out, okay?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_20_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man. Listen, those fucking scumbags are spreading like wildfire. It really pisses me off. Seems like everywhere we expand, there's a hick with an AK and a fucking death wish. I feel like that Greek guy pushing the stone. What was his name? Syphilis or some shit? Never mind.

Look, I want you to go southwest of Kiu Vongsa and make a bloody example of the assholes that roam the area, okay? We have to scare them so bad they won't dare to stick their heads out of their shitty burrows. At least for a while. Think you're up to it?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Hm. Fertilizer in those quantities isn’t accidental. The LAF doesn’t usually hit trucks unless there’s a good reason, which tells me this shipment mattered, and it sure as shit didn’t come out of nowhere. Follow the main road and find out where it originated. Stay sharp. Anyone moving material like this won’t want any attention.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_07_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR: How refreshingly dull. Still, staying ready while avoiding contact is rarely defensive. It usually means someone is waiting for the right moment to act, especially if the camp was recently supplied.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I checked the truck. Crew’s dead. No signs of looting. The cargo’s still there. It’s a lot of fertilizer, but I don't think these guys are farmers.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_3_PLAYER_: I found a PC with recordings. I'm sending them over.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Subobjective_1c_PLAYE: I found a makeshift infirmary set up inside one of the buildings. Looks like they’re preparing for casualties.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER: I found a note mentioning “liberated” civilians and how freedom demands sacrifice. It says not everyone needs a weapon to serve the cause, and that those who can’t be trained should be prepared for “other forms of contribution.” They’re very explicit about keeping this quiet.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_Ob: I found a piece of LLA propaganda. Looks like it was meant for fighters being sent into combat. Calls them “the tip of the spear,” praises sacrifice, and promises they’ll be remembered. It ends with: “Always forward. Do not stop.” And then… “Drown them in your blood.”
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2b_PLA: I found a pile of bodies near the wreckage. Looks like the passengers died in the crash and were dragged out afterward.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2d_PLA: I found a scribbled note. Looks like it was left by the looters. It says that everyone was already dead when they arrived. It also mentions the plane being "weird" and just dropping out of the sky.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Subobjective_1c_PLAYER: I found a strategic directive. It outlines a coordinated offensive. Once resistance around the Sawmill is eliminated, they plan to use it as a staging ground. The document describes a two-direction attack meant to force Fort Narith to split its attention.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Subobjective_2a_PLAYER_: I found an LAF truck on the trail. It’s abandoned, but there are three civilian bodies in the cargo bed.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER: I found an internal LLA document which confirms personnel and supplies were transferred here. They were ordered to stay ready, avoid unnecessary engagements, and keep things quiet. There’s also a note about monitoring activity around the Sawmill and awaiting further instructions.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Subobjective_1b_PLAYE: I found planning documents. Routes, timing windows, and target diagrams. It’s all focused on Fort Narith. This place is being set up as a launch point for an attack.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Subobjective_1a_PLAYE: I found several trucks being loaded with blue barrels. A lot of them. The guys here seem to be working around the clock.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_Ob: I found some notes belonging to one of the hostiles operating in the area. Looks like after their failed attack on Fort Narith, they took this camp from the Lamang Liberation Army. The LLA didn’t let that slide and hit back hard. That was the firefight we picked up. The hostiles managed to hold the camp, but it cost them badly.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I found some notes belonging to one of the hostiles operating in the area. Looks like after their failed attack on Fort Narith, they took this camp from the Lamang Liberation Army. The LLA didn’t let that slide and hit back hard. That was the firefight we picked up. The hostiles managed to hold the camp, but it cost them badly.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_4_PLAY: I found the LAF soldier. He’s dead. An interrogation transcript was next to him. It says these guys are planning to hit Fort Narith with explosives.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_15_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I found the billboard and confirmed what the scouts had hastily described: a stash of boxes full of state propaganda materials.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Subobjective_2b_PLAYER_: I found the rest of the villagers. They are all dead. Executed and dumped in an open mass grave.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_19_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I found the two deserters. They’ve been hanged inside a house near the crossroads.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_8_PLAY: I have located an old fishing hut with three bodies scattered around. If they were attempting to escape, they didn’t make it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_11_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Subobjective_2a_VENDOR_: I knew it! I fucking knew it! Those LAF cunts were behind this! Do you see anything else? Is that fucking all?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Labrat_06_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_5_PLAY: I located an explosives workshop. Looks like the hostiles are gearing up for a major operation. They’ve stockpiled a significant amount of kerosene and fertilizer and are using it to make barrel bombs.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_07_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_AcceptMsg:
I need you to check something out.

We picked up signs of a prolonged firefight northeast of the Sawmill. Lots of movement and noise, and then nothing. Whatever happened out there wasn’t just a quick hit-and-run. Someone dug in, and someone else really wanted them gone.

Head in, clear the area if needed, and figure out what went down. I want to know who was fighting, why they were fighting, and who walked away from it, if anyone did.

Stay sharp. If it was bad enough to light up the jungle like that, whatever’s left won’t be friendly.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_3_VEND: I need you to infiltrate the site and find out who they are and what they’re planning. Start by locating the LAF prisoner. He was definitely interrogated, so if you can figure out what they were asking him and what he gave them in return, we might kill two birds with one stone. I’m sure there’ll be a note somewhere that points to where they’re holding him.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_05_AcceptMsg:
I need you to move fast!

We’ve got to deal with those assholes from the Sawmill. They're stirring up trouble, and the last thing I need is more of that with higher-ups already breathing down my neck. 

Those fucking woodworms ambushed one of our scout teams recently. Luckily, our guys made it out, even though they were outnumbered, but we can’t just let that slide. They need to learn they can’t fuck with us and walk away.

Show them exactly what happens when they cross the line.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Labrat_01_AcceptMsg:
I need your immediate help.

I’ve been doing what I can to support a few forgotten locals and their families, managing to get them some much-needed supplies. But most of it never reached them. Some marauders roaming around Lamang stole the delivery. They didn’t just take it, they scattered the rest, ruined it... even urinated in the boxes.

I get it, people are desperate, and survival drives them to do questionable things. But this wasn’t survival. This was senseless malice. I can’t begin to understand that kind of cruelty. Why are people behaving like monsters?

Please… if you can, bring them new supplies. They’re hanging by a thread. This is a matter of life and death.

You will find the supplies in a storage shelter south of Kiu Vongsa. Be so kind and quickly deliver them to their homes.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_4_VENDOR_: I really had my hopes up this time. The amount of data on that recorder would be groundbreaking for my research... fuck. Well, spilled milk and all. It's a shame we didn't get it, but who could these "friends from the jungle" be?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Objective_2_PLAYER_Object: I traced the shipment. It leads to a rice depot down the road. The place is crawling with hostiles. There’s a large quantity of fertilizer stored there, and it looks like they’ve taken control of the site to access it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Name: I went, I saw, I conquered
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2a_PLA: I'm at the tail section. No access inside, but the casing where the black box should be is empty. Looks like someone got to it first.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I'm at the village. It was taken over by bandits. I found a wall near the main road, covered in blood and riddled with bullet holes. There are two bodies still lying here. Looks like the people here were lined up and executed.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_7_PLAY: I've found a notebook belonging to their medic. Looks like these guys are gunrunners from Cambodia. Along with descriptions of various injuries they sustained during an attack on Fort Narith, it also mentions a strange disease spreading quickly through their ranks. The last passage reads, "The situation is critical, and the commander doesn’t want to hear it. He is obsessed and will send us all to our deaths. I’m not the only one who sees this, and I cannot wait anymore. Today is the day. The river will be our salvation."
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_16_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I've located the truck. According to the gauges here, the tanker truck is completely dried out.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2a_Des: Inspect the tail section and try to locate the flight recorder
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Objective_1_Description: Investigate Ban Khantao and find out what happened
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_15_Objective_1_Description: Investigate a potential weapon cache on the road north of the Sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Briefing: Investigate a recently reactivated depot near Fort Narith. Search the area for signs of hostile activity, gather intelligence on what is being prepared there, and report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Briefing: Investigate a truck ambushed by the LAF and identify its cargo. Report your findings to Gunny and await further instructions.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Objective_1_Descriptio: Investigate the LLA camp and find any intel connected to their operations and plans
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the aftermath of a firefight northeast of the Sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Objective_1_Descripti: Investigate the captured LAF depot and report your findings to Handshake
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Briefing: Investigate the crash site of civilian airliner ZN209 northwest of the Sawmill and search for the flight recorder. Determine how the aircraft came down after the evacuation and report all findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Objective_1_Description: Investigate the truck ambushed by the LAF
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_3_Descrip: Investigate the wind turbine and send the recordings to Lab Rat
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_4_Descrip: Investigate what happened to the missing black box at the Sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_16_Debriefing: It almost seems like there’s not a single drop of fuel left on this entire godforsaken island. Just what the hell happened to all of it? Maybe that girl should look into this…
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2c_VEN: I’m not surprised, but I don’t think they’re the ones who brought the plane down. They’re just picking at the leftovers… No, whatever happened there was deliberate, and done with a clear objective.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_3_PLAY: I’m on the ridge. Unknown hostile forces confirmed. The entire Sawmill has been taken over.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_17_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been keeping an eye on the drug trade here. It seems some of the old production sites are still operational. Different people running them, same poison coming out.

I want you to pay one of them a visit. The location is marked on your map. Find where they’re producing the drugs and sabotage the operation. But be subtle about it. The drugs stay, the equipment stays. I don’t want anyone realizing what was actually targeted. The rest is up to you.

The longer they remain unaware of us, the more useful they’ll be.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_18_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been keeping an eye on the drug trade here. It seems some of the old production sites are still operational. Different people running them, same poison coming out.

I want you to pay one of them a visit. The location is marked on your map. Find where they’re producing the drugs and sabotage the operation. But be subtle about it. The drugs stay, the equipment stays. I don’t want anyone realizing what was actually targeted. The rest is up to you.

The longer they remain unaware of us, the more useful they’ll be.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_25_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a job for you, and I need it done fast. Got it?

Back when we still held some ground on this rock, we stashed a few ammo caches around for quick field resupplies. Now, with the situation being what it is, we need to find out if they’re still intact, and if so, recover them.

Your task is to check a few of these locations and report back whether the caches are still there and retrievable. I’ll send someone else to pick them up, don’t worry about that. I just need the intel.

There are four caches in total. I've marked the first one on your tactical map. Take care of it, and I’ll relay the rest to you as you go.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_6_PLAY: I’ve located a makeshift infirmary. All signs point to them taking one hell of a beating.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I’ve located the first cache. Everything seems to be in order.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_4_PLAYER_: I’ve located where they kept the black box. Unfortunately, it's not here anymore. However, I found a document that implies they were hired by another group to deliver it. Quote: “As per the agreement, our friends from the jungle took possession of the black box. They provided us with info about that motherfucker Banshee. That fucking snake will soon taste his own blood. Our agreement with them has ended, so shoot them on sight if you encounter them again. You can stop guarding the shack.”
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_Ob: Jesus Christ. They’re priming people to die. You don’t write something like that unless casualties are part of the plan… or the entire plan.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_3_VEND: Just as I thought. We’ve been getting reports that somebody’s been hitting the LAF in the area and even capturing prisoners. These must be the guys responsible. Even if I can’t say I’m too upset about someone else giving the LAF a hard time, we can’t just stand by and let it play out. Who knows what their actual goal is.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Labrat_06_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Briefing: Lab Rat wants you to investigate Phousai Village, located east of the Sawmill. The LAF conducted an incomplete CBRN cleanup there and then left abruptly. Collect soil and tissue samples, swab any bodies left behind, and recover any remaining intel.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Subobjective_2b_Descrip: Locate a mass grave and report your findings
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_21_Objective_1_Description: Locate a package in a barrel on the riverbank south of Kiu Vongsa, near a confluence, and bring it back to Handshake
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Subobjective_2a_Descrip: Locate an abandoned LAF truck and report your findings
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2d_Des: Locate any documents related to the crash
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Banshee_11_Objective_1_Description: Locate the Reflex Cameras and report back to Banshee
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_1_Description: Locate the cache and report back to Gunny
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_2_Description: Locate the cache and report back to Gunny
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_3_Description: Locate the cache and report back to Gunny
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_4_Description: Locate the cache and report back to Gunny
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Debriefing:
Looks like our Cambodian friends have gotten themselves into an A-grade shitshow. Now they’re regrouping, building bombs, and getting ready to try again.

If they want another crack at the LAF, that’s their funeral. But with the amount of ordnance they’re putting together, this could turn messy for everyone, us included. We can’t let them get too comfortable. I’ll start pushing for action before they decide to light the whole region up.

Good work bringing this in, man. You may have just saved a lot of people from a very loud problem.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_15_AcceptMsg:
Looks like our weapon shortage might be finally easing up. Our scouts spotted something suspicious on the road north of the Sawmill but didn’t have time to investigate.

They made some excuse about a more critical task Handshake assigned them. I’ve got my own opinion on that, but whatever. Based on their description, they might have stumbled upon a hidden weapon cache. And you know how it is in this country - nothing goes to waste, especially free guns.

I want you to check it out. They saw the cache near a billboard, so it shouldn’t be too hard to find. If our assumption is right, I’ll send a team to retrieve it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I need you to check something out. There's a village called Ban Khantao, southwest of Kiu Vongsa and northwest of the Sawmill. I've been in contact with the people there, but about a week ago, they stopped responding. It's normal for them to be quiet for a day or two, but this is far too long. I don't fucking like it.

Drop whatever bullshit you're up to and find out what's going on over there. Start on the main road leading through there and try knocking on some doors. Hopefully, it's just their radio acting up, but you'd better gear up, just in case. Ever since you lot showed up, it's been nothing but chaos and mayhem around here.

Understood? Good. Now get moving.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_05_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies around the Sawmill
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_20_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies around the crossroads southwest of Kiu Vongsa
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Subobjective_2b_VENDOR_: No... no no no, FUCKING NO! They were just trying to help. Trying to make this country a better place. They didn't fucking deserve this... they... fuck... Is that all? Please tell me that's all...
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2a_VEN: Of course they did... they knew exactly what they were looking for. Dammit! That flight recorder would’ve had everything. Someone made damn sure to grab the evidence before anyone else got there. But is this really just a cover-up... or were they after something else?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Subobjective_1c_VENDOR: Oh, I’m sure they would enjoy that. A neat little pincer, wrapped in revolutionary fervor. Very ambitious. You’ve done me a great service by bringing this to my attention, friend.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_AcceptMsg:
Oh, hey. You’re just in time. I’ve got something strange for you. Well, stranger than usual.

There’s a village on a cliff east of the Sawmill. Phousai Village. According to our surveillance, the LAF ran what looked like a full-scale CBRN cleanup operation there not too long ago. The strange thing is, they didn’t even finish. Suddenly, they just left in a hurry and never came back. They even left the bodies. I need to know what happened.

Please investigate the village. Collect soil and tissue samples, and try to bring back any intel that might help us understand what exactly went down there. Find the epicenter and also swab the bodies left behind. I know it’s a bit macabre, but the more data, the better. And if the LAF left anything behind - notes, logs, documents, anything - grab those too.

Please take every precaution. We don’t know what we’re dealing with here, and I’d really hate for something to happen to you. There’s still so much work to be done…
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_AcceptMsg:
Okay, listen up. 

We’ve got a truck sitting on the roadside that looks like it was ambushed by the LAF. The strange part is, we can’t discern any clear reason for the hit. It looks like they just wasted everyone and didn’t even bother to secure whatever the truck was carrying. That alone makes it worth a closer look.

Head to the site and inspect the vehicle. Once you’ve got eyes on the cargo, report back. We’ll decide the next move from there.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_08_AcceptMsg:
Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

Search the place marked on your map. Bring back a… sample. I will study it… thoroughly. Then I can decide if it’s time for a… hostile… takeover.

Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_6_Desc: Search for leads about what happened to the hostiles at the Sawmill

ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objective: Second cache located. Where to next?

ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_09_Objective_1_Description: Secure the box of samples and report back to Vulture
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_10_Objective_1_Description: Secure the box of samples and report back to Vulture
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_16_Briefing: Securing sufficient fuel is critical. A tanker truck appears to have been abandoned on the road south of the Sawmill. Inspect the vehicle and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_05_Briefing: Several previously established ammo caches may still be intact. Check the marked locations, confirm their status, and report to Gunny on whether the supplies are recoverable. Additional cache locations will be provided as you proceed.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_16_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Shit, another empty one, eh? We’ve been getting similar reports all over the place. Something is definitely not right...
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_7_VEND: So now we know, but that last bit interests me. Sounds like someone was planning to cut and run. I want to know where that leads. See if there’s anything nearby that points to an escape attempt. If they scattered, they might still be stirring up trouble somewhere else.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Debriefing:
So the flight recorder is gone, and the plane just fell out of the sky. No external damage tied to anything conventional. And then someone sends the Sawmill occupiers to take the recorder before anyone else can even respond? At first, I thought it was just a cover-up... but now I’m not so sure.

What if they didn’t just want to hide what happened? What if they were trying to understand it too? And do you think those "friends from the jungle" are the same ones who attacked us before?

Whatever brought that plane down wasn’t standard, and if it ties back to the Event, we might not be the only ones digging for the truth. And I’m starting to suspect that truth lies in Ground Zero...

Thank you for your help. I'm sorry we ended up with more questions than answers, but I know we'll figure it out. I'll take a more thorough look at the wind turbine recordings. Perhaps we'll find something interesting there, too.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_2_VENDOR_: So the flight recorder is gone... I was hoping we would finally have some more luck. In any case, we cannot leave empty-handed. Could you investigate the wind turbine near the Sawmill? I am sure there are cameras there that could have captured whoever took the recorder on video, as well as the crash itself.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Labrat_01_Briefing: Supplies intended for struggling locals were stolen and destroyed by marauders. The families are barely holding on, and Lab Rat wants to help them. Retrieve fresh supplies from the storage shelter south of Kiu Vongsa and deliver them to their homes.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_Objective_3_Desc: Survey the Sawmill from a nearby ridge
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Objective_2_VENDOR_Object: That explains the truck. Good work. Now we know where that fertilizer is coming from, and more importantly, how far they’re willing to go to get it.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Subobjective_1c_VENDO: That kind of setup only makes sense if they’re anticipating serious losses. Sounds like they're planning for a very ugly day.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_20_Debriefing: That's what I'm talking about! Those fucking cockroaches will crawl back eventually, but we just crushed their numbers and morale in one fell swoop. Now that's my kind of restructuring.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Subobjective_1a_VENDO: That’s a lot of material to be moving in a hurry. Barrels like that usually mean chemicals, fuel, or something worse. And that kind of tempo screams deadline.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2b_VEN: That’s horrible. I wish we could help those people somehow, but right now the best we can do is find out what happened…
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_07_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2d_VEN: That’s… unsettling. If it just dropped from the sky with no visible missile or gunfire damage… then something strange definitely happened there.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_20_Briefing: The hostile elements southwest of Kiu Vongsa are causing operational setbacks. Eliminate them.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_21_AcceptMsg:
There's no time for chit-chat. We must act quickly!

I need to help a "friend" who needs to pick up a package hidden in a barrel south of Kiu Vongsa. Shouldn’t be hard to find if you know where to look. He mentioned a confluence as a clue. There might be multiple barrels, so check the riverbank carefully.

Find the package and bring it back. Don't waste time; the package isn't entirely his, so someone could snatch it before we do. Understand?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Subobjective_2c_PLA: There’s a pile of luggage outside the wreck. Bags torn open, stuff scattered everywhere. Looks like scavengers are picking the place clean.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Artisan_Quest_29_Debriefing:
Those people there... they... they were helping the LLA. That's all. Not fighting or killing anybody. Just offering food, shelter, and maybe passing along a message or two.

The LAF must have found out... and decided to wipe them off the fucking map.

I keep saying that all went to shit the moment you mercs showed up, but... I know the rot was already here. That's what we were fighting. That's what we ARE fighting. You just threw a wrench into it, but you're not the cause. Just a fucking symptom...

I need some time to think.

ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Turncoat_Quest_28_Briefing: Turncoat has identified a Lamang Liberation Army camp that has recently gone quiet under suspicious circumstances. Infiltrate the site, search for internal documents, and report any information that could reveal the group’s current activities in the region.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_19_Briefing: Two contractors have gone AWOL. They were last seen heading southwest of Kiu Vongsa toward the crossroads. Investigate their whereabouts and report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_08_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_09_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Vulture_10_Briefing: Vulture needs product samples from hidden facilities scattered across Lamang. Secure a box of samples and bring it to him.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_19_AcceptMsg:
We've got a big problem, buddy. Imagine turning your back on everything and spitting in the company’s face - unthinkable, right? But some people just don’t know how good they have it.

Two of our contractors vanished without a word. Last anyone saw them, they were heading southwest of Kiu Vongsa toward the crossroads. That’s where I’d start looking.

Word is, they were cozying up to some shady locals. Probably got sweet-talked with big promises, and like the fucking idiots they are, they ate it up. Unbelievable.

Find them and bring them back. This kind of shit won’t be tolerated!
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Handshake_Quest_81_Subobjective_1b_VENDO: Well, fuck me. That’s a full-blown assault plan. Somebody thinks they’ve got a real shot at punching through one of the hardest targets on the island.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Handshake_19_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Well, that wasn’t much of a search. Not that I’m complaining. Ending up like this doesn’t surprise me. Even the locals couldn’t stand traitors. They got what they wanted… and what they deserved.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Gunny_15_Debriefing: Well, that’s a bummer. I’ll need to have a talk with the scouts. They should have their damn eyes checked if they’re mistaking a bunch of boxes for a weapon cache. This’ll be on their plate for a long time. Sloppy work won’t be tolerated.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Well, that’s what I call good news. As long as those idiots are busy tearing each other apart, they’re causing a lot less trouble for us. Good work digging that up.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_47_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_Ob: Well, that’s what I call good news. As long as those idiots are busy tearing each other apart, they’re causing a lot less trouble for us. Good work digging that up.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Handshake_Quest_01_AcceptMsg:
We’ve got a pressing matter to deal with.

I need you to check the area north of Fort Narith. There was supposed to be an abandoned Sawmill there, but it looks like some new homeowners moved in. We have to find out more.

Be prepared for resistance. Everything points to them being anything but friendly. Start by finding a good vantage point to survey the sawmill itself, and report back with what you see, capiche?
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Epic_Labrat_Quest_04_Objective_3_VENDOR_: Wonderful! Give me a moment... Interesting. If I am not mistaken, these people appear to be the ones currently occupying the Sawmill. But what could they possibly gain from stealing the flight recorder from a crashed airliner? Could you please go to the Sawmill and look for it? They probably locked it up somewhere on the premises. Try one of the shacks in the area.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Gunny_Quest_48_Debriefing:
You did solid work out there. Finding that depot gives us a clearer picture of who’s operating where, and leaves us with potential leverage, even if we don’t pull on it just yet. I’m also more than happy to see more of our enemies fighting each other. Warms my cold-ass heart.

We’ll keep this in our back pocket and watch how things develop.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.Labrat_Quest_37_Debriefing:
You're back! Good. Let me see…

You brought it all! Tissue samples, soil readings, and - wait, is this an actual LAF field report?

So, according to this document, the entire village was hit by a burst of radiation strong enough to vaporize people. Then it started fading, just like that. No known source. Just residual contamination and... psychological side effects? So that's why they pulled out so fast... 

The samples confirm it. Radiation’s still present, but nowhere near what it must’ve been at its peak.

This lines up with multiple reports about Ground Zero. I can't wait to analyze the samples properly! Thank you for your assistance... Are you feeling alright? Make sure you get a proper scrub and take some iodine while you're at it. I'm sure the levels there were acceptably safe, but you never know.
ST_Quests_SawmillRegion.CT_Labrat_01_Debriefing: You’re a treasure. It’s good to know not all PMCs are just in it for the money; some still have a heart. What you did will make a real difference for these families. Hopefully, the bandits will think twice before bothering them again. Here’s your reward, you’ve earned it.

ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Debriefing:
Alright. That’s all the confirmation I needed.

Forced labor from The Hole. Drug crops disguised as fertilizer. Army patrols keeping the perimeter tight and silent. This definitely was not just some back-alley operation. It was highly organized and very much protected.

However, we’re still missing one piece. The plant. Wherever they were refining the stuff, that’s where it all comes together. We find that, we find the heart of the operation.

Keep your gear ready. Once I get a lead, you’ll be the first to know.
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Copy that. If their operation is this widespread, it could jeopardize our efforts here. We need more intel ASAP. Check your active task list and proceed accordingly.
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDia: Copy that. If their operation is this widespread, it could jeopardize our efforts here. We need more intel ASAP. Check your active task list and proceed accordingly.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_Briefing: Despite severe losses, the LAF has intensified operations inside Ground Zero and is extracting high-value containers. Prevent them from securing these assets. Move to Fort Narith, then the remaining locations, intercept the shipments, and seize the containers.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_Objective_1_Descripti: Eliminate the LAF forces at Fort Narith
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_Objective_5_Descripti: Eliminate the LAF forces at Midnight Sapphire
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_Objective_3_Descripti: Eliminate the LAF forces at Tiger Bay

ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Objective_5_Descripti: Eliminate the hostiles at Hunter's Paradise
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Objective_9_Descripti: Eliminate the hostiles at Pha Lang Airfield
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Objective_3_Descripti: Eliminate the hostiles at the Blue Lagoon
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Objective_1_Descripti: Eliminate the hostiles at the Sawmill
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Debriefing: Fantastic! I know this shit wasn't easy, but you've exceeded all expectations. The boss is gonna be fucking ecstatic! I think you're starting to figure out that whatever is in these is very important to him and absolutely crucial for our mission here. I'd tell you more, but I'm afraid I know as much as you. But hey, why ask questions when the pay is so good, right?
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_: Figures. Hidden in plain sight, with all the right paperwork and the usual lies. Fertilizer, aid shipments, trusted drivers. It's always all the same everywhere. Almost routine by now.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_AcceptMsg:
Got a minute? 

I've been keeping an eye on your investigation into Pha Lang Airfield, and I wonder if you'd be willing to dig a little bit deeper. Thanks to you, we now know the drugs came from somewhere else before being packed and flown out. Probably from sites hidden in the jungle.

We’ve had some rough satellite data pointing to at least four possible poppy fields scattered across the region, but nothing concrete. Lucky for us, you’ve got access to better intel than I do. Your PMC toys should give you current imagery. Study your map closely and try to locate the sites. Once you find them, investigate. See if the crops are still there and look for any documents that might tell us where they're processing the stuff, or who's behind it. Every scrap of intel brings us one step closer to blowing this thing wide open.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Objective_6_VENDOR_Ob: Got another one in Ban Pa. Go there ASAP!
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_Objective_2_VENDOR_Ob: Great job! We have another one at Tiger Bay. You know what to do.
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_Briefing: Gunny is concerned that the rebels may have established multiple outposts across the island. This poses an ongoing threat. Analyze the map to identify the locations of the remaining camps, then check them on-site.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_AcceptMsg:
Here we go, the final stretch! The LAF has been conducting more and more operations in Ground Zero and, despite heavy casualties, securing valuable materials from within. We cannot let this continue!

The boss was very clear on this. We have to do whatever it takes to get hold of those containers. I know you've done this before, but not like this. Expect heavy resistance. The LAF knows damn well what they are doing, and they won't surrender the cargo without a fight. Whatever happened here during the Event, these things are the key to it all. The boss needs to have them, and we're gonna get them for him. This is why we are here. Do you understand? Start at Fort Narith, and I'll keep you posted about anything else we'll manage to find out. 

It all comes down to this. I hope you're ready.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1d_PLAYER_: I found a document at one of the fields. Looks like they were killing workers if target quotas weren’t met.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_: I found a note about transport. The poppy from these fields was bagged as fertilizer and sent to some processing plant. They even had a cover story ready in case anyone asked questions. Something about agricultural aid.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_: I just found a document at one of the sites. It confirms they were using forced labor from The Hole to harvest poppy.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1c_PLAYER_: I just picked up a file marked as confidential. It confirms the LAF was actively protecting these drug fields. Perimeter security, extraction, even emergency cover. All in exchange for meeting quotas.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1d_VENDOR_: I'm sad to say I'm not surprised. Numbers go down, bodies pile up. Honestly, it wouldn’t shock me if they used them as fertilizer. Anything to maximize production and profit.
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I've located a map at an LLA outpost deep in the jungle. Based on what I’m seeing, this isn't their only hidden camp. Looks like they've got bases scattered all over the region.
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_PLAYER_BecameAvailableDia: I've located a map at an LLA outpost deep in the jungle. Based on what I’m seeing, this isn't their only hidden camp. Looks like they've got bases scattered all over the region.
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_AcceptMsg:
If the rebels really have outposts like this scattered across the island, we need to initiate a full sweep of the area and identify every last one. We can’t leave any potential threats unaccounted for!

Analyze the map and pinpoint the locations of the remaining camps. That way, we can eliminate any surprises before they hit us.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1a_Descrip: Investigate the first hidden poppy field and report your findings
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1d_Descrip: Investigate the fourth hidden poppy field and report your findings
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1b_Descrip: Investigate the second hidden poppy field and report your findings
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1c_Descrip: Investigate the third hidden poppy field and report your findings
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_AcceptMsg:
Listen up! I've got an important task for you, and I need your full commitment, okay? We got reports of materials being transported from Ground Zero, and they are popping all over the place. It is of utmost importance that we secure them all. The boss was very clear about that, so I suggest you stop whatever you're doing and focus strictly on this.

The reports are still coming in, and I'm gonna keep updating you as you progress. What we know now is that those paramilitaries at the Sawmill got a hold of one of the containers used to transport whatever is in there, so pack your gear, head out there, neutralize any threats, and secure the cargo. By the time you're done, we'll hopefully have more info about other possible points of interest.

Understood? Good. Don't waste any time, and get to it!
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Objective_1_Description: Locate and investigate all the hidden poppy fields and report your findings to Banshee
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_Subobjective_1b_Descripti: Locate the LLA outpost northeast of Ban Pa

ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_Objective_4_VENDOR_Ob: Nicely done! Another one has been sighted at Midnight Sapphire. Let's finish this!
ST_Quests_Special.Gunny_Quest_31_Debriefing: Nicely done. Let’s hope that’s really all of their camps. Stay sharp and watch your back. You never know when one of those bastards might pop out of the ground like a pissed-off gopher.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_: Of course. The Hole, or YBL-1 as it's officialy named. Where else to get an endless supply of disposable labor, right under government control? This whole operation gets uglier the deeper we dig.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Objective_8_VENDOR_Ob: Our scouts spotted one of the containers at Pha Lang Airfield. Move out!

ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Briefing: Satellite data suggests multiple hidden poppy fields supplying the drug operation linked to Pha Lang Airfield. Locate the suspected sites, investigate their current status, and search for documents that could reveal where the narcotics are processed and who is running the network.
ST_Quests_Special.Banshee_Quest_27_Subobjective_1c_VENDOR_: So there it is. Plain as day. The army wasn't just turning a blind eye, they were in on it. Guarding drug operations like they were state secrets. And all signed off from the top. No wonder everyone kept quiet.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Briefing: The hostiles at the Sawmill have secured a container that originated from Ground Zero. These materials are a top priority, and Handshake wants them recovered. Head to the Sawmill, eliminate the enemy, and secure the container. Additional intelligence will be relayed as it becomes available.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_55_Objective_10_VENDOR_O: We got another one! Head to YBL-1.
ST_Quests_Special.Handshake_Quest_56_Debriefing:
You fucking did it! Great job, man. Your performance during this entire op was nothing short of exceptional. We might have had our differences, but I knew I could count on you.

The containers you secured are gonna be sent to a company lab off-site and studied inside out. I can tell you that we are on the verge of something fucking historical. The stuff that's inside... let's just say it will make us richer beyond our wildest dreams!

It might take some time, but I promise you this: Once we are prepared, we will take over Ground Zero and find out exactly what happened there.

Trust me, this is far from over...
