ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Gunny_Quest_5A_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fai: And have you really looked, or are you just saying that to piss me off? We can’t have casualties unaccounted for, understand? Either we do this by the book, or we don’t do it at all.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Briefing: Artisan has lost contact with a group of longtime associates operating near a lake south of Pha Lang. Go to the location, determine what happened to them, and report your findings to her.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_7A_Objective_1_Descripti: Confirm the identity of the body without marking it
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Objective_2_VENDOR_Ob: Fuck! So close! We could've been rich beyond our wildest dreams! I need a drink. This is really pissing me off!
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: Fucking hell! This can't be true... I have to do something. What the fuck do I do? Fuck! Fuck! FUCK!
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Briefing: Handshake has learned that a businessman hid valuable contraband in his abandoned villa south of Pha Lang. Go to the villa, search the premises thoroughly, and determine where the goods are hidden.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man. I’ve heard a juicy rumor. A very wealthy businessman used to have a summer villa here in Lamang, not far from town. Word is, he was involved in some shady business. Not surprisingly, he died, like many of his countrymen - falling out of a window. But that’s beside the point.

What matters now is that he left some unique goods behind. And I want them. Don’t worry, if this goes well, you won’t walk away empty-handed. In fact, this could make us both millionaires!

The building’s south of Pha Lang, up on a hill. Find it, search it, and figure out where he might’ve stashed the goods.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_7A_VENDOR_BecameAvailabl: Hey, you got a minute? I have a somewhat... sensitive mission for you.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Subobjective_1b_PLAYE: I found a computer. There was an email from the businessman. Quote: "Fundee, take the goods and escape with the help of the UNLRA. Take advantage of the chaos of the evacuation! Do that for me, and I promise you’ll be handsomely rewarded."
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Objective_2_PLAYER_Ob: I found the UNLRA meeting point. There are two dead UNLRA personnel and a list of evacuees. Fundee is on the list, but there's no sign of where the locals might have disappeared to.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I found the rest of the group. The others had killed them all. There was a notebook with interrogation records. Quote: "We tried everything, but all the evidence suggests that these idiots didn’t collaborate with the foreign mercenaries. Nevertheless, their deaths were a necessary sacrifice for the reconstruction of our homeland and for our cause."
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I'm at the lake. There are two bodies here, likely the criminals you mentioned. I found a note on them. Quote: "Mercenary whores! This is what happens to all collaborators who betray their homeland!"
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Subobjective_1a_PLAYE: I've found the maid's diary. It seems she was told to wait for further instructions. Quote: "Every day, I check the computer, yet the master stays silent. As ordered, I am guarding the treasured products and waiting. Fundee knows her duty."
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Gunny_Quest_5A_AcceptMsg:
I've got another assignment for you: Steven Clarke. He got separated from his squad during the retreat while seeking cover in a farmhouse southeast of the town's gas station. The last thing they heard on the comms was him screaming in terror and then suddenly dead silence. 

I need you to investigate and mark the body like before. Be extra careful on this one. I remember the guy, and he was tough as nails. No idea what happened to him to make him scream like that, so make sure the same thing doesn't happen to you.

I'll provide you with a tracker right away.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Subobjective_1b_VENDO: Interesting. Knowing what the merchandise was, he must have had immense trust in the person he was sending the e-mail to.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Objective_1_Description: Investigate what happened to the criminals near the lake
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Gunny_Quest_5A_Debriefing: Jesus Christ, what the hell happened to him? We’ll send a team to recover his body ASAP and bring it to the girl for examination. I hope she’ll manage to tell us just what is going on here…
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_7A_AcceptMsg:
Listen, we've got ourselves a delicate situation on our hands, and I'm counting on your discretion to handle it smoothly. You know how it goes - sometimes we face losses in the field. It's a tough reality, but we need to make sure we handle it the right way to protect our reputation and keep things running smoothly.

Now, I know what Sergeant Jackson tasked you to do, and while I agree with him, we need to take a step back and consider our entire situation here. If we release info about every casualty, this could quickly become a PR nightmare, and we can kiss our bonuses goodbye, got it? So, instead of marking the body for retrieval, you're just going to confirm it's really our guy, and that's it, okay?

We don't want this information to get out to the public or even spread in our ranks. It's all about maintaining our image and keeping morale up. I'm sure you understand, right?
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Objective_2_Descripti: Locate the UNLRA meeting point and find out what happened to the merchandise
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Gunny_Quest_5A_Objective_1_Description: Mark the location of the body
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_AcceptMsg:
Merc, come here and don’t interrupt me, okay? I need you to check on some of my friends who’ve stopped communicating. The easiest way to describe them would be, uh, a band of criminals... Hey, don’t give me that look! The situation here is complicated, so I don’t expect you to get it from an outsider’s perspective.

Look, I’ve known these guys since I was a kid. They stay away from violence... looting and stealing is a different story, but killing is a big no no. That’s the main reason I’m still on good terms with them. I used to get regular updates on what’s going on in their lives, but lately, nothing. And I’m starting to get a little worried.

Go find out what happened. They usually operate near a lake south of Pha Lang. You can’t miss it - it’s right next to the road. And hurry the hell up!
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_7A_Subobjective_X_PLAYER: No sign of the body anywhere. Looks like the problem solved itself.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Gunny_Quest_5A_Subobjective_X_PLAYER_Fai: No sign of the body. Whatever happened to him didn’t leave anything behind for us to find.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: No, why!? Fuck! They weren’t a threat to them! Merc, if you only found two bodies, the ones who killed them must’ve taken the rest to their place to extract more information... And from the note they left, I might have a lead on where they took them. Southwest of your position, there's a villa recently taken over by an armed group. Don’t ask. I… shit! I can't say more. Hurry, save the rest. They don’t deserve this!
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Objective_1_VENDOR_Ob: Okay, try to find the UNLRA meeting point. They have gathered locals predominantly near the main roads, so search the one going from Pha Lang towards Tiger Bay. I'll be damned if you don't find something!
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Objective_1_Descripti: Search the villa and report your findings
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Objective_2_Description: Search the villa southwest of Sabai lake and find out what happened to the rest of the criminals
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Subobjective_1a_VENDO: So she was guarding the goods. Good to know.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Gunny_Quest_5A_Briefing: Steven Clarke went missing during the retreat. He took cover in a farmhouse southeast of the town’s gas station. Investigate the area, find his body, and mark its location using the provided tracker. Remember to take the tracker with you.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_68_Debriefing: What a fucking disappointment. But nothing to be done now. I just hope some dumb bandits attacked them, and not someone who knew exactly what they were after. That way, we might still get lucky and stumble upon the goods.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_7A_Debriefing: What the fuck are you talking about!? If what you’re saying about the body is true… This is EXACTLY why we don’t mark them, see? Can you imagine the effect this would have on morale? Or if somebody here leaked this shit to the media? They would have a fucking field day with it, and our funding would go down the drain! You’re doing great work, man. Just keep it to yourself, and I assure you that you and I will come out of this on top, okay?
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Artisan_Quest_24_Debriefing: Why weren't you faster?! Maybe... Shit! No, you wouldn’t have been able to save them anyway. The other group had already made up their minds... Fuck! I need to make some calls. Leave me alone!
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_7A_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: You think? Or maybe you were just too slow, and somebody from our end already snatched it. Now I have another thing to worry about, fucking great.
ST_Quests_TownAtoMall.Handshake_Quest_7A_Subobjective_X_You_Fa: You think? Or maybe you were just too slow, and somebody from our end already snatched it. Now I have another thing to worry about, fucking great.

ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_23A_Objective_1_Descriptio: <DEV> Check on Artisan's friend at a small construction site west of Pha Lang
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_33_Objective_1_Description: <DEV> Find the Chichor family and bring them the supplies
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_23A_Objective_2_Descriptio: <DEV> Locate the letter at the friend's house northwest of the construction site and deliver it to Artisan
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Objective_3_VENDOR_Obje: <DEV> Merc, I have some work for you. Quit playing with your dick, and check your active tasks.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Handshake_Quest_71_Objective_1_Descripti: <DEV> Neutralize the enemies west of Pha Lang
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_33_Objective_2_Description: <DEV> Place the supplies in a box by the front door at a house in Namhou village
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Briefing: A woman named Fah Vongphachanh went missing during the evacuation. She worked at a small restaurant west of Pha Lang. Proceed to the restaurant and conduct a thorough search, and recover any information that could indicate her fate or whereabouts.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Objective_2_Description: Find Fah Vongphachanh north of the restaurant
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: Huh, my friend didn’t mention Fah was a sex worker, but maybe she didn’t know. It’s not exactly something you brag about. Either way, that letter sounds threatening... Fortunately, Fah was a secretive type, so there's a chance she slipped away, but you never know. According to my friend, the girl once mentioned that she lived relatively close to the restaurant, north of it, to be exact. Now hurry up and find her!
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I found Fah. Looks like she OD’d. I also went through her diary. She was surprisingly meticulous about keeping track of things she stole from the restaurant’s clients. Quote: "Looks like I won't have to buy coke for a while. One of the suckers had some white powder on him, so I appropriated it like the whites appropriated our island in the past. I bet it's some high class shit! In any case, it will serve its purpose."
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I found the UNLRA checkpoint, but there’s nothing here. Looks like they moved the supplies elsewhere. I did find a file describing the new location. Quote: "The locals are desperate and have started stealing our supplies. We had to move them to a safer place - either that or open fire on the looters, which would be detrimental to our mission here. The crates are at an abandoned farm southwest of our checkpoint. There's a lake with a large rock in it nearby, so you shouldn't miss it."
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I found the UNLRA supplies on the farm. They are untouched.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: I hope the bandits didn't already find them. Please follow the instructions in the document. It would really help us if you were successful in your search.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Debriefing: I knew I could count on you! This will be a tremendous help to everyone. Each vial, each bandage, they represent a chance for healing and recovery. It's a small victory, but one that matters so much to our people.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I’m at a suspicious-looking restaurant. It looks more like a brothel. I found a letter. Quote: "That idiot Fah took something she shouldn't have. We have to find her fast!"
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_AcceptMsg:
Listen, I’ve got bad news… Our medical supplies are running dangerously low. We’re about to hit a critical shortage, and I can’t let that happen. Fortunately, the UNLRA were well-stocked, and since they left in a hurry, they left plenty behind. 

I need you to search the UNLRA checkpoint west of Pha Lang, right on the main road. Go through it thoroughly and salvage whatever you can - every bit counts right now.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Objective_1_Description: Locate and search the UNLRA checkpoint west of Pha Lang
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Objective_2_Description: Locate the farm and search for the UNLRA supplies
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Debriefing:
Maybe I misunderstood the letter. They were probably trying to warn Fah not to snort that shit, but they couldn't reach her in time. Fuck... another wasted life.

You can go, mercenary. I don't need any more of your bad news.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Briefing: Medical supplies are dwindling and Lab Rat wants to do something about it. Intelligence indicates that the UNLRA abandoned substantial supplies during the evacuation. Proceed to the UNLRA checkpoint west of Pha Lang, thoroughly search the area, and report all usable medical materials.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_VENDOR_BecameAvailableD: Merc, I have some work for you. Quit playing with your dick, and check your map.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I need you to look for someone. Fah Vongphachanh. She's a friend of a friend, and went missing during the so-called evacuation.

According to my sources, she was a waitress at a small restaurant west of Pha Lang, and that was also the last place anyone saw her. Get over there and search the place. If she’s not there, at least find something that points us in the right direction.

Now stop wasting oxygen and go, merc, or I'll send someone more competent.
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Objective_1_Description: Search the restaurant west of Pha Lang and find out what happened to Fah Vongphachanh
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Artisan_Quest_25_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: Shit, she must have mixed up something way too strong for cocaine. Fucking hell...
ST_Quests_TownAtoResort.Labrat_Quest_28A_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: That's great! I'll send someone to pick them up right away.

ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_Objective_2_VENDOR_Object: <DEV> Finally some good news! I'll send someone to take care of them.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_Objective_2_PLAYER_Object: <DEV> I've located the supplies. Looks like they're really ours, just as you suspected.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_63_Objective_1_Descripti: <DEV> Investigate the potentially mined bridge west of Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_61_Objective_1_Descripti: <DEV> Neutralize the enemies east of Nam Thaven
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Artisan_Quest_22_Briefing: A radio tower west of Tiger Bay has gone offline, and Artisan requires an immediate repair. Head to the site to make the necessary repairs. Bring a multitool with you.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Briefing: A supply truck was ambushed by local thugs. Proceed to Khonwan village east of Nam Thaven and determine what happened to the shipment.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Subobjective_1b_VENDO: A transshipment point? What a strange choice of words. I'm curious to see what the idiots managed to gather...
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Briefing: According to intelligence reports, a local criminal leader has set up unauthorized checkpoints around Khonwan village and is extorting civilians to consolidate control. Go to Khonwan village, gather relevant intel, and locate the target. Report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_1_VENDOR_Ob: Alright, you’ve gathered enough intel. Go check out the transshipment point. They mentioned a garage, so look for one on the main road leading east. If we’re lucky, we might get an audience with the King himself.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Subobjective_1a_VENDO: Bitches, eh? One of the scout reports mentioned an abandoned strip bar further down the road; it could be the hiding place the notes were referring to...
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_AcceptMsg:
Can you do something for me, please? I would like you to check out Khamphet village. I was in contact with some of the locals there, but I haven't heard from them in a while.

The village is on the main road east of Nam Thaven towards the Blue Lagoon. Please, go there immediately. I need to ensure nothing terrible has happened.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Damn it. I was really hoping they would be dumber than that. Crafty bastards...
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Finally some good news! I'll send someone to take care of them.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Objective_1_Description: Find out what happened in Khamphet village
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Objective_1_Description: Find out what happened to the stolen shipment
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1c_Descripti: Find the boxes in a hut
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1b_Descripti: Find the boxes near the truck
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_2_VENDOR_Ob: Fuck, nobody's safe in this country. Guess you'll have to check out the strip bar. Terrible, I know. And remember, no hanky-panky with the service!
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: God... It must have been them. The villagers warned me there were dangerous people there, even before all this started happening...
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Debriefing: Goddammit! The bastards are smarter than I gave them credit for. They took what they could and left the tracker to taunt us. This couldn't have happened at a worse time...
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1c_VENDOR_Ob: I bet they'd even steal the air out of the boxes if they knew how. Try to find the tracker.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Debriefing: I feel like everyone I’ve ever tried to help here ends up dead sooner or later. Is it me? Could it all be my fault? I was just trying to do some good...
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objec: I found a dead woman in a pickup truck. It looks like she was kidnapped from the massacred village, but succumbed to her wounds. They were probably heading to the Blue Lagoon.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_PLAYER_BecameAvailableDia: I found a note in Khonwan village. Looks like the bandits ran off with some supplies. Quote: "They're onto us! Once you read this, take the fucking goods to the northern safe house behind the hill! And be quick about it!"
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_Ob: I found an empty house. No sign of the tracker or our supplies.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1c_PLAYER_Ob: I found some empty boxes. The bandits took everything.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Subobjective_1b_PLAYE: I found some notes. They mention a hiding place. Quote: "The King ordered us to transfer the confiscated goods to the garage. Heh, he called it a transshipment point; he really does talk like a damned noble sometimes. But then again, I saw the look in his eyes when he gave the order. Fuck. We stole so much, but he was still hungry for more!"
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_Ob: I found some of the boxes from the truck. Empty.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_3_PLAYER_Ob: I found the King's notes. It seems he disappeared to an unknown place. Quote: "Those rough men clung to me like ticks, and I couldn’t break free. They see me as some kind of tough guy because of my size, but all I’ve ever wanted is a little peace, a few episodes of Gilmore Girls, a cat on my lap, and some time for crochet."
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I found the UNLRA checkpoint, but there’s nothing here. Looks like they moved the supplies elsewhere. I did find a file describing the new location. Quote: "The locals are desperate and have started stealing our supplies. We had to move them to a safer place - either that or open fire on the looters, which would be detrimental to our mission here. The crates are in a shack in a field northeast of our checkpoint. It’s near Khonwan village and visible from the road."
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Objective_2_PLAYER_Objec: I found the UNLRA supplies in the shack. They are untouched.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I found the tracker. Looks like they ditched it the moment they realized what it was and took off with our supplies.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: I hope the bandits didn't already find them. Please follow the instructions in the document. It would really help us if you were successful in your search.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Debriefing: I knew I could count on you! This will be a tremendous help to everyone. Each vial, each bandage, they represent a chance for healing and recovery. It's a small victory, but one that matters so much to our people.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_AcceptMsg:
I want you to check out the "goods" those bastards mentioned in the note. It could just be a coincidence, and you’ll find a stash of stolen TVs, but I highly doubt it. Someone dared to steal from us, and everything points to these guys.

Even if you find other supplies, whether from the LAF or other PMC competitors, it’d still be useful. We need to salvage as much as we can.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_Debriefing: I was starting to think those supplies were gone for good. Good work, this'll help us a lot.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: I'm in Khamphet village. All the villagers were massacred. Someone locked them in a barn and set it on fire.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Artisan_Quest_22_Debriefing: I'm surprised the tower didn’t explode after your repair attempt. Seems like you know more than just mindless killing; maybe you should’ve focused on your other talents, merc.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_AcceptMsg:
I've been informed about an interesting fella who quickly took advantage of the dynamic situation after the evacuation. This smartass established a crime gang that set up checkpoints and began collecting tolls around Khonwan village.

The informants say their leader is built like a fucking mountain - a real giant, who sows fear just by his presence. Apparently, the bastard even started calling himself "The King." Confident, huh? Well, I think I speak for all of us when I say we don’t need a neighbor like that.

Your job will be to find the local monarch and deal with him the French way. Look around the Khonwan village for clues; I bet they left a few. You know how sloppy these idiots are.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Subobjective_1a_PLAYE: I've located a laptop. There's a message here. Quote: "The King has instructed us to retreat to our safe house if anything goes south. It shows he really cares about us, even though he looks like he’ll rip your arms off if you look at him the wrong way... But damn, I wish the bitches were still at that place."
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I've located the supplies. Looks like they're really ours, just as you suspected.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_2_PLAYER_Ob: I've located the transshipment point. There's nothing here. Looks like a rival gang hit them and stole their goods.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Objective_2_Description: Investigate who is responsible for the atrocities
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Briefing: Lab Rat has lost contact with the civilians of Khamphet village. The village is located along the main road east of Nam Thaven. Head to the location, assess the situation, and determine the status of its residents.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_AcceptMsg:
Listen, I’ve got bad news… Our medical supplies are running dangerously low. We’re about to hit a critical shortage, and I can’t let that happen. Fortunately, the UNLRA were well-stocked, and since they left in a hurry, they left plenty behind.

I need you to search the UNLRA checkpoint east of Nam Thaven, right on the main road. Go through it thoroughly and salvage whatever you can - every bit counts right now.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Artisan_Quest_22_Objective_1_Description: Locate and repair the radio tower west of Tiger Bay
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Objective_1_Description: Locate and search the UNLRA checkpoint east of Nam Thaven
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Objective_2_Description: Locate the shack and search for the UNLRA supplies
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_3_Descripti: Locate the strip bar further east and uncover what happened to the King
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_Objective_1_Description: Locate the supplies at the safe house north of Khonwan village
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_2_Descripti: Locate the transshipment point on the main road
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Briefing: Medical supplies are dwindling and Lab Rat wants to do something about it. Intelligence indicates that the UNLRA abandoned substantial supplies during the evacuation. Proceed to the UNLRA checkpoint east of Nam Thaven, thoroughly search the area, and report all usable medical materials.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Artisan_Quest_22_AcceptMsg:
Merc, I’ve got an urgent task for you. Don’t worry, it’s nothing too hardcore. Just fix a radio tower. What, not man enough for such a simple repair?

All you need to do is tighten a few screws, maybe cut a green wire if you find one, and sing it a lullaby. Nothing fancy. I'll provide you with the necessary multitool, so don't fucking forget to bring it with you!

The tower’s on a hill west of Tiger Bay... and it’s a tower, alright? A motherfucking big-ass TOWER. I’m sure you can manage to find it.

Don’t waste time, get moving. Unlike your precious company, I won’t pay you for slacking off.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_Ob: Not what I wanted to hear. See if they left anything somewhere around.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_1_Descripti: Search Khonwan village for intel on the King
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_Ob: Shit, try looking for more. Maybe you'll find some untouched ones or the tracker.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_28_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objec: That's great! I'll send someone to pick them up right away.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_Briefing: The discovered note mentions a stash. Investigate the safe house north of Khonwan village and report your findings to Gunny.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_34_AcceptMsg:
The local thugs are getting too cocky for their own good. They ambushed one of the supply trucks we managed to acquire in this shithole and stole a large shipment right from under our noses. Fortunately, we put a tracker in the boxes, so we know exactly where to find them.

I'll mark the location on your tactical device, and you'll get the supplies back. We can't afford to lose a shipment like this, and not just because of our miserable situation. How would we look if we let this slide? Like a weak animal. The kind jungle predators are just waiting to tear apart.

The tracker is pinging from a village east of Nam Thaven, right on the main road. Go and don't disappoint me.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Debriefing: This has to be one of the weirdest stories I’ve ever heard, buddy. Shit, to take orders from such a two-faced wuss… Unimaginable, right?
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.LabRat_Quest_29_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: Those monsters! They burned them alive! Please, you have to find who did it! Head east along the main road, they might still be close. Please, we can't let them get away with this!
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Gunny_Quest_35_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDia: Well, well, well. Looks like fortune is finally smiling upon us. We've lost some supplies, and I'll be damned if those assholes aren’t talking about the very same ones. Have a look at your map. I need you to help me with this.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMall.Handshake_Quest_62_Objective_3_VENDOR_Ob: What the fuck? So the famous King was more like a queen? At least we have one less problem to deal with, but damn, what an unexpected turn of events.

ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_66_Objective_1_Descripti: <DEV> Find the isolated house northwest of a bridge west of Nam Thaven and neutralize the equipment within
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: <DEV> I found a message detailing some the Lamang Liberation Army's stashes in the region. Quote: "Nithan, we’ve hidden some of the supplies in the southern jungle area. One barrel is buried behind a building on a farm near the jungle, and the second is in a hut southwest of the farm."
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_37_Objective_1_Description: <DEV> Locate all the enemy supplies at the gas station east of Fort Narith
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Objective_1_Descripti: <DEV> Locate the gas station east of Fort Narith

ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_37_Subobjective_1b_Descripti: <DEV> Secure the supplies in the bathroom
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_37_Subobjective_1c_Descripti: <DEV> Secure the supplies next to a large truck
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_37_Subobjective_1a_Descripti: <DEV> Secure the supplies next to a pickup truck
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: <DEV> Thank God for human stupidity! Check your active tasks.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_Briefing: A PMC casualty must be confirmed discreetly. Go to the location and verify the identity of your fallen colleague. Do not mark the body for retrieval.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_AcceptMsg:
A chance to sabotage the local bastards' plans is something I’m never going to pass up. I want you to locate the barrels mentioned in the message, and if they’re still in place, I’ll send someone to salvage them.

Based on the intel you found, I’d start by scouring the jungle southeast of YBL-1. There are a few farms in that area that match the description, and if you find the right one, locating the second stash, just southwest of the farm, should be a piece of cake.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Briefing: An opportunity to disrupt hostile operations has been identified. Locate the barrels mentioned in the intercepted message. Begin your search in the jungle southeast of YBL-1. Confirm both locations to Gunny.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_5B_Subobjective_X_VENDOR_Fai: And have you really looked, or are you just saying that to piss me off? We can’t have casualties unaccounted for, understand? Either we do this by the book, or we don’t do it at all.

ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_Objective_1_Descripti: Confirm the identity of the body without marking it
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Artisan_Quest_23_Briefing: Contact has been lost with Artisan's associate, who lives on a remote farm west of Nam Thaven. Verify the individual's status and report your findings.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Artisan_Quest_23_Objective_2_Description: Deliver the letter to a box at the front door of a farm east of Fort Narith
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Artisan_Quest_23_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: Fuck! This is bad. Someone beat us to it... Quickly, search around her farm for a letter. If we're lucky, it might still be there. Once you find it, take it to another farm east of Fort Narith. There's a box by the front door, so just slip the letter inside and get lost. Got it?
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Subobjective_1b_VENDO: Good find. Knowing the exact location of their base of operations will be very beneficial in our future dealings with them.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_Subobjective_1a_VENDO: Good job, buddy. Looks like they were able to do at least something right. Is that all?
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Objective_2_VENDOR_Object: Good job. I hope they'll really miss it.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Subobjective_1a_VENDOR_Ob: Good job. I hope they'll really miss it.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Subobjective_1b_PLAYE: Got a laptop. From what I can gather, they’ve converted the conquered military complex into their HQ.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_AcceptMsg:
Hey man, the big boss called. He wants to know more about the UNLRA evacuation and how it went down. According to his sources, the Blue Helmets set up a checkpoint and an improvised evac center behind a bridge west of Nam Thaven. From what we know, they were always keeping lists of evacuees - in this case, lists of underage evacuees.

The boss, bless his giant heart, wants to know if all the children from this area have been evacuated from the island. Head to that location, find the documents, and report back to me.

We don't want to disappoint our patron, so chop-chop.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_VENDOR_BecameAvailabl: Hey, you got a minute? I have a somewhat... sensitive mission for you.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_30_AcceptMsg:
I don't know where they stole it from, but the outlaws managed to get their hands on some UNLRA supplies. They don't deserve them, but plenty of suffering locals do.

I need you to search the small marketplace west of Nam Thaven, retrieve the supplies, and deliver them to an elderly couple living further west.

Take the main road toward Fort Narith until you come across a wide clay road. Follow it until you reach a small cluster of buildings. Look for a house with a box at the front door and leave the supplies there. The couple is wary of outsiders and will likely be hiding somewhere, so don't try to find them or engage in conversation.

If you reach a bridge, you've gone too far west. But if you head directly south from the bridge, you'll also find the settlement. Good luck.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_PLAYER_BecameAvailableDia: I found a message detailing some the Lamang Liberation Army's stashes in the region. Quote: "Nithan, we’ve hidden some of the supplies in the southern jungle area. One barrel is buried behind a building on a farm near the jungle, and the second is in a hut southwest of the farm."
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Subobjective_1a_PLAYE: I found some notes next to a military-grade radio that mention secret bases hidden deep in the jungle.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_Subobjective_1a_PLAYE: I found the UNLRA folder. According to this document, all the children on the list have been safely evacuated.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_Subobjective_1b_PLAYE: I found the UNLRA folder. According to this document, some of the children were unaccounted for or listed as missing.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Objective_3_PLAYER_Object: I've found the stash in the jungle hut.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Subobjective_1b_PLAYER_Ob: I've found the stash in the jungle hut.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Objective_2_PLAYER_Object: I've found the stash on the farm.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Subobjective_1a_PLAYER_Ob: I've found the stash on the farm.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Artisan_Quest_23_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I've found your friend. She's dead. Someone shot her.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_5B_AcceptMsg:
I've got another assignment for you: Steven Clarke. He got separated from his squad during the retreat while seeking cover in a farmhouse west of the town's gas station. The last thing they heard on the comms was him screaming in terror and then suddenly dead silence. 

I need you to investigate and mark the body like before. Be extra careful on this one. I remember the guy, and he was tough as nails. No idea what happened to him to make him scream like that, so make sure the same thing doesn't happen to you.

I'll provide you with a tracker right away.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Subobjective_1a_VENDO: Interesting. We can reasonably assume they still have hidden camps on the island, meaning they're not newcomers.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_5B_Debriefing: Jesus Christ, what the hell happened to him? We’ll send a team to recover his body ASAP and bring it to the girl for examination. I hope she’ll manage to tell us just what is going on here…
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_Debriefing: Leave it to the UNLRA to half-ass everything, eh? I'll report our findings to the boss. Hopefully, he won't be too pissed off about the results.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_AcceptMsg:
Listen, we've got ourselves a delicate situation on our hands, and I'm counting on your discretion to handle it smoothly. You know how it goes - sometimes we face losses in the field. It's a tough reality, but we need to make sure we handle it the right way to protect our reputation and keep things running smoothly.

Now, I know what Sergeant Jackson tasked you to do, and while I agree with him, we need to take a step back and consider our entire situation here. If we release info about every casualty, this could quickly become a PR nightmare, and we can kiss our bonuses goodbye, got it? So, instead of marking the body for retrieval, you're just going to confirm it's really our guy, and that's it, okay?

We don't want this information to get out to the public or even spread in our ranks. It's all about maintaining our image and keeping morale up. I'm sure you understand, right?
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Objective_1_Description: Locate the LLA stashes southeast of YBL-1
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_Objective_1_Descripti: Locate the UNLRA evac center west of Nam Thaven
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Subobjective_1b_Descripti: Locate the barrel in a jungle hut
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Subobjective_1a_Descripti: Locate the barrel on a farm
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_5B_Objective_1_Description: Mark the location of the body
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Artisan_Quest_23_AcceptMsg:
Merc, what the fuck are you doing? Are you zoning out again? It's like you don't know what to do with your time when you don't have a chance to massacre someone.

I've got a job for you. My friend lives west of Nam Thaven on a remote farm and hasn't contacted me in a while. I want you to check if she's okay. The farm shouldn't be hard to find, follow the main road from Nam Thaven towards Fort Narith and when you come to the second dirt road to the south, take it.

That's all. Just a regular check. No killing, no plundering, no pillaging. Boring for you, but essential for me. Rest assured, you will get your reward, so be on your way, hireling.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Objective_3_VENDOR_Object: Music to my ears. The less they have, the better.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Subobjective_1b_VENDOR_Ob: Music to my ears. The less they have, the better.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_Subobjective_X_PLAYER: No sign of the body anywhere. Looks like the problem solved itself.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_5B_Subobjective_X_PLAYER_Fai: No sign of the body. Whatever happened to him didn’t leave anything behind for us to find.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_30_Briefing: Outlaws have seized UNLRA supplies and are holding them in a small marketplace to the west of Nam Thaven. Secure the supplies and deliver them to an elderly couple living further west.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_Debriefing: Perfect. The less the LLA has, the better for us. I hope we get another chance to hurt them in whatever way possible.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_30_Subobjective_1a_Descript: Pick up the UNLRA supplies from a small marketplace west of Nam Thaven

Proceed to the site west of Nam Thaven, locate any relevant documentation, and determine whether all children from the area were successfully evacuated. Report your findings to Handshake.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Briefing: Reports indicate that the LLA are dispersing and are likely operating from a temporary base near the main road between Nam Thaven and Fort Narith. Search the suspected base, recover any actionable intel, and report back to Handshake.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_Objective_2_Descripti: Search the center and report your findings
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Objective_2_Descripti: Search the station and report your findings
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_5B_Briefing: Steven Clarke went missing during the retreat. He took cover in a farmhouse west of the town’s gas station. Investigate the area, find his body, and mark its location using the provided tracker. Remember to take the tracker with you.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Gunny_Quest_38_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDia: Thank God for human stupidity! Have a look at your map. I have a job for you.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Artisan_Quest_23_Debriefing: That was close. Everything almost went to shit. Just a shame to lose such a capable person... What are you waiting for, merc? A pat on the back? You delivered a letter, nothing groundbreaking. Piss off.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_Debriefing: These guys seem like a well-prepared and organized group that’s been running operations here long before any of this shit started. I'm intrigued to see what more we'll learn about the people who dared to challenge the LAF.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_67_AcceptMsg:
We need to gather as much information as possible about the LLA.

Everything suggests they’re spreading out, so if I were you, I’d focus on the main road leading from Nam Thaven to Fort Narith. There’s likely a building being used as a temporary base for their operations. A gas station should be nearby, so check it out.

Now, move fast. The sooner you find the intel, the better.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_64_Subobjective_1b_VENDO: Well, that's unfortunate. The boss ain't gonna be happy about this. Anything else?
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_Debriefing: What the fuck are you talking about!? If what you’re saying about the body is true… This is EXACTLY why we don’t mark them, see? Can you imagine the effect this would have on morale? Or if somebody here leaked this shit to the media? They would have a fucking field day with it, and our funding would go down the drain! You’re doing great work, man. Just keep it to yourself, and I assure you that you and I will come out of this on top, okay?
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_30_Debriefing: You did it! Thank you very much. It's good that we were able to provide essential supplies to those in need.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_Subobjective_X_VENDOR: You think? Or maybe you were just too slow, and somebody from our end already snatched it. Now I have another thing to worry about, fucking great.
ST_Quests_TownBtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_7B_Subobjective_X_You_Fa: You think? Or maybe you were just too slow, and somebody from our end already snatched it. Now I have another thing to worry about, fucking great.

ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Handshake_Quest_74_Objective_1_Descripti: <DEV> Neutralize the enemies around the crossroads southwest of Kiu Vongsa
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: I found the UNLRA checkpoint, but there’s nothing here. Looks like they moved the supplies elsewhere. I did find a file describing the new location. Quote: "The locals are desperate and have started stealing our supplies. We had to move them to a safer place - either that or open fire on the looters, which would be detrimental to our mission here. The crates are in a shack south of our checkpoint. There's a lake with a large rock in it nearby, so you shouldn't miss it."
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I found the UNLRA supplies in the shack. They are untouched.
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: I hope the bandits didn't already find them. Please follow the instructions in the document. It would really help us if you were successful in your search.
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Debriefing: I knew I could count on you! This will be a tremendous help to everyone. Each vial, each bandage, they represent a chance for healing and recovery. It's a small victory, but one that matters so much to our people.
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_AcceptMsg:
Listen, I’ve got bad news… Our medical supplies are running dangerously low. We’re about to hit a critical shortage, and I can’t let that happen. Fortunately, the UNLRA were well-stocked, and since they left in a hurry, they left plenty behind. 

I need you to search the UNLRA checkpoint southwest of Kiu Vongsa, right on the main road. Go through it thoroughly and salvage whatever you can - every bit counts right now.
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Objective_1_Description: Locate and search the UNLRA checkpoint southwest of Kiu Vongsa
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Objective_2_Description: Locate the shack and search for the UNLRA supplies
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Briefing: Medical supplies are dwindling and Lab Rat wants to do something about it. Intelligence indicates that the UNLRA abandoned substantial supplies during the evacuation. Proceed to the UNLRA checkpoint southwest of Kiu Vongsa, thoroughly search the area, and report all usable medical materials.
ST_Quests_TownCtoMilBase.Labrat_Quest_28C_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: That's great! I'll send someone to pick them up right away.

ST_Quests_TownCtoResort.Artisan_Quest_26_Debriefing:
A few locals were evicted from their homes because of this monstrosity... and not long after, the poor bastards were banished again - this time by the UNLRA "peacekeepers."

Shit! No wonder the police were so damn proactive over a so-called old people's home. Now it all makes sense. Fucking corrupt government! Nothing but a pack of hyenas...

ST_Quests_TownCtoResort.Artisan_Quest_26_Objective_2_Description: Find intel describing what is being built
ST_Quests_TownCtoResort.Artisan_Quest_26_Objective_2_VENDOR_Obje: Fucking bastards! I hope a stray bullet hits those developers.
ST_Quests_TownCtoResort.Handshake_Quest_7C_VENDOR_BecameAvailabl: Hey, you got a minute? I have a somewhat... sensitive mission for you.
ST_Quests_TownCtoResort.Artisan_Quest_26_AcceptMsg:
Hireling, I have an easy-to-do job for you. Normally, I would ask a trained monkey, but they're all busy, so you'll have to do.

Before all this crazy shit started, someone opened a construction site east of Kiu Vongsa. I have absolutely no idea who's in charge of the project or what is being built, but I need to know. We were informed that they were going to build an old people's home, but I doubt they would need a fucking crane just for the elderly.

Find out what is going on in that place. Follow the main road. As a mentioned, there's a big-ass crane. You can't miss it unless you're blind. It's giving a giant middle finger to everyone in the city.
ST_Quests_TownCtoResort.Artisan_Quest_26_Objective_2_PLAYER_Obje: I found blueprints. Looks like some bigshot tried to build a casino here.

ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Turncoat_Quest_02_AcceptMsg:

If you would be so kind as to assist me with a delicate matter, I might suppress my otherwise impeccable sense of taste and add that crime against aesthetics to my inventory.

I need you to visit two checkpoints on the edge of Ground Zero, specifically on its west and northeast sides, and bring back devices containing data about the Event. I am reliably informed that these devices are collected on a regular schedule, so it would be wise to intercept them before they disappear into less accommodating hands. Furthermore, to gain access, I shall need encryption codes that can be found on a hard drive discreetly placed inside the operations room at Fort Narith headquarters.

Now off you go, friend. And do be careful. As you very well know, the areas around Ground Zero tend to get a little... spicy.
