The LAF commander you just eliminated was carrying a custom-made weapon.

I should be able to add a similar firearm to my inventory, but before I do, I need your help. After weeks of careful maneuvering, I managed to establish contact with an LAF officer willing to assist me with my investigation. However, he has a condition. He wants the hostile presence in and around Pha Lang Airfield and the sawmill reduced. Substantially. I assume he intends to take credit for the results and use them to advance his position within the ranks.

Please, handle this for me. Once it is done, report back, and we'll see what he has for us.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Vulture_Quest_02_AcceptMsg:
The...foreigner you just... dispatched. He was in... possesion of a very special pistol.

I can offer it for... sale. But you... you will do something for me first.

One of my... collectors failed to make his delivery. Na Xieng Farms. Locked. Parts of the code... hidden in fields with secret... harvest. Same region. Two fields.

Make the delivery in his... stead. Place it in a box near the... remote hangars at the airfield. It needs to be... secured. Find the key in his car. Road by the... river. East of the airfield. Hide the key under the box once you're done.

Quickly.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Artisan_Quest_02_Objective_2_VENDO: There are two briefcases full of money used to buy the LAF’s loyalty to Narith. One is on the second floor of the Municipal Office Building. The other is hidden in the Amazing Shoes shop at Tiger Bay Central. I want you to head there and Robin Hood that shit. Bring them to me, and I’ll make sure the money reaches people who actually need it.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Artisan_Quest_02_Objective_1_VENDO: There you go, merc. Now put on your walking shoes, visit each of them, and when you’re done, report back with what you saw. A nice little stroll will do you good, trust me. You’re starting to get a bit fat, you know.

There you go, merc. Now put on your walking shoes, visit each of them, and when you’re done, report back with what you saw. A nice little stroll will do you good, trust me. You’re starting to get a bit fat, you know.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Artisan_Quest_01_Debriefing:
There you go. See? Simple. Just like you.

Now cough up the money, and you'll get the gun.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Vulture_Quest_03_Briefing: Vulture is looking to expand his selection of weapons and needs the Range & Rifle magazine to do so. Secure the periodical and deliver it to him.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Vulture_Quest_04_Briefing: Vulture is looking to expand his selection of weapons and needs the Range & Rifle magazine to do so. Secure the periodical and deliver it to him.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Gunny_Quest_05_AcceptMsg:
Well, shit. Is that the issue of Range & Rifle I think it is? There's a Benelli M4 setup in there I've been meaning to get a better look at.

Bring me the magazine. I've always had a soft spot for the M4. Reliable, tough, and it'll keep running through the kind of abuse that would turn a lesser shotgun into an expensive club. If it's the one I'm thinking of, I should be able to get a similar version into my stock.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Banshee_Quest_04_Debriefing:
Would you look at that. I never expected to find this issue here in Lamang. It’s difficult to obtain even in the West. Quite the unexpected blessing.

You have my thanks. Take a look at my stock; the camo model is waiting for you there.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Vulture_Quest_04_Debriefing:
Yes... this is the one. Very nice.

I'll make the necessary... arrangements. Have a look at my stock when you get the chance. The camo AUG A3 will be there.

Consider yourself... fortunate. I don't normally give my customers... first choice.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Artisan_Quest_02_Debriefing:
You didn’t skim a little off the top, did you? I’ll assume you’re not that desperate.

That money was meant to keep Narith’s lapdogs loyal. Now it’s going somewhere useful for a change. Hey, don’t get all warm and fuzzy about it. You’re not a fucking hero. Just correcting the balance a little.

As promised, the pistol’s available. Just make sure you point it at the right people.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Gunny_Quest_04_AcceptMsg:
You got your hands on a copy of Range & Rifle? Now that’s something I’d be interested in. Bring it to me, and I’ll make a camo Mossberg 590 available in my stock. Fair trade.

Don’t know if you actually read it, but you should. It’s a solid publication. Good insights, updates from the PMC world, and a few tricks worth remembering. Not everything useful comes through a screen.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Gunny_Quest_03_AcceptMsg:
You got your hands on that Range & Rifle magazine? Damn, I’d be interested in that. Bring it to me, and I can make a camo version of the DDM4 available for you.

Too many guys underestimate information like that. They rely on AI for everything these days. Truth is, there’s a lot more printed on good old paper than anyone would ever dare post online.
ST_Quests_VendorStock.Stock_Banshee_Quest_03_Debriefing:
You should really give this periodical a chance. I’ve read many similar magazines over the years, but this one surpasses them all by a wide margin. Never judge a book by its cover. Or in this case, a magazine.

Take a look at my offer. You will find the promised camo version there.

ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Labrat_Quest_36_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objec: <DEV> A hut in the middle of nowhere, covered in scientific notes? That sounds like a field lab! Please, have a look at your map.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Labrat_Quest_36_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objec: <DEV> I've located a small hut deep in the jungle. No one's home, but the place is covered in notes. Charts, formulas, pages full of scribbles… some of it looks scientific. Not sure what I’m looking at yet, but someone spent a lot of time here.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Labrat_Quest_36_Briefing: A hut containing mysterious research notes has been discovered. Search the area thoroughly for valuable intel that may clarify the purpose of the project. Focus on secured or locked sections and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Labrat_Quest_36_VENDOR_BecameAvailableDi: A hut in the middle of nowhere, covered in scientific notes? That sounds like a field lab! Please, have a look at your map.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Subobjective_7a_Des: Acquire the data from the computer
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Vulture_04_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Vulture_05_Debriefing:
Ah… there it is. Let me see what our little… entrepreneurs have been cooking. Quality… purity… value. Everything can be measured.

You did… well. If the product has potential, perhaps the business is worth… taking.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Debriefing: All four accounted for. Good work. We’ll handle the recovery, so consider your part done. Here’s your reward.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Debriefing:
Amazing! This will have a massive impact on my- I mean, our research here!

Glancing over the contents of the disk, it’s clear that the bunker is just an extension of some other facility we haven’t identified yet. The name "RLSL-1" comes up frequently, along with one other term: "Project Distant Voice." The same that was mentioned in the research papers.

This is absolutely fascinating! It’s clear the Soviets were conducting various experiments, but their objective remains elusive. I’ll need to dig deeper into this. I'm sure this discovery will be key to unlocking the secrets of this island!

Thank you so much. Once I've finished analyzing all the materials you brought back, you'll be the first one to know, don't worry!
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Gunny_Quest_49_Briefing: An LAF transport helicopter crashed in the swamps southeast of Fort Narith. Investigate the site, report your findings to Gunny, and await further instructions.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_24_Briefing: An informant reported suspicious enemy activity at a gas station east of Fort Narith. The location is believed to be used as a hideout and a supply depot. Investigate the site, verify the report, and secure any weapons or supplies found.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_3_VENDOR_: And while you’re there, try to access any old Soviet computers you can find. If data survived anywhere, it’ll be on those machines. Even fragments could point us in the right direction.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Artisan_05_Briefing: Artisan needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to her.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_06_Briefing: Banshee has a bad feeling about an upcoming meeting with a contact. Go in his place and meet them near the unstable bridge northwest of Nam Thaven.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_10_Briefing: Banshee needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_16_Briefing: Banshee wants to quietly interfere with drug production across Lamang. Disrupt the operation without drawing attention.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_22_Briefing: Banshee wants to trace the distribution of drugs across Lamang. Find the shipment at the marked site and plant a tracking device on it.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_23_AcceptMsg:
Building an informant network paid off quicker than I imagined, man. We've got a hot tip!

According to our local collaborator, he stumbled upon a hidden communications hub, similar to the one we've encountered near our Base Camp. And we definitely don't need any more assholes listening in on our comms, right?

I want you to check it out. The secluded house is northwest of the bridge that connects the main road from Nam Thaven to Fort Narith. You know the deal: investigate the building and sabotage any equipment that could be used against us. Now hurry up!
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Labrat_08_AcceptMsg:
Can you help me? I need your immediate assistance.

Someone has set up measuring stations northeast of Fort Narith, and it would be incredibly valuable if we could extract data from them. I don't know who did it, but it's clear they knew what they were doing. If you can transfer the data, we’ll gain a much deeper understanding of Ground Zero and the secrets hidden on this island.

Fortunately, I’ve secured the approximate locations of the stations. There are three in total.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_05_Debriefing: Can you smell that, friend? That's clean air, not reeking of the LLA lunatics' dirty stench. Thank you for your service to Lamang, friend. If I still-ahem, if I had the opportunity to give you a medal of honor, I would do so. But I suppose your reward is sufficient.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Objective_3_VENDOR_Objective: Check your tactical map. It should be marked.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Gunny_Quest_49_Objective_1_VENDOR_Object: Copy. If it’s sitting in the mud like that, anything sensitive would’ve been pulled fast. I want to know if the LLA managed to recover the cargo before the bird went under. Check the area around the crash and see what you can find. And watch yourself. That swamp’s probably crawling with those crazy bastards.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Objective_4_VENDOR_O: Dammit. Can’t at least one fucking thing work in our favor? You’ll have to make do. Move on and focus on our guys. From what we know, that place also served as a prison, so check any cells you find. If they’re still alive, they’ll be locked up in those.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_06_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objecti: Damn it. I was hoping I’d get the chance to get him out of the country.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Briefing: Deliver a package for Artisan to Ban Suk, a small village by the river. Retrieve it from your locker and place it inside a box near a house on the western outskirts of the village.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_4_Descrip: Disconnect the air filtration system in YBL-1
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_23_Objective_1_Description: Find the isolated house northwest of a bridge west of Nam Thaven and neutralize the equipment within
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Objective_4_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Objective_6_PLAYER_Objective: Fourth cache secured. Looks like we were lucky.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_05_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I need a quick favor from you.

I'm not sure if you've noticed, but I have some unfinished business with those ruffians from the LLA. You know me, I get along with everyone, but these troublemakers? They're a tough nut to crack. Unreasonable fanatics.

They’ve been making my life on the island a lot harder than it needs to be, and I’m not exactly thrilled about it. Just recently, thanks to their interference, I lost out on a major weapons deal… for some, let’s say, friends.

So here’s what I’m thinking: I know they’ve also been causing problems for both you and Mr. Handshake. I suggest reminding them that their worldview is not welcome here. Show them just how dangerous their twisted ideas really are, especially to themselves. Remove as many of them as you can, and I'll ensure you receive a fitting reward for your efforts.

Sounds good? Honestly, who in their right mind would pass on a chance to eliminate dangerous terrorists in the name of freedom? That’s what I thought. See you soon, friend.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_12_AcceptMsg:
Friend, I need your help with a troubling matter.

Don’t you just hate it when you wait at home all day for a package, only to find a paper slip in your mailbox claiming you were nowhere to be found? Infuriating, isn’t it? Well, something quite similar has happened to me, and I simply cannot afford to wait any longer.

Please, head out to Phon Chai Farm, east of Fort Narith and northwest of Nam Thaven, and have a look beneath one of the houses. Once you have the package, deliver it to a large empty jug at a shelter southeast of the farm.

I trust that neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night will keep you from swiftly fulfilling your postal duty… wouldn’t you agree?
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_18_AcceptMsg:
Friend, the moment I heard that you had clashed with the Lamang Liberation Army, I rushed to your aid as fast as I could. Know that I have a history with them, and I can guarantee you that these terrorists only understand violence.

Let me give you some advice: kill their leader, that damned old dog Lani Sayavong, and the rest of his thugs will piss themselves and flee in fear. And don't worry, I won't charge you for my help; in fact, I'll reward you if you decide to give the bastard what he deserves.

Eliminating the LLA leader would be a great favor not only to me, but also to all of Lamang.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Debriefing:
Fuck… I had people in that village. Families who thought keeping their heads down would be enough. And now this.

I still can’t believe the LLA is behind it. Even if they had a reason, they wouldn’t resort to something like that. Not a massacre. It has to be something else. Has to be...

I’ll make a few calls. Try to find out who, if anyone, would authorize that kind of “reorganization.” If this keeps happening... then what the fuck am I even doing?

Merc, I... never mind. You did your job. Now leave me alone.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_6_Descrip: Gather intel from the computers at YBL-1
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Objective_1_VENDOR_Objective: Glad to hear that. I'm marking the next one on your tactical map.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_06_Objective_1_Description: Go to the small bridge northwest of Nam Thaven to meet the contact
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Debriefing:
Goddamn animals! Just like I said, these so-called rebels are no different from the rest of the killers on this island. Maybe even worse. 

This whole mess could have been avoided. Sending people in to talk was wishful thinking. We're already understaffed, and we act like losing a few men is no big deal. Those deaths were absolutely unnecessary, and I am not letting it fucking slide.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_22_Debriefing: Good fucking work, my man. I bet those bastards stared at you like you were a goddamn apparition. The way you cleared out those shitheads helped us tremendously. They might come back, but I bet they’ll be shitting their pants and jumping at every shadow.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_10_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Objective_2_VENDOR_Objective: Good work. I've already marked it.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Objective_3_VENDOR_O: Good. Get inside and start by looking for the quickest escape route. There's supposed to be an underground passage somewhere in the compound that could make extraction a hell of a lot easier if you end up pulling them out.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_22_Debriefing: Good. Now we wait. Once someone comes to collect the shipment, we’ll have a front-row seat to wherever it goes. One delivery may not tell us much, but follow enough of them, and a network begins to take shape. Every trail has to lead somewhere.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_16_Debriefing:
Good. With any luck, they won’t realize what you’ve done until they try to get production running again. Faulty equipment, spoiled supplies, human error, an angry competitor... let them draw their own conclusions.

For now, we leave them to it. The less they understand, the more useful they remain.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_23_Debriefing: Great fucking job, man. You made sure these radio amateurs won't be overhearing shit from now on. I just hope this is the last of them.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_22_Briefing: Gunny needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_18_Debriefing: Ha ha ha! Friend, you are a wise and merciless man. I love it! The death of old Lani will strike fear into the hearts of the LLA assholes. Long have I waited for this moment. Sweet, sweet revenge. You have my gratitude.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_23_Briefing: Handshake has received reports from his informants about a potential communications hub. Investigate the site and neutralize the equipment.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_30_Briefing: Handshake needs to acquire certain items. Locate and deliver them to him.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_AcceptMsg:
Hey, can I ask for your help with something? It might be just what I need to finally get some more answers about what really happened here. Are you interested?

The more I learn about YBL-1, the more convinced I am that it was fitted with technology that goes far beyond standard military use, no matter how ancient it might look now. I have to say, it’s highly suspicious and very, very interesting. The Soviets wouldn’t need that many computers just to run a hole in the ground. Something else was happening down there. Mr. Pell - Handshake, doesn’t think we should allocate resources to investigate this matter, but I hold a different opinion.

Therefore, I would like you to head inside YBL-1 and uncover what the Soviets have been up to. Of course, it’s possible you won’t manage to retrieve anything of significance there, but I’m still hoping there’s at least something left that will help us get closer to the truth.

Start by looking for documents that could support my hypothesis. Anything that points to on-site research, experimental programs, or classified operations. Check the commander’s office first. Material like that would probably be kept there.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_30_AcceptMsg:
Hey, man. How's it hanging? I bet you wouldn't turn down an easy side gig, eh? I can tell you're interested.

I want you to look for a few specific items when you're out in the field. I have no clue where they are, so you’ll have to do a bit of digging, but I know you’ll manage, buddy. You're a pro, and a small detail like that is no obstacle for you.

If possible, proceed right away. The sooner this is done, the better. Just know that I have your reward on hand. Completely off the record, of course.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_06_Briefing: Hostile forces are disrupting Handshake's operations in the designated area. Conduct a rapid patrol of the marked locations where hostile activity has been observed, and eliminate any armed threats you encounter.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Gunny_Quest_49_Objective_2_VENDOR_Object: Huh, that's definitely not standard. Nobody moves equipment like that unless they’re expecting contamination. You know what? I’d bet my next paycheck that bird was heading toward Ground Zero.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_06_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objecti: I found a dead civilian near the shaky bridge. I assume he was the contact. He had nothing on him.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Subobjective_2b_PLAYER_: I found an LLA directive. It lays out how they “reorganize” villages. Draft the willing, pressure the hesitant, and publicly execute anyone who refuses.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Subobjective_5a_PLAY: I found one of the negotiators. He is dead. Tortured. Left in a cell covered in blood. Some of it looks decades old. This place has been used for a long time.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Subobjective_2a_PLAYER_: I found some dead civilians. It looks like they were executed by the LLA. Their propaganda is on full blast everywhere.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Gunny_Quest_49_Objective_2_PLAYER_Object: I found the cargo. Looks like the LLA pulled it from the helo and stashed it in one of the nearby houses. Multiple crates. No weapons. It’s all protective gear: hazmat suits, iodine pills, and Geiger counters.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Gunny_Quest_49_Objective_1_PLAYER_Object: I found the helo. It’s down in the swamp, mostly submerged. Looks like it took fire before going in. No sign of survivors.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Objective_4_PLAYER_O: I have located the passage. Bad news. It is buried under rubble. No way through.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Objective_3_PLAYER_Objective: I have the third cache. Where is the last one?
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Objective_3_PLAYER_O: I just found an alternate entrance to YBL-1.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_10_Debriefing:
I knew I could count on you. 

Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_3_VENDOR_: I knew it! No way they built a place like that for routine military work. If we can pull more physical data out of YBL-1, we might finally start understanding what happened here and why Lamang is the way it is now. I want you to bring me one of their air filters for analysis. So far, it looks like that facility is the only one here that could have trapped any hypothetical anomalous particles released during the Event into the surrounding environment.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Labrat_08_Debriefing: I knew my hunch was correct! Hopefully, we’ll be lucky and find more of these measuring stations, because the data I’ve managed to analyze so far is extraordinary. You have my thanks.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_30_Debriefing: I knew this would be a piece of cake for you. Enjoy your undocumented reward, amigo.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_6_PLAYER_: I located a cluster of old Soviet computer terminals deeper in the bunker. Most of them are dead, but one system still has removable storage. Looks like they were logging something regularly.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_06_AcceptMsg:
I need a swift situation assessment, now!

We’ve got multiple locations showing signs of hostile activity, and it’s screwing with our operations in the area. Your job is to go on patrol and neutralize any armed hicks you come across. I'll mark each point of interest on your tactical map. Check them fast, before those assholes get a chance to relocate.

I know you won’t let me down, man. Now, put on your walking shoes and get moving.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Labrat_Quest_36_PLAYER_BecameAvailableDi: I've located a small hut deep in the jungle. No one's home, but the place is covered in notes. Charts, formulas, pages full of scribbles… some of it looks scientific. Not sure what I’m looking at yet, but someone spent a lot of time here.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Objective_2_Description: Investigate Ban Suk and find out what happened
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Briefing: Investigate the YBL-1 bunker complex after two contractors sent to negotiate with the Lamang Liberation Army failed to report back. Locate an alternate entrance to the facility, search for the missing operatives, and determine what happened to them.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_23_AcceptMsg:
It appears that the LLA are preparing another major operation. Our scouts have spotted a group of rebels east of YBL-1, or The Hole, as people here call it. They've taken over a small, inconspicuous building and turned it into a covert outpost. We have been able to observe people - presumably rebels from other parts of the island - visiting this location on a regular basis, suggesting it's being used as a communication center.

Since they're not using radio communication, we can’t intercept their plans. That's why I need you to go to the outpost and gather any intel you can. We need to figure out what they're planning so we can counteract their moves. It's time to show them that murdering our colleagues comes with a heavy price. We’ll obliterate any attempt to expand their territory.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Briefing: It appears that the YBL-1 bunker complex is filled with technology far beyond the scope of standard military use. Investigate the complex and search for evidence of Soviet-era research. Recover any surviving records and report your findings to Lab Rat.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_22_AcceptMsg:
It has come to our attention that the local criminal trash are expanding into other areas, looting everything in their path. Normally, I wouldn’t care, but their complete disregard for basic societal rules might interfere with our mission here - and we can’t have that, can we?

Your job is to stop these motherfuckers and show them who’s in charge. No more freeloading. Head west of Nam Thaven and give these looters the justice they deserve.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Artisan_05_Debriefing: It took you longer than it should have, but whatever. You did your part. Here's your reward, merc.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_06_AcceptMsg:
I’m glad to see you. Could you lend me a hand once more?

I managed to convince one of the remaining civilians here to gather any documents that might support my case against the Lamangese government. Most of what he brought me were routine papers from local authorities, nothing of real interest. However, the last time we spoke, he sounded unusually excited. He claimed he had stumbled upon something significant and needed to show it to me immediately.

We agreed to meet near a small, unstable bridge northwest of Nam Thaven, but something didn’t sit right with me. I trust my instincts; they’ve saved me more than once.

I want you to go in my place and retrieve the documents from him. I mean, things could go south, and you have more combat experience.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_16_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been keeping an eye on the drug trade here. It seems some of the old production sites are still operational. Different people running them, same poison coming out.

I want you to pay one of them a visit. The location is marked on your map. Find where they’re producing the drugs and sabotage the operation. But be subtle about it. The drugs stay, the equipment stays. I don’t want anyone realizing what was actually targeted. The rest is up to you.

The longer they remain unaware of us, the more useful they’ll be.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_22_AcceptMsg:
I’ve been looking into how drugs are moving across Lamang. We know where some of them are coming from, but where they go from there... that’s another matter. I’d like to find out.

There’s a site marked on your map. Find a shipment waiting there and plant a GPS tracker on it. Don’t take anything and don’t tamper with the product. I need that shipment to continue on its way. Sooner or later, someone will come to collect it. And when they do, we’ll see where it takes us.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_3_PLAYER_: I’ve found research papers in the commander’s office. From what I understood, the Soviets were really conducting some top-secret research at YBL-1. Something called "Project Distant Voice."
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_AcceptMsg:
I’ve got a job for you, and I need it done fast. Got it?

Back when we still held some ground on this rock, we stashed a few ammo caches around for quick field resupplies. Now, with the situation being what it is, we need to find out if they’re still intact, and if so, recover them.

Your task is to check a few of these locations and report back whether the caches are still there and retrievable. I’ll send someone else to pick them up, don’t worry about that. I just need the intel.

There are four caches in total. I've marked the first one on your tactical map. Take care of it, and I’ll relay the rest to you as you go.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Objective_1_PLAYER_Objective: I’ve located the first cache. Everything seems to be in order.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Subobjective_5b_PLAY: I’ve located the negotiator - KIA. His body shows signs of torture.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Labrat_08_Briefing: Lab Rat is interested in measuring stations set up by an unknown actor across Lamang. Locate them and transmit the collected data for analysis.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_22_AcceptMsg:
Let's cut to the chase. I don't have time for long talks.

I need you to look for a few specific items. Reconnaissance teams were unable to narrow down the exact location where to look for them, so you'll have to sniff them out. You're not a rookie, so you'll pull it off.

Any questions? If not, then off to work. I have to keep Base Camp afloat.

ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_12_Debriefing: Marvelous! You truly have a gift for reliability. And discretion, of course. Please accept this token of my gratitude. Until we see each other again, friend.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_AcceptMsg:
Merc, rejoice. I’ve got a menial task for you that you cannot possibly fuck up.

I had a package sent to your locker. Pick it up and deliver it to a house on the western outskirts of Ban Suk, a small village by the river. And whatever you do, do not just waltz into the village itself. I have friends there, and I don’t want you to “accidentally” shoot them, since that seems to be your first response whenever you see anyone who isn’t one of your fucking buddies.

Once you’re done, report back to me. Now off you go, delivery boy.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: Merc, stay put for a minute and carefully observe the village itself. Don’t start anything unless you have to. Just check if everything’s alright and let me know, ok?
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Artisan_05_AcceptMsg:
Merc, why am I not surprised to see you wasting time on your device again? Let me guess, some crappy gacha game, or porn? Figures. Typical mercenary shit. Anyway, I’ve got a job for you.

I need you to look for a few specific items when you're out in the field. There is no particular place to pinpoint, so you’ll have to do a bit of searching, but I'm sure you’ll manage.

Now, stop doomscrolling and get to work, hireling!
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_22_Objective_1_Description: Neutralize the enemies west of Nam Thaven
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_6_VENDOR_: Ohhh, that’s exactly what I was hoping for. If there’s anything left from their experiments, that’s where it’ll be hiding. See if you can extract whatever media they were using. Even corrupted data could be priceless.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Objective_1_PLAYER_Obje: Package delivered. I left it at the building you marked. One thing though. The place is covered in giant LLA graffiti.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Vulture_04_AcceptMsg:
Parasites! Maggots! This… bloated corpse of a country is… swarming with them. Old production lines in… disarray. Some are still guarded, others… taken over by those… leeches. I need to… familiarize myself with what’s on… offer. A new day breeds new… opportunities. You will help me with this.

Search the place marked on your map. Bring back a… sample. I will study it… thoroughly. Then I can decide if it’s time for a… hostile… takeover.

ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_03_Briefing: Several previously established ammo caches may still be intact. Check the marked locations, confirm their status, and report to Gunny on whether the supplies are recoverable. Additional cache locations will be provided as you proceed.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Subobjective_5b_VEND: Shit! I knew this was a bad idea from the start. That's another one we won't be bringing home.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_24_Debriefing: So, the information was correct. Good job disrupting their plans. Whatever they were up to, I can tell you it wasn’t in our favor. And as a bonus, we got some much-needed supplies from the gas station. Two birds with one stone.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Subobjective_5a_VEND: Son of a bitch. These maniacs are not interested in talking. From my experience, fanatics like that only understand one thing. And we'll give them plenty of it.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_12_Objective_1_Description: Store the package inside an empty jug at a shelter southeast of the farm
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Objective_1_Description: Take the package from your locker and deliver it to a box by a house on the western outskirts of Ban Suk
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Banshee_06_Debriefing:
Thank you! Although it ended tragically, I am grateful for your efforts to assist me.

Perhaps one day we’ll learn whether he truly had an important document with him, or if he was killed by those who were waiting for me and believed he had betrayed them.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Objective_1_VENDOR_Obje: That's odd. They usually don’t bother advertising like that unless they’ve just rolled through somewhere. Doesn’t necessarily mean trouble, but...
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Subobjective_2b_VENDOR_: That's... impossible. I’ve seen their political materials before. They talk about freedom, choice, and protecting people. This is like some fanatic wrote it. That’s not what they claim to stand for.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_06_Debriefing: That’s what I like to see! The area’s clear, for now. Good work, man. Here’s a little something for all that walking and killing.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_05_Briefing: The LLA from YBL-1 is disrupting Turncoat’s operations. Sweep around the area and eliminate them.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Handshake_22_Briefing: The hostile elements west of Nam Thaven are causing operational setbacks. Eliminate them.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_23_Debriefing: This looks promising. Good work. It seems like the rebels are indeed gearing up for huge op on the island's east side. We’ll decode what we can from the intel. In the meantime, take a well-deserved rest and enjoy your reward. You’ve earned it.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Labrat_Quest_36_Debriefing:
This... this is huge! There's so much in here. Charts, corrections, entire sections in shorthand that I’ll need to decode properly...

It’s too early to say anything for certain, but this might be one of the most important pieces of pre-Event data we’ve ever come across on this island. Whoever this was, they were an expert in their field, and they were tracking something, but as the entries progress, the tone shifts. Disjointed thoughts, repetition, obsession. It’s clear their mind was starting to slip.

Give me some time to go through it all. Carefully. If what I think is in here is in here… well, we may need to rethink everything.

ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Turncoat_12_Briefing: Turncoat needs a favor, as there's something he desperately wants to possess. Locate the item he seeks and store it at the designated location.

ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Gunny_Quest_49_AcceptMsg:
We picked up reports of an LAF transport helo going down in the swamps not far from Fort Narith. Looks like it was brought down from the ground, most likely by the Lamang Liberation Army. Beyond that, we don’t know much.

Head to its last known position and assess the situation. I want to know what condition the bird is in and what the area looks like now.

Once you’ve got eyes on it, report back. We’ll take it from there.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_AcceptMsg:
We've got a big problem. Our enlightened head operator sent two of our boys to negotiate a cease-fire with the rebels occupying the YBL-1 bunker, and guess what happened? They didn't return and we lost contact with them. I told that wise ass it was a bad idea to send them there, but he insisted the risk was worth the potential reward. Fucking bullshit!

I know exactly what kind of people these so-called freedom fighters are. They are ruthless brutes and hardline extremists. To them, we're just intruders who have invaded their land, no better than the corrupt Lamang army. All the negotiation nonsense was doomed from the start.

Head to the bunker, find out what happened to our men, and bring them back if possible. I hope it's not too late. Start by scouting the perimeter and locating another way inside before you push deeper. You don't want to just waltz in through the main gate, do you? I'll relay more info once you get in. Be careful, but do not hesitate. It's time to end this farce and do what we do best.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Gunny_Quest_01_Objective_5_VENDOR_O: We’ll get them for this, but for now, get the hell out of there. We can’t afford any more casualties.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_24_AcceptMsg:
We’ve received a tip about suspicious activity from an organized enemy group. On the main road to Nam Thaven, east of Fort Narith, there is a gas station that our sources say has been captured and is being used as their hideout.

They’re stockpiling a large amount of weapons and supplies for something big. Your mission is to verify the informant’s report and secure their arsenal.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Gunny_Quest_49_Debriefing:
What rubs me the wrong way is this: if I’m right, it means the LAF, or someone in cahoots with them, is conducting operations inside Ground Zero while we’re still blindly stumbling around it. Could it be those bastards who attacked us? And how the hell did they get there before we did?

I’ll pass everything you found on to Lab Rat. If anyone can make sense of this, it’s her. As far as I’m concerned, Ground Zero is still a giant question mark.

Be that as it may, you did good.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Labrat_Quest_36_AcceptMsg:
What you just found is absolutely amazing! From what you’ve described, somebody was working on something important. Years, maybe even decades of research!

Sure, there’s always a chance it’s just the ravings of some jungle lunatic, but I don’t believe that. I think you just stumbled onto a treasure trove of information that might help us understand what exactly happened here.

Let me explain. Based on my research into Lamang’s history, they were very friendly with the Soviets back in the ‘70s. Apparently, they let them construct some kind of installation here. Details are scarce, but it had something to do with high-powered signal interception. When the Soviet Union collapsed, the whole thing was shut down, and all the scientists left the island.

But what if one of them stayed? And what if you just found his hiding spot?

You need to search that place thoroughly before Handshake finds out and ships everything off to some company lab in the middle of nowhere. Don’t just strip the entire place clean; look for whatever seems most important. My guess is it'll be stored somewhere secure. Probably locked. But I know you’ll figure it out.

Please, this could tremendously help my research. Can I count on you?
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Artisan_Quest_30_Subobjective_2a_VENDOR_: What? No. That can't be right. That's not how they operate. If civilians were killed, then either someone went rogue, or someone else staged it to look like them. You don't know what you're talking about, merc!
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.CT_Gunny_22_Debriefing: You did well. Here is your reward.
ST_Quests_YBL1Region.Epic_Labrat_Quest_01_Objective_3_VENDOR_: You might need to shut down the filtration system before removing the filter, so be sure to disconnect it properly to avoid causing any damage.

When you're out in the field, I need you to look for a few specific items. It's an oversight on my part, but I couldn't ascertain the exact location of where to find them. However, I have no doubt you'll be able to acquire them nontheless.

Please, I know you have a lot of other work, but I suspect you want to uncover the truth as much as I do. Assisting me with this will set us on the right path. Trust me. I'm counting on you!

ST_RTT_Solo.CT_Turncoat_15_AcceptMsg:
Friend, it's an immense pleasure to see you again! Have you lost weight, by any chance? You look in excellent shape! Ha ha! Listen, it saddens me to pester you again, but could you do me a favour?

Would you be so kind as to look for a few particular items for me while you're out in the wilderness? Alas, I am unable to determine the precise location of the items, so you will need to search for them. However, I have complete faith in your abilities. You have demonstrated on multiple occasions that you can masterfully improvise when required.

Rest assured, friend, I have prepared a marvellous reward for you. The sooner you finish, the sooner you can enjoy the fruits of your labor!
ST_RTT_Solo.CT_Banshee_02_AcceptMsg:
Good to see you. I would appreciate your cooperation if it's not too much trouble at the moment.

It would be invaluable if you could look for a few specific items while you're out in the field. Unfortunately, I'm not familiar with where to find them, so you'll need to do some detective work. Nevertheless, considering your experience, locating them shouldn't be a problem. I know how determined you are to finish your tasks.

I understand it might not seem like this will deliver justice to this country, but have faith in my methods. The law works in mysterious ways.
